cells.remarks: States that owing to the loss of jōya lands by Kṛishṇadēva-Rāya, the Muppāyavāḍa officer of Narasimha-rāya, many temples became neglected, and that Kṛishṇa-dēvarāya, on the occasion of his accession to the throne, made an oral donation (tāmbūla-śāsana) that such lands as those belonging to the Jaina and Buddhist temples in Paḍavīḍu-rājya, and Chandragiri-rājya, by which the Jaina temple Vīrarājēndra-perumpaḷḷi at Karaṇḍai was also bene-fited.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pedestal with marks of two feet out in relief, set up near the gōpura of Dharmadēvī. †
cells.remarks: An invocation for the undying fame of Samantabhadra, the sun to the lotus heart (i.e., teacher) of Pushpasēna-yōgīndra. In characters of the 16th century A.D.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAR TALUK · Tiruppurambur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the ruined Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Has a portion of the historical introduction com-mencing with the words Tirumagalpāḍa, etc. Seems to record gift of sheep.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records a gift of two lamps by Ālavandān, son of Sevvi, a Veḷḷāḷa residing at Piḷḷaippākkam, to the temple of Āḷuḍaiyār Tiruvīrāmēśvaram-Uḍaiyār at Tiruppuram-būr.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAR TALUK · Tiruppurambur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Built in the middle. Begins with the introduction Tiru-maṇṇi vaḷara, etc. Seems to record an agreement given by the ūrār of Parambūr to measure out a specified quantity of paddy in the temple money for the gift of a certain Paḍaikkili by Ravi of the village. On the back of this inscription is a record of two lines stating that a certain Ōttūr Śivan set up a pāda-pīṭha for Mahādēva.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAR TALUK · Tiruppurambur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.date: Śaka 1482, Raudri, Tulā, śu. 10, Monday, Anusham. Irregular. The details correspond to A. D. 1560, October 28, Monday, '17; The nakshatra on that day was Sadayam and not Anusham. [from date-calculation appendix, No. 149]
cells.remarks: Records a gift of two cows for a twilight lamp in the temple and of a vessel by the headman of Pārimangalam.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAR TALUK · Tiruppurambur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Stops with the date of the king and mentions Parambūr (hamlet) of Tirukkāmakkōṭṭ(apuram).

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / CHEVYAR TALUK—contd. / Tiruppaṇamūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Begins with the introduction Tirumagalpōla, etc., of Rājārāja I. Records a gift of sheep for a lamp in the temple of Mahādēva at Parambūr by a certain Ūrār Nakkaṇ.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / CHEVYAR TALUK—contd. / Tiruppaṇamūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to record an endowment of land. Another fragmentary inscription close by assignable to about the 9th century A.D. records the construction of the mukha-maṇḍapa in the temple by a merchant.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of Śiva temple †
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Seems to record a gift of land to the temple of Tiruvīrāmēśvaram-Uḍaiyār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Commences with the introduction Tirumagaļpōla, etc. Seems to record an endowment for lamps to the parivāradēvas such as Gaṇapati, Sapta-mātrikas, Subrahmanya, Tirukkēṭtaikki]atti-Bhaṭāri, i.e., Jyēshṭhādēvi, Durgā Chanḍēvāra and Kshētrapāla, in the tiruvuṇvāligai of the temple of Ūrāṇi-Nakkar at Paṛambūr in Šrikāmakkōṭṭapuram.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / CHEVYAR TALUK—contd. / Tiruppaṇamūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Stones lost in the middle. Begins with the introduction Tirumagaļpōla, etc. States that the officer, Šēnāpati Rājarāja-Mārāyar, made arrangements for burning lamps before the goddess Mukkarai-Nangai at Tiruppaṛambūr, including those endowed previously and in the 25th year of Kaṇṇaradēva.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK · Ukkal — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the central shrine, Vaidyanāthasvāmin temple.
cells.remarks: Records an order of Kulāśēkhara Śambuvāraya remitting certain specified taxes due from the tiramāḍaiyāḷam of the temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North and west walls of Vaidyanāthasvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: Records a remission of taxes due from Paḷampattu including Aṭṭipparru, by the chief, to provide for offerings, worship, lamps, etc., to the temple of Tirukkōyiluḍaiyār-Nāya-ṇār at Ukkal.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Vaidyanāthasvāmin temple †
cells.king: Parākēsarivarman alias Rājēndra-Chōḷadēva who took Gaṅgai and Kiḍāram.
cells.remarks: States that this stone temple was constructed by the officer Kumārakāḷ Vāsudēvan alias Aṭiśayāḷa-Mūvēndavēḷār of Ukkal.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.king: Parākēsarivarman alias Rājēndra-Chōḷadēva who took Gaṅgai and Kiḍāram.
cells.remarks: Records the same fact as the above.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the same shrine
cells.remarks: Damaged; Records a sale of 20,000 kuḻi of land, free of taxes to the temple of [Madhurāntaka-]Ḷivaṇudaiyār by the sabhā of Vikramābharaṇa-chaturvēdimangalam. Mentions a channel called Parākramachōḷa-vāyykkāl.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Vaidyanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Beginning of lines built in. Damaged. Seems to record a sale of house-site to the temple at Utkal in Pūgūr-nāḍu in Kāliyūrkōṭṭam.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North and east walls of Vaidyanāthasvāmin temple †
cells.date: 26]th year, Šaka 1284, Šubhakrit, Mēsha; šu. 4, Wednesday, Rōhiņf.
cells.remarks: Records sale of the village Pēdārikāgal by the assembly of Ukkal alias Vikramābharaṇa-chaturvēdimangalam to Pāgūr-nāḍu to two persons for 200 Vīrachampan-kaḻañju to provide funds for running the theatre in the tank to the south of the village, which had been in disrepair for a long time.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stono built into the east wall of Vaidyanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record gift of land as tiruvilāppuram by the king for conducting a sevən-day festival every year in the temple. Mentions Vikramābharaṇa-chaturvēdi-mangalam.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another stone built into the wall of Vaidyanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record some provision made for the temple and ghee every day to the temple of Peruttirukōyil-Mahādēva.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: A third stone built into the wall of Vaidyanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 10th century A.D. Incomplete. Seems to record an endowment of land to the temple by a merchant of the village named Marudampāk-kīļān Uriyāṇi.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Three stones built into the wall of Vaidyanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record a sale of land by the Mahāsabhā of Vikramābharaṇa-chaturvēdimangalam to 'Vīraśēkharinda-Kaikkōlar' for betel endowed to the temple. Two other fragments in slightly later characters found on the same wall record an endowment of land for providing offerings during the last service of the day in the temple of Perumtirukōyil-porumaṇadigal, by a number of persons.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillar in Vaidyanāthasvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: States that this pillar is the gift of Aiyānyāṇan, son of Aramajattar, a Kaikkōļa of the temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Lintel of Vaidyanāthasvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: States that this maṇḍapa was constructed by Vīrapperumāl Ālappirandān alias Rājarāja-Śambuvarāyan.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab in Vaidyanāthasvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: Modern. States that the Sthapana-maṇḍapa, in front of the central shrine and the Nichchhiyār-maṇḍapa were the gift of Timmarasar of Pāndyanallūr.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Base of the maṇḍapa of the Amman shrine in Vaidyanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to mention some regulation of taxes regarding the colonisation of temple land by agent of Bommu-Nāyaka. Mentions Koppu-Nāyaka and Pāppa- Nāyaka, probably the grand-father and father of Bommu- Nāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK · Māmandūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Brow of a natural cavern on the hill.
cells.remarks: Seems to record that this cavern was the gift of a certain chief (name lost) who captured Torūr and was the work of a mason (?) called Chāļaiyan.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEVYAR TALUK · Narasamaāgalam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the Šiva temple.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions the four nambis who acted as priests in the temple of Aruļāļa-Perumāl at Tiruvatiyūr.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / CHEYYAB TALUK—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Kūljamanđal.—West and south walls of the central shrine in the ruined Šiva temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1451, Vibhava (Virodhi), Mithuna, ba. 10, Monday, Āttan (Hasta).
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to record the sale of the tenancy right over two villages called Éjāyirachchēri and Kurukambichchēri belonging to Ukkal alias Vikramābharaga-chaturvēdimangalam in Kāliyūr-Pākka-nāđu, a subdivision of Jayangođađóla-manđalam by their four joint owners Širāmap Baṭtar Periyanādar Piljai, Širunādar Piljai, Kēćavabaṭtar Achchā Piljai and Gangaiyāđi Nārāyaṇa Piljai, to certain Mudaliyārs residing at Šannaiviljāgam, in specified proportion.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK · Tippasamudram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone called ‘Śīnak-kal’ set up in the village.
cells.date: Śaka 1497, Yuva, Makara, ba. trayōdaśī, Wednesday.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the village Valjivinātamāgalain alias Tippasamudram by China Bommu-Nayaka of Vēlūr with the permission of Krishnappa-Nāyaka and Śrīngādēva-Mahārāya, to the temple of Jvaraharatēva-svāmi at Vēlūr. The other face of the stone contains in relief figures of a śūla, sun and moon.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up on the bund of the lake
cells.remarks: Records that Prithivirāj-angariyar and his wife Ildāyapperuñ-dēviyār constructed the tank and the bank of their daughter Ayyakkutti, a channel, called Vīlupparaiyan, from the river to the tank at Valivallakkamangalam.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK · Vīrichchipuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the central shrine in the Mārgaśāhyēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Records gift of land by Ātkovandānli Eppōdumininyān, the headman of Valivalam after purchase from Pūjjayār Edirilī-śōja-Sambuvarāyar for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Uḍaiyār Valijutnall-Nāyanār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Stops after giving the date.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK · Vīrichchipuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.date: Šaka 1239, 21st year (in words), Māđi, 6u.13, Sunday, Rēvati.
cells.remarks: Damaged at the end. Seems to register remission of a number of taxes due from the temple to Kongarāya-Sambuva-rāyan in favour of Vajjitunai-Nāyanār at Tiruviñchchuram.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK · Vīrichchipuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record an order of Kalattikhāra-Śambu-varāyar to the ūrar of the village Uligai making a gift of some taxes due from them, to the temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK · Vīrichchipuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of cows by Ārāyumperumāl, wife of Rājagambhīra-Śambuvarāyar, for perpetual lamp in the temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of the central shrine in Mārgaśāhyēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Records an order of Sambuvarāya similar to that registered in No. 178 above, to the ūrurar of Murungaiyūr, to meet the expenses of the festival called 'Aṇḍalivarāyar-tirunāl'.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.date:
Śaka 1165 (in words), 28th year, Karkaṭaka 16, Monday, Rōhiṇī. [date-calculation appendix, No. 181: CHÕLA.
Tribhuvanachakravartin Rājarājadeva III.
Śaka 1165 (in words), 28th year, Karkataka 16, Monday, Rohiņi
= A. D. 1243, July 13, Monday ; 58. The solar date was 17
not 16.]
cells.remarks: Records a gift of the village Tiruviruñchuram as dēvadāna with all its taxes to the temple of Vaḻittuṇai-Nāyaṉār by Śeṅgēṇi Vīrāśaṇi Ammaiappaṉ Aḻagiyaśōḻaṉ Paḷavāyudavallavaṉ Taṉivāśikāṭṭit-taṉiniṉṟu-veṉṟa Ediriliśōḻa-Śambuvarāyaṉ.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK · Vīrichchipuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Ends of lines built in. Records gift of 32 Gaṇḍagōpālaṉ puḍumāḍai by a certain Kumaraṉ Śaṅkaraṉ for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Mārgaśāhyēśvara temple †
cells.date: Śaka 1[2*]28, . . . [Ku]mbha, śu.. . Sunday, . . [date-calculation appendix, No. 183: Śaka 1436, Yuva, Makara śu. 10, Monday, Tiruvōṇam. Irregular: The Śaka year is probably a mistake for 1437 in which case the other details correspond to A. D. 1516, January 14, Monday: But the nak. on that day was Kṛittikā 12.]
cells.remarks: Built in by a wall in the middle. Seems to record a tax-free gift of the village Ārani in Murugamaṅgalap-paṟṟu to the god by Vīrachampaṉ Ediriliśōḻa-Śambuvarāyaṉ.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.date: Śaka 1147, 10th year (in words), Karkaṭaka 8, Friday, trayōdaśī, Mṛigaśīrsha. [date-calculation appendix, No. 184: Śaka 1147, 10th year (in words), Karkataka 8, Fridday trayodaśī, Mrigaśīrsha= A. D. 1225, July 4, Friday ; f. d. t. .518 ; .54.]
cells.remarks: Damaged at the end. Records that the donor mentioned in No. 181 above renovated the temple with stone, repaired the Śrīvimāna and the gōpura, put up a compound wall called Aḻagiyaśōḻaṉ and that he constructed a car and also presented certain utensils to the temple of Vaḻittuṇai-Nāyaṉār of Iruñchuram.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Mārgaśāhyēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Three verses in praise of the sword of the king called here Vīra-Chōḷa.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records gift of 32 kāśu by Śeyyaperumāḷ alias Villavarāyaṉ for a perpetual lamp in the temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of Mārgaśāhyēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Damaged in the middle. Seems to record a gift of land by the nāṭṭavar of Śeruvāḷai for a perpetual lamp in the temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of land by Vīrāśaṇi Ammaiappaṉ Aḻagiyaśōḻa-Śambuvarāyaṉ for a perpetual lamp in the temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK · Vīrichchipuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.date: Śaka 1227 (in words), Mīna 2, .. Friday, .. and 2nd year (in words).
cells.remarks: Damaged at the end. Seems to record grant of certain specified taxes from the village Koṟṟamaṅgalam in Karaivaḻi Āṇḍi-nāḍu, in Paṅgaḷa-nāḍu, a subdivision of Paḍuvūr-kōṭṭam, by Vīrachampaṉ alias Ediriliśōḻa-Śambuvarāyaṉ.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of Mārgaśāhyēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Seems to record an agreement given by the tiruvuṇṇāḻigai-sabhā of the temple for some endowment left in their charge. Another inscription of three lines above this is erased and only the date, Śaka 1229, is clear.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the mahā-maṇḍapa in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Stops unfinished after the date portion.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the same maṇḍapa
cells.remarks: Records that the nṛitta-maṇḍapa in the temple of Vaḻittuṇai-Nāyiṉār at Iruñchuram in the northern division of Paṅgaḷa-nāḍu, a subdivision of Puliyūr-kōṭṭam in Jayaṅgoṇḍaśōḷa-maṇḍalam, was constructed by Oṭṭuvār-Nāyaṉ alias Ilaṅgēśuradēvaṉ, son of Nambāṭṭāḷ of Aḻagiyaśīyanallūr, a palace maid-servant (agampaḍip-peṇḍu) of Pallavāṇḍār alias Ediriliśōḻa-Śambuvarāya.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / CHEYYAB TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.date:
Śaka 1349, Plavaṅga, Mārgaḷi, 18 Monday, Viśākhā, dvādaśī.
The details correspond to A. D. 1427, December 15, Monday; but the nakshatra Viśākhā ended at ·94, the previous day, i.e. Sunday. [from date-calculation appendix, No. 193]
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 13th century A.D. Records the imposition among themselves of the magamai tax on articles of merchandise at certain specified rates, in favour of the god Vaḻittuṇai-Nāyaṉār 'who changed green-gram into pepper', by the 'merchants of the 18 countries trading in the four directions.'

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / VELLORE TALUK—contd. / Viriñchipuram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Records the grant of the hereditary right of Ariya-kaḻani by the trustee of the temple to Poruṇikkal Nāyaṉār, an ārya of Śāṇḍilya-gōtra and Bōdhāyana-sūtra [and a native of Rājamēndrapuri].

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of Mārgaśāhyēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Records sale of Poṇṇēri, the temple village, with all its income in taxes as kāśu-paṟu, by the bhaṇḍārattār of the temple and Nāgarasayyan to Timmappayyar, son of Śaṅkaradēva, a Kannaḍya-Brāhmaṇa of Rāmakuppam in Muḷvay-rājyam.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the second prākāra in Mārgaśāhyēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records grant of land and house-site by the trustees of the temple of Valittunai-Nāyaṇār at Tiruviriñchipuram to Arippālidēva of Perumbarrappuliyūr for the consideration of a tūni of paddy every day and 20 panam per year to be paid by him to the temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the prākāra of Mārgaśāhyēśvara †
cells.remarks: States that the grant made by the temple to Ārippāḷi-Ārippāḷi-dēva (see the number above) should also be extended to god Varadarāja on the same terms.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to the destruction of a channel by floods in the river and to the digging of a tank and a channel in the limits of the village Vēppūr. Registers re-gift of 1500 kuji of land presented for that purpose by the ūrār to Araśar Viṭṭappar, in return for which the authorities (bhandāratār) of the temple agreed to maintain three lamps before the god.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of same prākāra
cells.remarks: Purports to be an order of the god granting 7½ vēli of land and house-sites for adhyayana to the Uttrām-bhaṭṭas (Rudra-bhaṭṭas) under the lake Okkaṇāṉ-ēri instead of Śivan-agaram alias Umāpati-chaturvēdimangalam as the latter proved unsuitable for their living.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall -
cells.date: Śaka 1324, Chitra-bhānu, Kumbha, śu. 5, Sunday, Āśvati.
cells.remarks: Purports to be an order of Chandēśvara-Nāyinār ratifying the grant of 3 vēli of land under the tank at Paśumāttūr alias Maratakavallinallūr belonging to the god Valittunai-Nāyaṇār, and a house-site in the Šeyyārruvenrāṇ-tiruvidi at Tiruviriñchipuram by the ūravar to Tiruvājiyamuđaiyār, a maṭhapati-māhēśvara of the place, for a maṭha and for feeding therein five Māhēśvaras daily, in consideration of his efforts in having the tank dug.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the prākāra of Mārgaśāhyēśvara †
cells.remarks: Portions left unengraved in the middle. Seems to record gift of cows to the temple, by Amarakōn alias Periyaku, a shepherd of Tiruvalam.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the grant of the hereditary right of tirumāndavia-kkuḍi for the maintenance of a perpetual lamp in the temple, to Varuṭa-kōn, a shepherd of sēvavūr alias Pāḍi.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / VELLORE TALUK—contd. / Viriñchipuram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records a similar assignment, by Dēvarāyal-Perumal Vayirava-Nāyanar, of the tirumāndavai-kuḍi right of the temple of Valitunai-Nāyanar, to the sons of the shepherd Āriyankōn.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two stones found in the third prākāra of Mārgaśāhyēśvara temple, now kept in the first prākāra. †
cells.remarks: One of the pieces seems to record a gift of land as tirumāḍa-viļāgam, to the temple of Adiyaramanalluyar. The other mentions a vaittiya-bhāga.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another stone removed to the place of Mārgaśāhyēśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to a cattle raid and records the death of a warrior who died holding a cow. The inscription is cut in relief on the stone. This inscription is , where, however, only the two lines are given.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Third stone in the place of Mārgaśāhyēśvara †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions Vēlavīdu. , where only the first two lines are given. Seems to record a royal order to the Nagarattār of Sēruvālai-ma[galan] making a sarvaparihāra gift.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Fourth stone set up in the place of Mārgaśāhyēśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Kalaṇīppā[kka]m in Meyyāru-nādu and refers to a [ka]mādu evidently erected in memory of the hero, who is represented in relief near the inscription with a bow and arrow in his hands. First two lines of the inscription are .

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Fifth stone set up in the place of Mārgaśāhyēśvara †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Tiramagal-jiruvalar etc. Records a gift of land by Tiruppālaiyāṇḍan Appan Kaṅkākam alias Sōjakulānta-ka-Mūlāriyappallaran, after purchase from the assembly (ūr) of Gaugasigantāndapuram in Miyarai-nādu, a subdivision of Adhirājēndra-vaḷanādu in Jayangoṇḍasōla-maṇḍalam, for worship and flower to the temple of Durgā in the same village. Also for worship in the temple of Durgā in the village. The earlier portion of this inscription is .

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Hero stone set up in the place of Mārgaśāhyēśvara †
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Seems to refer to the grant of a kōmaḍu to the hero represented, by the side of the inscription, with a bow and a dagger in his hands. The characters are of about the 10th century A.D.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Inner side of the gōpura at the entrance to same prākāra.
cells.remarks: Stops misplaced and portions erased. Records the remission of the taxes such as jōdi and iļāvuāri by the king for providing offerings and worship in the temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Wall of the Kalyāṇa-maṇḍapa on the north side of the 3rd prākāra.
cells.remarks: Records the completion of the Vasanta-maṇḍapa which was the gift of Lingama-Nāyaka, son of Bomma-Nāyaka of Vēlūr.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT—concld. / VELLORE TALUK—concld. / Virifichipuram—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of the front gopura in Mārgaśāhyēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Records an order of Mahāmaṇḍaleśvara Jillella Obuladeva to his pātraṇpatyam officer Periya Kēsava-Nāyaka fixing the rates of taxes on specified professions, made over to the temple, from Viñcīpuram, with the bank of the Pālāru in Karavaiji nāḍu, an subdivision of Peluvi-nāḍu in Jayagoṇḍaśōḷa-maṇḍalam, for the merit of Krishṇama-rājaṅgaṇ.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up in front of the Soundarēśvara shrine in the west Mâda street.
cells.date:
Kali 4994, Nandana, Chaitrai 5. [date-calculation appendix, No. 213: Śaka 1414, Paridhāvi, Rishabha, śu. 1, Rōhiṇī, Friday
=A.D. 1492, April 27, Friday, ·68; f.d.n. ·54.]
cells.remarks: States that Mahākāvēndra-Sarasvatīsvāmi of the spiritual lineage of Upanishad-Brahmēndra-Sarasvati of Kāñchīpuram, repaired the Miṇākshi-Sundarēśvara temple constructed by Appaya-Dīkshita at Viriñchipuram with the help of Rāja-Dharmam bāhugginga family of the latter and others, celebrated the samprōkshana and provided for the worship and offerings of the god therein.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in the south Mâda street
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions the goddess Mârakatavalli at Tiru-viṟañjupuram and Sadāśiva-Udaiyār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VELLORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in the north Mâda street
cells.remarks: Mentions Jada -Râmhappanyāniāru and seems to record a grant of land to a matha. In characters of about the 18th century A.D.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / GUDIYATTAM TALUK · GUDIYATTAM TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pogaļūr.—Rock to the north of the village.
cells.remarks: Records a grant of land as sarvamānya to Paḍalachōhar by Ilaiyappa-Nāyaka, the agent of Kāttāranar for having dug a tank & sluice at Pugalūr. In characters of about the 16th century A.D.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / GUDIYATTAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another rock in the place of Soundarēśvara †
cells.remarks: Records the same order of Ilaiyappa-Nāyaka probably left incomplete.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / GINGEE TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT. / GINGEE TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Gingee (šeĵji).—Rock near the magazine in the Rājagiri hill.
cells.remarks: The writing seems to be a peculiar mixture of northern and southern varieties of the script and may be assigned to about the 10th century A.D. Mentions Narasimha-nṛipa as the donor of some village.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / GINGEE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the Veṅkaṭaramaṇa temple
cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions Singapura in Sāḍipappattu, a subdivision of Siṅgapura-nāḍu.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / GINGEE TALUK · Tiruvaddikkunram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock on the hill
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Records a royal order issued to the tängattär of the temple at Tiruvērkkuru remitting certain specified taxes on the lands belonging to the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / GINGEE TALUK · Kadali — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Lamp-post set up near the tomb of Mohabat Khan.
cells.date:
Śaka 1352, Mīṇa, ba. 10, Friday, Uttirādam
=A. D. 1431, March 9, Friday, ·39; ·21. [from date-calculation appendix, No. 221]
cells.remarks: Indistinct.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / GINGEE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock by the side of the road to Valatti
cells.remarks: States that (the site where this inscription is found) is the dēvadāna land belonging to Tiruttangūramudaiya-Nayinār at Malaiyanur.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / GINGEE TALUK · Vatudalampattu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillar set up in front of the Subramanya temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Engraved in characters of the 18th century A.D. Records the offer of asylum and the grant of exemption from dī-amaṇi and talaiyār-vari to the settlers in the hamlet of Ponnandangal, of the merit of Ayyan Govindappū by the son of Kayyilappar.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / GINGEE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another pillar set up in the place of Subramanya †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Tirumagalpola etc. Highly damaged. Records the setting up (of this) lamp post. On stone at the entrance into the temple is seriously damaged record of about the 15th century A.D., which mentions Vajuḍalambattu-śāvaji.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / GINGEE TALUK · Tirukkovilur Taluk — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Tīrumāmallūr.--North wall of the maṇṭapa in front of the central shrine, Bhaktajanēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Commences with the introduction Tirmmaṇi-valara, etc. Records a grant of land by the nagarattar of Tirumāmallur of Rājarājapuram, a city in Tirumunaipāḍi Mēlür-nāḍu, a subdivision of Jayangoṇḍachōla-valanāḍu, for offerings to the image of Sūryadēva and Nambiyārûranar (i.e. Sundaramurti-Nayanar) in the temple of Tirutondīśvaradāyār. Records also a further grant of land, after purchase, from the Assembly of the same town to the same temple, by Nänakkan Śrī Arangan[*] Iramānan Sēnāpati Rājēndrasōja-Brahmamārāyar.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / GINGEE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records grant of land to five persons (tirumūkkudam-adigāmār) for cleaning the precincts of the temple of Tiruttovādisvartāyār.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / GINGEE TALUK · Tirukkovilur Taluk — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Beginning with the introduction Tirumagal-valara, etc. Records a gift by Āppādi Malaipādi, a Vīrra[kk]ōḍiya [...] on behalf of Rajendrasōja-Brahmamārāyar, of a bronze vessel, sheep for providing curds daily to the images of Āḍavālr- Nambiyārangan and Ganapati, and cows for supplying milk and butter. He also arranged for the early morning service Sundays. He arranged for their supply of milk and curd daily to the temple in return for the 32 cows and sheep presented by different persons.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / GINGEE TALUK · Tirukkovilur Taluk — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Commences with the same introduction. Records the details of expenditure in the temple as fixed by Āyppādi Gunanidhi of Viļijūr, the Kangāņi-nāyaka of Tirumunaip-pādi Mēlūr-nādu along with the Karanattāņ, Bhanđāri, Vāriyar, Nagarattār, etc., from its income of 1473 and odd kālam of paddy and 79 kaļaņju of gold.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the same mandapa
cells.remarks: Do. Records gift of sheep by Veḍaiyāril Ulagan on behalf of Ponnampalam-śeyda-Pariśikai for a lamp in the temple of Tiruttaṇṭīśvaramudaiyār-Paramasvāmigaḷ at Tiruvaṇṇāmalai alias Rājādittapuram.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records grant of land as archanā-bhōga by Munaiyādaraiyan alias Apañjitan Kulamāṇikkan Mahādēvan. The inscription is engraved carelessly.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions Eṛaṇ ĵluvaṇ and ĵlavaṇ Kotti, two paļļi residents of Semmaṇaṇūr and Širuvārappūr respectively, probably as donors to the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Commences with the introduction Tirumagalpōla, etc. States that the sabhā of Aviyanṇūr endowed a lamp in the temple of Tiruttonđísvaramudaiya-Mahādēva and a half lamp in the shrine of Perungulattūrdēva (in the same temple) in expiation of their unfounded cleare a.ainst Sengaṇ Adigal Kutĵtēraṇ and Kāmaṇ ĵluvaṇ of Perungulattūr Virasundarappēriyaṇ.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records a grant of land (to the temple), after purchase from the bhattas, as tiruviḍaiyāttam for the maintenance of the tank to the south of Tiruvānaīūr alias Rājādittapuram, a dēvadāna in Tirumunaippāḍi Mēlur nāḍu in Gaṅgaikoṇḍaśōḷa-nāḍu, by Iṇjipparai Irāman Sirāḷan, at Maṅgaikōḍ of Irukkō-luḍūr.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records grant of land, after purchase, by Araiyan Munaiyan Mingan of Kuḍalūr as tiruviḍaiyāttam for offerings during the awakening service (tiruppalli-yeḷuchi) of the god.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Same as No. 362 of 1902.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of Bhaktajanēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Commences with the introduction, Tiramamaivālara, etc. Damaged. Records a gift of sheep by several persons for a lamp in the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning. Records gift of sheep for a lamp by the headman of Kurukāđi.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of a gold plate (pattram) to the god by Taṇḍikan Chēraṇ in alias Kuṭṭippanṇai of Vaikkāṅpakkam, the royal scribe (Uḍaiyār maṇōīva-dāśi eḷudum).

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning. Records gift of sheep for a lamp by Munaiyamāttāṇḍan Kali Rāman, a merchant of the village.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged and built in towards the end. Commences with the introduction Tirumalaigala, etc. Seems to record gold paffams presented to the god by ... Uttamakula Neṅmali-nāṭṭu Mūvēndavēḷār and Arumoḷi-Mūvēndavēḷār and to their subsequent loss in weight, which was later on detected and made good to temple official by Maṅgalaikilān Kāḷappan Pāli Nakkan, an officer of the nāḍu, who after enquiry had the loss made good.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 10th century A.D. States that Sāttukuţti Mādēvan alias Vāmaśivaņ consecrated the image of Chandēšvara and constructed a shrine of stone for this deity, in the temple of Tiruttondišvara at Tirunāvalūr.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the mahā-maṇḍapa
cells.remarks: Records an order of Peruṅjiṅgadēva granting land free of taxes in Kōvalai Kurumbūr situated in tirunāmalai-kku-n-tārukkali to god Viśvēśvaradēva set up by Gaṅgai-Jiñāneśvara alias Svāmīdēva, in the temple of Tirruṭton-īsvara nuḍaiy-... Nāyanar.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records a gift of 32 cows and a bull by the chief for a perpetual lamp in the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records an agreement given by Trimāl[u]*tti Bhaṭṭan Dēvapillai, a Śivabrāhmaṇa of the temple, to burn a lamp before the for the cows received from him one Danḍuśāyi Udayaṇa-paṇḍitar.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the same mahā-maṇḍapa
cells.remarks: The records the details of ornaments and utensils presented to the temple, by Pillai[yār] alias Sundarapāṇḍiya-Vilupparaiyan son of Sēkkiliān AnduKoṇḍān, the warden (irumeyk-kappāṇ) of the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged. In characters of about the 17th century A.D. Seems to record the renewal of a gift of land for worship, offerings, etc., to the god Toṇḍīśvaramudaiya-Nāyanār, which was probably in abeyance.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a golden pattram to the god by Iyakkam-pon of Rayanallūr in Veḷḷappanaḍu, a subdivision of Malaimanga-lam.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallūr—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: The first three lines are engraved over an erasure. Seems to record a sale of the sēvagam (service) right with its perquisite of half mã of land and a house site.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the same mahā-maṇḍapa
cells.remarks: States that the walls and the maṇḍapas in the temple of Toṇḍagaḷ-Nayiṉār at Tirunāvalūr had fallen, that worship in it had also been in abeyance, and that Śidāruḍaiyār Śēdirāyar represented the matter to his lord Tiruvēṅgaḍanāḍar Toṇḍaimāṉ who is given the titles, ‘Pagaittavargaḷ-kālaṉ’ ‘Gaṇḍa-Nārāyaṇaṉ’ and ‘Tiruppaḍi-Vēḷaikkāraṉ’ and with the latter's permission and for his welfare, made a gift of land, for reviving worship along with the services Pagaittavarkālaṉ-śandi and Śidāruḍaiyāṉ-śandi.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallfür—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: States that the temple of Toṇḍagal-Nayiṇār at Tirumānallūr, an independent village in the Tirukkōyilūr taluk, had become desolate for some years with the maṇḍapas and gōpuras fallen and that Amaramārār, the avasaram officer of the king, repaired them and after rehabilitating the village, made a gift of certain taxes accruing from the village for worship and offerings in the temple by order of the king. (See A.E. Nos. 111 and 213 of 1934-35). The order regarding this gift was communicated to the trustees of the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South side of the verandah round the central shrine.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 16th century A.D. Records sale of the tirumeykāval right in the temple of Toṇḍagal-Nayiṇār at Tirumānallūr by the trustees to Tirumalaikkōḷundār alias Aḷagiya-maṇavāḷa Vāṇavadarāyar, son of Vāṇavadarāyar of Śellapperumāḷi.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same side
cells.remarks: Commences with the introduction Samasta-bhuvanaikavīra etc. Records a royal gift of the village Ōgūr in Śendamangalam-gaḷapparu, mado free of taxes, as tirumānattukkaṇi for offerings during the service Ulagamuḍuḍaiyār-kaṇḍi in the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallfür—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same side
cells.remarks: Commences with the same introduction. Records gift of the chaturvēdimangalam village Uṛattūr renamed Vikramapāṇḍya-chaturvēdimangalam in Śendamangalam-gaḷapparu by the king (Śēndamīḍīr) among 44 Brahmins for reciting the Vēdas during the early morning service in the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North side of the verandah of Bhaktajanēśvara †
cells.remarks: Beginning of lines built in. Records gift of the village Ēkadhīrak-Kaḷattūr in Kāṇa-nāḍu to the south of the river Gaḷḷāru by the king, Tirumānallūr being a village in the sub-division of Kurumbalūr in Śevvirukkai Śembī-nāḍu, a subdivision of Pāṇḍi-nāḍu for offerings to the god Aḷagiya Tiruchchirambalamuḍaiya-Nāyaṇār, evidently set up by him in the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same side
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 16th century A.D. Records the grant of the tirumeykāval right in the temple along with its perquisites, by the trustees to Nāvuḍaippillai-Nāyaṇār (See also No. 251 above).

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East side of the verandah of Bhaktajanēśvara †
cells.remarks: Built in at the right end. Seems to record a royal gift of land free of taxes, for worship and offerings to the god Sundara.... set up by [Tiruchchiṟṟa]mbalam-uḍaiyār alias Kulaśēkhara-Maḷavarāyar in the street to the south of the temple of Toṇḍagaḷ-Nāyaṉār at Tirunāvalūr.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West side of the platform containing the navagraha images in the first prākāra.
cells.remarks: Stops unfinished after mention of the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the second prākāra, Bhaktajanēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Stones missing in the middle and incomplete. Seems to record an endowment made by Maruduḷāṉ Pakkaṉ Śāttaṉ, a merchant of Tirunāvalūr alias Rājādittapuram for a lamp in the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the agreement given by a Śivabrāhmaṇa of the temple to burn a twilight lamp before the image of Kshētrapāla-Piḷḷaiyār with (the interest on) 4 kaḻañju of gold received by him from a merchant of the village by pledging as security, his right of worship in the temple for 2 days out of his share of 3⅝ days in a month.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallfür—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Commences with the introduction Pūmēvuvaḷar, etc. Records, the gift of village Aviyaṉūr which had been a brahmadēya, after converting it into tirunāmattukkāṇi under the name Kalikaḍindaśōḻanallūr, for providing offerings to the god Tiruttoṇḍīśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēva at Mēlūr-nāṭṭu Tirunāvalūr in Tirumuṉaippāḍi alias Rājēndraśōḷa-vaḷanāḍu, a subdivision of Rājarāja-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallfür—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.date:
(Lost) [date-calculation appendix, No. 261: Śaka 1714, Paridhāvi, Paṅguni 24, Wednesday; śu. 2, Rēvatī.
Irregular. If the date of the month is a mistake for 4 the other details regularly correspond to A. D. 1793, March 13, Wednesday :
f.d.t. ·07 and f.d.n. ·27]
cells.remarks: Engraved in continuation of the previous inscription. Beginning of lines built in. Records a gift of 240 kāśu by the merchant, Tiruñānasambandaṉ Periyanāyaṉ of Neṟkuḷam, for two twilight lamps in the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallfür—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of 480 kāśu by two persons for 4 twilight lamps in the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallfür—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Stones misplaced and some lost. Records a gift of 720 kāśu by six persons for 6 lamps in the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallfür—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to record gift of money for burning lamps before the image of Tiruvīdi-Nāchchiyār set up in the temple by a certain Śiṟuttoṇḍaṉ.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallfür—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Incomplete and stones misplaced. Records the gift of a gold vessel to the temple by Śembai-Nāyaka alias Kulōttuṅgaśōḷa Magadai-Nāḍāḻvāṉ of Āragaḷūr in Āṟṟūr-kūṟṟam, a district of Milāḍu alias Jananātha-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallfür—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.date: Śaka 145[7], Manmatha, Dhanus, śu. [8] Thursday, Uttiraṭṭādi.
cells.remarks: Stones lost in the middle. Seems to record the assignment of the income of 50 poṉ due from the village Mēṭṭu-Urattūr as umbaḷi-poṉ to Pāpparāja and seven others for carrying the taṇḍigai (palanquin) and umbrella, evidently of the god at Tirunāvalūr. Also records a gift of 1 mā of land at Mēṭṭu-Urattūr by the beneficiaries to Meññāna-māmuni, the disciple of Śīkāḻivaḷḷal-Paṇḍāram, for the benefit of the maṭha at Tirunāvalūr. Mentions Salakarāja Tiru[malai]dēva-Mahārāja and Tipparājar Bhōgaiyar belonging to the family of Uraiyūr Chōḷas.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. / Tirunāmanallūr—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records a gift of 1 veli of land in Pēriņūr as madappuram made free of taxes by Kulōttungaśōla-Kachchiyarāyan to Tōṇḍānatāniyār for feeding devotees in the Rājākānsi-chan-dranmādam attached to the temple of Tiruppāśūr-uḍaiyār at Porundānamanallūr in Tirumaņāppāḍi-nāḍu, a subdivision of Rājēraja-vaļanāḍu.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the prākāra of Bhaktajanēśvara †
cells.date: 21st year (in words) [date-calculation appendix, No. 268: Śaka 1466, Krodhin, Dakshiṇāyana, Vrischika, śu. 10, Sunday, Uttirattadi =A. D. 1549, November 23, Sunday, f.d.t. ·24; ·60.]
cells.remarks: Stones misplaced in the middle. Records a gift of 240 kāhu by two persons for two lamps before the deity, Tirukkalinār-Śuramuđaiyanār alias Periyanāyanār at Tirumuṇaippāđi-Tirunāvalūr alias Rājāditṭya*'dēvapuram in Rājarāja-vaļanāđu. (See also No. 376 of 1902 in the same village.)

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in the pavement at the entrance to the Varadarāja shrine in Bhaktajanēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Modern. Mentions the Narasiṅgamunaiya-nāyar-matha and the Nandikēśuran Nijainādēva[rā]yaṇār-matha situated to the east, probably of the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Inner wall of the gōpura, left of entrance
cells.remarks: In characters of c. the 14th century A.D. Two verses in praise of Vaiñgurayan who fought a battle at Veļļūru.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall, right of entrance
cells.remarks: Records a gift of 50 cows by Kurucchi Araiyan Sundarattōj-uđaiyār alias Kūpakarāyar for supplying milk for bath and offerings to god Tiruttonđīsvaram-uđaiya-Nāyaṇār.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Lintel of the doorway of the gōpura of Varadarāja †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 14th century A.D. Gives the name Tirunallūān Kulakkēślaruḍaiyan Amarakōn.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West and south belts of the gōpura of Varadarāja †
cells.remarks: Records the deed given to Rāyasam Tiruamlaiyar-Ayyaṇ, agent of Kīshbuppa-Nāynka who was himself the agent of the king, by the tāṇuttār and the nāṭār regarding certain privileges, such as paricalṭam, etc., to the masons, carpenters and goldsmiths of Tirunāvalūr-śirmai and Kuppa-śirmai, similar to those enjoyed by the Kaymāṭar of Padaiviđu, Šeñji and Tiruvaṇṇāmalai.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Śēndamaṅgalam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine, Apatsahāyēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 13th century A.D. Gives the name of the maṇḍapa as 'Arirājavyābhujanga-tirumaṇḍapa'.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East side of the bases of the nandi-mandapa in Apatsahāyēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gives the name 'Mādāsiyam-ēri'.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: A beam of the same nandi-mandapa
cells.remarks: Reads 'Śrī-Ranaragarākshasan'.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the prākāra (outside) of Apatsahāyēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 15th century A.D. Records an undertaking given by a vēlaikkāraṇ named Ānandatāṇdava-perumāl Toṇdaimāṇār, promising to collect only 8½ paṇam from the weavers residing in the tīrumadaivilāgam of the god, Āpattukāttaruliya-Nāyaṇār at Sēndaṇaimaṅgalam.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 16th century A.D. Records the grant of 1 mā of land and a house-site by the temple as ulivappatti to the descendants of Perrān who off-th his head when the god Āvattukātaruliya-Nāyanār was taken out in procession during festival.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in the pavement of a private house in the south street.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 12th century A.D. Records the oath of fealty taken by Appaṇ, the younger brother of Pallavaraiyan and the son of Virasōlap-Piraiyan of Puttanūr, not to survive his master Alagiyapallavan Sadaiyampurānal.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Kallakkurichi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up near the ruined Chandrasekhara temple.
cells.remarks: Modern. Damaged at the end. Records a gift of land as sarvamānya at Kallakkurichi, to god Chandrasekhara, by Pallavarāyan of Sūryappa-Nāyakan-van of Sētapapayyur, at the merit of Sūryappa-Nāyakan of Sēdavangamālam, for nāttār of the 12-parru and the tānattār of Sēndavangamālam. Kallakkurichi is stated to have been the tiruwlaiyā-dam of god Āvattukātaruliya-Nāyanār.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Orattūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two stray stones lying in a street.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to record a gift of land, made free of taxes, from the 16th year of the king's reign, to god Bhūmēśvaramudaiya-Nāyaṇār. Mentions Vālvallaperumāl.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Pādūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up in the tank bund
cells.remarks: Modern. Damaged. Seems to refer to the celebration of a festival in honour of goddess Lakshmi and the construction of a channel by a certain Janārdana.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Perumbākkam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in a dry land to the east of the village.
cells.remarks: Modern. The inscription is engraved on a stone bearing the triśūla mark. Mentions the tiruandamakkāni (land) belonging to (god) Tondaga-Nāyinār.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Māmbākkam Pullūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up behind the Ādikēsava-Perumāl temple.
cells.date: Śaka 15[11], Virōdhi, Panguni 5, śu. Monday, Saptamī.
cells.remarks: A triśūla is engraved above this inscription and hence it should have belonged to a Śiva temple. The reverse side of the same stone records a sale of land to the temple and the gift of the village, Māmbākkam for offerings in a temple (name lost) at Vriddhāchalam by Kopdama-Nāyakkar-Aiyan, son of Krishnappaiya-Nāyakkar-ayyan.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Kilandūr (Pullūr) — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in a dry land to the east of the village near the railway line.
cells.remarks: Modern. Reads 'Śrī-Chennakēsvaravaram Virāta-bhachakra Vāsuanārāyana'. There is a Tengalai Vaishnava mark with a chakra on the stone.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in front of the Ādikēsava-Perumāl temple.
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Seems to record an agreement between the rājarāram (government) and some tenants, the nature of which is not clear.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pullür.—Stone set up in a dry land to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: States that the ūrār and other residents of Puļļūr made themselves responsible, by setting apart 700 kuži of land out of their service lands (iļaikkā-nilam) for the maintenance of worship in the temple of god Sōkkachchhiya-Vinnagar-āļvar consecrated in the village by Poṟrchi Teņṇavadarayar, for the welfare of the king.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in a wet land called 'Kīl-muļi '.
cells.remarks: The characters are of about the 14th century A.D. Records a gift of 480 kuži of wet land as tax-free tiruviḍaiyāttam to god Kēśava-Perumāl by Perumāl Toṇḍaimānār.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Maļavarāyānūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: (Eļavanāśūr).-Stone set up in front of Kaluvattarāyaṇ temple.
cells.remarks: Do. Above the inscription are carved the Pāṇḍya emblems of two carps and an anchor (!). States that Malavarāyanallūr alias Parākrama-Pāṇḍya-paţţiņam is a place of resort for the refugees (pāyiṇār-pugalidam).

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Tiruppayatar — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in the bed of the lake in front of the Nāṅgūr-Amman temple.
cells.remarks: The writing belongs to about the 13th century A.D. Records the digging of this tank and the construction of a sluice for it by Nirvėli Kūttan alias Kōvāļrayan.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Śīruvattūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone known as Śāruyādik-kal set up in a dry land to the north of the village.
cells.remarks: The characters are of about the 16th century A.D. Prescribes the 'standard-and-measuring rod' at 48 feet for dry lands in the village Sirupputtur by Sēnnaravattu Nandināyakkar, an agent of Echechhaṇa-Nāyakkarayyan.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Puttamaṅgalam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in the bed of an irrigation channel.
cells.remarks: Modern. Records a gift of 480 kuži of wet land as tax-free dēvadāna to the temple of Kayilāyamuḍaiya-Nāyanār at Pōstamaṅgalam by Āṇandatāṇḍavappərumāļ-Toṇḍaimānār.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · İdaikkal — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock to the north of the village.
cells.remarks: The characters are of about the 16th century A.D. Damaged. Seems to record the gift of a garden-land to provide for a lamp in the temple [(name lost)] by an agent (name lost) of Pāṇai Sadāśiva-Nāyakkar.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Kumāramangalam(Elavaṇāśūr) — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone found in the debris of the ruined Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Seems to record the construction and consecration of the temple of Tribhuvanēśvaramuḍaiyān and Tirupurāṇiśvari-Amman in the village by Subbaļaiyya-Iļaiyān of the Kshatriya (caste) who constructed the temple, and by another person called Meyyappaṇ Muttayyan. Refers to the brahmin Kaļiya-Gurukaļ as being instrumental for this work.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Vāli — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up in a dry field to the north of the village.
cells.remarks: Records the confirmation of the remission, previously granted, of other taxes and of the māvu-paţţam of the village Mēļūr made by Alappirandān Mōgan alias Rājarija-Kāva-varāyan. This remission is stated to be confined only to the Aļappirandān-ēri and the channel Aļappirandāṇ-kāl.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Pāchchāpāḷaiyam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock near the tank called Gōvindaṉkuḷam to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: The characters are of about the 18th century A.D. Incomplete. Records the remission granted by Tiruvēṅgaḷa-Ayyaṉ of all the taxes for a period of twelve years to the artisan families who colonised Pēṭṭai, a tiruviḷaiyāṭṭam of god Aḻagar.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Kaḷamarudūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the Śelliyammaṉ temple by the side of the road.
cells.remarks: The characters are of about the 16th century A.D. Records an order of one Vīramarasaiyaṉ granting full remission of taxes for the first six months and levying for the subsequent period three-fourths of the prevailing taxes on the artisan families colonising Ayyaṉ-[Śeru]ḍaiyāṉ-Marudūr situated in the śīrmai (jurisdiction) of Veṅkappaṉ, the agent of Sūrappa-Nāyaka.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up on the west side of the basement of the Muniyappaṉ shrine near the tank-bund.
cells.remarks: The characters are of about the 16th century A.D. Records an order of one Vīramarasaiyaṉ granting full remission of taxes for the first six months and levying for the subsequent period three-fourths of the prevailing taxes on the artisan families colonising Ayyaṉ-[Śeru]ḍaiyāṉ-Marudūr situated in the śīrmai (jurisdiction) of Veṅkappaṉ, the agent of Sūrappa-Nāyaka.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Tiruniraṅkoṉṟai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West side of the base of the verandah round the Chandranātha shrine in the Appāṇḍār Jaina temple on the hill.
cells.remarks: The characters are of about the 13th century A.D. States that Nallūr granted by king Kulōttuṅga-Chōḷa to the temple of Kanakach-chinagiri Appar is sacred ground.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock on the west side of the verandah of Chandra-nātha †
cells.remarks: Damaged, and right and left ends built in. Begins with the historical introduction Tirumanni-vaḷara, of Rājēndra-Chōḷa I. Records a gift of 96 sheep for a lamp to god . . . Pāḷiyilava (?) by Kalimāṉaṉ Vijayālayamallaṉ of Tirumaṇañjēri in Rājēndrasiṁha-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock at the entrance into the main shrine in Chandra-nātha shrine. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary and damaged. Contains the introduction of Kulōttuṅga I beginning with the words Pugalmādu-viḷaṅga. Seems to record an endowment of paddy for a lamp in the temple by Rājēndraśōḷa-Chēdirā[jaṉ]. Mentions Uḍaiyār Mallishēṇa, evidently a Jaina deity.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Lintel over the entrance into Chandra-nātha shrine. †
cells.language: Tamil (verse) †
cells.remarks: The characters are of about the 16th century A.D. A verse in praise of Guṇabaddira-Muṉivaṉ, evidently a Jaina saint who was famous in the southern land as a great scholar both in Tamil and in Sanskrit and who was a native of Koṇḍaimalai.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the front maṇḍapa right of entrance, in Chandra-nātha shrine. †
cells.date: Śaka 1283, Śubhakṛit, Dhanus, śu. 13, Wednesday, Kārttigai.
cells.language: Tamil †
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Appāṇ[ḍār] by a person (name lost), son of Śembādi Villavadaraiyaṉ of Palampaṭṭiṉam in Paṭṭiṉa-nāḍu, a subdivision of Śembūr-kōṭṭam in Jayaṅkoṇḍaśōḻa-maṇḍalam. Tirunaruṅgoṇḍai is said to have formed part of Āḍanūr in [Kuru]kkai-kūṟṟam in Tirumunaippāḍi-nāḍu, a subdivision of Naḍuvil-maṇḍalam. Mentions Gōppaṇṇa-Uḍaiyar as being instrumental for this gift. On the same wall is a short inscription in characters of about the 16th century A.D. mentioning Guṇabhadrāchārya, called also Vīrasaṅghapratishṭhāchāryaṉ.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall, left of entrance
cells.date: Śaka 1283, Śubhakṛit, Dhanus, śu. 13, Wednesday, Kārttigai.
cells.language: Tamil †
cells.remarks: Records another gift of land for the same purpose by the Nāṭṭavar of Āḍanūr-paṟṟu.

cells.location: SOUTH AROQT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · Tiruniraṅkoṉṟai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall, left of entrance
cells.language: Tamil (verse) †
cells.remarks: Built in at the right end. Records the Śaiva doctrine that all our actions have their origin in the Supreme Śiva. The characters belong to about the 13th century A.D.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: concld. TIBURKOYILUR TALUK—concld. Tirunāṅkoyil—concld. Above the entrance of the natural cavern on the hill of Chandra-nātha. †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 9th century A. D. States that the east maṇḍapa and the chaturmāṇḍikkyil of the works of Viśaiyānullān Kumāran Dēvan of Taḷakkuḍi in Mīrai-nāḍu on the south bank of the Kāvēri river.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West side of the same cavern
cells.remarks: Two incomplete pieces in characters of about the 9th century A. D. one mentioning Vāṇakovaraiyar and the other (much damaged) Aruḷagapuram (?).

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock to the west of the same cavern
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 9th century A. D. Records the gift of ten pon to the two paḷḷis (Jain shrines) by a certain Śiṅgāṇr pavadāyaṇār of Nariyappaḍi.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same rock
cells.remarks: Do. Damaged in the middle. Seems to record a similar gift by an individual (name lost), probably the son of Periya-nakkaṇār of Nariyappaḍi.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same rock
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Seems to record a gift of land under Kundavai-śrī (tank) after reclamation, by Maiḷan Mallan alias Vikramachōḷa-Malayan as Śiṅgaippāram (palanquin-maintenance) of the images of Aruḷmoḷidēvar and Nityakalyāṇadēvar in the festival occasions in Vaigāśi at Tirunāṅkoyil in Kuṇṛattūr-nāḍu, a subdivision of Tirumuṉappāḍi, a subdivision of Rājarāja-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same rock
cells.remarks: Records an endowment of 420 kalam of paddy by the measure Aṭkondāṇ-narakkāl, out of the annual pādikāral income from the village Ja[na]*[nātha-maṅgalam by Ajappirandāṇ Mōgaṇ alias Kulōttungaśola-Kāđavarāyaṇ for offerings to (the image of) Kacchi-Nāyaṇār.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the Āḷagamma-maṇḍapa on the hill of Chandra-nātha. †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to record a gift of cows by some persons (probably for lamps in the temple).

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Do. Seems to record a gift of certain taxes due to him from the village Tirumaṉaṅgoṇ(ḍai) by Kūḍal Aḷappiṟandāṉ Pīḷāṉ (or) gōpāḷa (or) Sō(ḷa) Kiḍāvarāyaṉ as endowment to the god (name lost).

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall (inside) of the prākāra of Chandra-nātha shrine. †
cells.remarks: Records the construction of this stroll-pavilion (tirunaḍai-māḷigai) to the temple to the south of Tirunaṅgoyil by....... Siṅgaṉ, a native of Paḷaiyūr.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the gōpura (inside) of Chandra-nātha shrine. †
cells.remarks: Modern. Records the completion, on this date, of the stone work of this gōpura of the Appāṇḍar temple at Tiruṇaruṅgoṇḍai by Parama Jīnadēva-Jiyar.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock on the way to the tank at the foot of the hill of Chandra-nātha. †
cells.remarks: The characters are of about the 13th century A.D. Records the construction of these steps by Gunavīirachāryan Payintadēva, a goldsmith of the place.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South side of the basement of a defunct shrine situated outside the south prākāra wall of Chandra-nātha shrine. †
cells.remarks: Records a gift of certain tax-income to him from the village Tirumaraik-kādu by the chief Kiļik[ki]: Mutti-Śōkkan alias Rājagārn-bha-Chēdhirāyan for offerings to the deities, Appar and Pāliyālīvār of the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock near the same basement
cells.remarks: States that this is the measuring span. This is engraved between two marks the length between which is 16 spans.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pedestal of a bronze image of Chandranātha in the Appāṇḍār temple.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 13th century A.D. States that the image of Kiļakkīi-Nāyikkar was endowed by Āļappirandān Mōgan Kuḍaiyāp[pi]rāyan at Tiruṇaruṅgoṇḍai.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up at the sluice of the tank
cells.language: Tamil (verse) †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 10th century A. D. Records the construction of this sluice to the tank at Naruṅgoṇdai by Araipperumāl.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Kuṉṇattūr (Malaiyampatti). South wall of the dilapidated Śiva temple
cells.language: Tamil (verse) †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction ‘Iruṇta[gō]ḍi, etc. Records an agreement given by the ūr (village assembly) of Kuṇattūr in Kuṇrattūr-nādu, a subdivision of Tirumunaippādi in Rājēndraśōla-vaļanādu, to burn 5 twilight lamps in the Kalaśamudaiyār temple on behalf of Śiṅgan Ambalattādi native of... A piece of land was endowed (by themselves) for this purpose.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT · Nattāmūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up on the east bund of the tank.
cells.language: Tamil (verse) †
cells.remarks: Modern. States that this is the tank dug by Śakku Māmudali, of the village of Vēļūr in Ammudūrūlikan-Sāyabu under the orders of his master.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Kūttāṇūr.--Rock standing near the main road.
cells.language: Tamil (verse) †
cells.remarks: States that this is the duvai (channel) for the wet lands at Eralāyir-kuṭṭam.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pūvaṇūr.--Stone set up near the platform below a pipal tree.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land after reclamation as ëripatti (tank maintenance) by a certain Paduġan Ōlaġan of Pūvaṇūr in Dāmar-nādu, a subdivision of Muṉṇaippādi.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Vada-kurumbūr.--Stone set up near a dilapidated Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: States that this (surrounding land) is the tiruviļaiyāttam of (god) Arulālanātha of Kāñchīpuram. In characters of about the 14th century A.D.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another stone lying near Śiva temple †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Contains part of the praśasti of Rājēraja I beginning with the words Tirumagalpōl, etc. Mentions Miļādu alias Jānanātha-vaļanādu.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Teṅkuṇam.--Stone not up in a field to the east of the village.
cells.remarks: Modern. States that the Viśvanāthasundaram (tank) was constructed for the merit of Rāya Tirumalai-Ayyar.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: San Thome.--Triangular slab kept in the Bishop's house.
cells.remarks: Reads LOVVADA SEA A EVRRISSIMA CONCEIGAO (Praise be to the most holy conception). The relief image of Our Lady in the centre). In the same place is kept another stone containing a part of the historical introduction of Rājēndra-Chōla.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SRIPERUMBUDUR TALUK · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT. / SRIPERUMBUDUR TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Kōvūr.—South wall of the Sundarēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Records an agreement given by Peṇumaļ-Bhaṭṭan, a Śiva brāhmaṇa of the temple of Rājēśvaramudaiya-Nāyanār at Kōvūr, to burn a twilight lamp in the temple for the person received from Kōmaṇaṇ Peṇungāṭṭuppiļļai who claims to belong to one of the 70 families of that of Eliślānīgan at Tirumaiyāppūr and whom Kāñchī-Chōla is stated to have settled at Rāmādovachēhēri in Kāñchī.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SRIPERUMBUDUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Loose pillar lying in the prākāra of Sundarēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged and mutilated. Seems to record an endowment of land for the daily worship of the god Tirumē... dēva at Kōvūr.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SRIPERUMBUDUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab lying in the Vishnu temple in the same village (as Sundarēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Seems to record a grant of land which had formerly been in the enjoyment of the Mahājanas, to Viṣhṇu-Makaran as sargamāṇiums Muṇiya-divasaiyan at Chaturvēdimangalam alias Kōvūr.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK · TIRUVALLUR TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Tiruvūr.—North and west walls of the central shrine of the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a house-site as madavilāgam to the temple of Siṅgēśvaramudaiya-Nāyanār at Tirunilai alias Turugūr by Sadāśiva-Nāyaka, the agent of Iṇmaḍi-Tirumalai-Nāyaka after purchasing the same from the Mahājanas of the village.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Śiva temple †
cells.remarks: States that this sacred stone temple was the work of Tiruaṇṇāmalai-Udaiyān, the headman of Paiyūr-[Tugaḍūr] and a native of Olugarai alias Kulōttuṅgachōlanallūr.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall ļ
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a piece of land as dēvadāna to the temple by a merchant named Periya-Vāṇdavār alias Kollattarayan of Olugarai alias Kulōttuṅgachōlanallūr.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall or Śiva temple †
cells.remarks: Records the restoration of the old dēvadāna village Ayattūr to the temple of Riśahēśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyanār at Turugūr forming part of Porumulaiyūr alias Ulagalan-daśoļa-chaturvedimangalam for the ikkāttu-kõttam for the usual worship and festivals in the chitrai month by the Pledg-holders and Villavaraiyar by regularising the charitable grants in continuation of the enjoyments of the temple till the 17th year (of the king).

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: A copy of No. 333 above. The donor is here called Malaiyan Tiruvaippalani-Udaiyān.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Lintel above the entrance into same shrine.
cells.date: about the 14 century A. D. †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 14 century A. D. States that this (mugamāni) is the gift of Anuiki Purushōttama-Bhattar Varadar, a native of the village.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Inner wall of the gōpura, right of entrance, of Śiva temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record the grant of the incomes from Tiruvūr and Perumulaipatṭu to (the shrine of ?) Kariyamānikka-Perumāl in the temple of Rīshyaśrīngīśvara by Śivaram Nāraṇappa-Nāyakkar, an agent of the king.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up in front of the gōpura of Śiva †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a cocoa-nut garden to the temple of Singi-śvara and Perumal by the temple priests (Ruhisvaram-uḍaiyār) by Kaśavarāya and the Mahājānas of the village for the merit of the former's father Tippayadeva-Mahārāya.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Second slab set up in the place of Śiva †
cells.remarks: Records the grant of the annual income of 6 poṇ due as nirkūli (water cess) to the village Turugūr from the dēvadāna villages Maṇdalapurushanpatṭu and Varadarājan-patṭu, to the temple of Śingīśuram-uđaiya-Nāyinār by Immađi Tirumalai-Nāyakkar and the Mahājanas of Turugūr.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Third slab set up in the place of Śiva †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 16th century A.D. Records the grant of the monthly income in money and paddy due to him as kaḍaikkāl-lakkas from the Singēśvaram-udaiya Nayanar's temple by Annamaiyan, son of Tiruvaruṅga-nāyaka-bhattar, for the morning worship and offerings and for the night lamps in the shrine of Attakka-Pillaiyār at Turugūr.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up in a field near the same village (as Śiva temple). †
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Mentions Huraiyar referred to above and the Mahājanas of Turuvūr.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK · Conjeevaram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab built into the wall of the outermost prākāra of the Ekāmranātha temple.
cells.remarks: The writing is of the 13th century A. D. States that the Iśānēśvar-madam was the gift of Periyanāttār. On the top of the silo is engraved a human figure seated on a pedestal holding a lotus stalk in either hand. To its right is composed the sun and to its left the crescent. Below the pedestal is an ornamental kumbha with a lamp on either side.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab built into a cross wall, adjacent to the above.
cells.remarks: A label reading Grihēśanā in characters of about the 7th century A. D.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Five stones built into the outer walls of Ekāmranātha temple. †
cells.remarks: In disconnected pieces with introduction commencing with Tingalēlaru, etc. Mentions flower-garden belonging to the temple of Tiruvēkambamuḍaiyār and refers to the formation of a new village with its boundaries specified.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CONJEEVARAM TALUK · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT—concld. / CONJEEVARAM TALUK—concld. / Conjeevaram.—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab built into the wall of Ekāmranātha †
cells.date: Šaka 1403, Šubbakrit, Makara 22, šu. 10, Rōhipī, Saturday .
cells.remarks: Records the establishment of a maṭha called Akkālandaiśvaramadam near the east gōpura of the temple, and an endowment of land for its maintenance by Kuḍudaiyān Taluvakkulaṇdān, a chef of Tiruvannālur, who was a disciple of Pudukkoṭṭai Maruṇdaivajjal of the Siḍāli-Tiruneṛi lineage. maṇi.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CONJEEVARAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CONJEEVARAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CONJEEVARAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu

Ayirattunūṟṭuvarttaraffār of Kanchipuram who are also called Dēvaśiṅgadhara-Karttar for the purpose of being endowed by the latter for any charity they thought fit.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CONJEEVARAM TALUK · Kalavagunta — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Registers an endowment of the village Siṭṭarābakkam for the expenses of daily worship and the conduct of festivals in the temple of Mukkāntiśvaraṇ-Uḍaiyār-Nāyaṇār at Kalvākuṭṭai in Iruvāpparaḍa, a subdivision of Tuyanāḍu in Tuṇḍamaṇḍalam by Mahānāyakara [Vayappa]- Nāyaka, son of Chinna-Timmappa-Nāyaka, for the merit of the king, of his own family and of the Nattavar of Iruvārapparu.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CONJEEVARAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of Mukkāntiśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Registers a similar endowment of the village Mēlai-Murukkampākkam for the requirements of the temple by one Rāmachandra-Dīkshita, for the merit of the Nāğu and his own family.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CONJEEVARAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Mukkāntiśvara temple. †
cells.date: . Šaka 1485, Rudhirōdĝāri, Kārttika 6, pañchami, Friday, Pushya.
cells.remarks: Records the allotment of lands at Pāśāppāṭṭai for the several requirements of the temple, by Veṅkaṭaṭta-[Nāyaka], officer (maṇiyakkāran) under Basavappa-Nāyaka, the agent of Āliya-Rāmappayyadēva-Mahārājayya, for the merit of the latter two, and the fixation of the extent of lands held as sarvamāna by the temple craftsmen and artisans in the dēvadāna village Siṭṭarambākkaṁ.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CONJEEVARAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the Subrahmaṇya shrine in Mukkāntiśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a village (name not clear) as sarvamāna to god Mukkāntiśvara at Kalavaguta by Dalavāyi Tirū Nāyaṇayya.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CONJEEVARAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stones built into the pavement near the gōpura in Subrahmaṇya shrine. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of land to the temple by the donor mentioned above, who is called the agent of the king.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CONJEEVARAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Inner wall of the gōpura of Subrahmaṇya, left side †
cells.date:
Śaka 1480, Kālayukti, Purattāśi
27, paurnami, Rēvati; lunar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Records an endowment of land for meeting the expenses of worship and offerings to the deity on the 4th day of the festival in the month of Vaiśāśi, by Bojjal Kīlatti-Uḍaiyār and dāsi... for the merit of their spiritual teacher and their parents.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CONJEEVARAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall, right side
