cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CONJEEVARAM TALUK · Kalavagunta — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall, right side
cells.remarks: Records the provision made by Aṇavallai Viraivayiran for the celebration of the Vasanata-tirunāl and Pavitra-tirunāl festivals in the temple of Mukkamaṇḍīśvaramint.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CONJEEVARAM TALUK · Kalavagunta — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall, right side
cells.remarks: Seriously damaged. Mentions [Tippa] Nā-Nāyani, and Mukkantiśvara at Kalavagunta.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CONJEEVARAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North and west walls of the gōpura of Subrahmaṇya †
cells.date: Śaka 1480, Kālayukti, Māsi ba. 7, Uttarādam, Sunday.
cells.remarks: Records the grant of their income of 50 paṇam accruing from the tax on looms of the weavers in the village Sittambākkaṁ by the Mahānāyakāchārya Mukkaravallabha-Tippa-Nāyaka, Narasingappa-Nāyaka, Rāghava-Nāyaka, Konda-Nāyaka and others for the expenses of one day's worship and offerings during the festivals in the month of Vaiśāśi in the temple.

cells.location: CHITTOR DISTRICT / CHITTOOR TALUK · CHITTOR DISTRICT—concld. / CHITTOOR TALUK—concld. / Kalavagunta—concld. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: East wall of the maṇdapa in front of the central shrine in the Lakshminā-rāyaṇa-Perumāl temple.
cells.remarks: Much damaged, and interrupted in the middle by pillars. Seems to record provision made for offerings in the temple of Tiruvēṅkaṭanātha at Kuḷavākkāṭṭai by Uttama Timmayadēva-Mahārāja.

cells.location: CHITTOR DISTRICT / CHITTOOR TALUK · Bommasamudram — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Two stones built into the walls of the central shrine in the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Fragments in characters of about the 10th century A. D. Some of them gives the 10th year of a king whose name is lost and the remaining portion of the record is a gift to the temple for a perpetual lamp.

cells.location: CHITTOR DISTRICT / CHITTOOR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Two other stones built into the same walls.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. This evidently belongs to Parāntaka I. Mentions a wall starting from Viraikkōṭṭai and refers to a previous measurement of land with which this standard agrees; these contains a fragmentary record in the same characters, and records a provision made for offerings and worship to the deity. Mentions a grain measure called Sāgajam.

cells.location: CHITTOR DISTRICT / CHITTOOR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Three other stones built into the same walls.
cells.dynasty: Chōla (?) †
cells.remarks: The characters may be assigned to about the 10th century A. D. Fragmentary. Mentions Rāśiyūr.

cells.location: CHITTOR DISTRICT / CHITTOOR TALUK · Naṅgavalli — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Wall of the Garuda-maṇdapa in the Bazar street.
cells.remarks: States that the Garuḍarāyid-maṇḍapa was built by Titta- Seṭṭiyār, son of Tiruvaranbaia-Seṭṭiyār of the Sāttandaigōtra, one of the Nagarattār (merchants) living in Pudupēṭṭai near Salem.

cells.location: CHITTOR DISTRICT / CHITTOOR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Three slabs lying on the bund of the tank by the road side.
cells.remarks: The inscriptions on two of the slabs are complete ones and are dated, one in Vikṛiti, Ārpaśi and the other in Āni, 30, respectively, while the former refers to a gift of land to Ādimūla-Seṭṭi and the latter to the setting up of the Viṇāyaka image by one Sōṅgalāni-Mu-taliyār, son of Kāvāṅdai Mudaliyār.

cells.location: CHITTOR DISTRICT / CHITTOOR TALUK · Kuṭippaṭti — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Boulder in a field
cells.remarks: Modern. States that this land to the south of Rāmīpuram was endowed as sarvamānya for the maintenance of a water shed by Rāmi-Reddiyār of Nāmakkal-śīrmai-subai (subah ?).

cells.location: CHITTOR DISTRICT / CHITTOOR TALUK · Pillūr (near Paramatti) — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: South wall of the Central shrine in the Tiruviratṭinum temple.

cells.location: CHITTOR DISTRICT / CHITTOOR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 10th century A. D. States that a gift of 14 kaļaņju of gold was made to the temple of Tiruvīratṭānattu-Perumānadigaļ for two forehead-plates and two gold-flowers to the god by the Pāraga-Nagarattār. These were also responsible for the payment of interest in paddy to the temple for the 33 and odd kaļaņju of gold (received by them).

cells.location: CHITTOR DISTRICT / CHITTOOR TALUK · Pānđamaņgalam — Andhra Pradesh

cells.remarks: Records the gift of a house-site with its income from trees, etc., for the expenses of abhishēka and for twilight lamps in the temple of Kīśi Viśvanāthasvāmin at Pāṇḍiamangalam.

cells.location: CHITTOR DISTRICT / CHITTOOR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh

cells.remarks: Records a grant of land by Immadi Rāmachandra-Nāyaka to Veṛguṇamālaiyita-Perumālayyar for forming an agrahāra.

cells.location: CHITTOR DISTRICT / CHITTOOR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh

cells.location: CHITTOR DISTRICT / CHITTOOR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same rock
cells.remarks: Incomplete. cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT. / Trichinopoly Taluk — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Wall of the Ammaṇ shrine in the same temple.

Purports to record an order of god Ādi-Chandēsvara on behalf of god Vijumiya-Nāyiṇār to a Kaikkōla named Vayittaya-nādak (Vaidyanātha)-Kālingarāyaṇ alias Peruvēlppaiyaṇ, son of Tirumēniaļagiyāṇ of Tirumaļapāđi making a sarvamānya grant of land and house-site to him out of the temple property through Kōnēridēva-Mahārāja (see No. 384 below).

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Inner wall of the outermost gōpura in the same temple, left of entrance.
cells.remarks: Records an endowment made by the Mahāsabhā of Jagadēka-vira-chaturvēdimaņgalam of tax-free land for providing sixty kalam of paddy annually for offerings to god Uyyakkonda-Nāyiṇār on the 12 days of festival in the Vaigāśi month.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Uyyakkoñdān-Tirumalai—concld.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Records an endorsement of tax-free land, by the Sabhāyār of Jagadēvakīra-chaturvēdimangalam for the expenses of the four days festival called the Vasantan-āruṇāl in the temple of Vilumīya-Nāyanar at Tirukakkudi Uyyakkondān-Tirumalai.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu

The land after being entered into the tax remission accounts was added to the dēvaśāna of the Vilumīya-Nāyanar temple. The record is signed at the end by Ponnāyacan Pallavarāyar of Tunjalūr in Mīlali-kūrram.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the remission of the kadamai and kudimai taxes on the village Nelkunram alias Irunkināperumāl-nallūr which was a dēvadāna/kani of the temple of Vilumīya- Nāyanar at Tirukakkudi in Uyyakkon-dān-kūrram, by the nāltaṇar of Vaja-kōn-kūn'du in Urattūr-kūrram as ordered by the king (Ulagudaiya-Perumal) to provide for the usual and special festival requirements of the temple.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the royal gift of two plots of land in the village Nerkuṇram alias Irunkiņāpperumālanallūr in Kōnādu alias Kadaladaiyādilangaiņādoḍa-valanādu, free of all taxes, for services in the temple of Vilumīya-Nāyanar and for a festival in the panguni month instituted formerly by king Alagiyadokkankarūr.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records grant o. the several kinds of taxes due to the king from the village for the expenses of worship and services in the temple by Mahāmāṇḍalēśvara Kodundēva-Mahārāja. See No. 378 above.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall, right of entrance
cells.remarks: Records a grant of 3 vēli of land and a house site by Annappudayar for feeding Brāhmaṇas in the choultry and for the expenses of a day's festival in the Panguni month.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall, right of entrance
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 12th century A. D. States that this is the gift of Tērri-Periyan alias Edirilisōja-Mūvendavēlān of Kūrrūr in Kūrrā-kūrram in Utṭungatunga-valnādu.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall, right of entrance
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Puyilali-Nadu, etc. Damaged. Seems to record a gift of land after purchase by a damaged (name lost) of Kikkalūr-nāḍu in Ikkāṭṭu-kōttam, a sub-division of Jayankoṇḍasōla-maṇḍalam, for the expenses of the aradhana service in the temple.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall, right of entrance
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record the formation of a new colony of merchants after acquiring lands and house-sites for the purpose in the village, under the name Koṅgu[koṇḍa]- sōlapuram, by order of the king, at the request of Toṇḍamān (the chief of the district); and states that the assessment of 23,000 kālam of paddy on cultivable lands and 1000 kāśu on dry lands (by the inhabitants). Quotes the 14th year of Kulōttunga-Chōladēva, 'who abolished the tolls'.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall, right of entrance

= A. D. 1244, May 4, Wednesday ; .48 ; f.d.n. .12.]
cells.remarks: Records a tax-free gift of land after purchase at Jagadēkavirachaturvēdimangalam by Pi[l]laiyār a[l]as Dēvaral Sēnāpatingaigal, a maid-servant of the temple, for worship and offerings and special festivals in honour of the goddess installed by her.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK · Pēttava[y]iṭṭalai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of manḍapa in front of central shrine Madhyarjuna temple.

cells.remarks: Built in at the ends of lines and incomplete. Seems to record the re-consecration of two temples, viz., of Avarīsvara and Madhyarjuna and the renovating the temple of Madhurāntikavaradayamanma-Avanīsamudrā[dhi]rāja, in Sūralūr-kūṟṟam, a subdivision of Rājarāja-vaḻanādu, by the nagarattār of the place, who also made provision for worship in them.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK · Peruṅguḍi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the central shrine, Agastyēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Gift of land by the Peruṅguḍi-Mahāsabhā of Jagadēkavirachaturvēdimangalam in Uraiyūr-kūrram, a subdivision of Rājarājāmbirāla-vaḻanādu on the southern bank, for conducting a festival in the temple of Tiruvagastīśvaramuḍaiya- Nāyaṇār at Peruṅguḍi, a hamlet of their village.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Gift of land after purchase by Kāmampuruṇān, the wife of Sembiyan Urrattirākkūṇ [alias] Mayilai-Tiṇḍan of Peruṅguḍi, for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tiruppurumuḍi-Paramēśvara.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Agastyēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Records a remission of taxes granted by the king on a land belonging to the temple for conducting a festival for the deity in Chaitirai month.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Agastyēśvara temple †
cells.date: 10th year, Kanni, ba. 13, Sunday, Punarppūsam and 19th year.
cells.remarks: States that a goldsmith of the place, named Kuṭṭaṇ gave three kaḻañju of gold for completing an unfinished portion of the wall and that he presented a forehead plate to the god in the 19th year, in gratitude for the recovery of the eye-sight of his son Nallamaṅgai.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the mandapa in front of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Records an endowment of land after purchase by Mayilai Tiņdaņ, mentioned in No. 392 above, for the several requirements of the temple.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records an agreement by two Šivabrāhmanas of the temple to burn a twilight lamp before the deity for 2 kāšu received by them from Triyambakaņ, a Kaikkóla of Peruņguđi.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK · Peruṅguḍi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Gift of sheep for a lamp in the temple by Maňjaņ Šēndi, the wife of a resident of Vayalūr (name lost).

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—concld. / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK—concld. / Perunguđi.—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of Agastyēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Records an agreement given to the temple by the dēvakarmis to pay as a kadam of paddy on every mā on 84 mā of land belonging to the village (which they had probably taken out on lease) for meeting the expenses of the festival in the month of Āni.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK — Tamil Nadu

cells.place: Another pillar in Agastyēśvara temple. †

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / TRICHINOPOLY TALUK — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: MALABAR DISTRICT / PALGHAT TALUK · MALABAR DISTRICT. / PALGHAT TALUK. — Kerala

cells.remarks: In characters of about the 14th century A.D. Records the perpetual devotion (tōgol) of Vīrappaṉ, the Kaḍanākṣi of Magadāraya-Paḍāyāṭchi. Perhaps the gift of this beam was made by the person named above.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / ARNI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall, right of entrance, of the front gōpura of Śiva temple. †
cells.date: Śaka 147[9], Pingala, Mārga, i 25, śu. 12, Monday, Rēvatī.
cells.remarks: Left unfinished. Seems to record an endowment of land for the daily worship and feeding of the god [and] flower-garden for the temple at Aṟiyalaḍaiyāppattu in Vāṅgōppādi-nādu, a dēva-dānam of Āṇṇamalaiyār (Aṟupachalēśvara at Tiruvannāmalai) by Viśvanātha-Nāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / ARNI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up to the west of the village
cells.date: Śaka 1474, Pratīchāpi, Vṛiśchika, śu. 3, Friday, Mūlam.
cells.remarks: Records the grant of the different kinds of taxes realised from the wares brought for sale in the Sunday market newly opened by Viśvanātha-Nāyaka for the same purpose mentioned above.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT. / SAIDAPET TALUK.
cells.place: Paļavantāngal.—On a stone set up in the village.
cells.date: Śaka 1452, Vikriti, Dakshiṇāyana, Vriśchika, śu. Paurnamī, Friday, Krittikā.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the grant of the villages Gaṅgaiṇallūr and Paiyavaṇkāḍal as dēvadāna to the temple of Subrahmaṇya called Suruvidi-Nayanār at Kōyampūṇḍu for the merit of the king by Mahāpradhāna Sāluva-Daṇṇāyaka of Kāñchīpuram. Nearby another slab containing a highly damaged inscription of the same king, records also the gift of a village (name not clear) to the same temple.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Vaḻaiyāvākkam
cells.place: West wall of the ruined Śiva temple on the roadside.
cells.remarks: An agreement by the Śivabrāhmaṇas of Maḻaiyāṭṭi Tuḻakkulaṇdān-Paṇḍitan Idanikkit-Bhaṭṭan to burn a twilight lamp in the temple of Tiruvēlūramudaiya-Nāyaṇār at Vaḻaiyākkam in Mēlūr-nāḍu for 1½ gaṇḍa-gōpāla-paṇḍam received by him from a lady, the wife of another Śivabrāhmaṇa of a temple at Kommaṇapākkam.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Tiruvaiyambāḍi
cells.place: North wall of the central shrine in the Ugrēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Records an agreement given by the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple at Tiruvaḷambāḍi in Perumūr-nāḍu, a sub-division of Ikkāttuk-kōṭṭam in Jayakoṇḍaśōla-maṇḍalam, for a twilight lamp to the god for 4 kāśu received by them from Tiruvaḍai, wife of the headman of Nogaṇali.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records a similar agreement by the Śivabrāhmaṇas to burn a twilight lamp for 3 kāśu endowed by four brothers.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Tiruvaiyambāḍi
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records a similar agreement by the Śivabrāhmaṇas for 4 kāśu received by them from Kayilāyamuḍaiyān Uyyaṅkoṇḍān a resident of the village.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Tiruvaiyambāḍi
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Another agreement similar to the above, for an endowment of 4 kāśu, for a lamp in the temple of Tiruvaḷambōgi-Uḍaiyār.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Tiruvaiyambāḍi
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Similar agreement for 3 kāśu endowed for a lamp by a resident of Mēliṅgaikkāvuṇḍuūr in the name of his wife, Alkoṇḍānachi-Ammai.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Tiruvaiyambāḍi
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of cows for a lamp in the temple by Nārāyaṇa Saṅkaran of Neṇṇamalēri in Malai-maṇḍalam.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Tiruvaiyambāḍi
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the gift of money for a twilight lamp in the temple by a certain Malaikiniyaṇiṅgāṉ.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: Records gift of lamp to the temple by Sivapâdasêkharan SûlapâniyAn of Nallâdi.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: Records gift of lamp to the temple by Sivapâdasêkharan SûlapâniyAn of Nallâdi.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: Similar agreement given by the same Sivabrâhmanas to a resident of Vayalkkâvûr in Paluvûr-nâḍu, a sub-division of Kâlyûr-kottam.

cells.remarks: Similar agreement given by the same Sivabrâhmanas to a resident of Vayalkkâvûr in Paluvûr-nâḍu, a sub-division of Kâlyûr-kottam.

cells.remarks: Similar agreement given by the same Sivabrâhmanas to a resident of Vayalkkâvûr in Paluvûr-nâḍu, a sub-division of Kâlyûr-kottam.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Tiruvaiyambāḍi — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records a royal order making a gift of land as dēvadāna for offerings and worship to the god and for making a tirunandāvanam and a flower-garden for the temple.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Tiruvaiyambāḍi — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: Records gift of 2 mādai of gold for a twilight lamp in the temple by a resident of Tiruvannaiyūr.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Tiruvaiyambāḍi — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: Records gift of land by purchase for a perpetual lamp in the temple by Poṇṇanachchutai Madhurāntakadēvar alias Mādavaṟaiyan.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the Pāṇḍya shrine.
cells.remarks: States that the tirumāḷigaippāḍigai of the temple was the foundation of a certain lady, ....,[daughter of] the servant (dēvadāsi) of the temple.

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: States that the taxes including īyam and antarāyam on the dēnadāna lands of the temple were got remitted by Puṇōlyī Dēviyār, the senior wife of Yādavarāyar alias Tirukkājatti-dēva of the Chandra-vahnā and the daughter of Parraiyār Pattiyaraiśar of Maddhamadēśa (Madhyamadēśa).

cells.location: CHINOLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up in the village
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of 45 sheep for a half-lamp [in the temple].

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VĪDDHACHALAM TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT. / VĪDDHACHALAM TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Vṛiddhāchalam.—Wall of the maṇdapa at the head of the steps leading into the river
cells.remarks: States that the stone steps of the Mapimuktā river were constructed by Settiyappa-Jñāniyār of Olagamādēvipuram with the financial help of Kājatti-Settlyār, a merchant of Chennapattanam and that this was recorded on stone by Aruṇāchala-Paṇdāram of the Aiyāyiravar-majam who supervised the construction.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VĪDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall (inside) of the outer prākāra of the Vṛiddhagīrīsvara temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record the construction of the prakāra wall by Muddukrishṇappa-Nāyaka, [son of] Krishṇappa Nāyaka.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VĪDDHACHALAM TALUK · Śāttakkūḍai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up in a field
cells.remarks: Records a saramādyam gift of wet land made in the time of Tiruvēṅkaṭa-Śēshādri at Śāttakkūḍai situated in the svāmibhōga of Pillai-porukkika-Piḷḷai at Śāṇmūkāla-Piḷḷai Āryankāṇ-Piḷḷai of midday worship in the temple of Kalīśvarasvāmi.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VĪDDHACHALAM TALUK · Rājēndrappaṭṭaṇam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Wall of the gōpura, Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning for the major portion. Seems to record a gift of land free of all taxes for worship in the temple (name lost).

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VĪDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillar in the maṇḍapa of the Śiva temple
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 8th century A.D. Mentions Sāri-putra, discople of Buddhavarmā.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VĪDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another pillar in Śiva temple †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 7th century A.D. Reads ‘Śrī-Maki(ndra)’.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VĪDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Third pillar in Śiva temple †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 8th century A.D. Reads ‘Śrī-Śāntasēni’.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VĪDDHACHALAM TALUK · Wallār — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the central shrine in the Viśvārāyśvara temple.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 12th century A.D. States that the image of Durgā (in the niche ?) was consecrated by Vaiġavāduyan Segai Nallaṉgāviyāṉ.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT-contd. / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK-contd. / Nallūr-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Viśvārāyśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Records the sale by the āṉattār of the temple, of the right of singing the hymn (Tiruvembāvai-Mudalpāṭu) in the temple of Naḷḷuṇāyanār and of accompanying the god on foot and in the car in procession, to two dēvaradiyār for a kāśu and half.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Seems to record a similar sale of the turning of dēvaraḍiyār named Mādū[mi] alías Kōvaparvutalā.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT-contd. / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK-contd. / Nallūr-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Registers the gift of the whole village of Naḷḷūr consisting of 360 vēli of land and of other pieces elsewhere amounting to ten vēli and odd with their income in taxes like mākkālam, ayam and kījirātpām for the requirements of the temple of Naḷḷuṇāyanār at Naḷḷūr by Alappirandān Mōgan alias Kāḍavarāyan.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Viśvārāyśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Records the gift, with its income in taxes like pāḍikāval, taṟiṅgai, etc., of 5 mā of land other than those mentioned in No. 145 above by Irumuḍichōla-Mūvaraiyan Amattai of Karuppūr.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Seems to be connected with No. 145 above. Registers a gift of 370 vēli of land, of which 360 vēli were in Naḷḷūr, 5 vēli of ḍhōṭa garden in Ānāṅgūr and 5 vēli at Naḷḷūr in vakkudi as archandhabhōga to the temple of Naḷḷūr by a person called Dhammaputtiran, (evidently Kāḍavarāyan).

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT-contd. / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK-contd. / Nallūr-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 12th century A.D. Records the consecration of the image of Dakshiṇāmūrti and an endowment of wet lands for worship daily by a certain Māṇḍai Ponnan alias . . . . ōḍa-Malayamāṇ of (village) Sāttiyakkam.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT-contd. / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK-contd. / Nallūr-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Registers the sale of the right of singing the Tiruvembāvai [vaṇ] kadakkāppām in the temple of Nalluṇāyanār to the raḍiyāl by name Udayaṅkāñchi alias Kuḷōttuṅgaśōḷamāṇikkam by the āṉattār of the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT-contd. / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK-contd. / Nallūr-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the construction of a shrine for and consecration of the image of Dakshiṇāmūrti in the temple of Naḷḷūr by Aḍavalla-Nambi of Koḍuṅgalūram, who stated also to have endowed a quarter vēli of wet land for offerings and lamps to the deity.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT-contd. / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK-contd. / Nallūr-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Registers an endowment of the village Kūchākuvakuṭṭi in Nallanāḍu, as dēvadāna to the temple of Nalla-Nāyinar Rājārājadēvan alias Vāṇakōvaraiyan of Āṅgalūr. This is signed at the end by Magadai-rāyan alias Vāṇakōvaraiyan who was perhaps the donor himself or the officer who issued the order.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Viśvārāyśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of millet received in specified quantity on each vēli of land in the dēvadāna village from the tenants as the pāṭikāval fee by Rājarājadēvan Ponparappinān Vānakōvaraiyan for offerings to god Ponparappiśvaramudaiya-Nāyanār set up as an āśrayalinga in the temple by Tillaināysakavēlān.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Highly damaged and fragmentary. Mention the nāttārar of Chiṟuttamēli-Iruṅgōlarai of Iruṅgōlappāḍi and of Rājarājappāḍi.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Viśvārāyśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records an endowment of 7 mā of land after clearing jungle made by Tappiyil Tāḹyvāḹi alias Tirūkkāḹiruppuḍai-Nāṅgai, a dēvadāniyil of the temple for special worship on festival days.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Viśvārāyśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Begins with the historical introduction Samastajagadādhāra, Records a royal order addressed to the nattār of Nallanādu, the endowment of the village Nallūr to the temple of Nayanar for the maintenance of a service in the name of the king and for (the expenses of the) festival in the month of Tai.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records a similar royal order issued to the nāttār of the temple making a tax-free gift of the village Vāṇakūttūr in the proportion of three shares to one for the expenses of a festival called after the king and the daily worship and service in the name of the king and for the worship of the images of (Vira-) pāṇḍīsuvaramuḍaiya-Nāyanār and Dēsāmikks-Perumānachchiyar consecrated by the same prince in the temple, Sundara-Pāṇḍya is called in the inscriptions 'Ubhayadafa- Samaraṅkāra'.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT-contd. / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK-contd. / Nallūr-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records an endowment of land for singing of Tiruchchalal and for offerings to the goddess in the temple of Nalla-Nāyanar by Kōvaip-Valaiyan alias Vāṇaraiyappēraraiyan.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT-contd. / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK-contd. / Nallūr-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.date: Śaka 1415, Ānanda, Kumbha, ba. monday, Punarpūsam.
cells.remarks: Records the grant of Truppēru, a hamlet of Tūliyūr on the north bank of the river, as an archandogai on sarvamāniga for the expenses of special worship and other services on the Mākhā in the temple of Nalla-Nāyanar, for the welfare of Rāja-Kōnēridēva-Mahārāja who is given the birudas, Faltukatirāyigal, Vāsūvasākāravan, Madāgīdamannar-māyanayaka and Kānchīpuravarādhīsvaran.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT-contd. / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK-contd. / Nallūr-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: States that this maṇḍapa is (the gift of) Rājarijādēvan alias Poṇparappān and that it was constructed by Sundar- Bajuvan alias Tillaināyaka-Vīlān of Aigūr.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK—concld. / Nallür—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record the appointment of Būmāvi, daughter of Pōrkōyil-Nangai, as the dēvaraḍiyāl of the temple for performing the dēkkaiam (dance) and singing the tiruppadiyam before the deity on certain terms (details lost) on the demise of one Udayaṅkāñchi alias Kuḷōttuṅga-māṇikkam, daughter of Tiruvēgamā-Nangai.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK—concld. / Nallür—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records a similar appointment by the āṉattār of the temple, of Ālvi Valuyamalaigai Paḍinçēmā-Naṅgai, as a dēvaraḍiyāl, to sing the Tiruvembāvai (Tiruvām-tiruppāṭu) and to dance before the deity on specified occasions, for 3 kuḻi-ju of gold received by them.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South and east walls of Viśvārāyśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to record a gift of land to the temple of Kaṇilīsamuḍaiya-Nāyanār at Vaṇṇattūri.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of Viśvārāyśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Records an endowment of land at . . vindalūr, a suburb of Pāṇdapuram in Ālārrūr-kūrram, a subdivision of Malāđu alias Jananātha-[valanāđu], for a perpetual lamp in the temple at Nal[lūr]; which is stated to be in the same kūrram, by Mānikkanāyāṇ Gangayurāyāṇ, son of Sembōdi Villavadaraiyar of Pajampattinam in Pattiṇa-nāđu, a subdivision of Sembūr-kōttam. (Vide: A.R. No 480 of 1937-38: 308 and 304 of 1939-40).

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.language: Tamil (verse) †
cells.remarks: Two verses in praise of Paraṇivāṉaṭṭu-Nambi as a devotee of Śiva and a patron of poets.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the outer gōpura in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Ends of lines built in. Seems to state that the gateway of the sadhia was the gift of Aṅgippraṇādan Kōpperuñjōganādar.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · Ulaganallūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the central shrine in the Šiva temple.
cells.date: Šaka 1418, Naja, Makara, 6u. Pūrnai, Wednesday, Āyilyam, lunar eclipse
cells.remarks: Records the remission granted by Tyāgarāja-Nāyakkar who held the nāyakattanam over Malaḍu (?), for the welfare of svāmi Narasā-Nāyakkar-Udaiyār, of the tax nilavaikāṇikkai which had been unjustly levied in the time of Daļavāy Kempaiyan of Kiḷ-Aṇai (Kiliyanūr) and Muddayi-Varaḍarāyar alias Poṇparappinā-Nāyanār and other temple lands in villages round about Kaḷaikkuṅkuṟuḷi.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: The characters are of the 13th century A.D. A deed by som[e] officers of the king and certain madaigrāmam exemption from the payment of paṭṭayam on the dēvadāna lands belonging to god Poṇparappina-Chōliśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyanār at Ulagayavaliyanallūr from the seventh year of the king's reign.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Śiva temple †
cells.remarks: Gives a list of some lands presented to the temple. Mentions a certain Iruṅgolappāḍi-elān. The writing belongs to about the 13th century A.D.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Śiva temple †
cells.remarks: Records a royal order granting half a vēli of land tax-free for worship to god Vaṇ neñja-Chōjīsvaramudaiya-Nāyaṇār consecrated in the temple by Vāṇādarāyaṇ as ādrayalinga, with effect from the 16th year (of the king). The inscription is signed at the end by Vāṇakōvaraiyaṇ and Vijuppādarāyaṇ. The writing belongs to about the 13th century A.D.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Śiva temple. †
cells.remarks: Grant of 500 kuḻi of land tax-free in their village by the sabhā and the ūrār of Ulagāvaliyanallūr under royal orders, for worship to the god in the tiruṇīlakaṇṭakōilmuḍaiya- Periya-nāchchiyār in the temple with effect from the 7th year of the reign of the king'.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records an assurance given on oath on Śivans' Iśvara-Nākam by Tippaiya-Nāyakkar to the Nāttāvar of Magadai-maṇḍalam that he would not levy any taxes from them beyond the rates specified in the aḍai-ōlai executed by him nor disturb any household (as a consequence). This assurance was the resumption of steps made by the nāttāvar that their families were broken up on account of several hardships suffered by them.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Śiva temple †
cells.remarks: A royal order making an endowment of 500 kuḻi of land taxfree to the goddess Tirukkilākkūttu-mēl-aiyā-Periya-ndchehiyār in the temple with effect from the 11th year of the reign of the king. The signatories at the end are Vāṇakōvaraiyan, Villavaraiyan and Viluppāḍaraiyan.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: An order of Vāṇakōvaraiyan issued to the anthigāri and ūrār remitting the taxes on a thousand kuḻi of temple land (tirunāmattukkāṇi) for the welfare of Vaṇṇāḍa-Nāyanār (king).

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · Ulaganallūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Gift of 4 vēli of land tax-free by Ulagagaṇḍa, Vāṇakōvaraiyar for the pro-perity of his house, to the temple of Poṇparappināvaraṇamuḍaiya-Nāyanār at Ulagāvaliyanallūr in Vaḍa-Narayūrnāḍu in Milādu alias Jananātha-vaḷanādu. This was supplemented later by an additional gift of 4 vēli of land at Ambaṇatūr by order of the king.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Wall of the west verandah (over the entrance into the central shrine).
cells.remarks: A (royal) gift of 500 kuļi of tax-free land for offerings to the goddess from the 7th year (of the king), by order of Vāṇakō-varaiyar.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the second prākāra, Śiva temple. †
cells.remarks: Specifies the names of the dancing women who were to dance and sing before the god on each of the days of certain festivals in the temple. Signed by Vāṇadaraiyan at the end.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK · KALLAKURICHI TALUK—contd. / Ulaganallur—concl. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab lying in the prākāra of Śiva †
cells.remarks: An agreement by the nallāvar of Kallikurichchi to make an annual gift of 12 kalam of oil for a perpetual and a twilight lamp in the temple and for torches on the days of festival every month.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Inner wall of the gopura in Śiva temple. †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 15th century A.D. Records the construction by Aṇṇāyanitta-Śējādaraiyar, son of Irugikinaperumal Sējādaraiyar, and his wife Muttu Nacchiyar, of the high wall of the Ardhamandapa temple, gopura, the shrine for the goddess, the stepped-well, the tank with its steps and maṇḍapa, the cowshed, the kitchen and the car and the gift of several requirements for the festivals in the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Below sculptured panels containing human figurines in the outer gopura of Śiva temple. †
cells.remarks: Gives the names of the figures above. One is in characters of the 16th century A.D. and reads Nayināttai-Pijjai. The other labels which are earlier gives the names of Pachchai-Āāri Āraṇipperumāl-Āāri of Tiruvadikupṇam and Aru-[mai]-Āāri of the same place.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the ruined Vishnu temple.
cells.remarks: In characters of the 14th century A.D. States that this maṇḍapa is the gift of Pichchan Singaraiyan of Neduvāyūr.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK · Varadarājaṇ — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the central shrine in the Pāśupatīśvara temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1227, Viéā-['vasu'], Dhanus, ba. 1, Sunday, Tiruvādirai.
cells.remarks: Gift, after purchase, of land at Kaṛuppuḍaiyūr forming part of Pāṇḍapuram in Malāḍu alias Jananātha-vajanāḍu, for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tiruvalañjuramuḍaiya-Nāyanār by Māṇattanāyaṇ Gāngayanāyaṇ, son of Śembōdi Villavadaraiyar of Palampattiṇam in Pattiṇa-nāḍu. (Vide No. 163 above; and A.R. 480 of 1937-38; 303, 304 of 1939-40).

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Pāśupatīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Records the remission of all the taxes due to the nāḍu (nāḍāni[ni]ttam) in the araṇ-puram villages Tiruvaraiñjpuram, Guṇamaṅgalam and Nāvalūr-kilvalai in favour of the temple by order of the king.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Pāśupatīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Records the addition of the first inner tier and bolt to the platform of the temple by a kāraikkāḍu named Amarakoṇ.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the Chōla same shrine.
cells.remarks: Records the admittance into the Iḍangai community, of the Maḷayamakkal and Naṭamakkal of Jānanātha-valaṇādu by the nāllāvar of the several nāḍus assembled at Tiru-vaḷiñjpuram.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Pāśupatīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 14th century A.D. Records a gift of 3 mā of land at Maruvūr (a hamlet of Pāndīpuram in Mēlai Ālram, for offerings and a perpetual lamp in the temple of Sattappayakkar and Mallappa-Nāyakkar, son of somevānāyaka-Nāyakkar. Above these lines is one of writing which give the date Saka 1293, [V]irōdhikrit, ba., 1, Sunday, Tiruvādirai.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall Pāśupatīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Records the permission given to the temple by Kuppan Vēdi-rājēndrayadēva thirubhuvanādhipati Valavakkuvān, the headman of Maņarpakkan (evidently an officer), to utilise for burning 60 lamps every day during service, the yield of additional trees which had been planted in the dēvadāna lands, over and above the quarter share of the produce already allotted to it by the state.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: An agreement by three Sivabrāhmaņas of the temple to maintain a twilight lamp in the temple for a hundred kāśu received by them from a resident of Maņarpakkan in Tiruvavaraiji-ram is here stated to be situated in Meyppūr-kūṟṟam.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK · Varadarājaṇ — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: The characters are of about the 14th century A.D. In-complete. Seems to record a gift of the land belonging to Mōrur-uļaiyan at Guņamaingalam to the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK · Varadarājaṇ — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the endowment of the village Malayānyūr together with all its taxes for worship and service in the temple by Magadaināyakan Rājēndraśōlan alias Vaņakkōvaraiyan.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK · Varadarājaṇ — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.date: Šaka 1422 (wrong for 1420), Kāļayukti, Makara, 6u. 7, Friday, Ratha-saptamī.
cells.remarks: Records the endowment of the village Gaņjardattāmangalam in Pāndūpara-puṟṟu, a subdivision of Alāri-kūṟṟam by Salakayadēva Mahārāja and the Nāttavar of the pāṟṟu for special worship on every Amāvāsya day for the victory (jayamjaya) of the king (Swami Mahārāyar).

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK · Varadarājaṇ — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 12th century A.D. Gift of a vessel weighing 37 palaṁ to the temple by a shepherd named Irājan Nakkaṟan.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Inaiyūr.-Broken stone lying in a street.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions Iraiyūr.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Kuṟāttūr (Elavanāsur). Stone set up in a dry field to the south of the village.
cells.remarks: Records gift of the village Kuṟāttūr (renamed Kāśi-Viśvanātha-nallūr) in Śīkkāṭṭūr-nādu, to provide for the images of Viśvanātha and Koṇḍeśvara by Krishṇāya-Nāyakaḥ son of Ma-Nāyakar, on the occasion of the Mahōdaya.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK · 'Śīkkāṭṭūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North and west walls of the central shrine in the dilapidated Siva temple.
cells.remarks: Built in and incomplete. Seems to record a royal grant of 9½ māvam for a perpetual lamp before the image of Vi[m]yāka in the temple of Āgastyēśvara, re-consecrated for the welfare of king Achyutarāyadēva-Mahārāya.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUKKOYILUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Siva temple †
cells.remarks: A royal order to the dānattār of the temple of Śīkkāḍuļaiya-Nāyanār granting some specified plots of land for the expenses of the service conducted in the name of (king) Vikramā Pāṇḍya, for the monthly festivals and for a perpetual lamp.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT-concld. / KALLAKURICHI TALUK-concld. / Varaiyāram-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Siva temple †
cells.remarks: Ends of lines lost. Seems to record an endowment of a village (name lost) on the [southern] bank of the river Peṇṇai in Vaļudullampattu-chīvaḍi by mahāpradhānaṇ Anna...

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to record a gift of land to the temple of Tiruvakkīśvaramudaiya-Nāyanār by Vīraṉ Kappudaiperuṇāl alias Vaniyāpuraṇdarāṉ of Neṟkunram, a member of the Pudinērisaigam (guild).

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT-concld. / KALLAKURICHI TALUK-concld. / Varaiyāram-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the construction of the tiara, entrance, etc., in the temple of Tiruvakkīśvaram-Uḍaiyār otherwise known as Periyaṇtiṟu-tiṟukkaraṇai, by a certain Pagaḍaṇ Uraṇ Dēvaṇ.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the maṇḍapa, right of entrance in Siva temple. †
cells.remarks: Records an agreement given by the ayyan, the regent of Kōṇḍrippur Piļļai to the temple, to receive certain specified amounts evidently at reduced rates on the different kinds of produce grown on some lands at Śikkāḍu which had gone fallow and lay neglected (and which had now been brought under cultivation).

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in front of Siva temple †
cells.remarks: States that two residents of the village built the tiruṇdukkai-kuṟi (wall) of the temple, reclaimed certain (temple) lands and instituted a festival for the goddess.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock on the hill
cells.language: Tamil (verse) †
cells.remarks: Records the construction of a tank by Kōṇḍriyarāya for growing red lilies for worship to the god Śikkā[ṭ]ṭu-Īśar.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK · Kāttu-Iśaiyār — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the Chidambarēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Records the endowment of Attiyappattu, a hamlet of Iśaiyā-rājyār, as tax-free dēvadāna to the temple of Tirunalaṁ-puriñdarālu-Nāyanār (Naṭarāja) at Iśaiyāru belonging to Adaṇiyūr, for the expenses of worship and offerings during the service called Rājakkā[ṇ]ḍam instituted in the name of the royal donor and during festival days.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of Chidambarēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: States that the pattugappadai of the maṇḍapa-maṇḍapa in the temple to the length of three cubits was the gift of Paṭṭan Nambi, son of Maṅgalānuttapparaiyan Poriyan.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|xxvii||101" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. XXVII, No. 101</button>

filters.also: Also in another book we hold

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in front of Chidambarēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: States that the tirumalaivāsayagam known as Seyyampogan was (the gift of) the king who is also styled a devotee of Alagiya Tiruchchirambalam-Uḍaiyār.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in a dry land about a mile to the north of the village.
cells.remarks: The characters are of about the 15th century A.D. Records the gift of (the village) Sōlapānd[yapūram] by the ūruvar of Sengaṇāngollai as the tirukkaiva;akkam of the god at Tiruk-kōvalūr for the maintenance of the Šivandakālalagiyārmaḥa.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place:
Širunāvalūr.—Rock in a dry land to the south of the village.
TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT
cells.remarks: Carelessly engraved and fragmentary. Mentions (village) Irašai.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK · Śendurai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of the Śiva temple
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records a gift of land after purchasing it from the sabhā of Śendurai by a certain Teṉṉavan Pāttirāśēkharan to the temple of Śendurai-Mahādēva for the conduct of a festival in the month of Tai-māśam. The village of Śendurai is stated to have been a dēvadānabrahmadēya situated in Tuṇḍanāḍu.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register a gift of land for worship in the temple. Mentions the temple of Kōdaṇḍa-Tambirāṉār.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the same temple
cells.remarks: Connected with No. 207 above.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of a bell to the temple by Pēraiyaṉ Śāndan Kūttan of Palivēḷūr.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK · Koṭumbāḷūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East tier of the maṇḍapa of the recently excavated Aivar temple.
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Stops with the mention of a lady by name Aṉantam Paḷiyili of Uraiyūr.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same tier
cells.remarks: Records a gift of ten pon for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tiru-Aindali-Mādēva at Uṭṭattūr-kūṟṟam by Tāḷi Śāttan alias Rāśiṅgappallavaraiyaṉ on behalf of (his wife) Tāḷi Araṅgai.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South tier of Aivar temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of 30 kalañju of gold for a perpetual lamp to the temple by Dēvaputran Mārgaśāyi.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same tier
cells.remarks: Gift of 16 kalañju of gold for another perpetual lamp by Dēvaputran Mārgaśāyi.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK · Śittannavāśal — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Wall to the left of the rock-out cave.
cells.language: Tamil (verse) †
cells.remarks: Same as A.R. No. 368 of 1904. Records the renovation of the temple of Paṇṇavar (Jaina god) and provision made for worship therein by gifts of money by Iḷautamavām of Madura in the reign of Śrīvallabha Avaṉipēdēkhara. (See also A.R. for 1930, pt. II., para. 4).

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK · Nūrttāmalai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: States that this temple (originally) founded by Śāttampuḍi alias Iḷaṅgō-Āḍiraiyar having been destroyed by (heavy) rains, was renovated by Mallan Viḍuman alias Teṉṉavaṉ Tamil-Adiaraṉ.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / KALLAKURICHI TALUK · Viśālūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the Śiva Cōḻa temple.
cells.remarks: Records tax-free endowment of lands made to the temple of Vāsukīśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēva by the ūrār of Viśālūr in Milēlai-nāḍu for worship and offerings to the deity.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PUDUKKOTTAI STATE · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT-concld. / PUDUKKOTTAI STATE-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Sembāttūr.-Pedestal of a seated Yakshi image found in the Siṁgārattōppu near the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: States that this Yakshi (imago) was made by Mēvandā-lvār of Jayakoṇḍaśōlamangala-nādu.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PUDUKKOTTAI STATE — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Nirppalaṇi.-Slab with triśūla figure set up in front of the Vaļarmadaīvara temple.
cells.remarks: Lower portion built in. Records the consecration of this Sīla-tammadi by a certain Kauṇi Araiyaṇ of Nirppalani who calls himself 'the foremost of the Tāmaraikkulam'.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PUDUKKOTTAI STATE — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same slab
cells.remarks: Do. Gives a list of gifts in money evidently made to the temple by several persons.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PUDUKKOTTAI STATE — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Maļakkōttai.-Wall of the eastern rockout cave.
cells.remarks: A rectangular space marked off by thick line contains the inscription in lines one below another. The first three lines in the same script and to its proper right are two which seem to refer to the divine qualities of this (instrument).

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PUDUKKOTTAI STATE — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Kunnāṇdārkōyil.-Wall of the rock-cut cave.
cells.remarks: In characters of the 8th century A.D. Mentions Kandavarāchēni, wife of Siṅgan.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT. / MADURA TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Niļaiyūr.-South side of the sluice called Paṇamadaļ near the tank bund.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 9th century A.D. Gives the name Śrī Vīra-Nārāyaṇan.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · Kūḍalnāgarikku. (hamlet of Nilaiyūr) — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab lying near the village Chiṁvaḍi.
cells.remarks: Records an adai-śāsanam given to lady resident of Nilaiyūr by a certain Aṇṇamalai-Nāyakkar. Mentions Kūdaiyūr-guṇyu.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Vaḍa-Palaiyil.-Slab set up in front of the Vināyaka shrine.
cells.remarks: Seems to record a sarvamānya gift of the village Māvāraṇyar-gaydaṇ-pēttai alias Vaḍapalaiyil by Mahāpradhāna Māvali-Vāṇādarāyar (probably to the temple at Madura).

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab lying in a garden in the same village (as Vināyaka shrine) †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 12th century Anūdan alias Mupaṇyil Mugalamangaiyaṇ that he would not survive (his master) Vāļavaṇdān Dōvaṇ alias Kaļļagarāyaṇ.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Mullippaļlam.-Two stones lying in the premises of the dilapidated Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record a gift (of sheep) for a perpetual lamp (in the temple) by Pōriyangi, wife of Kārāmbichheṭṭa Udayasēvakara Bhaṭṭa[r] of the 5th chēri (quarter of the village).

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two other stones lying in the place of Śiva MEŁŪR TALUK. †
cells.remarks: Commences with the Praśasti Tribhuvanadēva, etc. Seonna Kōṭṭai. Mentions an endowment to the temple by a native of Kōṭṭiūr. Mentions (an officer) Rājēndrōla-Amarakōtika.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place:
Kōtṭainattappatti. (near Aribelakkāranpatti).—Door jamb to the proper right of entrance into the dilapidated Śiva temple.

RAMNAD DISTRICT.
cells.remarks: Modern. Records the construction of this Iśvara temple by three persons.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · Śēttīr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the central shrine in the Sulōchanēśvara temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1483, 13th year, Durmati, Dakshipāyana Mēshaṛitu, Kanṇi-Ravi 19, śu. 10, Thuresday, Uttirājam.
cells.remarks: An order purporting to have been issued by god Dṛishrtīśvara ratifying the appointment made by prince Alagan Perumāl Ativirarāma of Ūruđaiya-Mudali alias Virapānd[ya*]n śūdikkođutta-Mudali of the temple of Tiruvālavāyuđaiyār at Māđakku[akki]madurai as the accountant of this temple, with the remuneration pertaining to the post specified. Šērrūr is stated to be situated in Aṇmarai-nāđu.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the remission by the king, of the taxes on quarter vaṭṭi of land endowed by Alaigan Śirigan alias Singalariyan of Sengamalam, for conducting offerings and for feeding taṇavānis in a mat́a built by the donor to the south of the temple of Kaṇṇudai-Iśvaramudaiya-Nāyanar.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone built into the west wall of Śulō-hanumānvan temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to record a mortgage deed (orri-ōlai).

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the Saundarayālaki-Amman shrine in Śulō-hanumānvan temple. †
cells.remarks: Beginning of lines lost. Records the construction of the shrine of Tirukkāmakkōtṭam Alagiyanāchchiyār in the temple at Semmaram alias Kulaśēkharapuram in Aṇmā-nāđu, by Šāttan Iravi of Kilkujam in Malaimaṇdalam.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Amman shrine †
cells.remarks: An agreement by the Sāmbhavīkhan of the temple of Kannudaiya-Iśvaranadiyār-Nāyanar to maintain a twilight lamp in the shrine of the goddess Alagiyanāchchiyār for money received from them for Kuñjiyaṇ Śangan alias Uvavēppumai, a tānattār of the place.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the central shrine in the Sēnivāsa-Perumāl temple.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Pūviṇkīlatti, etc. Records a royal order granting the village Tiruvaranganēri, tax-free, for the expenses of worship and offerings in the temple of Šeranārāyana Viṇnagar Ālvār built by Viradamuđitta-Perumāl. The village was left in charge of the nagarak-kaṇakku by name Pulivalamuđaiyān and his descendants as tenants.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Sēnivāsa-Perumāl temple †
cells.remarks: Do. Records another gift of half a vēli of land to the temple by the king at the request of his brother-in-law Viradamuđitta-Perumāl (mentioned above). The king is said to have been seated on his throne (Pallippiđam), Majavarāyan, in his palace at Madura, east of Māđakkujam in Madurēdaya-vajanāđu. Mentions Mantri Rāmaṇ alias Pallavarājan of Perumanalūr in Aṇda-nāđu.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT · RAMNAD DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: contd. SAVILLIPUTTUR TALUK—contd. Sēttūr—contd. Stones built irregularly into the walls of Sēnivāsa-Perumāl temple. †
cells.remarks: Begins with the foundation of the temple. Records an endowment for daily offerings and worship in the same temple by the nagarattār of Kulēśēkharapuram including the pieces already endowed by them to the temples at Tirumāliruñjōlai (Alagarkōyil) and at Śrīvilliputtūr.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North side of a hillock known as Moṭṭai-malai near the same village (as Sēnivāsa-Perumāl temple). †
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Seems to record a gift of land. Mentions Vāḷavand-ēri.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT · Dēvadānam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the central shrine in the Nuchchēdīśvara temple.
cells.king: Tribh. Kōnērimēṇkoṇḍa Perumāḷ Aḷagaperumāḷ Ātivīrarāman alias Śrīvallabhadēva.
cells.date: Šaka 1494, 10th year, Āngirasa, Uttarāyaṇe, Makara, šu. 7, Monday.
cells.remarks: Records an endowment evidently by the king, of three pieces of land at Śēṭṭūr-nāḍu in Aṇṇā-nāḍu for special offerings and worship to god Nāchchēdīśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyaṉār at Tiruppagavā-pūrai in Aṇṇā-nāḍu. Mentions a tank called Kōvaḷan-ēri among the boundaries.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.date: Śaka 1407, (in words) Riṣabha 26, ba. 8, Sunday, Uttiram.
cells.remarks: Purports to record an order of the god appointing a certain Maṇṇāḷvārkōṇār of the scribes for the temple, granting a piece of land as the remuneration.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North and west walls of Nuchchēdīśvara temple †
cells.date: 33+1st year (in words), Śimha 20, šu. 11, Wednesday, Chittirai.
cells.remarks: An order of the king to the āḷattār of the temple of Aḷudaiya-Nāyaṉār at Tiruppagavā-pūrai, granting a piece of land in Parāndēvaṉ (Parāntakan)-Maṅgalam-apparu in Āri-nāḍu for the expenses of the morning service to the deity, instituted by the royal donor.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Nuchchēdīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Built in the middle. Registers a similar gift of land called Peṟaṇēri by the king for the evening service of the deity, instituted by him in the temple.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.date: 31st year (in words), Kumbha 26, śu. 1, Friday, Puraṭṭādi.
cells.remarks: Records an order of the king issued from his office room (eṭuttu-maṇdapa) at Varatu[ṅga*]dēvanallīr in Āriya-nādu granting the village Tondaṇkulam for the expenses of the service called Āhavgrāmaṇ-šandi instituted by the king in the temple, of festivals and of the sacred bath on ashṭamī days in the da.k fortnights. Pūraṭṭādi is stated to be the natal star of the king. Refers to some previous gifts made by the king in his 28+2nd year and by Nāyaṇār Parākrama-Pāṇdyadēva. Refers also to a donation made for conducting Parākrama-Pāṇdyaṇ-šandi.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West and south walls of Nuchchēdīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of the village Tirukkuḷam by the king for the expenses of the midnight services in the temple and of the sacred bath during the Paṅguṇi-uttiram festival.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Nuchchēdīśvara temple †
cells.date: Śaka 1476, 12th year, Ānanda, Dakshināyana, Vriśchika, 22, ba. 12, Wednesday, Svāti.
cells.remarks: Records the appuṭṭam by prince Alagapperumāl, of Uruḍaimudali alias Virayāṇḍān at Tiruvāniyālaiyūr temple at Madurai east of Malakkulam via Madāpakaṇṇakāku in the temple with his remuneration specified. The king is also called Parākrama-Pāṇdyadēva in the body of the record.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the order of the king while staying at Dēvadānam appointing a certain Muđivelangumpān-lya-Brahmādarāyan alias Sūrya-Bhatṭa, the dēvakarmi of the Tirukkajāđaiya-Nāyanār temple at Katuvānallūr in Āri-nāđu, for worship in the temple of Tirruppagavaṇ-pārai-Āvuđaiya-Nāyanār, after its renovation.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the maṇṭapa in front of Nuchchēdīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Records a similar order of the king issue from his camp at Dēvadānam endowing a piece of land as tiruppavippuram (for service) to the temple.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.king:
Māyavarman alias Tribh.
Pāṇdyadēva. [Sundarakaradēva who having taken the Chōla country, was pleased to perform the anointment of heroes at Muḍikoṇdāśōlapuram].
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Records a gift of land by the nagarattār of Sōmaram alias Kulēśēkharapuram to a certain Tiru[vī]n-A[di]kāri Deva-Śēkhara-[kōnār] of the place as pulāma-oyutt (for his scholarship).

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT · Dēvadānam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record a gift of land for the repairs, etc., of the temple (tiruvāykkēlvikkam).

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place:
South and east walls of the same maṇṭapa
...
cells.date:
Śaka 1409 (in words),
2nd year (in words), Mithuna 16, ba. 7, Wednesday, Uttiraṭṭādi;
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Built in below. Stops with the mention of a native of Angalagonḍi belonging to the Vadhūla-gōtra and Āpastamba-sūtra.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same walls
cells.date:
Śaka 1409 (in words),
2nd year (in words), Mithuna 16, ba. 7, Wednesday, Uttiraṭṭādi;
cells.remarks: Built in at the end. Purports to record an order of the deity appointing a certain Śaṅkaranārāyaṇa-Bhaṭṭa of the Vasishṭha-gōtra-āśvalāyana-sūtra for the service of adhyāyana in the temple, with his descendants, on duty fixed by the grant of tax-free lands and house-site.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North and west bases of the Amman shrine in the same house temple.
cells.king: Jaṭāvarman alias Tribh. Kuṇ[ja]r malikoṇḍān Perumāl Abhirāma Varatuṅgarāman alias Vīra-Pāṇdyadēva.
cells.date:
Śaka 1520, 10th year, Hēvilambi, Mādi
22, śu. 7, Saturday, Anusham.
cells.remarks: Built in at the end. Records a gift of money by Alikaṇuṭṭaiyān Perumāl of Perumalur, a devādāna in Aṇmā-nādu for purchasing and maintaining flowergarden.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT. / NANGUNERI TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Tiriyāniyālai.-East wall of the Ādīkkaḷankāla-Vināyaka temple.
cells.remarks: States that Ādāikaṅkāla-Vināyaka is the protector of Mīḻakkāṁkhia-Piḷḷai, son of Śrī-Subrahmanya Piḷḷai of Aḷyār-Trunangari, probably meaning that he built this temple.

cells.location: Chittoor — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab built into the south wall of the prākāra of the Mahārājēvara (Śāstā) temple.
cells.remarks: Fragment. In characters of about the 13th century A.D. Seems to record an endowment of some plots of land as tax-free dēvadāna (to a temple) from the 40th year (of the king).

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—contd. / NANGUNERI TALUK—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Śingikulam.—South wall of the central shrine, Kailāsanātha temple.
cells.remarks: Beginnings of lines huilt in. Records an endowment of land made tax-free by the nagarattār of Piḷām alias Rājarijamaṅgalam in Tīrkarai-nādu, through Uḍaiyār Miṇṇarān Mādāṅkarai and dēsisanrir in the K-Aparāṇan maṅga attached to the temple of Kulēśēkhara-Iśvaram-Uḍaiyār of the place on certain festival days.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Unfinished.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—contd. / NANGUNERI TALUK—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Built in the middle by the Dakshinamurti shrine. Seems to record an order of the king issued from his palace at Kannanur, remitting the taxes on some lands endowed to the temple by the nagarattār of Piḷām.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—contd. / NANGUNERI TALUK—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Built in the middle by the Dakshinamūrti shrine. Records an order of the king issued while he was seated on the throne called Tiruviṇkāṇkā-Uḍaiyān in his palace at Viradhāvālam remitting taxes on several plots of land which had been endowed to the temple as adhyayanakarai, rīni-vritti tirumēṇippūchchuvuṇyam (for ungiven) and tirumāḷvānapuṇyam (for flower garden), etc.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Eastern wall of Kailāsanātha temple †
cells.remarks: This is connected with no. 257 above. The date is given as 11+1+1st year of the king. The lands endowed are stated here to have been left in charge of Aiyāyan alias Pāṇdya-Sēnādaraiyan who had the right of worship in the temple.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records a sale of land by the nagarattār of Piḷām to the temple making it tax-free. The sale is said to have been necessitated by the default in the payment of the taxes panjippuli and sandirōgaippēru by Viluppādārayar.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of Kailāsanātha temple †
cells.remarks: Another sale of house-site by the same community to the temple for the erection of an oil mill and for the oilmonger to live in, with the maṇiyāṇ-āḷukkādamai and other taxes being remitted.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: The inscription starts from bottom upwards. Built in at the ends of lines. Seems to record an endowment made in the 30th year of the king, of land for worship to the image of Kēraḷaṇtaka-Ïçvaramuḍaiyār (god set up and installed in the temple by a dēvaradiyāl of the temple, to whom the kārāṇmai (tenancy) right over the land endowed was given.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the maṇṭapa in front of Kailāsanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: An action in order of the king ratifying the decision of the nagarattōr of Pūlam alias Rājarājapuram fixing the amount of produce due from the several lands to the temple. Mentions a shrine and a land called after . . . Perumāl alias Uḍaiyār Mā[ṇikkavāchakat]tigaḷ.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of the same maṇṭapa
cells.date: 13th year (fi. year ?), Āvaṇi 29, ba. 12, Wednesday, Āyil-yan.
cells.remarks: Records an agreement by the Sēvabrāhmaṇas of the temple to burn two perpetual lamps before the deity for 60 paṇam received by them from Aṇuṇāyakan alias Ādi-āśirvāda[ya]chāchhi-Sēṭṭi, a member of the nagarattōr.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: A similar agreement by the Sēvabrāhmaṇas to burn twelve twilight lamps in the temple till midnight on some special occasions in the year for 20 gadyāṇams received by them from a person whose name is lost.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Door jamb to the proper right of entrance into the temple.
cells.language: Tamil (verse) †
cells.remarks: Modern. Records the construction by Savuṇḍara-Pāṇḍiyan of the wall in which this door is situated, and also the gold-plated dhvajastambha. Records also the digging of an irrigation channel for a land purchased by the donor for the expenses of worship.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Boulder called Vaḷaikkuṇapparai on the river bed near Kailāsanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Records the digging of a spring channel by a certain Malaiyāṭṭāṇ for irrigating some lands on the banks of the river) at Siṅgi-kuḷam.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same boulder
cells.date: Šaka 1643, Kollam 897, Šobhakrit, Chitrai 14, 6u. 5. Monday, Anusham.
cells.remarks: States that the river-channel to the south-east of Pūlam alias Rājarājapuram was dug for the merit of Aṇuṇāhān Kimān Khān Pāṭṭāyittu, Sāyabu, son of Mirēkhān Pāṭṭāyittu, who was the elder brother of Khān-é-Ajam-Mahammadu Khān-Pāṭṭāyittu by a person whose name is not clear.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the Bhāgavati temple on the hill in the same village (as Kailāsanātha temple). †
cells.remarks: Records the uttaravu giving effect to an order of the king issued at the request of the minister) Aṇṇan Tamil[appalla]varāyar to make provision for the execution of works ordered after purchase from the nagarattor of Rājājaripuram by Madisāgaran Adhibhātarān of Pugaiōkāmāthanallūr in Pugaiōkāṇtha-vaḷanādu as kārāṇmai-paḷichchandam for the worship to the image of Eṇakkunallāṇa-nāyakar in the shrine of Jinarigāmalai [at] the hill by the donor on the hill at Tiḍiyūr called Jiṇagirimālai in the name of Tamijappallavaraiyan, who is called Oruvārurṇandān Eṇakkunallaperumāḷ and who is stated to be a native of Rājāvallapuram in Kīlveṇba-nāḍu.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / NANGUNERI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West and south walls of Bhāgavati temple †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Bāmiyum Tiruvirum, etc., connected with the above inscription and records the original order of the king.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHOHENDUR TALUK · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUCHOHENDUR TALUK.—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Kulaśēkharapatṭanam.—Slab set up in front of the Gaṇēśa shrine under a pipal tree.
cells.remarks: Records a deed given in the regime of Daḷavāy Tiṭṭārappa Mudaliyār by the several members of the nāḍu community of Kulāśēkharapaṭṭaṇam to those of three sections of the Sāndre agreeing not to levy any more dues on the latter than what had been recovered hitherto.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHOHENDUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another slab set up in a waste land called Mūppaṇār-Vēḷai, Gaṇēśa shrine. †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a cocoanut garden to the temples of Kāñchi-puram, Kūḍal-nagar, etc., by the members of the nāḍu community of Kuḷaśēkharapaṭṭaṇam in Māra-vira-vaḷanāḍu and of Sub-rahmanya at Tiruchendūr and to a maṭha in the same village by Chidambarānātha Mūppaṇār, son of Vīra-Kumārasvāmi-mūppaṇār, a resident of Śēraṇyugaṇḍan-paṭṭaṇam in Maḷa-nāḍu.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHOHENDUR TALUK · Paḷḷakkurichi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab lying in the pre-mises of the Varaguṇa Pāṇḍyēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register a gift of land to the temple of Varaguṇa-Pāṇḍyēśvara at Paḷḷakkurichi in Māṇavīra-vaḷanāḷu by Vayirava-nāyakk, the agent of Viśvanātha-Nāyaka.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHOHENDUR TALUK · Kurumbūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North west and south walls of the central shrine in the Ādinārāyaṇa temple.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Begins with the introduction Pūmaruviya, etc. Gives a list of several pieces of land endowed to the temple of Sundara-Pāṇdya-Vinnagar-Emberumāṇ at Kurumbil alias Rājendranallūr in Kuđa-nādu, a sub-division of Pāṇdi-nādu by the ūrār of the village and their predecessors. Refers to a gift made in the 11th year of a king whose name is not specified.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHOHENDUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North and west walls of Ādinārāyaṇa temple †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Pūriṇ kiļati, etc. Portions lost in the middle. Seems to record an agreement given by Vēļāṇ Aiyanambi and Vēļāṇ Ulaguttamaṇ to pay the kađamai, etc. taxes due on 2½ mā of land sold some time previously by their jātī Širi: aṇgō Irāśiṅgadēvaṇ alias Alagiyapāṇdya Karkurichi-Muvēndavēļāṇ to a certain Sējiyakōṇār, who endowed it for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Sundara-Sēļapāṇdya-Vinnagar-Emberumāṇ at Kurumbil alias Rājendranallūr without however fulfilling his obligation of paying the taxes thereon. Kurumbil is said to be a dēvadāṇa village of god Tiruvānandapurattu-dēvar.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHOHENDUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of Ādinārāyaṇa temple †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Records an agreement by the ūrār of ... nāḍu to pay the taxes on two pieces of land endowed as tax-free dēvadāna to the temple by Appi Puruṣōttaman alias Uttamaśōḷachēṭṭiyākoṇ and two other persons of the village for some consideration, the nature of which is not clear.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHOHENDUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Portions lost. Seems to record the construction of the temple with all its adjuncts, the consecration of the images of Vishnu with his two consorts and endowment of land for offerings and worship by the ūrār of Kurumbūr alias Rājēndranallūr and his son Uttaman after purchasing the same tax-free from the ūrār.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHOHENDUR TALUK · Kurumbūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records an endowment of two pieces of land, after purchase, by Korran Vīradamudittān and other agambadis of Alaigiya-pāṇḍya-Viḷupparaiyar of Viḷattūr for offerings and worship during Tai-ayanam in the temple of Sundarapāṇḍya-Viṇṇagar-Emberumān. The ūrār had the right over the lands was to maintain, however, the ūrār and the taxes on the lands were agreed to be paid by the ūrār who received a lump-sum for the purpose.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHOHENDUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Ādinārāyaṇa temple †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Pūmaruviya, etc. Records an endowment of a land tax-free by Appi Viruṇḍān alias Rājēndra-Śēḷiyakōn for the offerings of the temple deity Sundara-Chōḷa-Pāṇḍya-Viṇṇagar-Emberumān on Amā-vāsya days.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHOHENDUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Ādinārāyaṇa temple †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Pngalmādu vilaṅga, etc. Records a sale of land made tax-free by the mahāsabhā of Śivandala Gaṅgaimaṅgalam, a brahmadēya in Kuṇanādu in Uttamaśōla-vajanādu, a sub-division of Rājarajapāṇdi-nādu, to Sōla Tirunilakaṇdaṇ alias Rājaraja-Kuṇanāttu-muvēndaveĵaṇ for an endowment to the temple as tirumadaippalīpuram.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHOHENDUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Begins with the same introduction as above. Stops with the mention of the temple of Sundara-Śōḷa-Pāṇḍya-Viṇṇagar-Emberumān in Śōḷa-Pāṇḍya-chaturvēdimangalam in Śōḷa-maṇḍalam.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHOHENDUR TALUK · Kurumbūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Gift of 25 sheep for a twilight lamp in the temple by Nakkaṇ Piḷḷaiyāṇḍān of Śōḷa-Pāṇḍya-chaturvēdimangalam in Śōḷa-maṇḍalam.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHOHENDUR TALUK · Tēṇṭiruppērai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Door jambs of the north entrance into the first prākāra from the maṇḍapa of the Makaraṅkuḷam-kuḷakkī-ḍār (Vishnu) temple.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Tirumagaḷpōla, etc. Records a sale of land made tax-free by the mahāsabhā of Kaitava-Kaittava-chaturvēdimangalam in Tiruvāḷudi-vaḷanāḍu to the temple of Udaya-divāran of Kaḷiavaṇam-galam in Kuda-nāḍu.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHOHENDUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab built into the walls of the kitchen and maṇḍapa in Ādinārāyaṇa temple. †
cells.remarks: Records the construction of a maṇḍapa called Jñānāsamudram in the temple of the god by Śōṇāḍu-vaḻaṅgiya Aravamud-āḻvār. The heading of the inscription on a second slab seems to refer to a sale of land by the ūrār of Rājarājanallūr for endowment by purchase (for worship) to Śrī Bhūmipirāṭṭiyār set up in the temple.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK-concld. / TANTIRUPPĒRIA-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North side of the inner gōpura (right of entrance) of Ādinārāyaṇa temple. †
cells.remarks: Records a gift of 300 ponuams to the temple by Mainduvakranavita-nambiyär Āriyapiran Tīdan for offerings in the temple during the daily recitation (adhyayana) and on the days of festival in Panguni with a right to a share of the offered food to the donor and his descendants.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the mandapa in front of the central shrine in the Kailasanätha temple.
cells.remarks: Records an agreement by the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple of Kailāsam-Uḍaiyār at Teṇ-Tiruppēr alias Sundarapāṇdya-chaturvēdimaṅgalam in Tiruvajudi-valanādu, to burn twelve lamps daily before the deity for the money received by them from Ijambarattuppiijai, another Śivabrāhmaṇa of the same temple. Above this inscription is a fragmentary record dated in the 3rd year and 84th day of a king whose name is lost, confirming some endowment by the king made by his predecessor (Seāmidērar) for the worship of goddess Tirukkāmak-kōṭṭattu-Ājuḍaiya-Nāchchiyā r consecrated in the temple by a certain Ponṇacchi. From this endowment a portion of the paddy was allotted by the Śivabrāhmaṇas to one Āṇdār Ponnārmēniyār for the worship of Gaṇapati probably within the same temple.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the confirmation by the king of an order made by his predecessor to the dānalar remitting certain specified taxes in favour of the temple for the worship of the goddess.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of Ādinārāyaṇa temple †
cells.king: Māravarman alias Tribh. ... who took the Chōla country and (anointed himself at) Muḍigoṇḍa-sōlapuram.
cells.remarks: Stones misplaced and some lost. Refers to the consecration of the images of Sundaraparamal and his consort Paravai-Nāchchiyar and to the gift of a house-site.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of the Alagiyasundarī-Amman shrine in Ādinārāyaṇa temple. †
cells.remarks: Stones lost. Seems to record an endowment of land for worship to the goddess Alagiya-Po[nnäichchiyar] by a person whose name is lost.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Alagiyasundarī-Amman shrine †
