cells.remarks: Records an endowment of tax-free land by the mahāsabhā in whose favour for worship to the same goddess.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillar set up at the entrance into the same temple.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Pugaļmādu-viļanga, etc. Records a kaiyiđu (bond) given by the mahāsabħā of Tailakulakāla-chaturvēdimangalam in Tiruvaludi-vaļanādu, a sub-division of Mudigondasōla-vaļanādu in Rājarāja-Pānčinādu to the temple of Virrirundaruļina-Ālvār at Teņ-Tiruppēr in the same nādu with regard to two vēli of land in their village endowed tax-free by king Rājamahēndradēva, in place of the old deed which was lost.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Tinnevelly (Tirunelvēli): South wall of the Vērnbattūr-mađam in the south car street.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Pūmalar tiruvum, etc. Portions lost. Records an endowment of several plots of land in different places made tax-free, by the king at the request of Aiyaņ Malavarāyaņ for feeding 3.3 persons including a number of dēsāntri-tapasvins, hymnists and other servants of the temple (at Tirunelvēli) in the maļha called Šeyyanambirātţi-mađam built by the king's aunt (māmatti) in her name in the south street at Tirunelvēli in Kiļvēmbā-nādu.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the royal order issued to the tapasvins in charge of the Śōyannamāṛirāti-maṭha communicating the above endowment, with effect from the 11th year and 184th day of the king's reign.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK-concld. / TANTIRUPPĒRIA-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the ulvari entered in the accounts giving effect to the endowment registered above.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK-concld. / TANTIRUPPĒRIA-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records an agreement given by the stone masons of the temple at Tirunelvēli to the authorities of the temple to pay a certain Tirunelvēli-Uḍaiyār, the tānāpati-Mudaḷiyār of the Śōyannamāṛirāti-maḍam. At the end of the inscription is another agreement by the latter to pay a sixth of his emoluments for the maṭha.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK-concld. / TANTIRUPPĒRIA-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records a similar agreement given by another set of masons or architects (Śilpāchāryas) to give one-eighth of their income to the same maṭha and the maḍappuṛaiyam (maintenance of the maṭha). This gift is referred to in the latter portion of the above record.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA · Kōvilpaṭṭi Taluk. Kōvilpaṭṭi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the prākāra of the Bhuvanēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to record the consecration of some image (Toḻukan) by a certain Nakkaṉ Gaṇapati of Iraippaḍai.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the prākāra of Bhuvanēśvara †
cells.king: Tribh. ... who conquered Iḷam (Ceylon) and Koṅgu, and performed the anointment of heroes at Perum-paṛappuliyūr.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to record some endowment for worship in the temple of Puṉavāśuramudaiya-Nāyaṉār at Iraippaḍam alias Rājapāṇḍanallūr in Muḍukuḍi-nāḍu, by a resident of the place.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Do. Records gift of a lamp-stand to the same temple by Ammaiyāḻvān Uyyavān ... of Tirukkaḍavūr.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK / TANTIRUPPĒRIA · Iḷavēṉgāḷ — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Haro-stone set up in survey No. 247/6.
cells.remarks: Records the death of a certain Pōvāti Malavārya-Śiruvaṉ, the Maraṉaṉ of Kuṇḍayaṅkōṭṭai while fighting (his foes) on the occasion of the attack by Veṅgaḷarāja with his army during the sojourn of Tirunelvēlipperumāḷ alias Vēṭṭumperumāḷ at Iḷavēṉgāḷ.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT-concld. / KOVILPATTI TALUK-concld. / ILAVĒṆGAL-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Second hero-stone in the place of Bhuvanēśvara †
cells.remarks: Records the death of another Mâravar warrior by name Sivanaimaravādēvar Perumānkikki Pičchchaiaḥ (son of ?) Aḹiyādagaapparayar of KuṆdayaṅkōṭṭai, during the same raid.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Third hero-stone in the place of Bhuvanēśvara †
cells.remarks: Records the death of Āḹiyādagaapparayar mentioned above.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Fourth hero-stone in the place of Bhuvanēśvara †
cells.remarks: Records the death of Sivalingam Verrumundigondan Visālayadevaran, son of Visālaya®devan Paṇḍiyadevar of Kuṇḍaiyamkōṭṭai, evidently in the same raid.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Fifth hero-stone in the place of Bhuvanēśvara †
cells.remarks: Records the death of Sōlaiperumal Rāmakeṭṭi, son of the Marava Araśanāmaivāra Pāṇḍiyadevar of Ilavēṅgal, after piercing (his enemy's) horse.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Sixth hero-stone in the place of Bhuvanēśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the death of another warrior named Rajavēṅgai, son of Toṇḍaimān Mikkupūkai of Paindalai in a similar or same combat with a cavalier enemy.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Seventh hero-stone in the place of Bhuvanēśvara †
cells.remarks: Records the death of Piḷḷaipporūti, son of Periyādan Toṇḍaimān (of Kuṇḍaiyamkōṭṭai) at Egaṇḍalai in a combat with the Vaduga army probably during the same raid.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Eighth hero-stone in the place of Bhuvanēśvara †
cells.remarks: Do. of Aḹiyādan Irimaiytti, a Marava of the same place during the raid of Rājāji (i.e., Veṅgalarāja mentioned above in no. 300).

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Ninth stone (without sculpture) set up in the place of Bhuvanēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Fragment.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Tenth hero-stone set up in the place of Bhuvanēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Records the death of the Marava warrior Āliņdi Tinavai, son of Araśanāmaivāran after piercing a horse on the occasion of Veṅgalarāja's raid.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Vaippar.-Stone built into the balipīṭha in front of the Siva temple.
cells.remarks: Fragment. In characters of about the 14-15th century A.D. Mentions the Vishṇu temple of Maṇpāl-Viṇnagar-Emberumāñ. A modern damaged inscription on a pillar lying in front of the temple outside records the construction of the Šadīrkai (?) by Mammadu Subānu-Sāyabu and mentions the goddess Viśālātchi-Ammañ.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab built into the ceiling of the deserted Vishnu temple.
cells.remarks: Records the construction in stone of a well at Kulattūr alias Kumāraśēkarana[llūr], a maḍappuram village of god Ilaiya-nāya[nār] at Tiruchchoṇḍūr, by Vēḷiyudachchchiyar.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL · Vīllikūlulam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in a dry land at Siunākamāpatti hamlet.
cells.date: Saka I[56]6, Subhā-[nu*], Tai[1], Pushya, Monday, Sankramapa.
cells.remarks: Records an endowment of three villages Siunākamāpatti, Kuṇaiyampatti, and Kūlakkāyampatti, for worship and offerings in the temple of Chillanambārvēśvara, built by Mūrtii-Seṭṭiyar, Amman, by Tummini Nāyaka on behalf of Mūrtti-Seṭṭiyar. The gift was left in charge of one Nallaperumāliyyan.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL · Vānaramuṭṭi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Gimukha in the north Pāṇḍya wall of the central shrine in the Rāmānāthasvāmin temple.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of this gōmukha by Sokkan Perumbāttan alias Dēśāyar Śāriya-kaṭṭan of Uṛuṛukūr in Nerchūra-nāḍu.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.king: [Māra*] varman alias Tribh. Sun [dara- Pā] jdyadeva
cells.remarks: Records the sale of the village Śengulam to the temple of Tiruviśvaramudaiya-Nāyanār at Śīvalliputtūr by Ūnai Sundarapāṇḍyanallūr in Nerchūra-nāḍu a sub-division of Pāṇḍamaṇḍalam, by the araiyar of the village who agreed to pay all the taxes due thereon, themselves.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Vishnu temple †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records the sale of the tenancy right (kārāṇmai) over a land in the dēvadāna village Koppakkulam to a number of persons by the authorities of the temple for 1000 panam.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|xxvii||7" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. XXVII, No. 7</button>

filters.also: Also in another book we hold

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the mukha-maṇḍapa (right of entrance) in front of Vishnu temple. †
cells.remarks: Built in and stones lost. Seems to record sale of lands in a village to various specified individuals by Dēvēndiradavraman (evidently an officer of the king) with the mission of Kaṇḍiyadēva, as the original holders had left the place without paying the dues thereon. A fragment of an inscription on the south side close by is dated in the reign of Tribhuvanachakravartin Sundara-Pāṇḍyadēva.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the mahāmaṇḍapa in the same Pāṇḍya temple.
cells.remarks: Portions lost. Seems to record an agreement by the authorities of the temple at Uṛuṛukūr, given to a certain Iśānavēra of the Śējūrmukhyan-kulam, with regard to damage to the images of Kūttāḍjudēva and his consort, for the land endowed by him.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / KOVILPATTI TALUK / ILAVĒṆGAL — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone built into the pavement of the varandah in Vishnu temple. †
cells.remarks: States that the śāyāna-maṇḍapa in the temple was completed on this date by Śinnappāṭṭiyār, son of Vaiyyappāṭṭiyar of Vāgaramuṭṭi.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Jammalamađugu.—Slab paved in the verandah of the post-office.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary and worn out. Seems to register the grant of their varānas, by the vipravinōdins for the merit of their twenty-four families. The benefit was to go for the mahōtsava (festivals) of some deity. Mentions Jambulamadaka.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Dommara-Nandyāla — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in the Chennakēsava temple.
cells.remarks: Records the obeisance of Veṅkaṭanārāyana-dāsan, son of Tirumalayya of Anantapuram, to gōd Kēśava of Nandāla. In characters of about the 18th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Wall of Vishnu temple †
cells.remarks: Registers a reciprocal deed given by Vēgūri-Narasimharāju in favour of Pōti Apayagāru to the effect that the amount of 5½ varāha-gadgas was paid in cash. In characters of about the 18th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA · CUDDAPAH DISTRICT-contd. / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK-contd. / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA-concld. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in Survey No. 77, 1 miles to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: States that the field is the mānya land of god Chennarāya of Domari-Nandyāla and specified its extent as 4 puṭṭis and 5 tūmuvů. In characters of about the 17th century.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA · Kannelūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone lying in the back-yard of the Šiva temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Refers to Dugganār-Eyyappa who was ruling over (the territory) as far as the Kirudope from Nariyānūru.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in the liṅgamanya shrine behind the Siva temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Seems to register certain grants of land made by Pāpāmiṇyāru, son of Goṇḍugumari Būmināyudu, and (the former's wife) Pāpasāni at the village Kanyalūru granted to them by Salakarāju Pe[da Tirumala]- rāju. (See the next number).

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A second slab in the place of Siva †
cells.remarks: Registers grant of land made by Makhamadālīkāra Salakarāju Peda Tirumalayadeva-Mahārāja, the brother-in-law of the king, at the instance of Kampaṇārya, son of Śrīnāthason of Godugumari Būmināyudu at Kamalēūru, situated in the Cherunūru-sīma which was given as nāyaṅkara to him by the king, for the merit of the chief's father Salakarāju.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Dēvagudi.-Ceiling of the maṇḍapa at the entrance into the compound of the Taḷakaṇṭamma shrine.
cells.remarks: States that the maṇḍapa in front of the Talakaṇṭādēvi shrine was erected by Lingāreḍḍi of Chadupurula while he was holding the two villages Devigadi (and) Sugumaṇchipale obtained by him as amara from Timmāṇēyuḍu.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar in the mukhamandapa of the Taḷakaṇṭamma shrine, first face.
cells.remarks: Records the release deed relating to his worshipping rights executed by the Baṛaliya-Nāgejjya, the priest of the Talakaṇḍēvī temple. The crisis are stated to have been caused by him in the years Jaya and Magamatha.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same pillar, second face
cells.remarks: Registers the release deed relating to the share of Naḷadāsjya, the priest of the Taḷakaṇḍēvī temple, formerly sold by him on account of the hardships experienced during a famine in the years Jaya and Manmatha.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A second pillar in Taḷakaṇṭamma shrine, first face. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to a certain Bēmarēḍi, Taḷajīya and Śirrōla Vēḷaśani. The purport of the inscription is not clear.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same pillar, second face
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records that Muchchena and Vijjena should enjoy their vṛitti in equal parte. Refers to the temple of Taḷakaṇḍēvī. In characters of about the 14th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A third pillar in Taḷakaṇṭamma shrine †
cells.remarks: Registers the details regarding the enjoyment of the vṛitti by Bīna and others and their worshipping rights amongst certain Jīyas of the Taḷakaṇḍēvī temple.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|xxvii||279" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. XXVII, No. 279</button>

filters.also: Also in another book we hold

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same pillar
cells.remarks: Records the sale of worshipping rights and attached land made by Bīna to Bammappaiya. The trustees of the temple to 5 other Jīyas of the temple of Rāmēśvara, are cited. The Sthānāpatis of the temple of Rāmēśvara, Eranḍāśa-Jīya, the Sthānāpati of the Taḷakaṇḍēvī temple and others.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA · Kannelūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same pillar
cells.remarks: Registers the apportionment of vṛittis of the temple land between the two sons of a certain Jīya. In characters of about the 13th century A.D.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|xxvii||83" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. XXVII, No. 83</button>

filters.also: Also in another book we hold

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A fourth pillar in the place of Taḷakaṇṭamma; north face. †
cells.remarks: Records a similar apportionment as decided by the sthānāpatis of Rāmēśvaram. In the same pillar is another chisel-ed-out record which is dated in Krōdhana.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same pillar
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to register a similar agreement as the above. The witness mentioned towards the end of the record and the writer of the inscription are the same as those of the above number.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A fifth pillar in the place of Taḷakaṇṭamma †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions a certain Naḷa-Jīya. Seems to do an apportionment of worshipping rights and attached holdings.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Peddapasupula.-Slab set up in front of the Vīrabhadra temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Seems to register a gift of lands by a Sāluva chief (name lost) on the occasion of a lunar eclipse for the merit of his father, Rājīrāju. Mentions gods Vīrūpākshadeva and Tirumvengala[nātha]. Among the boundaries occurs the name Rāmachandrapuram.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar near the compound of the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Is the tomb-stone of [Vōsi]redi. In characters of the 16th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone in the back yard (doddi) of the house of Jivvimānu Pōchi-Reddi.
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Refers to the rule of Bhāṇḍādiva over Rēnādu in the reign of a king (name lost) and to an attack on Nandakūru and seems to record a gift made to aṇ Kaṟaṇa, the offspring (progeny) of Ayitama Gāmuṇḍa. In characters of about the 8th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Hero-stone lying near the same house
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Mentions a certain Mutta[rūju], probably the hero depicted on the stone and refers to a fight. In characters of about the 8th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK / DOMMARA-NANDYĀLA — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in Survey No. 1033, 2½ miles to the south of the village.
cells.date: aka 1304 (in words), Dundubhi, Māgha, ba. [3]0, Monday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers gift of land at Hiriya-Pasupula in Mulikeya-nādu by tie king to Rāyasada Vithappa, son of Karanika [Āde]ppa of the Rik-śākhā and Kāṣyapagōtra. Mentions (the village) Dānavanahālu (modern Dānavulapādu) among the boundaries.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · CUDDAPAH DISTRICT—contd. / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK—contd. / Peddapasupula.—concld. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in survey No. 1278, 1 1/2 miles to the east of the village.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land as sarvamānya to Phakiru-Mamadu, son of Madadu Husēnu Chōpadār by the Reddīs and Karana of Khaupi-Peddapasupula on the request made by the former for the provision for the same and for the fort of Lālá Jamadār-Sāhebu.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Chinnapasupula — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up near the mosque.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land as madfix-mānaya, made by the Dēdiyi, Reddī and Karanama of the village to Nayanatsuku Pulla-sāni-va-hēnu for having erected a Masjid in the village in honour of Khuda-Rasuli. At the top is engraved the name Janiāra-Khānu.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab near the well in survey No. 204.
cells.remarks: Registers a similar gift of land by the Dēdiyi, Reddī and Kara-nama of Mējidinne to the same donee. The gift is said to have been made at the command of the Khānu-Sāhebu.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Mējidinne — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying near the Añja-nēya temple.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land made to the temple of Hanumān at Mējidinne by Narsimha-Reddī, son of Nāyaḍu, after renovating the temple which was in a dilapidated condition and reconsecrating the image of the god therein.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another slab lying in the place of Śiva †
cells.remarks: Registers the gift of the 'VipravinōdI-vartana made by Parra-tayya and Anantayya, sons of Pedavallabhayya of the Kāśyapa-gōtra, Āpastamba-sūtra and Yajuk-śākhā of the Sampradāya (community) of dommaras to rāja-guru Chennakadeva and Hanumān of the village Mēdī-guddirine surnamed Krishnarājasamudra in the Ghaṇḍi-kōța-sīma of the Chandragiri-rājya. The gift was made on the holy occasion of Srīrāmanavami.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Chidipirāladinne — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying near the ruined temple of Śiva.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Records grant of the village Chidipirāladinne in Chāṅgalamari-sīma for the worship and offerings of the local god (name lost).

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same slab
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Records grant of the village Chadi-pirāladinne as sarvamānva by [Basayavadēva-Mahārāja, son of Mahāmandalēśvara-Mahārāja.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Garisalanka — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying near the ruined temple of Śiva.
cells.remarks: Registers gift of land made by Narsākaḍga, son of Tirumalarājayya, grandson and grandson of king Timmarāja for the benefit of the god Chennakēśava st... ... on the bank of the Kumudvatī in the Chêngalamari-sīma of Muliki-nāḍu in the Udayagiri-rājya. The donor bears a number of epithets, such as Boyiddakapurvarāja, Madhvarājava-pradishṭa, Baṇḍeyakolāpakāleya, āchārya, etc. He belonged to the solar race and Vaśishṭhagōtra and is said to be a subordinate of the king. Also records a provision made to the pipers, etc., for service in the temple.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Chinnamudiyam — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Broken slab lying near the Chāvadi.
cells.remarks: Fragment. In chafacters of the 13th century A.D. Seems to record the sale of land to Akajītya. Mentions Tippajītya and Sōmajītya.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar in the mukha-maṇḍapa of the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Reads 'Magaradhvaja Jōgāiṅgha'.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Pēmalladāne — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in front of the Vishnu temple.
cells.remarks: Registers the remission made by Mahamaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarāja Tirumalarājadēva-Mahārāja of the several taxes on the barbers of the village Nēnaladāne, situated in the Avuku-sīma, similar to the remissions made to the barbers in his realm by the king at the request of Koṇḍōju.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another slab set up in the place of Vishnu †
cells.remarks: Records confirmation of a former grant of the eḷala-maṅka made by the Vilīvan-Mahājana of the village Namiliḍāne and by Kommaḍi of Pulīri-sīma (of Pulivendala) previously by Rāmarāya (of Aravīḍu) for the dalamāhātmawas of the Perumal. The village Namiliḍāne is stated to be situated in Pūliri-sīma and given as nāyAṅkara to Bukkārija-Timmarāja.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A third slab set up in the place of Vishnu †
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land as vṛitti made by the Virūpamāhāmaṇḍalika Mahāmamaṇḍalēśvara [Jīl]lella Rāmarājayyadēva-mahārāja, a(smanantes ? ) Tirumalaya for his having made afreirah the sculpture of god Nāgavula Chennakēśava.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone lying in the bastion (burz)
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to record a gift of perumaṇḍu (presents?) for the lamp (dīpa) at the (village) Chhikūru. Mentions Rēnāḍu-[7000]. In characters of about the 8th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Uppalūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying in front of the Anjaneya temple.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions Sūlava Gōvindarāja and Timma- Nīyuḍu. 'Seems to record some grant, probably of land, to the artisan (who made an image).

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Jaṅgalapalle — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying near survey No. 519.
cells.remarks: Marks the boundary of Mōgivēmuḷa-agrahāram. Ends with the invocation 'Śrī-Virūpāksha'. In characters of about the 14th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying on the boundary of Survey Nc. 530-31.
cells.remarks: Another inscription similar to the above.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Peddamudiyam — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab paved in the floor of the mukha-maṇḍapa of the Lakshmi- Narasimha temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land as māḍaya made by the 108 mahājans of Brahmamaṇḍiyam-agrahāram to two artisans for having built the śikhara to the temple of Narasimha and for its permanent upkeep and repairs.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Pālūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab built into the ceiling of the mukha-maṇḍapa of the Agastīśvara temple.
cells.remarks: States that the maṇḍapa for god Agastīśvara was built by Rāmi-Redḍi, son of Veṁkaṭi of Vuppalūru. Refers also to the construction of a private people.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab built into the ceiling of the Kalyāṇamaṇḍapa of Agastīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: States that the kalyāṇa-maṇḍapa was built for god Agastīśvara by Siṅgari, son of Peda-Gōpālayya, the Kuramun of Pālūru.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab built into the ceiling of the Kalyāṇamaṇḍapa of the Kēśava temple.
cells.remarks: States that the kalyāṇa-maṇḍapa of god Lakshmi-Chinnakēśava of Pālūru was built by Rūmi-Redḍi, son of Dēvi- Reddi of Mudiyam.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab built into the ceiling of the mukhamaṇḍapa of the Kēśava temple
cells.remarks: States that the maṇḍapa was built by Veṁkaṭa-Reddi and Nāgi-Reddi, sons of Timmā-Reddi and grandsons of Peda Siṅgai-Reddi for god Chi[nna] kēsava-Perumāl.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying near Kēśava temple †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Tippā Niyanagāru, son of Nar[a]vula Peddaṅgai-Nāyuḍu and Anantu and records grant of money made for the construction of the stone temple of Chennakēśvara-Perumal of Pālūru.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Bōjippanāpāḍu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab fixed in the wall of the Guigamma shrine.
cells.remarks: Records the foundation of a grove by Ponnanā-Reddi, Chennā Reddi and Pōti Reddi to please god Sūryamārāyana.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying in a field about a mile northwest of the village.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of māṇya land at Pālūru-agrahāra made by Tipā-Nāyanigāru, son of Naṇavula Pelagi ugi-Nāyaniṅgāru to [Ka]ṁjībhasliram Timmabaṭṭu, son of Bukkāpaṭṇam Peḍdōju. The village in which the gift land was situated is stated to have been given to the donor as nāyaṅkara by Vīra Narasasiṁhayya Mahārāya.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Vāparēla — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying near a field called Ba[vi]lōlēmu, 1 miles to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. States that the field belonged to god Virūpākshadeva of Diguvapatnam.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Torrimētuḷa — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in front of the Āñjanēya temple.
cells.remarks: [States that this field belongs] to Virūpākshadēva of Diguvapaṭṇam. See No. 366 above. Slightly damaged. Registers a gift of land made to the temple of Hanuman probably by Rāmānuja China-Timmarāju who received, as vābali, the villages Toravēmuḷa and Kaṭumuḷa in the Rāmēśvara[m]-Poiāțūru-sīma, granted to him as nāyaṅkāra.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another slab lying in the place of Guigamma †
cells.remarks: States that Kannama-Nāyuḍu, son of Gapta Yerrama- Nāyuḍu had a step-well of stone masonry built for the merit of his parents and his elder brother Pedda-Ammil Nāyuḍu.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Pārapāpalle — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone lying near a well in the village.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Registers a grant of land made for Pemmaani Timma-Nāyuḍu to Cheveku Gōpaya for having dug and built a well.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Bhu magyūm — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Broken slab set up in front of the Chennakēśava temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of their iṭṭuga-vurtana made by the Vipanēndras for the annual festivals of god Chennakēśava- Perumāl of Bhūmaguṇḍam alias Achyutarāyapuram.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same slab
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Refers to the gift made by Mōkanudālēvaru Gūtikoṇa [Vīra] bayadavēda-Mahārāja (a stone cutter) Kūne Liṅgābaṭuḍu. The nature of the gift is not known. Mentions Bhūmaguṇḍam.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Fragment of a slab lying in front of the Kēsava temple.
cells.remarks: Few mentary and damaged. Seems to register a gift of land to (the artisan) Lingā baṭuḍu of Rāvalachuvu for some construction in the Chennakēśava-Perumāl temple at [Bhi]māguṇḍam.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another slab set up in the place of Kēsava †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 15th century A.D. Very indifferently written. Gives a number of fanclfu epithets of goddess Durgā (?) and mentions Ghaṇḍikōṭa, Vēruṇṭi Pratāparudra and the fifty-six countries.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Būtamāpuram — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in the centre of the village.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions some members of the vipravinōdin community and god Chennakēśava of the village Būtumūpuru situated in the Rēnāți-sīma, north of the Piṇākini river.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · A-yavāri-Kambaladinne — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Nandi pillar set up in front of the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Slightly damaged. Registers a gift of the village [Kam]- bhaladinne situated in the Chandrikōṭa-sīma by the donor (name lost) to god Kēśavanātha of Tiruvēṅkaṇam Mahādēva Gaṇgaḍhēva for the merit of the king. The donor is also stated to have held Ghaṇḍikōṭa-sīma as amara-māgāṇi under the king.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone lying in a field belonging to Jamal- Reddi.
cells.remarks: In char-acters of the 16th century A.D. States that the village belongs to Gouigadliṅga.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Golāla-Uppalapāđu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Broken slab lying in front of the Aṅjanēya temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Registers gift of land at Gollala-Uppalapāđu made by Aliya Rāmappayyadēva Mahārāja, of the Ātrēya-gōṭra, Āpastamba-sūtra and Yajus-śākhā, who held the Ghanđikōṭa-sima as nāyankara under the king, to Nāraṇayya, son of Narasimīha-Bhatṭa of Pulivendala.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another stone lying in the place of Śiva †
cells.remarks: Records gift of land made by (dālavāyi ?) Narasappa-Nāvaningāru, the ḍelṭa of Madhūvarēḍdivāru Nandēla Timmayyadēva-Mahārāja, to the pipers and drummers for services in the temple of Chennakēśava-Perumāl at Galla-Uplapādu, situated in Guṇḍikōṭa-sīma which was given as niḍgankora to Timmayyadēva by the king.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH · CULDAPAH DISTRICT—contd. / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH—contd.
cells.place: Bestavēmula.—Boundary stone in Survey No. 34.
cells.remarks: States that this is the boundary stone between Bestavēmuḷa alias Prasannamrāghavapuram and Goḷlapalle.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Boundary stone in Survey No. 138
cells.remarks: A similar boundary stone is found in Survey No. 138. States that this is the boundary stone between Bestavēmuḷa alias Prasannarāghavapuram and Chavudaḍampalle.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone in Survey No. 49
cells.remarks: Marks this land at Goḷlala-Uppalapādu (see No. 376 above) as the gift made by Aliya Rāmappayyadēva Mahārāja to Pulivendala Nārāyaṇayya.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH · Chinnaventurla — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying in the cour- -yard of the Kēśava temple.
cells.remarks: States that the Kāpus and the Karayas of Chinnavēputurla granted lands to Rāmaṇa, son of Ghaṭtu Kēśavaya, who renovated the temple of Chennakēśvara-Perumāl, originally consecrated by Paraśurāma and to the scuptors Tippaya, son of Rāla-Lungābattudu and Ayyana, son of Lakkōju Buchchana.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH · Vaḍdarēlla — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab behind the Vīrabhadra image.
cells.remarks: Reads 'Śvasti śrī Traiyōka-Ādityuru'. In characters of the 9th century A.D.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Basement of the dhvajastambha in front of the Kēśava temple.
cells.remarks: Gives the standard length of a 'mūra' i.e. a cubit. In late characters.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up at the entrance into the compound of Kēśava temple. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to refer to some reconsecration of images and to record gift of lands made to the goda Kēśava, Chennarāya, etc., by some Kōpas and Karaṇas.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH · Gaṇḍikōṭa — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab on the threshold at the entrance into the second maṇḍapa in the Madhavasvāmin temple.
cells.remarks: Records the obeisance made to god Mādhavarāya by several individuals among whom figures Pāpa Timmarāju and their offer of a 'siga (garland) to the god. In characters of about the 16th century A.D.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Rock called Tallētīguṇḍu in the river-bed, a mile north-west of the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refer to the Dēvi-prithvī-Mahā.. and Mallikārjuna and a number of private individuals among whom figures a kōva. In characters of the 14th century A.D.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Rock near the G. T. mark on the way to Khiḍarābād, on the south bank of the river.
cells.remarks: Records the obeisance of a certain Vellamā[vi] Mahānadaya to Bhagavan. In characters of about the 14th century A.D.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH · Gūḍenacheruvu
cells.place: Slab fixed into the bastion.
cells.remarks: States that the bastion was 'suit by Venkatadāri, son of Kopḍa-dīsari. The inscription was engraved by Karumāla Veńgiggallu.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH · Pūrva-Bommēpalle
cells.place: Slab near a well called 'Polimerābhavi' to the east of the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to refer to the settlement of a certain boundary dispute between Gūḍencheruvu and some other village.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH · Ṣumnāpurallapalle — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Wall of the Ān. janēya shrine inside the fort.
cells.remarks: States that the bastion was built by Saidụ Abdullāgāhū Havāldāru and the work was executed by Dumpa Jaṅga-m Reḍḍi.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab built into the fort wall.
cells.remarks: States that the fort was built by Madanā Sāni, wife of Havāldār Saidu Abdu-rasūlu Mayā Sāhēbu and the work was executed by Chamḍa Sāhēbu.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH · Ponnatōta — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone lying at a distance of about a furlong from the temple of Āñjanēya.
cells.remarks: Slightly damaged. Registers a gift of land as dasavanda for having repaired a breach in the local tank. The names of the donor and the donee are lost.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying near the image of Gaṇeśa
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register a gift of their incomes made by the Vipravinōdins probably to the local temple. The gift was entrusted into the hands of the Mahājans of the village.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH · Kosinēpalle — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying in survey No. 71, about 2 furlongs south of the railway line.
cells.date: about the 9th century A.D. †
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Registers a gift of 30 marutus of land as pannasa by the queen of Tṛihikipati. The characters are of about the 9th century A.D.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH
cells.place: Slab set up in front of the Ānjanēya image.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of their tyaiga-svatāntra income due from the Mahājanas of the village Kōsīnēpalli to the Vipravinōdins to god Kōna-Truvenganātḥu for the cheru-pu festival of the deity. The village was a sarvamānya-agrahāra and was surnamed Harihararāyapuram and was included in the Chervūru-sīma.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH
cells.place: Slab in the Chennakēśava temple.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Registers a gift of land out of the god's holding (kara-gēta) made by Bhōdari-Nāyuṇḍu and three others (named) to Nandi Aṇṭu for worship of Valabhyya, his wife and others. In characters of about the 15th century A.D.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH · Timmāpuram near Penikalapādu
cells.place: Stone near a well near the Redḍi's house.
cells.date: about the 17th century A.D. †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 17th century A.D. States that the stone marks the north-eastern boundary of Triyambakapuram. Contains invocation to god Lakshmīpati at the top.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH
cells.place: Stone in the road poromboke about 2 furlongs to the east of the village.
cells.remarks: States that the stone marks the northern boundary of Triyambakapuram. Contains invocation to god Narasimha at the top.

cells.location: CULDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUH · Rājula-Guruvūrapalle, hamlet of Timmāpuram
cells.place: Stone on the way to Penikalapādu.
cells.remarks: States that the land near the boundary between Nallapalle and Penikalapādu belongs to the artisan Rīchabashātu of Vēlupula (jaria).

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · CUDDAPAH DISTRICT—contd. / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK—contd. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Penikelapādu.—Slab in the compound of the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: States that a certain Bairāju built a temple for god Mahādēva at Penukalapāḍu which was given to him by Vallabharāju, and granted land as dasavanda to Aṭla Malli Reḍḍi-Basvi Reḍḍi for the preservation of the temple.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab near the shrine of Rāma.
cells.remarks: Records that in the name of the thirty-three crores of gods and of his family deity Vīrabhadra and his ancestors, Vaḍḷu (artisan) Peddayya of Penikelapāḍu built a temple for Vighnēśvara on the platform and planted the ficus and margosa trees with a platform and consecrated on it an idol of Vighnēśvara.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab built into the platform in the same place.
cells.remarks: States that the six sons (named) of Tippi Reḍḍi of Nandavaram endowed a trough (gāḍi) at Penukalapāḍu for the merit of their parents. In characters of about the 17th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up near the tank a mile south-west of the village.
cells.remarks: Records that Voḍḷa Peḍavīraṇṇa of Vēlpucharla constructed a tank in memory of his ancestors. States also that Vīramma, wife of Peda-Vīrabattu of Penikelapāḍu built a charity pond on the way to Vuppalūru and to the west of Vāmikoṇḍa.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A rock called Sanyāsiguṇḍu on the Vāmikoṇḍa hill.
cells.remarks: States that ‘the excellent teacher Vṛishabha who was a cloud to the crops, namely the righteous (bhavyas) and an unshakable rock to his opponents in discourse, lived on this hill’. In characters of about the 7th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Vēlpucherla — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in survey No. 170, east of the village.
cells.date: about the 9th century A.D. †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land at Vēlpucheṟuvu along with its tax-incomes (?) by Karikālachōḷa Ka[th]lavyreṁgu, a subordinate of the king, while ruling over Vēlpucheṟuvu. In characters of about the 9th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in survey No. 283, west of the village.
cells.remarks: Records the grant of the perquisites excluding the Mahārāja prayōjana, etc., that accrued in the form of money, rice, betel, etc., from the village Vēlpucherla in the Chaṁgalamarri-sīma, the nāyaṅkara of Nallan-Timarājayya, Pōṭlāvāri-Uppalūru and Varadarājula-Dudyāla in the Ghaṇḍikōṭa-sīma, the nāyaṅkara of Nandyāla Timmarājayya-Nāraparājayya, by the asaṅkhyātas of the villages to the goddess Aṁkāḷaparamēśvarī of Vēlpucherla for worship and festivals. Records also gift of daily rations to the artisan (Vaḍla) Timvōju of Vēlpucherla for having engraved this inscription.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in survey No. 235, south of the village.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of sunka made by Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Kopḍarājayya, son of China-Timmaya and grandson of Pedakompadāria of Āravīḍu for offerings to god Madanagōpālakrishṇa of Vēlupucheria (probably installed by the chief).

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in survey No. 293, south of the village.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Records gift of mānya and rations to the (artisan) Pōtārajuju of Vēlupucheria by the sakala-sanḍōkha (i.e. general body of devotees) from the fifty-six countries who assembled in the maṇḍapa of the goddess at Vēlupucheria.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another slab in the place of Rāma. †
cells.date: about the 9th century A.D. †
cells.language: Telugu. (chhaṇdasa) †
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of 40 marutus of land at Vēlpucheyuru by Ayiēmma Āribālāvayirengu, son of Kāthla-vyreŋgalli to Vārisāni Bhōdāsi Komaraya. As emmunukālu, Edike kilu, Mēshikonḍilu, etc. In characters of about the 9th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in survey No. 298, adjacent to the Sīmbalśiva temple.
cells.date: about the 9th century A.D. †
cells.language: Telugu. (chhaṇdasa) †
cells.remarks: Begins with the Aviddharam-vara etc., prastasti and registers a grant of ponnaza land of fifty marutus extent yielding a siddhāya of 15 gold rukas and 7 puffis of other land at Ḍrōmmanaḍyāla and at Vēlupucheruvu to Mēyi Bhatlu by Kali-Chōla, the son (maṇgaru) and one Vala(bhā)ya. In characters of about the 9th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another slab in the place of Sīmbalśiva †
cells.language: Telugu. (chhaṇdasa) †
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of the durga-daṇḍāni-varisana, bēg̣a, kānike etc., of the two villages belonging to god Vira(bha)dra, to the sthānīka (Nangayāla Tummayyadeva-Mahārāja to the 6 sthānīkes (named) of the village.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Pedda-Duḍyāla — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in the compound of the Chennakēśava temple.
cells.language: Telugu. (chhaṇdasa) †
cells.remarks: Registers the renewal of a grant formerly made by the members of the merchant guild of the 50 countries who were well versed in the ańgaya-śvīchāra. Headed by Riti Chenna- Mallappa for offerings and worship of god Varadārāja of Duḍela, the original grant having been lost.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab paved on the floor in the nandi-maṇḍapa of Chennakēśava temple. †
cells.language: Telugu. (chhaṇdasa) †
cells.remarks: Records the obeisance of Narasimha, son of Taḍaka Lakshmaya to god Varadārāja of Duḍyāla.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same slab
cells.language: Telugu. (chhaṇdasa) †
cells.remarks: Records the obeisance of Gaṅgarāju, son of Irugalūri Apparāju.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Pedda-Duḍyāla — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same slab
cells.language: Telugu. (chhaṇdasa) †
cells.remarks: States that Ghaṇta Narasimha was a devotee of god Lakshmīpati (i.e. Vishnu).

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Pedda-Duḍyāla — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same slab
cells.language: Telugu. (chhaṇdasa) †
cells.remarks: States that Patikoṇḍa Varadārāja constructed the big tank for the merit of Nandiyēla Nārasappa.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Pedda-Duḍyāla — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same slab
cells.language: Telugu. (chhaṇdasa) †
cells.remarks: States that Mallēla Rānalingam came here and joined duty.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Pedda-Duḍyāla — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same slab
cells.language: Telugu. (chhaṇdasa) †
cells.remarks: Records the obeisance of Tippāvōjhula Basavaya to god Varadārāja.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Bondalakuṇta — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Broken slab set up in a field, a furlong east of the village.
cells.language: Telugu. (chhaṇdasa) †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · CUDDAPAH DISTRICT—contd. / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK—contd. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Āravētipalle.—Slab in a field, a furlong west of the village.
cells.remarks: States that the pillar marks the southern boundary of Chinta-kuṇṭa-agrahāra which was a Rāyadati.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Chintakuṇṭa — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Rock near a tamarind grove on the way to Yāmavaram.
cells.remarks: States that the grove was an endowment of Pedda Appayya. Refers to the Government of the East India Company (Kuṃpini doratanam Paṇḍigādi).

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Rock under a banyan tree on the way to Yāmavaram.
cells.remarks: States that the grove was planted by Kaṇyam Subbayya.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Yāmavaram — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in the centre of the village.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of their annual income of six rūkas due from the Mahājanas of the village Yāmavaram to the temple of Lakṣmīkānta-Perumāḷ for the annual Sankranti festival in the Dharmamāsa.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Korrapāḍu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Broken slab at the ‘Kōḍi-kaṭṭirāḷla-kaṇamu, 1½ miles south of the village’.
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: States that Nārāyaṇa Reḍḍi, son of Veḷḷeti Surra-Reḍḍi constructed the steps at the hill-pass called ‘Kōḍikaṭṭi-rāḷla-kaṇamu’. In late characters.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab of the ceiling in the Śiva temple
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of one marutu of land at Malavuru by Per-Bāṇā-dhirāja to (god ?) Aditya Bhaṭāra while Bāṇa-āju was ruling over Igippu and a certain Kuppaḷḷy-aru was ruling over Korrapāḍu and the donor himself was ruling over a tract (name lost).

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Second slab in the place of Śiva †
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Records a gift of one marutu of land at Malavuru by Per-Bāṇādhirāja. The donee's name is not mentioned. The gift seems to have been made to the same deity as in the above on the occasion of an eclipse (not specified).

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A third slab in the place of Śiva †
cells.date: 8th century A.D. †
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions Rāchaḷḷanūru. In characters of the 8th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab on the platform outside Śiva temple. †
cells.date: 8th century A.D. †
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. States that Kōk made a raid on Baḷavaruma-pāḍu and died in the encounter while Saṅgrāma-dhīru was ruling over Korrapāḍu. In characters of the 8th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab fixed near the steps leading to the above platform.
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Much damaged and built in. Mentions Ka[liki] and [Ba-] lavarmapāgu. In characters of the 8th century A.D. Another slab in the same place with writing of about the same period mentions Korāpādu and seems to record a gift.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone beam lying by the road side near the Śiva temple.
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: States that the villagers headed by the artisans Peddachennā Ređđi, Chennayya and Gurumūrti brought the five slabs. Another beam in the same place with the same details of date gives the name of Bhāskarayya of Māyalūru.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab paved on the platform round the dhvajastambha of the Kēśava temple.
cells.date: 8th century A.D. †
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land as panavāra by Balavarmmarāja to Chilkapara at Koralapūru. In characters of the 8th century A.D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A second slab in the same platform, Kēśava temple. †
cells.remarks: Registers remission of the several taxes such as siddhāya, Kāvili-pannu, etc., due by the barbers of Korapāḍu situated in Ghaṇḍikōṭa, by Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Nāndēla Timmārājayadēva-Mahārāja by order of the king at the instance of Rāmanājadēva-Mahārāja.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up outside Kēśava temple †
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land at Paḍumaṭi-Korapāḍu in Ghaṇḍikōṭa-sīma, belonging to Nāndēla-yāgiri-rājya, by Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Nāndēla Timmārājayadēva-Mahārāja and Mahārāja, grandson of Aruḷahēśvaradēva-Mahārāja and son of Pīna-Avuḷahēśvaradēva-Mahārāja to Vāmana Nārāyaṇa-Jya, the disciple of Śhaṭagōpa-Jya. The gift was made in the holy presence of the god in the presence of god Narasiṁha on the bank of the river Pinākinī

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Broken image behind Kēśava temple †
cells.date: about the 9th century A.D. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. In characters of about the 9th century A.D. Refers to the regime of one Prōlaya Buḍeya-Bōya. Purport not clear.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab near the well close to the railway line
cells.date: Šaka 1439, Iśvara, Jyēshtha, ba. 30, Thursday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Registers the gift of the village Tāḷlapalle attached to Ghaṇḍikōṭa-sīma to the temple of god Kēśava by Sāḷuva Gēvinlarāja-Voḍeya, the son of Rīchirāja-Ayya of the Kaunḍinya-gōtra, Āpastamba-ba-sūtra and Yajus-śākhi for the worship of god Raghunātha of Ghaṇḍikōṭa.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Chautapalle — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in front of the Kēśava temple.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to record an agreement given by Mummaḍi- Nāyuḍu, the Kāryakarta of Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Nāndyēla Nārāparāju-Kṛishṇapādēva-Mahārāja to the share-holders of the village (name not clear).

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Mutsumarri — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in front of the Midhasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Records a grant probably of land made to god Chennakēśava-Perumāḷ. The name of the donor is lost.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab on the boundary of survey No. 5, to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: Registers gift of land made by Hemmāṇđi Dēvarāja Ananta-rāja for a garden for the benefit of god Srirangarāja.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Erraguḍi — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Boulder near the temple of Hanumān.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of the village Yaraguđi by Mahāmaṇdalēsvara Nārayadēva-Mahārāja, son of Nandēla Narasingayadēva-Mahārāja for the benefit of god Ahōbala. The boundaries of the village are given in detail.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · CUDDAPAH DISTRICT—concld. / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK—concld. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Sankēpalle.—Slab in front of the Hanu-mān temple.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of four lōmus free of the sidhāya and kānike taxes to god Janārdana of Saṅkēpalle by Mahāmandalēśvara Varadarājasula Chinaṅgenayadēva-Mahārāja who hold Guttī as nāyankara from Aliya Rāmarājaya Mahārāja.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Kibīli-Sugumanchipalle.-Slab in front of the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Records the conversion of the Karanamīnya, vritti, mānyams and the wet-lands given formerly to the Karanams of the village by Mahāmaṇdalēśvara Chinna-Timmayyadēva-Mahārāja of Āravīdu, into sarvamānya lands free from the imposts of the village Śukumbai which is to be included in called a padumatisīma, held by the donor as nāyankara the Ghaṇdikōta-sīma, held by the donor as nāyankara from the king.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Second slab in the place of Śiva †
cells.remarks: Registers the remission of taxes such as the kānike, katnam odiōmiam, dommaripannu, niddhāyam, etc., due from the village to the nēyōgi of Aknukūru, Mahāmāṇdalēśvara Rāmarāju Tirumala-Ayyayyadēva Mahārāja.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab on the platform in front of Śiva temple. †
cells.date: 18th century A. D. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged and broken. Seems to refer to the settlement of some land dispute in characters of about the 18th century A. D.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Tāllapaddūru.-Slab in the mangoose grove on the road side, south of the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers a cultivation agreement given to the several persons of the padanēla bhandāravāda (village) Tālapaddūru by Rūmalinga Nāyundu, son of Pemmasāni Timma Nāyundu, who enjoyed the nāyankara of the village.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A Nandi pillar on the road-side leading into the village.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions Tālipāṭi. In late characters.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Enumulachintāla.-Slab in front of the temple of Añjanēya.
cells.date: Śaka 1473, Saumya, Chaitra, ba. 30, Friday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Registers the gift of the village Vannamachintala in the Chintalapallu-sīma included in the Gintti-māgāni, by China-Timma-Nāyundu-Tiruvenganāyadhāni, for the merit of the king, Aliya-Rāmappayya and the donor's parents Timma-Nāyuḍu and Machamammun.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in survey No. 240 to the west of the village.
cells.date: Śaka 13[88], Vyaya, Phālguna, ba. 30, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the village Mēdīkariti by Mahāmaṇdalēśvara Huliya Mallayadēva-Mahārāja for worship of the deities Sōmanāthadēva, Kākatiya-Gōpināthadēva, Rēpuvanēśvaramu that the net income from the various taxes of the village be equally shared between the two temples. The donor bears the titles Ghōyagarāya, Rūpa-Nārāyaṇa, Rāyu-Rāyu-Gandababhiranda, etc. The gift was made for the merit of Narasimharājojaya.

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Timmāpuram near Ennumulachintāla — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab near a well west of the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers a grant of land to some persons (names not legible) by the Revuḍu and Karnam of the village juvvi attached to the Jambulamadaka-samutu for their having dug a well and raised a grove for the merit of Hajarati Navābu Sāhebu (name not clear).

cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / JAMMALAMADUGU TALUK · Siddhavattam — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab in the mosque
cells.remarks: Indistinct.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / VAYALPAD TALUK · CHITTOOR DISTRICT. / VAYALPAD TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Kalakaṇa.—Tier round the basement of the ruined Šiva temple.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land to the Šiva temple at Karkadai in Kīlai-Mārāyapāđi situated in Irattapāđikonṇa-Sōļamaṇdalam by Vaidumbarājan Tiđališan.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / VAYALPAD TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Front wall of Śiva temple †
cells.remarks: Registers the remission of all the taxes barring the Dogarāchapannu, Padevālepannu, Padiyēripannu and the Sandhivigrahi-pannu to certain kānipus (names specified) of Vēnāṇdu by the king on the occasion of his coronation. Also seems to record certain regulations in respect of the punishment for adultery and consequent murder (?).

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / VAYALPAD TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Hero-stone in a field about a furlong to the west of the village.
cells.date: about the 9th century A. D. †
cells.remarks: Records the death of a hero named Aiala in a cattle raid. Mentions Pallavayya, the younger brother of the king. In characters of about the 9th century A. D., contains a sculpture of the fighting hero.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / VAYALPAD TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Tarigoṇḍa.-Wall of the central shrine of the Narasimhasvāmin temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Records remission of taxes on the harbours by Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Jillela Vengalarājadēva-Mahārāja with the sanction of the king and Mahāmānḍalēśvara Rāmarājadēva-Mahārāja.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / VAYALPAD TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Prākāra wall (inside) of Narasimhasvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: Records the construction of a hōma-śāla and the kitchenmandapa by Errappa, son of Jaganu-Setti and grandson of Ram[gileti-dēva, a devotee of Guru Bhasakāchārya and the recipient of booms from the goddess Vāsavāmbika.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / VAYALPAD TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab at the entrance (inside) into Narasimhasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Records that Krishṇa-Setti, son of Subhi-Setti and grandson of Kandula Gurusapya of the Vaisya-kula built the kalyāna-maṇḍapa for god Lakshmī-Nṛisimha.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / CHANDRAGIRI TALUK · CHITTOOR DISTRICT—concld. / CHANDRAGIRI TALUK. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Tirupati.—In the temple
cells.remarks: Modern. Dated 28th of August 1918 A. D. Mentions the name of the structure 'Gate of the Kalwala porch'.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · ANANTAPUR DISTRICT. / GOOTY TALUK. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Konakondla.—Slab in the well near the mosque in the bazaar.
cells.remarks: In characters of the 12th century A. D. Records the construction of a well and the Mallikarjuna-śatra (satra) by Ayypadeva-Ayyayju.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Boulder on the hillock called the Rasaśiddhula-gutta, north of the village.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 10th century A. D. Mentions the tomb (nisihi) of Śrī-Nāgasēnadēva.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another boulder on the same hillock
cells.remarks: In faint characters of about the 14th century A. D. Seems to mention Sri Vidyānandasvāmin and Chippagiri.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Third boulder in the place of Narasimhasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Faint and damaged. Seems to mention Bōliya Nāga. In characters of about the 14th century A. D.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Fourth boulder in the place of Narasimhasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Seems to mention 'Singanandi-vandāttan'. In characters of about the 7th century A. D.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A fifth boulder in the place of Narasimhasvāmin (from a photograph). †
cells.remarks: Reads 'Srī Ūriga-pāsindi'. In characters of about the 7th century A. D.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Sixth boulder in the same place (do.)
cells.remarks: Reads 'Śrī-Silākōmaran'. In characters of about the 7th century A. D.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Seventh boulder in the place of Narasimhasvāmin. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Brammâliya, son of Gummi-Seți. In characters of about the 12th century A. D. Incomplete.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Rock over the cave of Gari-Venkatesvara, on the hillock south of the village.
cells.remarks: Seems to mention 'ridhara(vijaya) . . .' and 'Śrī-Tammerakarlu'. In characters of the 7-8th century A. D.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Tripurāntakam — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar set up outside the eastern gōpura of the Tripurāntakēśvara temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1055, in figures and chronogram, lunar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of 25 cows by Bandaya alias Pendaya, the younger brother, and 25 cows by Rājēndra-Chōda, the son, of Velanāṭī Gonka to Pushpātmajiya, the sthānādhipati, for maintaining a perpetual lamp in the temple of god Mahādēva of Tripurāntakam.
