cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Sāvel.-South wall of the central shrine of the Rāmalingēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Gives the name of Paratra Bhēṭaja Mahāmuni, the disciple (śishya) of Chārgi Bhēṭala-Gorava. In characters of the 9th century A. D.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: West wall of Rāmalingēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Reads 'tri-ōjadou'. In characters of the 9th century A. D.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: South wall of the mahāmaṇḍapa of Rāmalingēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Mentions Srī-Kōchikim-nya[vam]tāra of Sēna[pankō]ta and seems to record his digging of the site. In characters of the 8th century A. D.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar in the mahāmaṇḍapa (proper left) of Rāmalingēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: In late characters. States that Koniki Bhadrāva (the figure depicted in the sculpture) is worshipping god Rāmēśvara.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another pillar in the place of Rāmalingēśvara †
cells.remarks: Refers to an assault made by the son (name not given) of Gaṅgauju Ahma (Ahamāyā) on his father when he (the father) paid (a fine of) 40 varāhas. In characters of the 18th century A. D.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: East wall of the apsidal shrine in the Rimalingēśvara temple.
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Reads 'Śrī-Buddh-yuddha-Śiṅgam Śrī-Bhanan-Bhāskorunru'. In characters of the 7th century A. D.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same wall
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Reads 'Svastl Śrī-Bojarichitti' and 'Parbuta-rishi'. In characters of the 8th century A. D.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Santhanapādu.—Fragment of a slab excavated behind the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to register a gift of land by Rāmānāyanigāru in the presence of god Tiruveṅgalanātha. The donee's name is lost. In characters of about the 16th century A. D.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Vēlpūru.-Pillar in the temple of the village goddess by the road-side.
cells.date: In characters of about the 3rd century A. D. †
cells.remarks: Damaged and mutilated. Mentions a king (name lost) of the Aira clan who bears the epithets Mahārāja and Hirinīpati. In characters of about the 3rd century A. D.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Marble pillar in the temple of Rāmalingasvāmin.
cells.date: In characters of about the 6th century A. D. †
cells.remarks: Reads 'Ubhaya-bhata'. In characters of about the 6th century A. D.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Nāgājunakaṇda.-Base of a mutilated image found on the river bank, now kept in local Archaeological Museum.
cells.king: Mahārāja Siri Chhuvula Chinta-la[ka]na †
cells.date: 3rd century A. D. †
cells.remarks: Seems to state that this (image) was caused to be made by Khānduvui, the queen of Mahārāja Siri Chhuvula Chintala[ka]na, who was the lord of a jivaputa. In characters of about the 3rd century A. D.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Nidadavolu.-Pillar, found in a pit near shepherd's house, to the north of the Madanagōpālasvāmin temple.
cells.remarks: Telugu

cells.location: WEST GODAVARI DISTRICT / NIDAMAVÕLU TALUK · WEST GODAVARI DISTRICT-concld. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place:
NIDAMAVÕLU TALUK-concld.

Nidamadõlu-concld.
Pillar lying in front of the Madanagópālasvāmin temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land and 50 cows by Pubbaya of Niravadayaprõlu to the Dēva-bhōya for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Mahādēva stipulating an annual payment of one rûka/rupayga and two chĩ (anas) probably as interest (?) by the donee.

cells.location: WEST GODAVARI DISTRICT / NIDAMAVÕLU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar set up near the mosque
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record the setting up of the pillar in the Mahādēva temple by a private person (name lost).

cells.location: WEST GODAVARI DISTRICT / NIDAMAVÕLU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar lying in the street to the south-west of the market-site.
cells.date: In characters of about the 13th century A.D. †
cells.remarks: States that the pillar in the madapam of Mahādēvānandēva was set up by Bōlūju, son of Nunkōju. In characters of about the 13th century A. D.

cells.location: WEST GODAVARI DISTRICT / NIDAMAVÕLU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone pillar found near the old fort-wall now kept near the Ayurvedic dispensary.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records gift of land by certain Jiyana-rju-Peddingāru of Atukūru to god Chenna-Mahādēva.

cells.location: WEST GODAVARI DISTRICT / NIDAMAVÕLU TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same pillar
cells.remarks: Registers gift of land made to the same god by certain Jiyana.

cells.location: WEST GODAVARI DISTRICT / NIDAMAVÕLU TALUK · WEST GODAVARI DISTRICT-concld. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same pillar
cells.king: Vishnuvardhana Mahārāja †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of land as vritti for offer-ings to god Chenna-Mallisvara at Gurgāla-guṇṭa by Vishnu-vardhana Mahārāja.

cells.location: WEST GODAVARI DISTRICT / NIDAMAVÕLU TALUK · WEST GODAVARI DISTRICT-concld. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same pillar
cells.king: Vishnuvardhana Mahārāja alias Mahēndradēva-Kumāra †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers a gift of land at Maddūru for offerings to god Gaṭṭiņēpalli Mallisvara at Gurālagunta by Vishnuvardhana Maliarāja alias Mahēndradēva-Kumāra. In characters of the 13th century A. D.

cells.location: WEST GODAVARI DISTRICT / NIDAMAVÕLU TALUK · WEST GODAVARI DISTRICT-concld. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same pillar
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record gifts of land to god Oṭṭi-Mallīśvara-Mahādēva at Gurālagunta. The name of the donor is lost.

cells.location: KISTNA DISTRICT / KAIKALUR TALUK · KISTNA DISTRICT. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place:
KAIKALUR TALUK.
Kaikalūr.—Pillar in the temple of Veṅkaṭēśvarasvāmin.
cells.remarks: Records the foundation of certain temples at Kaika-lūru alias Kaiṅkaryapura and gifts of lands made to them and their deities by Timma-Nāyudu of the Kūdugūti family, who was a Mādhva of the Kānva-śākhā.

cells.location: VIZAGAPATAM DISTRICT / VIZAGAPATAM TALUK · VIZAGAPATAM DISTRICT. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place:
VIZAGAPATAM TALUK.

Appikoṇḍa.—A pillar in the Śiva temple on the sea-shore.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Begins with the Eastern Chājukya process, Sakala-bhuvang, etc. Refers to god Sōmēśvara of Appikonda to whom some gifts were made by the king for the merit of his father Koy-payadāva-Chakravarti. The king is mentioned as a devotee of god Chillmēvara-Mahādāva.

cells.location: VIZAGAPATAM DISTRICT / VIZAGAPATAM TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another pillar in Śiva temple. †
cells.date: Śaka 1053, Chājukya-Vikrama year 5(6), Bādhārapa, Phālgupa, ba. 11, Wednesday.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to record the confirmation of the existing gift of the dērabhōga village Appikonda to god Sōmēśvara of Dantivāra by the general Māchimayya-Nāyska and the Commandor Mārtapdzyya-Nāyaka. The former is stated to be the predhāna of Mahāpradhāna Drṇdanāyukī Annarāje, who bears several titles, and to be in charge of (samenādhikāri) Viśākhapatṭapa in the east of Pathpavāṇi.

cells.location: WEST GODAVARI DISTRICT / ELLORE TALUK · WEST GODAVARI DISTRICT. / ELLORE TALUK. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Mundūru.—Broken pillar set up on the sluice of the tank called Kannesamudram, 1 1/4 miles to the east of the village.
cells.language: Sanskrit and Telugu prose and verse.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Refers to the construction of a tank called Kannamgaru by the chief Mādhēvāyu of the Chintalapaṭli family in the name of his mother. A tenth portion of the produce under the tank is assigned to the engineer who built it. In characters of about the 16th century A. D.

cells.location: KISTNA DISTRICT / GANNAVARAM TALUK · KISTNA DISTRICT. GANNAVARAM TALUK. Aiḷūru. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: (Ayyalūru).—Pillar set up in the compound of the Vishnu temple.
cells.king: Hajarati Ālampanah Sultān Abdullā Khutupa Śāha.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of the village Madhurūpūru as an agrahāra to Vaṇūri Anantarāmāchārya, Sarvatomukhayāji, for having performed the sarvatōmukha-yajña, by the local chief Ḥāji-Amīr-Muḥammad-Saiyyid-Nawwab at the instance of Mahāgaiji-Nārāyaṇarāo. A bout-cut inscription on the reverse of the pillar seems to define land boundaries.

cells.location: KISTNA DISTRICT / GANNAVARAM TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Book side of the Krishna image in the Kompaiamma in the Krishnā river.
cells.remarks: Marks the boundary between Kanigalanka, the hamlet of Ayilūru and Annavaramkāla, the hamlet of Annavaram.

cells.location: KISTNA DISTRICT / GANNAVARAM TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Śāyāpuram.—Pillar set up in front of the Vishnu temple.
cells.date: Śaka 150(0) (in words). Tārapa, Kārttika, Saradritu, ba. 11, Thursday.
cells.language: Sanskrit and Telugu prose and verse.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gives the genealogy of the minister Anantaprabha and records the foundation of an agrahāra named Lakshmī-Nṛsiṁhapura, by him and his wife Timmāmba.

cells.location: KISTNA DISTRICT / KAIKALUR TALUK · KISTNA DISTRICT-concld. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place:
KAIKALUR TALUK.
Lōkānarapuram (hamlet of Kollitikūṭu).—The pīṭhasthānam of the liṅga in the temple of Gōkarnēśvara.
cells.remarks: Registers gift of ‘money, land and a house-site made by Vāsana-Bōyundu, son of Maila-Bōyundu of Guḍivāḍa. Enaki-reddi, a perpetual lamp to the temple of Gōkarnēśvara-Mahādēva of Guḍipāndu. Refers to the measure called Nandimānikā.

cells.location: KISTNA DISTRICT / KAIKALUR TALUK · KISTNA DISTRICT-concld. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place:
KAIKALUR TALUK.
Lōkānarapuram (hamlet of Kollitikūṭu).—The pīṭhasthānam of the liṅga in the temple of Gōkarnēśvara.
cells.date: Śaka 1134, Uttarāyapa. [date-calculation appendix, No. 8: Śaka 1674, Āṅgirasa, Arpaśi 5, śu. 10 (Vijayadaśamī), Tuesday, Avittam =A. D. 1752, October 17, Tuesday; ·95; f.d.n. ·12.]
cells.remarks: Very much worn out. Records the gift of 50 inpa-edlu for a perpetual lamp to the god Gōkarnēśvara-Mahādēva. Seems to refer to a chief (?) called Kēdāvabāhupati and one Sītāpati.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK · GUNTUR DISTRICT. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place:
PALNAD TALUK
Reṅgachintala.—Slab fixed into the wall at the entrance into the temple of Mallēśvarasvāmin.
cells.remarks: Records the obeisance of Virappa, son of Tumula Ashṭamūrti, and Siṁhanābu, son of Viranna of the same family to god Īśvara.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK · Māchērala — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up near a channel close to the temple of Kitamappu, 3 miles south of the village.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of 2 maṭuttus of land made by Chamīṇubāvi-Amma, theyounger sister of Gandapendāra Gangī[ya]-Sāhini for the daily offerings of god Alājanātha of Kāñchehi (Conjeevaram). The Sanskrit portion mentions the Hastigiri (i.e., the hillock on which the god Varadarāja of Conjeevaram is installed).

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying in front of a private house, now removed into the Chennakēśava temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary and worn out. Records the remission of taxes due by barbers (veṛigal-panna) such as veṭi-vēmu, etc.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up near a field close to the Chaṇḍravanka stream on the way to the temple of Chiṃtala-Rāmaliṅgēśvara.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Refers to the consecration of the god Chiṃtala-Rāmaliṅgasvāmin and the goddess Bāla-Tripurasundarī and registers an endowment of money made for their daily worship and endowment of the king, to the donor who belonged to the Harka-gōtra is lost.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A broken Nandi-pillar lying in the compound of the temple of Chi. †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land made by Mallikārjuna-Nāyaka the son of Bōl-Nāyudu and a subordinate of the king, to the god Rāmanāthadēva of Mahādēvapēra in Pallināḍu 300, in the presence of god Mallināthadēva of Srīparvata.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Sculptured-stone lying behind the temple of Chi. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions Bētariju. The sculpture depicts an armed warrior riding a caparisoned horse. In characters of about the 13th century A. D.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in the field of Mahaboob Sahib, teacher in the local Government School.
cells.remarks: Records the grant of land at Mächērala in the Nāgārjunakoṇḍa-sīma made by Kōnapa-Nāyudu, son of Kamarāju-Nāyudu. The Karyakarta of tiriyanakarāsayya' who was governor of Koṇḍavīdu, for the daily offerings, vegetables and flowers, to the temples of the gods Ishta-Kāmēśvara and Vīrēśvara (of the place).

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Broken slab kept in the compound of the taluk office.
cells.date: Śaka 1056, (in chronogram), Ānanda, Pushya, ba. 15, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Registers the gift of Anniṃgum-Gānabhūpati of the village Koppunūru in Pallināḍu-300 to the god Mallikārjunadēva at Trilōchanapallava at the city of Mahādēvapuram. Records the gift of Mallikārjunadēva Mallikarjuna, son of Kóśava, for daily offerings.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another broken slab lying in the place of Chi. †
cells.remarks: Records the endowment of an annuity of 25 varāhas, for the maintenance of the perpetual lamp, by the dēvara and the goddess Bāla-Tripurasundarī to the banks the Chaṇḍrabhāgā, made by Nāgulāpati Appāji-Pantuļu, son of Veṅkaṇṇa-Pantuļu and grandson of Mṛityuṁjaya-Dīkshit-ulu, met the expenses of the daily tols collected in the different villages of the 5 parganas and remitted by mude with the consent of the Dēsamukhs and Dēsapāndes of the parganas (See No. 13 above which is a copy of the present record).

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Broken slab found near the well about 2 miles from Macherla on the way to Kam-bhampādu.
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Slightly damaged. Registers a grant of land made by Kalyi-pavasantulu, the son (?) of Dhanyavasanta-Pṛithvī-Dēsarattagudi, who was the son (?) of Dayāvasanta-Pṛithvī-Mahāraja, to telerāgulu Ārahanta-Bhaṭāra. The was to be maintained by the family of Batjaguls of the thūru.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / GUNTUR TALUK · GUNTUR DISTRICT. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place:
GUNTUR TALUK.
Dharaṇikōṭa.—Fragment of a sculpture found at Dharanikōṭa, now in the possession of Dr. M. Rama Rao.
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Reads 'Sīdham Bhagavató'. In characters of about the 4th century A.D.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / GUNTUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Base of a sculpture found at Kondavīdu, now in the possession of Dr. M. Rama Rao.
cells.remarks: Reads ‘Tirupa-[Nā]ryanduvāru'. In characters of about the 15th century A.D.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE · KURNOOL DISTRICT. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place:
BANGANAPALLE STATE.
Yāgāṇṭipalle.—Slab set up in the orchard called 'sālasānaguṇṭōta'.
cells.remarks: Damaged and mutilated. Records a gift of land made to the temple of Indrēśvarandeva and entrusted into the hands of Kari-Madhavajīya by Merikara Kētamalla-Nāyaka.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in the compound of the temple of Yāgāṇṭisvara.
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Registers the gift of the village Prītankāju sur-named Vijaya-Bukkāriyapuram for the daily offerings of the god Mallikārjunadēva of Yēṅgaṇṭi. The gift was entrusted into the hands of (Ūrundēva) Sōmajiyya, the priest of the temple of Mallikārjunadēva.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Fragments of a slab lying in the compound of Yāgāṇṭisvara. †
cells.remarks: Refers to gifts of land made to certain artisans such as masons, cartmen, etc., who served in the construction of the temple. In characters of the 16th century A.D.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE · Anantarājapuram — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar in the mukha-mandapa of the Prasanna-Venkatēśvarasvāmin temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to refer to the consecration of god Śrīnivāsa-chalaśuvarin and the oblation of Chakravarula Konndappagāru to the god.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE · Godugūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in Survey No. 3014, south-east of the village.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged and worn out. Seems to register a gift of lands, tolls on pack-bullock carrying salt, etc., to the god [Gō]pinātha.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE · Akkalarēpalle — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in front of the temple of Mallikārjuna on the Gōringaparvata.
cells.remarks: Records the building of a temple of Śiva by Gaurēśvarābhyamangāru for the worship of God Gōśingadēva thereof, and gift of lands made to Brāhmaṇas. Refers to the Mahāvatī-Gauṅgā river "flowing westward", Śrīnāparvata and Himaparvata.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Hero-stone set up near the above
cells.remarks: Slightly damaged. Mentions Śrī Śōyanāthani. In characters of about the 13th century A.D.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE · Śaṅkhavaram — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying in front of the Chennakēśavasvāmin temple.
cells.remarks: Records the remission of the tax on the barbers in the villages in Ghaṇḍikōta-sīma by Nandyala Timmarijyaya consequent on an emission, made on the request of the king, under the order of the king, at the request of Koṇḍōju, son of Timmoju.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another slab lying in the place of Chennakēśavasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Registers the grant by Muppinīni Pārvati-Nayanāgāru of the village Muddirēdḍipalle situated in the Sakali-sīma in the Ghaṇḍikōta-sīma held as nāyankaraha by Mahāmāṇḍalēśvara Nandyāla Timmarijyayya Nārāpatipāyyadeva-Mahārāja to the priest Chennakālidēva (personul) of Śankēsvaram for daily worship and offerings.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up by the side of the cart track to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record gifts of lands made to the artisans, etc. The names of the donor and the donee are lost. Refers to Nandēla Aubhalarāja. Contains the Vaishnava Vadagalai cast-mark with the saṅkha and the chakra at the top.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE · Varikunia — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up near the well behind the Rānasvāmin temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register a gift of land as sartamānya for a tank at Varikunta by Mahāmaṇdalēśvara Sambaṭa Hanumerājayyadēva-Mabārāja. Mentions Dēmappa-Nāyaningāru.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE · Pūrumāmīlla — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar in the verandah in front of the Lakshmīkānesvāmin temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a sarvamanya gift of the taxes, such as puttige, upa-puttige, sunkam (kaṭnam, etc.) realized in the apratidva village Kōmpādu by Mahamaṇḍalēsvara Nandēla Timmayyadēva-Mahārāja to Narasiṁhapaganda Gōvindayya of the Bhāradvāja-gōtra and Āpastamba-sūtra.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Second pillar in the place of Lakshmīkānesvāmin †
cells.remarks: Records the remission of the taxes on barbers in the villages of the Ghaṇḍikōta and Sakali sīmas which were held as nāyankara by Timmayyadēva, under the orders of Mahamaṇḍalēsvara Rāmarājaya-Rāmarājayyagāri, son of Koṇḍōju, son of Timmoju of Kandanavõlu. The gift was made in the presence of the gods Virūpāksha and Viṭhalēśvara on the bank of the Tuṅgabhadrā.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Third pillar in the place of Lakshmīkānesvāmin †
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of exemption by Nandēla Timmarāja, son of Narasingarāja and grandson of Avubhalarāja from tolls on food, salt, horses, spices, etc., on temple bulls from the Udayagiri rājya, the Pākaṇāḍu sīma to the Sakali-sīma, for offerings to god Ahōbalēśvara of Vēdādri-Garuḍādri.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: The jamb of the main entrance into Lakshmīkānesvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Records a grant of land made to Pōrumāmīlla Ammā(dvarā)-Nāyaka by Vengalayya, son of Rēvūri Krishṇamarājuyu, for the construction of a well and raising of a flower-garden in the mantam at the instance of the queen. Also records the grant of land to the temple of Anjanēya who held the parupatyāgam of the sthāna and included in the Ghaṇḍikōta-sīma which was given as nāyaṅkara to Dēmarusayya by the Dēmarusayya.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: North wall of Lakshmīkānesvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of land at Rāviguṇṭa made by Mahamaṇḍalēsvara Varadarājayyadeva-Mahārāja, son of Raṅgarāja and grandson of Mahamaṇḍalēsvara Nandēla Varadarāja for training apsarases, viz., Talārigāru, daughter of Chūḍakudutta-Nāchchhiyār and Krishṇamāchāryulu and Nārāyanayagāru of Pōrumāmīlla alias Gōpināthapaṭṇam, in Peddagaļi-sīma of the Ghaṇḍikōta-dūṟga assigned as nāyaṅkara by the king to Nandēla Timmarāja.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Front wall of the 'Krishnamma' temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a landsale-deed executed by Purāṇam Aubhala-Bhaṭlu in favour of god Gōpālakrishna for twenty varāhas.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up by the road side opposite the Police station.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions Tātayya-Bhikshāvitti, Dēvarāya-Mahārāya and god Narasiṁha. In characters of about the 14th century A.D.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE · Taṅgēdupalle — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A hero-stone in survey No. 35/1.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Rēvaviṭta and (his wife) Dommasāni. The sculpture depicts a warrior standing with his wife on his right side. The woman seems to hold some leaves in her left hand. The characters of the inscription are able to about the 13th century A. D.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / BANGANAPALLE STATE · Pāṭa-Prahladivaram — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Sculpture of a seated sage lying on a mound on the western bank of the Sagilēru.
cells.remarks: States that the sculpture depicted is that of Yalljiyya the grandfather of Siṅgajiyya.

cells.location: CUĐDAPAH DISTRICT / BADVEL TALUK · CUĐDAPAH DISTRICT—concld. / BADVEL TALUK—concld. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying near the Nili-tofti outside the village.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Refers to the mahajanus of Prabhuvulaviđu, the kānpus and the people of the 56 countries assembled in the mukhamandapa of Yakkalidēvamma of Kaulakuṇta.

cells.location: CUĐDAPAH DISTRICT / BADVEL TALUK · Pāndivīḍu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in front of the ruined temple of Śiva.
cells.date: about the 9th century A.D. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. In characters of about the 9th century A. D. Gives the epithets 'Švētadhvaj-ādhipati' and 'Rīshabha-lānchihana' of a chief (name lost), and mentions Niđugla (for Niđugala).

cells.location: CUĐDAPAH DISTRICT / BADVEL TALUK
cells.place: Same slab, reverse
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Registers a grant of twelve tūmu made by Brammi Reḍdi and others, the lōria of ... dēvulu to the gōd Niśhānathadēva, for the merit of their parents, during the regime of Bramme-Nāyaka.

cells.location: CUĐDAPAH DISTRICT / BADVEL TALUK
cells.place: A Garuḍa-pillar lying on the bank of the Sagilēru.
cells.remarks: States that Krāñja Pōlarāju set up the Garuḍalvār (i.e., garuḍa pillar) in front of the temple of Chennakēśava.

cells.location: CUĐDAPAH DISTRICT / BADVEL TALUK · Gōdlavūdu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in the Chennakēśava temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Seems to record the construction of a temple by Ippasāni...and the grants made to it. The name of the donor is lost. Mentions [Pedi]rājugāru.

cells.location: CUĐDAPAH DISTRICT / BADVEL TALUK · Pālugurājpalle
cells.place: Broken slab lying in the compound of the Chennakēśava temple.
cells.remarks: Beginning lost. Registers the remission of taxes like kāvali-kānike, rokha-dhānyas (rents in cash and kind), etc., on lands granted to the donees (name lost) for the dōlu and nāgasvara services rendered by them in the temples of Sōmāšvara and Chennakēšava. The lands in question are called kāṇāchi-mānyas. (Same as No. 405 of 1926.)

cells.location: CUĐDAPAH DISTRICT / BADVEL TALUK · Kōdūru
cells.place: Broken stone lying behind a house to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Only the imprecatory verses are preserved.

cells.location: CUĐDAPAH DISTRICT / BADVEL TALUK · Sōmireddipalle — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up near the ruined temples (Śiva) on the Bhaṅgārammaluva, a mile east of the village.
cells.date: Svābhānu, Śrāvaṇa, śu. 15, Pūrṇimā, lunar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Records the grant of the village Goḍlavitti Voḍde-Mādana-pasāyita (division) by Mahamaṇḍalēśvara Jōtiñja Guṇḍaya-dēva-Mahārāja for the merit of his parents Jōtirāja and Malādēvi, as an agrahāra to his religious preceptor Aghōraśi-malādēvins, to the ephetars of śrīvīruachualēsa, Bhūsaharāinēndra, Ghaṇḍikōla Pāṇḍyakula and Kōpanāpratāpa. The gift was made in the presence of god Tripurāntakadēva.

cells.location: CUĐDAPAH DISTRICT / BADVEL TALUK · Teliapādu
cells.place: Slab lying in a field near the tank about ¾ mile to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land as desabandu made by Pedda-Vōbuḷ-nāyiṇḍugāru, the son of Mahāraṅgāka-ārya Vennam Adināyudu, to three persons who repaired the breach in, and rebuilt, the tank at Teḷlapādu which was situated in the Kalsapāṃ division of the Sikali-sīma in the Ghāṣtikāsīma, as a sarvamānya nāyankaral gī'vn by Nandela Timmayyarājā to the donor.

cells.location: CUĐDAPAH DISTRICT / BADVEL TALUK · Higullapādu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying near a ruined temple in the old village site about 2 furlongs to the east of the village.
cells.date: śaka [82] Vikārin, Chaitra, ba. ... Thursday, Mēsha saṅkrānti.
cells.remarks: Much worn out. Records the grant of the village Muḍumāla in the Kalsapāṃ-sīma, a subdivision of the chiefship of the Abhinava-Gākai-mahāt at Sripasvata by the pontiff for the entertainment of the Brāhmaṇas and guests and for worship in the Vidyā-maṇḍapa attached to the Śiva-liṅga-matha (of the place).

cells.location: CUĐDAPAH DISTRICT / BADVEL TALUK · Sāvisetti-pāle
cells.place: Slab lying in a field near a well by the side of the cart-track leading to Kōḍigullapāṃju.
cells.date: In characters of about the 9th century A. D. †
cells.language: Telugu. (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record a gift of the siddhāya tax. The details about the donor and the donee are lost. Mentions Rācha-Perggada Dandiyan, Kommana-Raṣṣoṣi and few others as witnesses. In characters of about the 9th century A. D.

cells.location: CUĐDAPAH DISTRICT / BADVEL TALUK · Kēsavalunā-yāņi
cells.place: [Kottāla (hamlet of Kēsavaru)].—Slab under a tamarind tree in a field to the east of the village.
cells.language: Telugu. (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers a gift of the pannasa income by the king to Urasa-Nambūru. In characters of about the 8th century A. D.

cells.location: CUĐDAPAH DISTRICT / BADVEL TALUK · Kōḍigullapāṃju (hamlet of Katteragandla)
cells.place: Fragment of a slab lying on the cart-track to the west of the village.
cells.date: In characters of about the 8th century A. D. †
cells.language: Telugu. (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Records a gift of 80 marttus of land as brahmadēya. In characters of about the 8th century A. D.

cells.location: CUĐDAPAH DISTRICT / BADVEL TALUK · Paĥadapāṃ-ulle
cells.place: Slab lying in a field near the Erravāṃka.
cells.date: śaka 1466 (wrong for 1469), Plava, Bhādrapada, Āshādha śu. 11.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land situated between Peda-Vadamānu and Sivisettipāle-kalaṣapāṃ-sīma, made by Mahāmaṇḍalēsvara Gollapāli-Chinnana-Vēma-Reddi to Subayyanāgāru. The sima was given as nayankarām to the donor by Nandela Timmayyarāju.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI · NELLORE DISTRICT. / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Nindali.—Slab lying near a well in Survey No. 63/12.
cells.date: śaka 1710, Kīlaka, Kārtika, śu. paurōṇamā, Thursday.
cells.remarks: Records the construction of a well and a maṇḍapa at Nindali by Sētriān Pedda-Rangappa, son of Narsu of the Granthāla-gōtra who were the clerks (pramātā) of Chennappa-Seŧŧi, the son of Dānappa-Seŧŧi, born of the Sūgūrimvaṃśa.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Nandi-slab set up in Survey No. 38/10.
cells.king: Malevaṅgapāḍu Avubhalanadēva-Mahārāja †
cells.remarks: Records gift of the village Nimādāpalli as sarvamānyagōd Bhīmēsvara's Dīkishārama "the best of the five arāmas" by Malevaṅgapāḍu Avubhalanadēva-Mahārāja, the lord of Vēṅgiṣvaya consisting of one-and-a-half lakhs of varahas to Āchārya-vibhūshana Mahādeva-bhaṣṣarāya-Ayyagāru, above Dēvachānda Mahārāja. On the same slab at the bottom is another much damaged inscription in later characters, which mentions the name of the village Nindali.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in Survey No. 26
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions the village Nindali given as amurā to [Vode]palle Raṅgappa by the chief and records a gift of some mānya to him for the upkeep of the tank at the village.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI · NELLORE DISTRICT—concld. / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI—concld. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Mātumađugu.—Slab set up near a ruined temple.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of the village Māmōdimadugu now surnamed 'Srinivāsapuram' in the Veļumpāți-sīma made by the king, as ekabhōga, to Tirumala Tātāchārya of the Sāthamarakshana-gōtra. The gift was made in the presence of god Vithalēśvara on the bank of the Tungabhadra.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another slab set up close to Chennakēśava temple. †
cells.remarks: Records a gift of one mādai of money made by Puḍollī-Bāyindan, son of Sūre-Bōyindan for an evening lamp in the temple of Kēśava-Perumāļ at Mārāpūḍi-maduvu
