cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI · Kāyūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying on the tank bund.
cells.date: Śaka 1333, Kīlaka, Kārttika, śu. 10, Tuesday and śu. 12, Thursday.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift by the king, of land called Sūryanārāyana-puram near Koḍḍavalli in Chandragiri-sīma made to Vājapēya-Sōmayāji on his representation that he had no place for residence.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|xxvii||21" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. XXVII, No. 21</button>

filters.also: Also in another book we hold

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI · Chilamanapūrle — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in the street opposite the village headman's house.
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records a gift of some corn income by Mahamaṇḍalēsvara Gollapūḍi Jaggagarēdva-Mahārāja for the maintenance of the tank of the village.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI · Perinatidi — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Sculptured stone set up near the tank bund.
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Gives the label as 'Iruga, son of Malu-Nāgu, a servant (?) of Bhīmarāja.'

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A second stone in the place of Chennakēśava †
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record the death of some warrior (name of the hero and figures is given below the inscription, at the hands of Vasanta(ṇ)ju. Gives the epithets (of the victim) Sāvanta-gajaṁku, Ugrampuļi, etc.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A third stone in the place of Chennakēśava †
cells.date: about the 9th century A.D. †
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gives a number of epithets, such as Praiā-vīra-nārāyaṇu, Airāvatannu, Choļakāridityarvaru, Kali-dhiran-Bhuvi-rācha-mēruvaru, etc. and records his death in a fight. In characters of about the 9th century A.D.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A fourth stone in the place of Chennakēśava †
cells.date: 9th century A.D. †
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Badly damaged and covered by the roots of a banyan tree. Mentions Bhīmarāja. In characters of the 9th century A.D.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|xxvii||173" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. XXVII, No. 173</button>

filters.also: Also in another book we hold

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A fifth stone in the place of Chennakēśava †
cells.date: about the 9th century A. D. †
cells.language: Telugu (archaic) †
cells.remarks: Damaged. In characters of about the 9th century A. D. Seems to record the death of the warrior, (Rudra)manru who was a servant at Ugrampuļi, in a fight.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in front of the Gaṇēśa temple
cells.remarks: Records the grant of grain income (called kuṇṭa-śīmas) made by Mahamaṇḍalēsvara Rāmarāju Mūrti Krishṇa-marsiyayyadēva-Mahārāja for the maintenance of the tōpe at Pechchālī.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI · Chīyyēṛu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up on the path near the mosque.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of the money income called Vīramuṣi-penu of the villages in the Cheyyēri-aima, made for the merit of the Siddhābhikshāvritti-Aiya and the vīramuṣṭis by some seṭṭis. Mentions the Ayyāvali community.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI · Rāchānapalle — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up near a well by the road side.
cells.date: Chālukya-Vikrama year 45, Vaiśākha, puṇṇame, Sunday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Registers grants of lands, houses and an oil-mill for a perpetual lamp, made by the chiefs Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Rēvirarassu, the son-in-law of Bhuvanaikamalla-Mahārāja, of the Sindva family, mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Mummaḍi Chōlarasa, to Mallikārjuna-Paṇḍitārādhya, karni of the god Mallikārjuna at Reddiyapalli, the head-quarters of Kuḍiya[na]-40. The two latter chiefs bear a string of epithets, such as Sikhidhvaja, Siṁhalāchāchana, ‘Creyipuravardhīśvara, etc.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same slab
cells.date: Chālukya-Vikrama year 47, Nandana, Chaitra, śu. pañchamī, Sunday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Records a grant of 1 pana from his uḍḍārvēṭṭa income realised in the Kuḍiyali-sthala, made by Donnaraṇgaka Anantakaviēva after taking an oath from the heriyanika tax made by Daṇḍanayaka Sōvanasa, and also another grant of money income made by Ma’ānandālēśvara Mācanarasa for perpetual lamps in the temple of Mallikārjunadēva of Kuḍiyali-sthala called Kuḍiyāpya-sthala.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up by the road side
cells.date: Chālukya-Vikrama year 45, Vaiśākha, puṇṇame, Sunday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Damaged and mutilated. Mentions Rēviyarasa and Munmadi Chōla[rasa], of whom the latter bears the praśasti beginning with aridarhararasa, and registers some gifts of land, oil-mill, etc., made to them to Siddhārāśi-Paṇḍita, probably the servant of god Mūlasthāna.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: the slab of Gaṇēśa †
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Seems to register some gift made to the god of Mūlasthāna. Another record near this mentions Rojjanāyaka, the god of Mūlasthāna and Kuḍiyali.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Hero-stone set up by the road-side near the village.
cells.remarks: Registers the mahāvarnēṭṭa agreement relating to rents, etc., made to Maṇḍalēśvara Chanasarasi with his pāda-mūlas (followers) on the death of... on the battle-field. It seems to record the death of some hero in an attack on the village. Mentions Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Mahaneryagade Mahā-pruclanda-daṇḍanayaka Āneya Kēsimayya.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up by the road-side near the model village.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 10th century A. D. Records the self-immolation of Kasavida Ganga consequent on the death of (his master) Pallayya Arumu-rāju and registers a gift of 12 marguṭṭus of land to his memory.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / VENKATAGIRI ZAMINDARI · Ādavani — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A boulder on the hill with a jaina figure and a pair of foot-prints carved upon it.
cells.remarks: Much damaged and worn out. In characters of about the 15th century A. D. The former inscription records a Šaka date (lost) while the latter seems to be a label.

cells.location: BELLARY DISTRICT · BELLARY DISTRICT-contd. / Adoni Taluk-concl. / Adavāni.-concld. — Karnataka
cells.place: On the back of the Gaņeśa rock-cut image close to the entrance of the Bāvāji Math.
cells.date: In characters of about the 13th century A. D. †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 13th century A. D. Seems to record a gift of land by Sūre-seţi.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT. / SAIDAPET TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Mādavaram.-West wall of the central shrine in the Kulīsānaätha temple.
cells.remarks: In characters of the 9th century A. D. Beginning lost. Records the gift of sheep by Tiruvēngadattāṇ of Vangipuram, a member of the āluṇ-gaṇa of ĥkadhīra-chaturvēdi-maṅgalam in Pular-kōṭtam, for a perpetual lamp in the temple of SRI Kailāsadēva of the village.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Round Gaṇēśa temple †
cells.remarks: Do. Fragmentary. Seems to record a sale of land by the sabhā of the village.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Puļiyūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of the central shrine in the Bharadvājēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Gift of 2 cows for a twilight lamp in the temple of Tiruvalakkōyiluďaiya-Nayanar at Puļiyūr in Puļiyūr-nādu, a subdivision of Puļiyūr-kōttam alias Kuļõttungasõla-valanādu, by Tilläikkūttan Ponnappillai, the headman of Vērkādu.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of Bharadvājēśvara temple †
cells.date: 13th century A. D. †
cells.remarks: In characters of the 13th century A. D. Gives the label ‘Pottappichõļan’.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Peruñvalai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stul, used as gōmukhi on the north side of the central shrine in the Vishņu temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Arugatturai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Wall of the kitchen in the Vāramartīśvara temple.
cells.date: Šaka 1751, Kali 4930, Virōdhi, Kārttigai 17, Chaturthi, Monday, Uttirāđam.
cells.remarks: States that the kitchen of the temple of Vāramartīśvara was built by one Subbarāya Mudaliyār, son of Nāchchiyappa Mudaliyār, an inhabitant of the Veļļāla community of Kānigaappūr near Pūvīrańdavallür (Poonamallee) in the name of his deceased wife of Vaļļīyammal.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT. / POLUR TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Vakūr.-Two sides of a slab set up in front of the Mutiyāmma temple in the street.
cells.remarks: States that the kitchen of the temple of Vāramartīśvara was built by one Subbarāya Mudaliyār, son of Nāchchiyappa Mudaliyār, an inhabitant of the Veļļāla community of Kānigaappūr near Pūvīrańdavallür (Poonamallee) in the name of his deceased wife of Vaļļīyammal.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East side of the rock close to a natural spring on the hillock to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Tirumagalpola, etc. Registera a gift of land by Tengajūr Ponkambattaiyan, a member of the governing body (āluṅganam) of Vašugūr in Vasugūrnāđu, a subdivision of Palkunṇa-kōtṭam for providing two nāñi of rice for offerings during the evening worship to the goddess ŕrudaichchelvi-Sunaimēṇangai of the place. The land was made tax-free by payment of iraidravyam and water-fee (nīrvilai-dravyam) to the sabhā of the village by Iṇakkutṭi Nakkaṇ alias Rājarājappēraraiyaṇ of Vājaippandal in Vājaippandal-nāđu.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: Begins with the same introduction. Records a tax-free gift of land, after purchasing it from the sabhā of the place, for daily offerings to the same goddess by Šattan Manināgaṇ of Pākkam in Pākka-nāđu, a subdivision of Vēšālippāđi.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: Records a sale of land made tax-free by the assembly of Vašugūr in Vašugūrnāđu, a subdivision of Palkunṇakōtṭam to Avikākaṇ Poļyājpātakaṇ Dutthagāmi, a bodyguard of Kaṇṇaradēva Chakravarti who endowed it for worship to the goddess during the three services, and left it in charge of Siddhappayaṇ, a member of the ālumyaṇa. See No. 102 below.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.date: Rājakēsarivarman 'who destroyed the ships at Šalai'
cells.remarks: Registers the sale of 500 kuļi of land made tax-free by the assembly of Vašugūr to Šūlapāni Kuñjiramallaṇ, a headman of Kōyilārķūr in ŕrrukkātṭuk-kōtṭam to be endowed by the latter for daily worship and offerings to the goddess.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Māmbaṭṭu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab built into the ceiling of the maṇḍapa at the entrance into the Svayambhūnātha temple.
cells.date: Rājakēsarivarman 'who destroyed the ships at Šalai'
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record the construction of a mandapa by the residents of the village with the income derived from a land endowed by a certain Pūvālappaṇ. above this is an inscription record an endowment of land (?) by Appai Ellappar for burning a nakshatra-māla of 27 lamps.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up in front of Svayambhūnātha temple †
cells.date: Rājakēsarivarman 'who destroyed the ships at Šalai'
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land as sarvamānya for expenses of festival in the temple of Tāntōṇpiśvaram-Uđaiya-Nāyaṇār at Māmpattū by Gaṇdabērunda Uriya Kāmaṇa Nāyakkar.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Eḷuvāmbāḍi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock by the side of a private house in the street.
cells.date: Rājakēsarivarman 'who destroyed the ships at Šalai'
cells.remarks: States that 2 [mā] of land to the North of the temple garden is sarvamānya.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two pieces of a broken slab lying on a vacant ground near the village Munaif’s house.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the village Eļuvānāđi alias Chitramēji-chaturvēdimangalam, in Palkunṇa-kōtṭam, a subdivision of Jayangonda-šōla-mandalam a tax-free agrahāra to Varantarum-piļai alias Pāligaivā[n]-dāsari and others, by the nātļavar of the place.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Jaṭādhārikkuppam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab lying near the tank.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 16th century A. D. States that the tank called Appaṇ Tirukkōnēri was dug by a merchant name Šulavaṅgātū Vernbānđai.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Three stones set up under a pipal tree in a street.
cells.remarks: The writing on two stones seem to form one Incomplete inscription, while that on the third stone is a copy of a portion of the inscription. Records an endowment of (land called) Irungōlan Endal in Murugamaṅgala-parķu as madappuram to Bhikshāmađam-Išānaśivāchārya, by a certain Tirumalanayinār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / POLUR TALUK—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Karappūndi.—Slab built into the ceiling of the Māriyammap shrine.
cells.remarks: Ends of lines lost. Seems to register grant of land as saramāṇya by a certain Sūrappa-Nāyaka. Mentions the temple of Sōmanā[tha] at Paḍaiyūru [where the assembly of the village met].

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Rēṇḍarāmpattu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab, set up in front of Durgaiyamman shrine at the entrance to the village.
cells.remarks: Records an endowment of 1300 kuḷi of land by Sālimēyar alias Toṇḍaimān to the god Tirukkāmīśuram-uḍaiya-Nāyanār at Saṁbukulappuram in Tirumuṇaippāḍi.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Kuṇṇattūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up near a well at the entrance into the village.
cells.remarks: Records a tax-free grant of land as ērippatĵi, by Mōndūr Attālichađangavi, a member of the ālunganam of Kunpattīr alias Mārili-Mahākālachaturvēdimangalam in Muhai-nāđu.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North tier of the central shrine of the ruined Vishnu temple.
cells.remarks: Modern. Records the gift of 100 kuḷi of land in Aparam-Kuṇṇattūr by the assembly of the village to the [Vishnu] temple] by Veṅkaṭādri, son of Aṇṇa Rēji[yā]r of Puṇyākō-rigadaṇallūr for the merit of Vēlūr Chinnu Tippu Nāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Tiers of the west and south walls, same shrine.
cells.remarks: Do. Seems to record the endowment by Sūrappa-Nāyaka for burning lamps on the days of ākkādaśi and amāvāsyā in the temple of Vīrirunda-Perumāl.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Tiers of the maṇḍapa in front of Vishnu temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Mentions Kuppaṇa, the maṇiyam of Idaiitturil.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same tiers
cells.remarks: Gift of 12½ kaḻañju of gold left in charge of the sabbhā of the place for feeding (itinerants) by Kāmakākşi Tatta bhatten.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two pieces of a broken slab set up in front of Vishnu temple. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to record the revival of festivals in and repairs to the temple of Paramēśvara Vinnagara Virirundarulya Perumāl at Kuṇṇattūr and the assignment of some taxes due to them, by the nāṭṭār of the region for the purpose.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Hero-stone set up in the place of Vishnu †
cells.remarks: The inscription is engraved above the figure of a warrior holding a bow in his left hand and a dagger in his right, with an attendant on his right. Records the death of a warrior named Pāpāṭakanan [who] bravely fought, after dispatching (his enemies) in a fight. The village Varuir is mentioned. (Cf. No. 86 above).

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the Rishabhanātha basti near Vishnu temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record the construction of the Arhat (Jaina) temple at Kuṅrai (i.e., Kuṇṇattūr).

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North and west walls of the central shrine of the Virajambēśvara temple.
cells.date: Śaka 143[1]. Śukla, Makara-śu, 2, Friday, Tiruvōṇam, Saṅkramapa.
cells.remarks: Records the provision made from the śudam due to Iḍatturai by Tirumalai-Nāyaka-Vīra-Nāyaka for conducting a festival on the day of Tiruvōṇam in the month of Tai, and for burning lamps in the temple of Vīrachampēśvara at Kuṛṛattūr on the west bank (mēlkkarai) of the Śeyyāṛu in Muṛugamaṅgalapparu, situated in Paṅgala-nāḍu, a division of Puḷkuṇṛa-kōṭṭam, in Jayaṅgoṇḍaśōḻa-maṇḍalam.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Virajambēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records an order of Śamburāya remitting taxes on several bits of devadāna lands belonging to god Vīrachampēśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyaṉār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Records the levy of 6 paṇam and mentions god Vīrachampē-Nāyaṉār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Virajambēśvara temple †
cells.date: Šaka 1474, Virōdhikrit, Makara, śu. 11, Tiruvādirai, Monday.
cells.remarks: Records the assignment of taxes due from the Kakkōḷas of Kunnattūr, for worship to god Vira Champa-Nayinār by Kunnattūr Bommu-Nāyaka and Kakkōḷa-Nāyaka of Vālūr, for the merit of Kṛishṇama-Nāyaka, Siruappa-Nāyaka and Kālama-Nāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillar in the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine of the dilapidated Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Begins with the historical introduction Tiruvalamvuḍaiyān, etc. Records sale of 250 kaḻañju of land by the sabhā of Kunrattūr alias Mārlīmahākāla-chaturvēdimangalam in Mugai-nāḍu, a subdivision of Palkunrak-kōṭṭam, to a merchant of Adīrama-ṭṭanam (Ādīramāṇikyanappaṭṭanaparru), named Mullaiprādhyan alias Disaimāṇikqupōtetti who purchased the same and assigned it for a night lamp till day-break in the abhihēka-maṇḍapa constructed by him in the temple of Tirukkāri-Ālvār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another pillar in Śiva temple †
cells.remarks: Records that Puttulān Āṇḍaiyān Vasīvāraṇan Pambaiyāṉaḻan set up the Palliyarai-Nāchchiyār in the temple of Tiruk-kāriśuramudaiya-Nāyanār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South, east and north walls of Śiva temple. †
cells.remarks: Begins with the historical introduction Tirumaṇi-pālvāy, etc. Damaged and incomplete. Records a sale of land by the sabhā of Kunrattūr alias Mārlīmahākāla-chaturvēdimangalam in Mugai-nāḍu, a subdivision of Palkunrak-kōṭṭam, to a member of the dēvaṅgaṇa of the village. Another fragmentary inscription in the same place beginning with the same introduction records a sale of land by the same sabhā to a member of the village-assembly of Dēndēśvaramuttan, who evidently assigned it for lamps during the three sandis in the temple of Daṇḍēśvara constructed by him. A third fragmentary inscription of the king engraved close by and beginning with the same introduction is dated in the 19th year.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same walls
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records the setting up of the image of Astra-dēva in the temple of Tirukkārimurti-uḍaiya-Nāyanār by Sōlavāṇḍai, a dēvaradiyār of the temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Kuruvimalai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillar lying in the precincts of the Karikaṇḍīśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Refers to Tiruvvaṇṇāmalai of the god (dēvar). Another fragmentary inscription found on a broken pillar close by mentions Tiruvvāṇḍurai and records gift of money for providing offerings (to the god).

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Āṇavaḍi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab built into the ceiling of the Muttyalamma shrine.
cells.date: Šaka 1[4]31, Vi[bhava], Makara, śu. 10, Thursday, Rēvati.
cells.remarks: Beginning and end built in. Records a sale of land by the ūrattār of the temple of Tiruvaṇṇāmalai-uḍaiya-Nāyanār to a certain individual of the agaram Kamalapuramāṇallūr.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Nammiyampalṭ — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two pieces of a broken slab set up by the side of the new viralai shrine.
cells.king: Gaṅgaraiyan Āḷappirandān †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records an order (thai) of ... Gaṅgaraiyan Āḷappirandān who bears the titles, lord of Kuvalālapura, kulōttungan, Kāvērivallabhan and Nandagirināthan to the ūrattār of Ammai-ēndāl assigning their village with its taxes as sroppāṇai to the maṭha of Aghōrasiva-Mudaliyār at Tiru-nappanmalai to be enjoyed permanently by him and his disciples in succession.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / POLUR TALUK—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Tirušür.—Rock known as Āṇaikkal on the south-bund of the tank, a furlong from the kaisingula.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift in favour of the drūvai of Tīridai in Muruganangalapparru.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Veymānallūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two sides of a hero-stone on the roadside, a furlong from the modern Pillaiyār temple.
cells.remarks: In characters of the 9th century A. D. Engraved above the figure of a warrior represented with a shield in the left hand and a scimitar in the right. Records the death of Gauavayan, the disciple of the preceptor (Āśān) Tennapavan, when Veymani was destroyed in the time of Valluvar-Kanarāyar.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Mandakulaṭṭūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillar in the maṇḍapa in the ruined Kunīśvara temple.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 13th century A. D. States that a merchant named Vīrpēdu Kijān Orri Ponnemula Pillai residing at Pēdi alias Silachintāmaṇipuram, made a gift of one pillar (to the temple).

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another pillar in Kunīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of another pillar by the same individual.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: A third pillar in Kunīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of a pillar by a merchant named Tevarpal Udaiyān Kaundi.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: A fourth pillar in Kunīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Another gift of a pillar by Origi Sambanda-Perumal, the heart-man of Virpēdu and a merchant residing at Pēdi alias Silachintāmaṇipuram.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the central shrine in Kunīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records gift of land entrusted to the assembly of Kulattur alias Naranāyakapuram and to Marudūrke of Kuḷattūr in Kuḷattur-nādu by a merchant of Nidūr for the worship to the goddess Tirumainūrchchētakhiyār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of maṇḍapa in the Sundara-varada-Perumāl temple in the same village (as Kunīśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. In characters of about the 17th century A. D. Mentions Dēśināthayyanapperumāl.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Door jambs at the entrance into the central shrine of Sundara-varada-Perumāl temple. †
cells.remarks: States that the façade (maṇḍapam) and the pillars (tiruvilaiṭṭil) were the gifts of......Sōkkanār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Four faces of the base of a Yūpadamuka standing behind the Local Board school.
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Records salutation to Bōdhāyana.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Murugappādi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock on waste land south of Pallitangal tank, a mile north of the village.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 17th century A. D. Grant of land by the Mahājanam to Karaiyan for maintaining a perpetual lamp (in the temple).

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Pōliyūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two pillars in the maṇḍapa in front of the Pōlikai-amman shrine, near the market.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records gift of land, after purchase from the sabhā of Pōliyūr alias Mahādēva-chaturvēdimangalam, in Puṟanūr-nāḍu, a subdivision of Paduvūr-kōṭṭam, to the god in the village, by Kāmakkāṇi Appiyarāṇipperu-māl of Tiruvēlī-nāḍu, an subāṇḍiu of sōlānāḍu.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another pillar in Pōlikai-amman shrine †
cells.remarks: Records gift of land after purchase, from the assembly of Pōliyūr alias (Mahādēva)-chaturvēdimangalam, by Kōrrappāṇ, alias Gaṇḍarādiharma Peruntunai, son of Arugunān Nambi Chetti of Arugūr, in Miyyāru-nāḍu, a subdivision of Paduvūr-kōṭṭam, to Nārāyana-Saran, son of Śrīsāli in the Bhāradvāja-gōtra, a dēvaradiyār of the temple, for a night lamp to be constructed in the middle of the village as an adjunct to the Peruṇatunai of Arugūr-nāḍu for providing in it water during summer and firewood during winter.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another pillar in Pōlikai-amman shrine †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary and highly damaged.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Kaliyampattu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Threshold at the entrance to the Ostrasamma shrine.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record the gift of a village by the king as undaikkōlu to Milūvachch-chakravartti.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Panappamkattu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two sides of a slab used as foot-rest in a well in a private field.
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Mentions Tiṇḍivanam and an agent of the local Muhammadan chief.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Tiṇḍivanam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab under a pipal tree
cells.remarks: Begins with the historical introduction ‘Tingalartaru’ etc. Records gift of land (1100 aṭṭai) after purchasing it for 11 rūpakkāśu (1100 kaḻañju) of gold, from the ūrattār of Aḍai-diva-chaturvēdimangalam in Neḍuvaṅgai-mugai-nāḍu in Paṅgala-nāḍu, a subdivision of Jayangoṇḍachōla-maṇḍalam, by the Śrīkaṇṭhapuram of the temple of Tiruttiṇḍil-uḍaiya-Mahādēva for burning two perpetual lamps in the temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two slabs near the ruined Śiva temple close to the hill.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Begins with the granthi, commencing with the words ‘Tirumagal [m]uyanga sthiramaṅgal valañga’. Records the purchase of land (kaṇikkupāḍi) alias Kalaimai-kaḷakkallik-kāṇi, by a certain individual, Ayamān, who is given the titles Chalakaṇḍallān, Gajamallan etc.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Śanikāvādi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Both sides of a pillar in a private field.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 15th century A. D. Records an order of the assembly of Ṭinaiyūru who had acquired land and settled at another place consequent on the devastation of their village by flood in the year Durmati, promising to collect only 1/64 param per loon from the next year.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Karaṇiyambādi-(hamlet of Ānaiāṉidi) — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two sides of a slab set up in a private field.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Begins with the historical introduction ‘Tiru-maṇṇivalara’ etc. Records sale of land by the ūrattār of Kurāppākkam in Maṅgala-nāḍu, a subdivision of Paṅgala-nāḍu in Jayangoṇḍasōlamaṇḍalam, to a peruṅdaram officer, for providing in it sacred bath and offerings during two sandis in the temple of the village.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Kurāppākkam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two sides of a slab set up by the side of a wall in a private field.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Begins with the historical introduction ‘Tiruv-maṇṇivalara’ etc. Records sale of land by the ūrattār of Kurāp-pākkam in Maṅgala-nāḍu, a subdivision of Paṅgala-nāḍu in Jayangoṇḍasōlaṇḍalam, to a peruṅdaram officer, for providing in it sacred bath and offerings during two sandis in the temple of the village.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Palliyūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Three sides of a slab set up in a private field (Sur. No. 322/1).
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift for providing offerings (to the deity) in a temple on a certain day and on the days of festival. Mentions Ēkappa Nāyaka and his son.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock in a private land bearing Sur. No. 323/5.
cells.remarks: States that (the income from) Palāṭaṅgal alias Periya-nāchchiyārapuram, offerings during the midnight service and lamps, should be provided to Tirumaṇaikkuṇḍar.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / POLUR TALUK—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Periyagaram.—South wall of the central shrine in the ruined Vishnu temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Refers to (two) garlands of pearls.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Alattūrpādi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two sides of a slab set up in a private land.
cells.remarks: Highly-damaged. Refers to Śriranga-Nāyaka, son of Tuluva Veṅkața-Nāyaka, an unbōdipi-grāma, and to the concessions shown to the families settling in it.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two sides of a broken slab lying near a well in a private land.
cells.remarks: Damaged. In characters of about the 14th century A. D. Seems to record gift of 3000 kuhi of land at Alampūndi.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Padiyanbattu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillars in the mandapa of the Draupadi temple.
cells.remarks: Beginning lost. States that the mahā-mandapa and ardha-mandapa, evidently of the temple, got Tiruvik-vachchhirupākkattadēva at Korramangalam was constructed of stone and also that a stone image of Rishabhadeva was set up by Attimala (Hastimalai) aliza Kannaradēva Prithivigangādaraiyan, chief of Pādā-nādu, and another for pūr-maryādā and that he gave the village Korramangalam for providing offerings to the deity and for feeding daily eight Brāhmaṇas. A portion of the historical introduction of Rājarāja begins with the words 'Tirumagalpola etc., is found closely below. Another inscription in the same place states that Perumāmanadigal wishing to respect the gift of Prithivigangaraiyan issued an order to this effect through his adhikāri Mugaiyuruiyān and Minavan Muvendavēļān.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Idaippari — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two sides of slab set up in Pāndya's thē Vēdīappan temple.
cells.remarks: Purports to be an abhaya-śāsuna (Aṇjināṇpu:alīdam) given by Kulaśēkhara (aṅganārāyanachakravartti, promisinz to take ī panam per family from the Kaikkōlas, Vāṇiyar, Šeļfis etc., settling at Idaipparai.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Ōdalavādi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South base of the central shrine in the Arhat (Jain) temple.
cells.remarks: Records gift of tax-free land as pallichchandam by (u)lalan Sōjan Mūrtiyaralvar of Odaippadi, after purchasing it from the senior of the village of to the (Jain) temple of Nayinar Aniya-dayigaiyar.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of Vēdīappan temple †
cells.remarks: Stops after mentioning the name of the king.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Broken pillar lying in the street opposite to the sama temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Records a gift by the nāttavar of Murugaman-galapparraru for worship and cloth (tirapparivattam) to the deity.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Right door jamb of the ruined Perumal temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. In characters of about the 9th century A.D. Fragmentary. Gives the boundaries of a piece of land.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up on tank bund in Sur. No. 355.
cells.remarks: Records the order of Yirepalli Mukunda Reddi, agent of Timmā-Nāyaka, to utilise the trees (Vīlāmaram) standing on the tank rent (from the fish rent) in renovating the tank at Ōdalapādi.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Attūrai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two slabs of slab set up in tank bed (Sur. No. 212/1).
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Seems to refer to the renovation of the tank in the village.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Chittattūrai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two slabs of a slab set up in the street near Mutyalamma temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to refer to gift of the village Śrīrājāmarai.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Narasingapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Both sides of slab set up in a private land.
cells.date: Saka 1482, Raudra, Tui, śu. 10, Monday, Anusham.
cells.remarks: Records the formation of a pālaiyam in Narasinganallúr situated in Tacchhúr-nāđu, a division of Murugamaṅgalaparĵru, in Palkuṇrak-kōṭtam, in the name of Tirumalai-Nāyaka, son of Muttu-Liṅgappa-Nāyaka, by İ.kappa-Nāyaka. Emigrants of all castes were permitted to settle on it without payment of any taxes for three years, but thereafter a fee of 3 panam per annum was levied on each family. Sadáíva is given the titles Tribhuwanarāyagūli and Śambuvarāya-sthāpanāchārya.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another slab in a private land, Mutyalamma temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers gift of land to goddess Ellamman.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Three sides of a huge slab set up in another private land.
cells.date: Šaka 1404, Śubhakrit, Simha, šu. [10], Monday, Tiruvōṇam.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records sale of land in Odalapādi situated in Tachchāmbādi-nādu, a sub-division of Mandaraśakar-Padai-malai-Ayyagāra, a Kuṇrālaiyar of Narasinagappādi and the son of Kappa-Nāyakkar, living in Narasinagappādi by the ānattār of the temple at Tiruvanāmalai, an independent village in Penna-Vadagarai Vānagōppādi in Śenguṇa-kōttam, which was a district of Jayangonda-śōlamaṇdalam.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab built into the platform at the entrance to Vinayaka shrine on a hill.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 11th century A. D. Records grant of 3,000 kuţi (kēku) of land (at ōḍai) by the Eighty-two éram-spans (mūvarāśān-kōl) by Mudar-dēvrai Dēvādiēviran to a Brāhmaṇa named Madhavyan.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Turinūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Round the stone mortar lying outside the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 11th century A.D. States that the oil-press (sēkkv) was the gift of Maídēvan, son of Ilaichōhān-dap of Tumbaiyūr.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Sēvyanāndal — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Three sides of a rock in a reserve forest.
cells.remarks: Records grant of land in Karunāpkādi included in the sīma of Śātapattu, by Nāranappa-Nāyaka, the agent of Vijaya-Raghunatha-Nāyaka as the gift of his lord (Periya-Nāyaka), for the early morning service of the god Tirumalakoijundar at Dēvikāpuram.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Tachchāmbādi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Walls of the gōpura of the Jain temple and south wall of the ruined Śiva temple on the hillock.
cells.remarks: The gōpura of the Jain temple was constructed with the stones from the ruined Śiva temple on the hillock. Some of the inscribed stones are missing. Seems to record the decision regarding the right of collecting grain-fees granted by certain villages to the temple of Ammaiarraiya-Nāyār Marudarāsar-Padaivīdu with the right of collecting a small cess (alku) in them. Also states that these communities bestowed upon Iruvēngalanāthar, son of Mala-Appana-yakkar, the title 'Marainpulak-kāvalan'.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / POLŪR TALUK—contd. / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up in a private land.
cells.remarks: Records gift of land in Tachchāmbāḍi according to the order (rāyasam) of Narasingadēja-Uḍaiyār, for providing cake offerings to the god Iḷaiya-Nayiṉār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another stone in a private land
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 10th century A. D. Records gift of land by Śērippuramuḍaiyān, son of Ayyāraḍigal of Pāḍa-nāḍu, for daily offerings to the god, Tachchāmbāḍi-Mādēva.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Both sides of a slab set up in the tank bed
cells.remarks: Records the construction of a sluice to the tank at Tachchāmbāḍi in Pāḍi-nāḍu, a sub-division of Paḷkunra-kōṭṭam, in memory (?) of Mañjikaṇār who died and who was the daughter of Pāḍaḍaiyār Nambi Eluvanār and the wife of Chēramāṇ-pērumān, son of Pāḍaḍaiyār, the chief of Pāḍa-nāḍu. The sluice was called Tirumafapāḍi.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI · Kulakkaraivāḍi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone mortar in a private garden (Sur. No. 71).
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 11th century A. D. Records that Varaguṇap of Noyyāḍi was the donor of the mortar (śekku).

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI · Manśarābāḍ — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two sides of a stone set up on the tank bund (Sur. No. 64).
cells.remarks: Modern. Engraved carelessly. Seems to state that the tank was the gift of Ranga-chetti of Ēṭṭappattu.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI · Śiṭṭupaṭṭu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Three sides of a slab set up near the Dharmarāja temple.
cells.remarks: States that Śēkhādri ayyan of Tiruvannāmalai re-settled at Śēruppaṭṭu the ryots who had migrated from it being unable to cultivate the lands on lease according to the then prevailing rate of lease (kuttagai) assuring them that specified taxes as common rate would be collected from them. The new arrangement (kaṭṭalai) was made for the merit of Raghunātha Nāyaka and Dīkshitarrayagay.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab used as foot-rest in a well in the ruined Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Modern. Incomplete. Records a deed (nāmā) given to Muṭṭukkappa-uḍaiyār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab in the north wall of the central śrī-koil of the ruined Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Mentions the names, Nārāyaṇapperumāḷ and [Mā]dhavapperumāḷ.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Three faces of a stone lying in the back-yard of the Police station.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record a gift of land.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI · Appēđu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Flagstaff in front of Lakshminārāyaṇa Perumā] temple.
cells.remarks: Modern. States that the flagstaff was the gift of Po[ṇa]. yyaṅgar.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI · Olagampattu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two slabs set up near the Pillaiyār temple.
cells.language: Sanskrit and in Grantha and Tamil.
cells.remarks: Records tax-free gift of the village ‘Ulagallapattu alias Śrī-Alankarachakravartti-maharāya-bhaṭṭa-galapparu, in Palkunra-kōttam, to Tirumali Periya Nallān-Chakravartti, son of Śri-Alagar Chakravartti who was the son of Urupputtur Kāvya-Chakravartgal. The inscription praises the ancestors of the donee.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI · Indirāvanam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up on the road-side opposite to school.
cells.remarks: Registers gift of the village Indirāvanam free of all specified taxes and divided into 32 shares with 32 house-sites as sarvamānya-agrahāra, among the Saṅvaras headed by the fish-amount darayar.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up on the tank bund
cells.date: Śaka 1368, Krichdhana, Dhanus, tu 5, Thursday, Punarpūsam.
cells.remarks: Records the provision made by one Timmü-Nāyakkar for dredging the tank at Indirāvanam with the amount realised from it.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI · Alliānamangalam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Lintel entrance into the ruined Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Beginning built in and highly damaged. Seems to record some provision for worship.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI · Pēdakam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up on the bank of a tank near the Mariamman temple.
cells.remarks: Records the provision made for reading the purāņa in the matha constructed by Sūryahattar.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up near the well in the Abhārā-mīsvara temple.
cells.remarks: States that one Gaṅgāchūļāmaņi alias Pushpa-mānikkachetti constructed a sluice to the tank at Pādagam, and called it ' Nakkā[n]pirātti,' after the name of his daughter.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI · Śīttampaṭṭu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab built into the wall of a well in a private land.
cells.remarks: Registers gift of the village Sigirapanallur alias Chitra-mēlinallur, by the nāttavar of Muruganamgalapparu to Sempavalakkuñjaram-Udaiyar at Tiruvannamalai.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI · Kikarikkāttür — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up into the platform in front of the Aṇjanēya temple.
cells.remarks: Beginning lost and fragmentary. Seems to record gift of two house-sites.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another slab in the place of Aṇjanēya †
cells.remarks: Fragment.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI · Rayankuppam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Flagstaff in front of the Pillaiyar temple.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to record remission of water cess (nīr-kūli).

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI · Śāduppēri — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillar set up on the land belonging to the village munntiff.
cells.date: 4th year, Chitrahi-nụ Misha du. 7, Friday, Punarpūsam.
cells.remarks: Records gift of the village Śāduppēri alias Rājanārāyaṇa-chaturvējimaṅgalam (Madurantakapoṭṭari-nādu), a sub-division of Veṇkuṇra-nādu, in Palkunrak-kōttam, a sub-division of Jayangoṇdaśōla-maṇdalam, as a tax-free sarvamānya among 54 Brahmans of the Lāda and Vaļuga (countries).

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI · Gadalur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up on the tank bund
cells.remarks: Records the assignment of water cess on the lands belonging to the temple of Kariya-Perumal for the maintenance of 4 lamps in the same temple by Rāmappa Dēvachāmāla-rāja.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up in a private land
cells.remarks: Records gift of land as ēvrippatti by Dhīran-Mādēvan, a resident of Kūdalür in Tachchhulāmpādi.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLŪR TALUK / TACHCHĀMBĀḌI · Teṇ-Paļippaṭṭu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the central shrine in the ruined Vishnu temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a provision made for offerings to the God by Toṇḍaimān, the agent of Tirumalainikolun-dupillai who was himself an agent of Raghunātha-Nāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / POLUR TALUK—contd. / Teṇ-Pallipaṭtu—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of Vishnu temple †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of the village Rāmanchan-drapuram to the temple of Varadarāja-Perumāl at [Pal]-lipattu for worship, service, etc., by Sevvappa-Nāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Pullûr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up in a private land
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record a gift of land as Udira-ppatti.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set-up in front of the local school
cells.remarks: Seems to record a gift of land in Pullûr for service in the temple of the god Udaiyâr Tiruvayanamalaiudaiyâr.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Sēvunganuttēri — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone lying in a private land behind the ruined Śiva temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1440, Bahudhâ-nya, Karkāṭaka, śu. 5, Monday, Uttirâṇ.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the gift of a village (?) after purchase from the tānahâr of the temple of Tiruvannâmalaiudaiyâna-Nâyanâr, for worship etc., to the goddess Umâmulai-Ammâi, at the gift of Krishṇadēva-Mahârâya, by Chinnappa-Nâyaka.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Mēl Āraṇi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone lying in Sēkkumēdu, on the way to Mēl Vilvarāyanallūr.
cells.remarks: Modern. Records an order of Mannâr-Pillai of Pôliyûr-âfrmani and agent of Râja Śri Aiyan Annantôlî Panditaraiyan, remitting the taxes mugarâjvai and aduppuerri, on the village Āraṇi which (the taxes) had been ordered to be remitted by his master (for the whole) of Pôliyûr-sîrmai.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Mēlvilvarāyanallūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock on the way to the Vishņu temple on the hill.
cells.date: Śaka 144[1], Vikrama, Vrischika ..., śu. 10, Friday, Svâti.
cells.remarks: Highly worn out. Records gift of land in Villi[ya]râj[i]nallûr for worship, etc., in the Perumâl temple. Mentions Appajina-Nâyaka, the delavoy of Âṇaikundî Râmânyadēva-Mahârâya.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone lying in a private land (Patta No. 312).
cells.remarks: Contains the concluding portion of an inscription.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone in the place of Śiva †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift to the Perumâl temple at Puliyur by Appu-Nâyaka as the gift of Râma-[ppa*]ldēvachôla-Mahârâja.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Three sides of a slab built into the pial of a house in the village nattam, No. 97/1.
cells.remarks: Beginning lost and highly damaged. Seems to record a gift to the Perumâl temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock known as “Śīppâppâri” to the north of the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records gift of land as tax-free devadāna for offerings and lamp in the temple of Tâṅkôpîśvaram-Udaiyâr at Tatâpâdi (Tachchampâdi) by Tillai-Udaiyâr, son of Gaṇḍa-gajabhîman.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up in a private land about a mile to the south of the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to the construction of a tank at Villavarâyanallûr and to a grant of 500 kuli of land below it, to Tiruttâ-pillai, the servant (panaiyal) of [Ga]ṅgaigarâgal. The inscription bears the signature of Malaihîchchôhi Villavarâyar at the end.
