cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Elattur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West face of a rook known as Periyāpparai on the river bank and to the south of the traveller's bungalow.
cells.remarks: States that (the land called) Pārigutpendal was endowed for the maintenance of the Periyanāyakār Aruṇagiri Jīvarmāha.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Kachcherimangalam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Hero-stone set up behind the Draupadi temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of tax-free land in Sērumangalam to the god at Tiruvappārmalai and for lamps to the goddess Uyyakkondān-nāchiṭyār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Kil Potturai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up by the side of the Pillaiyār temple in the street.
cells.date: Śaka 1349, Plavamga, Margali 18, Monday, Viśākhā, Dvādaśī.
cells.remarks: States that since the irrigation channel at P[u]ll[i]l[i]r was damaged by rain, it was repaired by the merchant Bhaṭṭakaradeva, son of Singana Dīkshita, for the merit of Mallappa Dannāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Chōlapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab built into the floor in the east prākāra of the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records an order of Lakkappaṇaḷ-Udaiyār to the sthānikas of the temple of Tiruvaṇṇāmalaiudaaiya- Nāyanār remitting certain taxes due on the temple lands [al]ngu[n]gū[ru]ttal-pākkada-nādu, till the year Pramādi, and indicating certain concessions for other lands from the month of Ādi of the same year.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Broken stone in the prākāra of Śiva . †
cells.remarks: Begins with the historical introduction 'Tirumagalpōla' of Rājarāja I and stops before mentioning the king's name.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab built into the balipitha in the prākāra of Śiva. †
cells.remarks: Seems to record a gift of land for providing offerings to the god [Sat]yarāman[f]al[y]ar.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up in the south prākāra of Śiva temple. †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of 3000 kañji of land to the deity Śatti Nakkan of Sattimamgalam by the nā-anar of Terkiṟvai for sounding (tiruvamdu) with five persons during the three services (of the tiruvamdu) in the temple. Refers to a piece of land named Kōdaṇḍarāmap-perumpatti.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South tier of the central shrine in Śiva temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary, and damaged. Seems to record a gift of land to the temple of Dēvanāyaka. Unnāmali-Udaiyār is mentioned as the gift of the king (Ulaguḍaiyar). Another record close by mentions that the Sōmāskanda images were set up [in the temple] by Perumāṇāmbi-Kampan, a merchant of that village.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two halves of a slab built into the steps of the Pillaiyār temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1408, Parābhava, Simha, su. 10, Ānusham, Monday.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records a gift, entrusted to Viravēdiya-nambi, for providing three arivānam of offerings on the occasion of the lunar eclipse, to the god Tiruvaṇṇamalaiudaiya Nāyanār and the goddess Upṇamulai-Nāchchiyār by Kommayadēva-Timmarāja, as the gift of Sāluva Narasingadēva-Mahārāya.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Three stones lying amidst the ruins of the Chōļa Vishnu temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Begins with the introduction 'Pūrvēdeḍānam-Gangaiyām-Kiḍāramum-kongu' etc. Records a land for offerings and money for a lamp, by the nagarattar of '[U]lagalandasōlapuram.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up on the wayside, a furlong north of the Mariyamman temple.
cells.remarks: Engraved below a figure seated on a pedestal supported by a long shaft and holding a dagger by the right hand. Gives the name of the hero as Maṇali Toṇḍaimān Kāṇḍan [Vīra]- viran. In characters of about the 15th century A.D.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up in a garden, south-west of the Mariyamman shrine.
cells.remarks: States that the land known as 'Iyar tiruttu' (was given) as tiruvalakkapuram to god Ulagalanda-Perumāl.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT-concld. / Polur Taluk-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place:
Plvampa u (hamlet of Solapuram).-
Three stones lying in a street.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT. Trichinopoly Taluk. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Śrīraṅgam.-Right side of the entrance into the Nāliki[da]n-gōpura.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Records a gift by the Kannaṣasandhīvigrām of Tribhuvanamalladēva (name lost) for maintaining two lamps in the temple. (See Part II below, paras 36 and 79.)

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT · Lalgudi Taluk. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Peruvalanalallur.-Rock in the old site near the hamlet Pallappuram.
cells.remarks: Gift of 8 cows for lamp to the temple of Kāllōlai Mahādēva, by Chandiran Periyanāṇ, a merchant residing at Irayāchchēri in Prāmmalindallūr-Kaṇḍam.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT · Pudūr Uttamanūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock called 'Panchapāṇḍavar-pārai.'
cells.remarks: Records the grant of the right of worship in the temple to certain persons by Uttamasōlalar alias Virātarāyar.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT · PUDUKKOTTAI STATE. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Kuḍimiyāmalai.-Hill rock near the Bāṇa cavern.
cells.remarks: Verses in praise of Āraivā| (Āraga|ūr) Tyāgavāṇan and his sons Poṇṇin-Perumā| and Añjāda Perumā|. (See No. 385 of 1906.)

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same rock
cells.remarks: Same as one of the verses given in No. 507 of 1902 in praise of the chief Magadai-Perumāl.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT · Ammāchchatram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone lying in front of Chōļa the cavern with beds in the Kuḍagumalai hillock.
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Records provision for offerings and lamps to the temple of Tiruppallimali-Ālvār at [Vaḍasīravāru nāḍu].

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another stone in the place of Mariyamman †
cells.remarks: Records gift of land for conducting a festival of seven days in the temple of the god at Tiruppallimali in Vaḍasīravāru nāḍu.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT · Pillayāval — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Four sides of a stone set up to the north of the village.
cells.remarks: States that Piḷḷaiyāval alias Pāṇḍippuramaṇallūr, the tax from which was assigned to the temple of Āuḍaiya-Tan-dēvar at Mēlaikkāḍu, was mortgaged and purchased by several persons and that it was released and made over to the temple as tirumāttukkāṇi, when Ekapparuḷā-Toṇḍaimāṇ had to collect tribute for payment to the Rāya who took Madura.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT · Śilāttūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the central shrine of the Ponnambalanāthēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Built in the middle, by the Dakshiṇāmūrti shrine. Refers to the nakarattār of the village of Ālagiya-Poṇṇambalanātha at Śilāttūr and to a gift of land to Śivabrāhmaṇa of Araṇ-tāngi in Iḷangō-nāḍu, a subdivision of Sundarapāṇḍya-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the mandapa in front of Ponnambalanāthēśvara temple. †
cells.date: Śaka 1414, Paridāpi, Rishabha, śu., 1, Rōhiṇi, Friday.
cells.remarks: Records gift, as tirunāmattukkāni to the god Ālagiya Poņnambalanātha at Šilattūr, of the villages Karukkānguđi, and Dēvanguđi in his sima in Milalaikūrřam, by the chief of Arantāngi, Ākapperumāļ Tonđaimānār who is given due birudas, 'one who knows no fear,' 'who is not perturbed', 'one who took Iļam in seven days' etc.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of land, after purchase, by Sundaratōḷuḍaiyān Paṭṭaḷagan of Veḷiyāttūr, as tiruviḷakkappuram for burning a twilight lamp in the temple of Ālagiya-kkuccaramuḍaiya-Nāyaṇār.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone fixed into the pavement of the anta-rāḷa of Ponnambalanāthēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records gift of the village Māveṭṭi in Erukkali-kkōṭṭam by Ekapparuḷā Toṇḍaimāṇ to the son of Āṇḍāy-piḷḷai of Tiruṇārāyaṇa-caturvēdimangalam.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT · Kurumbūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the central shrine of the Siddhānathēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Records gift of the village Pāravākkōṭṭai by the chief of Āraṇtāngi, Uḍaiyār Tiruvīraṇḍippēruṇḍai Toṇḍaimāṇ to the temple of Śittanākkāḷk-Nāyaṇār at Kurumbūr-ūr.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of the village Śeṇpattūr to the temple by the chief mentioned above.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT · Kurumbūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records an agreement given by the nagarattār of Maramadakki alias Rājēndrapuram in Urumai-nāḍu to the Uravar of Kurumbūr in Paḷaiyūr-nāḍu, a subdivision of the Rājārāja-vaḷanāḍu, to pay the oḍi kārai tax on their village at 12 paṇam per annum.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT · Kurumbūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: States that the wall (tirumañjana-kkaru) in the temple of Śittanākkāḷk-Nāyaṇār was the gift of Gaṇavati Kajarikkōn, a tenant (of the temple) of Āvuḍaiya-Nāyaṇār.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT · Kurumbūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the income of 1 kaḷam of paddy on each mā of land to the temple from the lands assigned as kiṇi-āchi to the son of (....) of Ālagiya-kuṇavāḷapparuḷā-Toṇḍ-aimāṇ, the chief of Āraṇtāngi.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT · TANJORE DISTRICT-concld. / Arantangi Taluk-concld. / Kurumbūr-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of the same shrine
cells.remarks: Records grant of land in Āneichchūr-vayal situated in Vadavellāru-nādu by Sūryadēvar Kulakulēśvara Toṇḍaimān, as dēvadāna to the temple of Sīttānaklaki-Nāyinar at Kurumbūr which was caused to be engraved by Avuḍai-Nāyiyar Toṇḍaimānār.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT · TANJORE DISTRICT-concld. / Arantangi Taluk-concld. / Kurumbūr-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Siddhānathēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Records the income of the temple of Šittañkalakki-Nayiṇār, at 1 kalam of paddy (per mā) by Ilakkaṇa-Depñāyaka Tonđaimānār, son of Alagiyamaṇavālapperumāl, the chief of Arantāngi in Ijangō-nāđu, a sub-division of Vađave|jāru alias Sundarapāndya-vajanāđu, from the villages Korramaṅgalam and Kurumbil assigned to him as kāṇi-āṭchi.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Siddhānathēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Records gift of land as dēvadāna, in Puduvayal by Alagiyamanavāla Toṇḍaimān, the chief of Ārantangi, to the god Uruḍaiya-Nāyinar Sīttānaklaki-Nāyinar at Kurumbūr.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record an order of Alagiyamanavāla- Tondaimān, the chief of Ārantangi, exempting Ārantangi and Kurumbūr from the payment of certain taxes.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT · TANJORE DISTRICT-concld. / Arantangi Taluk-concld. / Kurumbūr-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: States that (the temple) was renovated by Kamban Mādēvan alias Vattarayar, the chief (araśa) of the village.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT · TANJORE DISTRICT-concld. / Arantangi Taluk-concld. / Kurumbūr-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of 12 mā of land to the temple by Inbavanapperumal Toṇḍaimānār, the chief of Arantangi.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT · TANJORE DISTRICT-concld. / Arantangi Taluk-concld. / Kurumbūr-concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records an order issued to the residents of Kurumbūr by Meṇṇṇura Perumān Toṇḍaimānā,- the chief of Ārantāngi, extending to them the privileges enjoyed at Arantāngi and promising not to levy any other tax besides 25 paṇam per mā annually.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the maṇdapa in front of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Inscribed stones missing in the middle and at the right end. Seems to record a gift of paddy to the temple by the ūrar of the village.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Do. Damaged. Records an order of the ūrār and the tānattār of the temple granting 3 ma of land as kaniātchi, probably to the accountant (of the temple).

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / PATTUKKOTTAI TALUK · PATTUKKOTTAI TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Mahājānasandam.—Stone built into the pavement on the east side of the second prākāra of the Raṅganāthasvāmin temple, Siddhānathēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Mentions Rāja[s]ekharatālu and Vidaraiśvaram-uḍaiyār. Another fragmentary inscription found on the platform near the kitchen of the same temple seems to record an agreement made by the nagarattar towards remission of taxes on some piece of land by payment of money.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / PATTUKKOTTAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: In the gopura of Siddhānathēśvara temple, proper left. left. †
cells.remarks: Fragment. The inscribed stones belong to a Śiva temple. Records gift of land to the deity (name lost) set up in the temple of Menmudi-Nāyanār. menkaṇḍāśōja-chaturvēdimangalam in Rājārajāvajanalūku.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / PATTUKKOTTAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the Āṇḍāl shrine in Siddhānathēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a remission of taxes by Venkarāja, as the gift of [Sevappa] Nāyaka.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / PATTUKKOTTAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Tirukka[d]yūr.—Pillar lying in the Chōla compound of the ruined Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Records the boundary of 1/8th (veli) of land belonging to the god Niṉṛanārūrabera at Tirukkuṅkiliyur, a brahmadeya in Ārkāṭṭūk-kūṟṟam.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / PATTUKKOTTAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Perumāḷ temple.
cells.remarks: A bilingual inscription in Tamil and Telugu recording the gift of the Mahājanas of the agrahāra of Tirukkamkuḍi to bāgum Mallarāsar. In characters of about the 15th century A. D.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / PATTUKKOTTAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Tiruvallam[p]i.—Door jambs at the Chōla southern entrance of the Mahā-maṇḍapa in the Vaṭamūlēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction 'Pugaḷmādu' etc. Records an agreement given by the Sivabrāhmaṇas of the temple of Mahādēva at Tiruvallampoli, hamlet of Parappaikkuḍi in Arkāḍukūṟram, a subdivision of Dinachintāmaṇi-nādu to burn a perpetual lamp before the god for the gold received by them from two private persons.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / PATTUKKOTTAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the same Mahā-maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record gift of land by certain persons to the Mahājanas for turning a lamp in the temple of the god at Parambaikkuḍi in Tiruvāṭkūk-kūṟṟam.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / PATTUKKOTTAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Veṇdayampatti.—North, west and south walls of the central shrine of the Tāṇṭōśrīvara temple.
cells.remarks: Records gift of the village Śemkabugudi by the Sāmanta T[yā]garājāyan Alagiyap[erumāl] belonging to Tiruvanmāḍi who bears a number of titles such as Rāvuttanimandan, Takkāru-takkān etc., for worship and offerings to the god Tāṇṭōṅgīśvaramudaiya-Tambirān.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / PATTUKKOTTAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West and south walls of the Chaṇḍēśvara shrines in Tāṇṭōśrīvara temple. †
cells.remarks: States that the shrine of Chaṇḍēśvara was repaired by an agambaḍi-mudali named Śembuamtha, son of Pāṇḍyaperumāl.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT. / MADURA TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Tirupparankuṇṇam :—Stray stone fixed into the wall near the dvīrapālaka (left) at the entrance into the central shrine in the Subrahmanya temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record a grant of land for providing offerings to the goddess Avayanāyakī.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT—contd. / MADURA TALUK—contd. / Tirupparankuṇram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Beginning of the inscription lost. Records a grant of ūrvari by the king at the instance of Aiyan Malavarāyar regarding a tax-free land known as Aṟaiyūr-maṇram in Iruṅkōṇ-tapasu-nāḍu in the muṅkūṟ constructed in the name of Bhagavatī Ālvār to the north-east of the temple of Tirupparankunramuḍaiyār.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Inner wall of the Mahā-maṇḍapa (proper right of entrance) in Tāṇṭōśrīvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Commences with the introduction 'Pūvikiḷatti' etc., and is obstructed by images towards the end. Seems to record sale of land, free of taxes, by the authorities of the temple of Tirupparankunramuḍaiyār to the assembly (ūrār) of Kuḷacēkharapuram.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Beginning lost and built in at the end. Seems to record gift of house-sites to several servants of the temple.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall (inside) of the sama maṇḍapa
cells.remarks: Records a royal order issued while halting at Vīra-Dhāvala granting land and a house-site to a daughter of a temple servant (dēvarāḍiyāl). Records also a grant of land as kuṭikiśānam by the trustees of the temple to the (potter) Āļvi Rājasagambhīra-viṇṇadaraaiyan.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Inner wall of Tāṇṭōśrīvara temple, left of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Records a royal order, issued at the instance of Kāliṅgarāyar remitting the taxes of Kuḷacēkharapuram, for providing the taxes of Kuḷacēkharapuram, for providing the ūrvari for lighting the lamp in the temple of Tirupparankunramuḍaiyār as a nagara by clubbing together certain villages in the 9th year of the king, is also appended to the record.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Entrance into Mahā-maṇḍapa, left
cells.king: Vimalāditya †
cells.remarks: Tamil and Sanskrit in characters of the 15th century A.D. Fragmentary and of lines chiselled. Contains a genealogical account of the Āraṇīu chiefs and mentions Ayyana Sōmēnēra-nripati, the king Vimalāditya and his son Rājamarēndra nripati, whose presence is recorded. Includes a praśasti introduced into the Āndhra Bhāshā. The kings, Sarvajña Sōmēsvara-nripati, Pinnama, Kōnēpēra-nripati, Viṭha-Jēsvara and Timma Bhūpa are also mentioned towards the end of the inscription.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall, right of entrance
cells.remarks: Beginning of lines built in. Seems to record a gift of land to the temple by the assembly (ūr) of Kuḷacēkharapuram.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: At the entrance (proper right) into the Mahā-maṇḍapa of Tāṇṭōśrīvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to be in praise of the god.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: Verse by Bakalavidyāchakravartti in praise of a Bāṇa chief. See also A. R. No. 544 of 1902.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place, proper left
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction 'Tirumalar tiruvum' of Māravarman Sundara-Pāṇḍya II. Ende of lines built in. Records a midnight gift of land for offering to the god during the midnight service instituted in the temple in the name of Piḷḷai Bagavati-Ālvār.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT—contd. / MADURA TALUK—contd. / Tirupparankuṇram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place, proper left
cells.remarks: Engraved in continuation of the previous inscription and connected with it. Ends of lines built in. Seems to register a remission of taxes to meet the expenses of (the midnight service) referred to 'above.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT—contd. / MADURA TALUK—contd. / Tirupparankuṇram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place, proper left
cells.remarks: Beginning of lines built in. Records the issue of vāri for the remission of taxes mentioned in No. 249 above.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Wall of the kambattaḍi-maṇḍapa (inside), left of entrance.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction 'Pūmaruviya tirumađandaiyum' etc. Intercepted by a wall in the middle. Records sale of land to two goldsmiths by the Śri Rudra-Mahēśvaras for providing offerings to the god, as the original endowment of the village Tiruvunnāligainallīr made for this purpose in the [+]+1+1st year of Periṇanāyānār Kulasēkharadēva, remained fallow without any yield.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Commences with the introduction 'Tirumaimāmalai' etc. Records a royal order issued at the instance of the brotherin-law, Vikramasōladēvar, while the king was halting at Aliyūr in Nāṭṭārūpukku, granting the village Puḍukkulam for providing offerings to the god Vikramapāṇḍya-īśvaram-Udaiyār, constructed by Tiruvaruṅgōlampaḍaiyatapasvin of Kiḷainādam at Tirupparaṅgunram and for this maintenance of this person and his samāna.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT—contd. / MADURA TALUK—contd. / Tirupparankuṇram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Pertains to the grant noticed above.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Wall of the kambattaḍi-maṇḍapa, right of entrance.
cells.remarks: Obstructed by a railing in the middle. Records an agreement given by the Sivabrāhmaṇas of the temple of Tirupparaṅguṇram to burn and maintain a twilight lamp in the shrine of the goddess, for 1 poṉ received by them from a person of Malaimalāṇam.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Left of entrance into the kambattaḍimaṇḍapa above the steps.
cells.remarks: In praise of the Bāṇa chief Virapperumāl Magadēśan (cf. 507 of 1902).

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: In praise of the Bāṇa chief Virapperumāl Magadēśan (cf. 507 of 1902).

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT—contd. / MADURA TALUK—contd. / Tirupparankuṇram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Do. Right of entrance
cells.remarks: In praise of the Bāṇa chief Virapperumāl Magadēśan (cf. 507 of 1902).

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: Two verses in praise of the same chief.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT—contd. / MADURA TALUK—contd. / Tirupparankuṇram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Mentions [Poṇparappina] Perumāl 'who took Madurai, Karuvūr and Kāñchī'.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in the gōpura
cells.remarks: Remrs to a grant of a piḷaiyāram as raṭṭakāṇikkai, to (the same Perumāl) Āṇḍān, son of Ellappa Mudali, who fell from the gōpura evidently to vindicate some right and to a gift of land for providing offerings to the god daily.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT-contd. / MADURA TALUK-contd. / Tirupparankunram-contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Above the platform of the gōpura of Tāṇṭōśrīvara (proper right). †
cells.date: Śaka 1714, Paridāpi, Pa:iguni 24, Wednesday, śu. 4, 2, Rēvati.
cells.remarks: States that during the administration of Gōpālakrya under Ahmad Khādar Saheb and Hazarat Nababu Saheb when Hazarat Kepilai Nababu Saheb was ruling the country, one Kuṭṭi, son of Vayirāvi Muṭṭakkuruppan, fell from the gōpura (as a protest against the demolition of the complex of Sōklānattha and Palakanniya-Pillai, whose amānam dāni) was granted a pūjāyom as raṭṭakāṇikkai making provision for providing offerings to the god daily.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: States that the gōpura and the compound wall (tīrumadiḷ) were built by Virappa-Nāyaka, son of Viśvanātha-Nāyaka Krishṇappa-Nāyaka.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same gōpura (proper left)
cells.remarks: States that the gōpura and the compound wall (tīrumadiḷ) were built by Virappa-Nāyaka, son of Viśvanātha-Nāyaka Krishṇappa-Nāyaka.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT-contd. / MADURA TALUK-contd. / Tirupparankunram-contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same gōpura (proper left)
cells.remarks: States that Kishṇaya-Vīrappaṇ is given the title 'Kachchippperu[n]chan' constructed a kai-maṇḍapa to the east of the gōpura at Parankuṇram and he set up in it the image of Ganapati (Anaikaran) to spread the renown of Viśvanātha-Nāyaka.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the Pasupatēśvara shrine.
cells.remarks: Records a royal gift of land at Kulaiśēkharanallur, hamlet of Aḷiyūr in Nāṭṭārūppukku, to be held at the instance of his ma[chch]uṇan Vikramasōla[dēvar] as madappuram to Irāvaiar Pasupatidēva residing at Poṇpambalaikāṭṭiṇgmaṭha at Tirupparankunram.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Madura.—First gōpura of the Sundarēśvara temple (left of entrance).
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Seems to record gift of land to a bhiksha of the Āśvalāyana-sūtra and refer to spending of the fish lease amount on the (local) tank.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records grants of the kaṇiyāṭchi right over the village Kaṇṇanūr in Puḍūr-śīrmai to Madhyadhē-Mahārāja son of ... sōla-Mahārāja, 'the agent of the temple of Tiruvalavāyuḍaya-Tambiran', with the stipulation to pay annually a specified tax permanently (nāḍik-kaḍamai) to the god Viṭ[p]aṇika.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Right of entrance
cells.date: Šaka 1466, Krōdhin, Dakshiṇāyana, Vriśchika, 4u. 10, Sunday, Uttiratṭādi.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of the hamlet Paṭṭi-ēriṇdai in the village Kapaṇkakuḍi in Teṅkaḷavāi-nādu, a subdivision of Kalla-nādu, to Sadāśiva-Mahārāja, for offerings during one sandhi in the temple of Sokkanātha for providing garlands, (for the merit of) Vithaladēva-Mahārāja, son of Rāmarāja-Tirumaladēva-Mahārāja.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT-contd. / MADURA TALUK-contd. / Tirupparankunram-contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Right of entrance
cells.remarks: States that the gōpura was constructed for the merit of Acyutadēva-Mahārāya, by Vasuvappa-Nāyaka, the elder brother of Vaiyappa-Nāyaka and the son of Iärappa-Nāyaka and who had the titles 'Uddagirisānāgan, Mapingapuravardhīsvaran' etc.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the second prākāra of the same Pāndya temple.
cells.remarks: Records remission of taxes by the king on two villages granted to the temple of Tirumālirñjōlaiyāndār, which are situated between Malaiyāmpodavu and the Vaigai river, for providing garlands to the god Tiruvälävudayāiya-Nāyanar.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the prākāra of Pāndya †
cells.remarks: Damaged and built in at the beginning. Purports to be an order of the deity assigning the right of cultivation of temple lands at Sērumāgēri, which had so far remained fallow to a certain person and fixing a permanent tax of 4 achchu per year as due to the temple.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place .
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Seems to record an order of the authorities of the temple of Tiruvälävudayāiya-Nāyanar assigning the cultivation rights of certain temple lands to two persons.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT-contd. / MADURA TALUK-contd. / Tirupparankunram-contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place .
cells.date: 21st year (in words), Makaram, ba. 3, Satday, Uttiram.
cells.remarks: Records sale of land for 100 pudukkāśu-panam to a kaikkōla of the temple of Tiruvālävudayāiya-Nāyanar, by the trustees of the Mahā-sabhā of Kodimangalam alias Muditalākondāpāndya-chaturvedimangalam, a brahmadēya in Madurōdaya-valanādu.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT-contd. / MADURA TALUK-contd. / Tirupparankunram-contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place .
cells.remarks: Engraved in continuation of the previous inscription. Damaged. Purports to be an order of the deity granting to a certain Madura Alagiyākkōkanār alias Sundarapāndyadēvatirukkovil-nambi through the trustees of the mahā-sabhā of Kōdimangalam alias Muditalākondāpāndyachaturvēdimangalam (granted) as adukkalaipuram, for the maintenance of the kitchen in the temple.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT-contd. / MADURA TALUK-contd. / Tirupparankunram-contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place .
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Records an agreement given by the ūrār to maintain two sacred lamps on the stand at the outer entrance of the garbhagriha of the temple of Tiruvālavāyudaiyār, for 20 achchu received by them from an agappari-vāra-mudali of the king (nāyaṇār). Mention is made of Muṇaiyadaraiyaṇ.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT-contd. / MADURA TALUK-contd. / Tirupparankunram-contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place .
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning and damaged. Purports to be an order issued by the deity granting land as jīvitakkāni for the maintenance of 11 musicians belonging to the temple.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT-contd. / MADURA TALUK-contd. / Tirupparankunram-contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place .
cells.remarks: Damaged. Another similar order of the deity granting land at Munaiyanēri in Ayda-nādu for the maintenance of Periyān Taningavāndān alias Valikana-pāndyāvadāmarāyar, a musician attached to the temple.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT—concld. / MADURA TALUK—concld. / Madura—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Registers a royal grant of the village Kāraikkuḷam in Vayalīr-nāḍu, at the instance of Kāliṅgarāya, to Kānaikkāvu for the maintenance of the servants looking after the two flower-gardens of the god and goddess founded by Nāyinār Virada-muḍitta-Perumāḷ and named (after his title) Bhuvanēka-māra-pāṇḍya-puram, given for providing a lamp, sugarcane, and for feeding 1,000 pilgrims at the rate of 100 daily during the ten days of the festival in the month of Āvaṇi.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT—concld. / MADURA TALUK—concld. / Madura—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Purports to be an order issued by the deity remitting the taxes on a plot of land in [Parākrama]-Pāṇḍya-chaturvēdi-maṅgalam, given for the maintenance of the temple cook, Tiruvambalapperumāl, a servant of the temple and Bōdhāyana-sūtra and belonging to Maruttuvakkudi in Aṇḍa-nāḍu.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT—concld. / MADURA TALUK—concld. / Madura—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records a royal order issued, at the instance of the mahēśvaras, by Vikrama Chōḷadēva to the managing trustees of the temple of Tiruvalavāy-uḍaiyār, assigning the 4 achchu due from Turumūr in Aṇḍa-nāḍu from the Aiyidaiyar, Aṇimakkal etc., for supplying sandal-paste to the god.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT—concld. / MADURA TALUK—concld. / Madura—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Ends of lines left unengraved. Records the assignment of 25 kalam of paddy from the village of Turumūr for (offer-ings) to god Ādiraviśi-Aḍuvar and for the celebration of the Pūram festival in the month of Āppasi.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: In the Kiḷi-gōpura (proper right) of Pāndya temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged and built in at the end. Refers to a quarrel among his servants (vēlār), evidently about the levy on betel-leaves and areca-nut in Madura and Rāchāpuram-śīmai and to the remission of the same by the Nāyaka ruler.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Inner wall of the gōpura of Kiḷi †
cells.remarks: Records the remission of the caste levy (pāṭṭam) on Reḍḍis in the 4 sīmais of the Madura kingdom.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: Records remission of brokerage fee from sandy-market (Sandai) at Mayilam by the chief by the Kaikkōḷa-mudali of Aṇukkuḍi including the vehicle bearers (Sīpādam-tāḻ-gusdar) of the temple of Sōkanātha at Madura.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Kiḷai-gōpura (proper right) of the temple of Kiḷi. †
cells.remarks: States that the gōpura [was built by] Avaiyāvēdarāmar.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same gōpura (proper left)
cells.remarks: Calls the gōpura as ‘Sundara-Pāṇḍyan-gōpura’.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT—concld. / MADURA TALUK—concld. / Madura—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same gōpura (proper left)
cells.date: Śaka 1547, Krōdhana, Āppasi 17, ba. 12, Monday, Chitra.
cells.remarks: Records remission of several specified taxes due from the temple of Chidambaranātha-mēlūra for conducting the Mārgaḷi festival of Chokkaranāthasvāmi for the merit of Vīranātha-Nāyaka-Tirumalai-Nāyaka.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT—concld. / MADURA TALUK—concld. / Madura—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same gōpura (proper left)
cells.remarks: Records remission of taxes on the villages granted to the vehicle bearers (of the temple) of Chokkaranāthasvāmi.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / MADURA TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone planted in the Minākshi-Nāyaka maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Records the provision made for daily worship in the Śrī Minākshi-Sōmasundarēśvara temple from the interest on one lakh of pagodas endowed by Pachchiappan Pachchayappa Mudaliyār. Also provides for the appointment of a tutor on 10 varāhas for a month for teaching law (vivakāra-śāstra) and another on 5 varāhas for teaching English to Hindu boys of the locality. (See also No. 145 of 1938–39).

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · KURN OL DISTRICT. / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Bannūru.—Broken stone pillar lying near the Vighnēšvara temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary and damaged. Mentions Śrīparbata. In characters of about the 10th century A. D.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Broken slab lying near the village chāvaḍi
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register the endowment of the village Gudipāḍu, attached to bannūru, situated in the Gaṇi-sīma included in the province of Sakunikaṭaku, in favour of the sanctuary of the goddess Mahāmāyamma of the place by Mahamaṇḍalēśvara (name lost) for the merit of his father Śrī-Rangarāju in the presence of the god Viṭhalēśvara.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Fragment lying in the place of Vighnēśvara †
cells.remarks: Registers the gift of the village Koplasamudram, inclusive of all privileges, as an agrahāra for the merit of his father Ayadēva Mahārāja.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Bhairāpuram.—Slab set up on the tank known as Fakkirankammuṭa about two miles away from the village.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land by Vāñla Basavappa, son of Lingaṭṭi, to Elagaṁ Abureḍi for his having constructed a tank at Bayirāpuram which was granted to the former as an amaram fief by Mahamaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarāja-Gōpālarājayya.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Chauṭūru.—Broken slab set up near the Chennakēśavasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Only the improcatory portion of the inscription is preserved. In characters of about the 16th century A. D.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Chērukūru.—Slab set up in the Chennakēśavasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a sarvamānya gift of the village Telikicharla situated in the Gaṇi-sīma, inclusive of all privileges such as kānika, veñchuṁku, etc., both in cash and kind and the sunkasthāvaram as in the days of Daniyan Baasavappa, to the learned Brāhmaṇas of the village, viz., Bhrāhmaṇa Lakshmīpati-Ayyaḍēva-Mahārāja for the merit of his father Śrīrangarāja in the presence of god Viṭhalēśvara.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in a field known as Ganḍrēḍināni-baraka about 1 mile from the village.
cells.remarks: States that the wall (near) by was constructed by Vēbireḍi, son of Gundreḍi Chinnareḍi of Telakochera.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place:
Chintalapalli.—Slab set up in the
Āñjanēyasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a sarvamānya gift of the village Chintalapalle situated in the Gaṇi-sīma, with all rights, viz., kānika, veñchuṁku, reñchuṁku, etc., both in cash and kind and the sunka-sthāvaram etc., in the days of Danayāni Basavappa, to Narasimha Sōmayāji by Mahamaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarāja Venkaṭādri-Ayyadēva-Mahārāya for the merit of his father Śrīrangarāja in the presence of the god Viṭhalēśvara.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab lying near the Vīrabhadrasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: Records the expanded reconstruction of the Nagēśvara and Vīrabhadrasvāmi temples at Chintalairu by the two cousins, Veṅkaṭa Reḍḍi and Annā-reḍḍi, the great-grandsons of Burrā Reḍdi.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · Dēvarāyu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up near the Veṅkaṭēśvarasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land to the mason Vīraju by Vēdirāju Lōka-pagāru for the upkeep of a well of drinking water in the agrahāra village of Dēvarāyu alias Rāmāgamanābhāpura.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up near the Śivālaya in the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register the sarvamānya gift of the agrahāra-village Raṅganāmakāmpura to a Brāhmaṇa (name not clear) who was the son of Anantayya and who belonged to Kasyapa-gōtra and Āpastamba-sūtra, by Vīrapratāpadēvavarāya Mahārāja, son of Veṅkaṭādri-rājavaṅga and grandson of Rāmarāja-Śriṅgarājayya of the Aravīḍu family.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · Kaḍumūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone pillar set up in front of the Añjanēyasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: States that the lamp-pillar was set up near (the god) Hanumān by Avubalayya and Tirumallayyanagāru, sons of Aṇṇagāru of Bhōjanapalli-Kadamūru.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · Kōṇeṭiampalli — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A slab set up near the Añjanēyasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land made out of his private holding by Veṅkaṭaraṁmu, son of Naṇḍayya and grandson of Munigavēḍi Vishvapa of Āpastamba-sūtra and Haritasa-gōtra to god Mahānandiśvara of Kōṇeṭiammapalle, the suburb of Vēpugunta, formed in the name of the god by his grandfather Pāpartīru who founded the temple, but confiscated, in consequence of which daily worship and other rites to the god had ceased.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · Maṇḍlam — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up on a well near the mosque.
cells.remarks: States that the well was constructed by a Brāhmaṇa lady named Pārvati, the wife of Nandārānu, whose parents were [Jaiyarāmu and Drōpati (Draupadi)].

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up by the side of the road leading to Taṭakūru.
cells.remarks: Registers the foundation of a well to the south of the village by Kichehayya, son of Nārāyana Lakshchaya.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · Nēgaliṭūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Two fragments lying in the compound of the Añjanēyasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Seems to register a sarvamānya endowment the details of which are lost.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · Naṇḍikōṭkūr — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar of the Nandi-maṇḍapam in the Mallēśvarasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of garden land in the village of (Naṇḍikōṭkūr) to Rāvichēṭi Kavi Pāparājayya, a devotee of Mallikārjuna and Bhramarāmbā.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slabs built into the pavement near the Añjanēya image in the Añjanēyasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: States that the mānya of one puṭṭi of land given to [Rāvichēṭi Kavi-Pāparāju is in the endowment of Prauḍharāya.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar set up in the satram in front of the above temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Refers to the vṛtti lands endowed by Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Appalrāja, son of Tipparāja and grandson of Kaiṇva Appalrāja of the Ātrēya-gōtra in favour of Brāhmaṇas for offerings to god Ahōbalanātha in the Vēligōḍu-sīmai which was given away as amara to the donor by the king.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up on a dilapidated well known as Polamēra-bhavi about two miles to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Refers to the pillar demarcating the boundary of Naṇḍikōṭkūr and Achīru set up by the residents of the former place who won the dispute connected with it.

cells.location: KURN OL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up on a dilapidated well known as Pūjārivallā-bhāvi to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: States that the Musali-sēti Akalisēti, son of Kūnaṭi Pūlisēti Mallaya of the Jānakūlu gōtra constructed a well called Rāmāsetti-ti or in the vicinity of Naṇḍikōṭkūru and had platforms constructed for Aśvattha and other trees.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · KURNOOL DISTRICT—contd. / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK—contd. / Nandikötkür—contd. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Nandi-pillar set up in a field (Sur. No. 116) outside the village.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land at Nandikōtūru made by Rudradēva, son of Mahāsāmanta Cheruku Manuma Bollaya Reddi, to Sarvavarayanagāru for the merit of his parents. The latter in turn gave away the gift land to the temples of Sarvavarēśvara and Bollēśvara-dēva founded by him at Maliyāla.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pagidyāla.–Slab set up near the Vīrabhadrasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of one varaha per year to the god Vīrabhadra of Pagidyāla situated in the madhyasīma by Sūrappa-Reddi, son of Jiyyana whose surname is missing) for the merit of the twenty-four families of their dommari (acrobat) community.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up near the primary school.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant made by the three Vīravaṁśins, Anantayya, Govindayya and Mādhavayya, of a portion of their annual incomes (vartana) bestowel upon their community by the Mahajanas of the place to the god Kēśava-Perumāl in the thiruvīthi of the place. The village was included in the 'Mosalīmadugu-sīma and belonged to Kanthāla Śrīrangāchārya.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up near the Añjanēyasvāmi temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1439, Īśvara, J[y]ēshtha, ba. 30, Friday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Records that Yinumula Timmayyanāgāru restored the lands constituting the gift to the gods at Paindindla by exempting the assessment before god Mallikārjuna at Bejavāda, on the banks of the Krishnā, for the merit of Krishnarāya-Mahārāja and his own preceptor and parents.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Paipālem.–Slab set up near the Āñjanēyasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of the village Vişnu-Gudipūdu, situated in the Kandanavõri-sīma as sarvamānya inclusive of all the privileges such as ańika, velichchumada, kolappāram, and the ańika-vōni-kanchi, made to the god Danāyuni Bāsavanna, to Rāvuladūvuni Ākīrāju by Mahāmandalēśvara Rāmarāju-Venkatādri Ayyadeva-Mahārāju for the merit of his father Srirangarāja, on the auspicious occasion of Uthana-dvādasi in the presence of god Vithala.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pālamarri.–Stone built into the ceiling of the Kēdārasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land for the maintenance of a perpetual lamp to the god Chennarāya at Pālamarri. In late characters.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pārumanchāla.–A pillar in the Chennakēśavasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: Records the construction of the temple (nagaru) of Chennakēśvara at Pārumanchāla by Sanitayya son of Savaram Rāminēju.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Broken stone lying in a field known as Turakapalle Pāṭimīndichēnu, about 4 miles from the village.
cells.remarks: States that the land situated to the north of the boundary of Turakalapalle field is assigned to the god Alāḍanātha. In very late characters.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stones built into the wall of a well, known as Peddabāvi.
cells.remarks: States that the well was constructed by Chaṁnāreḍi, son of Kēśavareḍḍi-Vīrāreḍḍi.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · Saṅgamēśvaram — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up on the ghāṭ near the western gate of the Saṅgamēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: States that Fakīru Mahammadu Sāhebulagāru exempted the toll on the pilgrims arriving for (an auspicious bath) in the river Kṛishṇā on the occasion of Kanyā-Bhāgīrathī.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab built into the platform of the maṇḍapa outside the western gate of Sangamēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land for the worship of god [Saṁga-]mēśvara and for the feeding and clothing of the Sthānapati Tatpurushapaṇḍita by the representatives of the Four-nāḍu and Eight-nāḍu, the Seṭṭis of Kaṁnaḍa-Four-thousand and Eḍadore-Two-thousand and others headed by the Five-hundred Svāmis of Ayyāvoḷe, after constructing a portal (tōraṇa) and setting up the image of the goddess Bhagavatī at Kāḍalūr situated in Aṁyiṇavāḍi.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar set up near the northern entrance of the central shrine of Sangamēśvara temple. †
cells.date: Chāḷukya Vikrama-varsha [7], Dundubhi, Jyēshṭha, puṇṇime, Monday, lunar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Satyarasa who bears the epithets Tagarapuravarēśvara, Jīmūtavāhanakulasaṁbhava and Suvarṇagaruḍadhvaja among others. Seems to record a gift of land at Nivṛitti-Saṅgama.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar in the maṇḍapa to the right of the entrance of the central shrine in Sangamēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: The names, Sāḷva, Aḍivi Basavarāju and Pārthasārathi Nāyuḍu are engraved in characters of about the 18th century A. D.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another pillar in Sangamēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: States that it is the work of the mason Guruvappa, son of Dāmaḍugu Satra-battuḍu. In characters of about the 18th century A. D.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar of the maṇḍapa to the left of the northern entrance of Sangamēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: States that the worshipping figure represents Gōraya. The figure of a man in a worshipping attitude is engraved to the proper right of the inscription.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: In the place of Sangamēśvara below the above †
cells.remarks: Reads ‘Śrī-Vibhūti Gōrayaṉ’.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: In the same place below
cells.remarks: States that Vibhūti Gaura, born at Māchirājapalli near Ōruṁgal residing on the top of Śrīgiri, a servant of the house of Śrī Paṇḍitārādhya solicits the god's protection. (Cf. A. R. Nos. 168, 169, of 1913; 418 and 419 of 1926.)

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: In the same place below
cells.remarks: Records the supplication of Vibhūti Gauraya. (Cf. A. R. Nos. 168-69 of 1913 and 418-19 of 1926.)

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · Sātānikōṭa — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Boulder in a field about 2 miles away from the village.
cells.remarks: Reads ‘Śrī-Īśaraṇṛu’. In characters of about the 10th century A. D.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK · KURNOOL DISTRICT—contd. / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK—contd. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Siddhēśvaram.—Two sides of a pillar built into the platform of the Ashurkhāna.
cells.date: Śaka, [983] Plava, Jyēshṭha, Amāvāsyā, Wednesday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions the Telugu Chōja chief Irugana-chāla Mahārāja who was governing Kanne-300, Peđakel-800, Naravādi-500 and Ayije-300 from Mosaleyamađuru and records a gift of the toll-incomes of the river at Siddhēśvara to the disciple (name not clear) of the ascetic Kalyāṇa-śakti who was the sthānādhipati of Sidhēśvara.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: The other pillar in the place of Sangamēśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register some gift to god Nivṛitti-Sangameśvara by Chinnayya, Nāvatimāgāru, son of Rāinētu and grandson of Mudulagūru Akkinēyu.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another pillar in the place of Sangamēśvara †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of some vrittis of land to two villages made by Mattala Mallayya, a feudatory of the king to god Viśvanāthu at Sidhēśvara whose temple was constructed by Ganapadēva-Samanta, overseer of the prākāra of the temple of Ganapadēva Mahārāja. The management of the endowed land was handed over to Pōchūriju Vengana Pegada, the agent of Vidyāśirāvaleya, who was the sthānapati of Saṁgamēśvara and Bhāśārakshētra.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A broken pillar lying in the compound of the Sidhēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record an endowment of some vrittis of land after purchase by Kannaiya and Mallaiya. In characters of about the 12th century A. D.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Śrīsailam.–Stone set up near the nandi-gōpura outside the Mallikārjuna temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out Seems to register some gift by a certain Nāyanigāru (name not clear) of Vēlūru for the merit of his father. In characters of about the 18th century A. D.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up on the paved way leading from the southern gōpura of the Mallikārjuna temple to the Chēchū colony.
cells.remarks: States that Kātamareddi constructed the stone steps leading to Sīkahēśvara for the spiritual merit of Kōmarareddi and his queen (Ammarāgral). [Kōmangareddi] stoods for the epithets, Gajakōţi-kēhari, Gajapati-vihēbha, and among others.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in the compound of the temple of Ārāma Viśvēśvara.
cells.remarks: Same as No. 41 of 1915.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar set up near the northern gopura inside the Mallikārjuna temple.
cells.date:
Śaka 1322, Vikrama,
Ādhika-Chaitra, ba.
15, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. The portion of the inscription containing the details of the grant etc., is broken and lost.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab built into the wall of the Annapūrṇa-satram inside Mallikārjuna temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Records the services rendered by Gumūpāli Muttarāju who is described as one interested in performing the sixteen Mahādānas, to god Srīgarīnātha, Mallikārjuna presenting golden bells, etc.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Nandi-pillar set up in the courtyard to the south of the Nandi-maṇdapa inside Mallikārjuna temple. †
cells.remarks: States that Gamagaiya and Viramma dedicated a lamp to the god Mallikārjuna. In characters of about the 17th century A. D.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Nandi-pillar set up westward near the southern porch of the main shrine of Mallikārjuna temple. †
cells.date: Śaka 1389, Sarvajit, Māgha, ba. 14, Monday, Śivarātri.
cells.language: Sanskrit verse and Telugu in Telugu characters.
cells.remarks: Same as No. 33 of 1915.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Four sides of a broken stone pillar set up in the place of Mallikārjuna. †
cells.language: Sanskrit verse and Telugu in Telugu characters.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged and worn out. Mentions Śrīparvata and Śrī-Mallikārjuna. In characters of the 14th century A. D.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar built into the wall of the southern entrance to the inner prākāra of Mallikārjuna temple. †
cells.remarks: Records the construction of some shrines and halls probably in the Mallikārjuna temple by Hanja Devappa-Nāyanigāru.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A Nandi-pillar set up near the Mallikārjuna-yandam, inside Mallikārjuna temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another Nandi-pillar set up in the place of Mallikārjuna. †
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. Mentions Basvaya. In late characters.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Third Nandi-pillar set up in the place of Mallikārjuna. †
cells.remarks: Reads 'Goruvanāthu'. In late characters.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: A mutilated slab lying in the place of Mallikārjuna. †
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Records the founding of a village called Ganapavuram in the name of his mother and making a gift of it to god Śrigirinātha (i.e., Mallikārjuna at Śri-sailam) by the general Kāchaya Ređdi who bore the epithet, Mahārāyasthāpanāchāryya (the establisher of the great king) and who is said to have vanquished the Muhammadan ruler that had penetrated into the Telugu country after conquering the Gauja, Gūrjara, Mālava, Mahārāshtra and other provinces. He is stated to be the son of Mailaya Ređdi who placed on a firm footing the Kākita throne (pitha). In characters of the 13th century A. D.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Broken pillar set up in the compound of a Śiva temple to the west of and within the prākāra of the Mallikārjuna temple.
cells.remarks: Records the installation of a lingam named Tryanībaka for the prosperity of his family, by Anantarāja, son of Gāparasa and grandson of Mallarasa and a great grandson of Danḍanātha who was the hēvadiri minister of king Bukka. Gōpanasa is stated to be the minister of Harihara.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Nandi-pillar set up near the northern gōpura outside the temple.
cells.remarks: States that the lamp-post was erected by a person named Kalyānam-Arya. In late characters.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another Nandi-pillar set up in the place of Śiva. †
cells.remarks: Mentions the name of Parvātaya-Nāgaya, son of the mason, Māchi Batu of Dēvarakoṇda. In late characters.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTRUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Third Nandi-pillar set up in the place of Śiva. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register a gift of land to the god Mallikārjuna for offerings etc. Mentions Koṇḍanarāsayya, Pārvatayya and Sidhaya.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · NANDIKOTKUR TALUK-contd. / Śrīsailam-concld. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Broken slab lying outside the northern prākāra wall of Śiva temple. †
cells.language: Sanskrit and Telugu in Telugu characters.
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Records the gift of a perpetual lamp to the god Mallikārjuna of Śrīsailam by Vīra-Rājēndra (Chōla). Gives a string of birudas of the chief, among which may be noted the title ārūḍhapuṁśchali-bhaṭāra, and the lion insignia in Pākāṇḍu (Pākāṇḍu-Yindulūri-punganur vellahallu).

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Bell hung in a niche in the Ghaṇṭā-maṭha.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the bell to the God Mallikārjuna for the salvation of his deceased ancestors by Piriya Rājānyadēva-mahā-arasu, son of Śrīkaṇṭharājayya of Sōmavāśa, Rik-sākka and Harita-gōtra, who describes himself as the ruler of Namjārayāpatana.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pedestal of an image of an ascetic kept in the same maṭha.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Mallikārjuna and Ghaṇṭā-siddha [Ka-li]nātha. In characters of about the 12th century A.D.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar of the maṇḍapa in the same maṭha.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. In late characters.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · Taridūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in the compound of the Kēśavasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: States that the Dharma-maṇdapam was constructed by the Hudēdārs. At the top of the slab is a record of the same cyclic year Kilaka, Jyēshṭha, šu. 10, mentioning the service of Cōmāji.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slabs of a stone mortar kept in Kēśavasvāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Portions damaged and lost. Mentions a feudatory (maṇdalika) whose name probably is Rājāditya of the Jimūtavāhana lineage bearing the epithet, Suvarṇagaruđadhvaja and a teacher named Viśvēvara-paṇdita.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up near Pirāla-bāvi
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register a gift of land to the temples of Mallikārjuna, Kamnīśvara, Vīrabhadra and others by Tirumalarāja-Mahāraj[y]a, son of A[liya Rāma[rā]jadēva and Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Gobbūru Narasarājayya from their amaram fiefu in the Kamdavōli-sīma.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · Vaḍdamānūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up near the well called Kāḍi-bāvi.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged and worn out.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up near the Yallamma temple.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged and worn out. Mentions a Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · Kaṭṭiagarampāḷayam — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Rock in a private field.
cells.remarks: Records remission of taxes on the lands given as Kuḍai-mānyam by Vasavarāsayan to Kaṇḍiyadēva, by pradhāni Tippa-rasa-Uḍaiyar when he went to Chengam.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab used as a picota-base near a well in a private field.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to the construction of a maṇḍapa in front of the temple at Kaṭṭai-agaram in Paṅgalanāḍu, by Naḷḷa Tāyār, daughter of the commander Kāḷiṅgarāya of Maḷgā-dēvimaṅgalam.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: North wall (inside) of the gōpura of the Modern Vyāghrapurīśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Modern. States that the gōpura of the temple of Siṅgīśuram-Uḍaiyār was erected by Sivakkoṇḍu Chetti, son of Ponnumkach-Chetti of Kaṇḍanai.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Beam in the ceiling of the mukhamanḍapa of the same temple.
cells.remarks: States that Pāppu Nāyaka of Śiyanēndal constructed the mahāmandapa for the merit of Chinna Bommu Nāyaka and the mahājanas.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Beam in the ceiling of the mukhamanḍapa of Modern Vyāghrapurīśvara temple. †
cells.date: Šaka 1[56]4, Vishu, Vrīśchika, šu. 3, Friday, Jyēshṭha.
cells.remarks: States that the inclusion of certain land below the big lake to the temple of the village Gaṅgākulamādēvi alias Dharma Viri-pākshapuram.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: South wall of Kāśī Viśvanātha temple †
cells.remarks: Records an order (ōlai) of Prithivī-Gaṅgaṇ alias Arasanāyaṇ Tiruvanpāmalai Perumāļ granting one vēli of land, free of taxes, in Gaṅgakulamādēvinallūr for providing offerings, worship, etc., to the god Gaṅgarkulamādēviśuram-uđaiya-Nāyanār, set up by his mother Nādāljvār.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Two sides of the base of a flagstaff set up in front of the Vishnu temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1505, Chitra-bhānu, Karkataka, daśamī, Saturday, Viśākha.
cells.remarks: Refers to the setting up of the flag-staff with a raised platform for the temple of Lakshminārāyaṇa Perumāļ by Pāppu Nāyaka of Śiyanēndal, son of Dēvaru Nāyaka for the merit of Chinna Bommu Nāyaka of Vēlūr, the mahājanas of the agrahāra Katṭtai-agaram alias Krīshṇarāyapuram and others. (See 71 above.)

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in front of the Māriyamman temple.
cells.remarks: Refers to the construction with the permission of Pāppa Nāyaka mentioned in No. 74 above, of the temple of Kūttānār, the consecration of the image and a gift of land for providing worship to the deity for the merit of the mahājanas. (See 71 above.)

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · Kiḍampāḷayam — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone set up in a field (survey No. 51 15).
cells.remarks: States that Kiḷḷaik-Kaṭṭapuram was the dēvadāna (village) of god Tirumalai-Nāyaṇār at Dēvikāpuram.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · Gaṅgāvaram — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone lying in a private field.
cells.remarks: Records gift of 500 kuḷi of land to the tank called Kumāndūr Naḍagāyār-kuḷam for forming a grove by [Saura]ppan, son of mahāpradhāni.... mātha-Nāyaka.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · Navāmpāḷayam (hamlet of Gaṅgāvaram) — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Four sides of a stone set up in a private land.
cells.remarks: Records the foundation of a village within the limits of Gaṅgā-varam from the lands of the village, with the name of the local ruler Kānē Ajam Ājarāti Nāyabu Sāyabu with a kavul issued to the local authorities, Amuvarkhān, Erappa-gauṇḍa and others granting certain concessions for the settlers in it.

cells.location: KURNOOL DISTRICT / NANDIKOTKUR TALUK · Gaṭṭalamahādēvi (hamlet of Ādamangalam) — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up in a private land.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to an order of Tirumali-paṇḍita, Tryambaka-paṇḍita and Pāpayya-paṇḍita regarding Perumāḷpāḷayam. Refers also to a gift made to the local deity for the merit of Ēkōji Rājā Ayyay.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT—contd. / POLUR TALUK—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Perumālpājayam.—Two sides of a slab set up in a private land.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Gaṅgākulamādēvi and Aḷagiyāḷa-nallūr in Paṅgaḷa-nāḍu.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Śinandal — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab built into the floor inside the central shrine of the ruined Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Records an order of [Ni]mbōji-Paṇditar granting remission of taxes for the first year to the families settling at [Chan]-dirādirājar-pāļaiyam.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the shrine of the goddess in Śiva temple. †
cells.remarks: Beginning lost. Seems to record the provision made for offerings of food to the god Sōmanātha-Nāyaṇār at Śīyaneṇal. Mentions Paṅgaḷa-nāḍu included in the śīrmai of Tirumalai-Nāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Lintel over the entrance into the central shrine of the Veḷḷāṅgāṭṭīśvara temple (in ruins).
cells.date: Śaka 1557, Yuva, Vṛiśhika, ba. 7, Makhā, Friday.
cells.remarks: Records the remission of water-cess (nīrkūli) of 5 poṇ on 1330 kufi of land granted for providing offerings, worship, etc. to the god Veļjantāngī-Isvarasvāmiyār at Kūttāđundēvanallūr, for the worship on Fridays to the goddess Arundāmuļai-nāchchiyār, for the merit of the bhaṇdārattār of the temple of Tiruvaṇpāmalai-uđaiya-Nāyanār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone lying in front of the Vināyaka shrine in ruins.
cells.remarks: Damaged at the end. Seems to record a gift of land by Taḷavāy Venkaṭādri Nāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of a maṇḍapa to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: Modern. States that this maṇḍapa is the gift of Chinnatambi-Uḍaiyār, son of Muttappa-Uḍaiyār-Nāyaka-Uḍaiyār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in a land adjoining the Āchārya-maṭha.
cells.date: Śaka 1633, Khara, Karkataka, ba. 1, Thursday, Śrava-ṇam.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Stops with the date.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Four sides of a stone set up in a private land.
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Seems to record favourable terms offered to families settling at Uṇaimuḷaiyammai-pēṭṭai and also to provide for unguent (puḷugukāppu) to the goddess Uṇṇā-muḷaiyammai.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Vēḷanḍal (hamlet of Dēvarāyampāḷayam) — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two sides of a slab set up by the roadside in the village.
cells.remarks: States that the hamlet Vēļārēndal was purchased from the mahājanas by Obajarāja, son of Kondarāja of Pōjiyūr in Širu[vā]lūr-nāđu on the north bank o' the river Šeyāru and granted to the temple of Varadarāja-Perumāļ at Kāñchi-mānagara; and since it remained untenanted, its possession was resumed from the temple and settlement in it encouraged by promising not to levy taxes for five years.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another slab lying near Muṭyāḷammaṇ shrine, Āchārya-maṭha. †
cells.remarks: Records an endowment of land to Muṭyāḷ Ammaṇ of Vēḷar-ēṇḍal by an agent of Veṅkaṭādri Nāyaka of Neḷḷippaṭṭu.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same slab
cells.remarks: Records grant of another bit of land to the same goddess by Raghupati Nāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Siruvallur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two slabs, one inside the south wall of the sanctum and the other on the west side of Nandi-pīṭha, in the deserted Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Begins with the historical introduction Tirumagaḷpōla. Records gift of gold for maintaining a lamp before the god Śentaḷi Āṇḍār at Śelu[vār], by Anukkaṉ, a veḷḷāḷa of Ādamaṅgalam in Puḍa[na]ḍappāḍi.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall (inside) of the mukha-maṇḍapa of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Begins with the historical introduction Tirumagaḷpōla etc. Records a gift of land for a perpetual lamp and for offerings during the night, in the temple of Nandipradhīśvarattāṇḍār at Śeliṟūr in Kāṇḍaḷūr-kūṟṟam, a sub-division of Paṅgāḷa-nāḍu, by a resident of the village.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two sides of a stone lying near the Kailāsanātha temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records a kavul given to the mahājanas of Śiruvāḷūr by Nallāpiḷḷai, agent of Anantōji Paṇḍita.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two sides of a slab set up in the street .
cells.remarks: Records grant of land for a lake and to one Toḍupatti Āchāriyaṉ, by Koḍukkar Tombattārāyiravar of Śe[l]iṟūr in Kāṇḍaḷūr-kūṟṟam, a sub-division of Kīḻ[vē]nāḍu in Palguṉṟak-kōṭṭam. The lake is stated to have been dug by Māḍalaṅkiḻāṉ Nampiḍāraṉ and called Aiññūṟṟuvat-tombattārāyirap-pērēri.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Mel-Palur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two sides of a slab set up in Survey no. 71/1.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Beginning lost. Records grant of land by Ariappar as maṭhappuṟam to the Periyamaṭha at Tiruvaṇṇāmalai and to Namaśśivāyadēva of Teṟkil-maṭha.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Kelur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two sides of a slab set up near the Vināyaka shrine.
cells.remarks: Damaged. An image of Āñjanēya is carved over the front face of the inscription. Seems to record the grant of the village Kēḷūr remitting a number of specified taxes on it, as a jīvita to Ma[kka]nāyaṉ Māḷuvachchakravarti.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Sitteri — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone lying in the dry lake-bed (survey no. 80/1).
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to state that the income from the fish-lease should be utilised for the upkeep of the lake.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Three sides of a stone lying near the flag-staff in the village site.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a remission of taxes by the king. Mentions Śūrappa Nāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Turinjikuppam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two stones set up by the side of the Śiva temple in ruins.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Records that Śiva-Dīkshita, son of Mallamāmbā, who was learned and had performed many makhas, obtained the village Kiñjalikuppam from the king and after constructing two tanks, gave it to four of his relatives who were subjected to the conditions that they should not bear any ill-will amongst themselves, nor mingle matrimonially with other castes, should be ardent in the study of the Vēdas and Śāstras and should worship only gods like Vishṇu or Īśvara and not evil deities.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Two sides of a slab set up in a field (survey no. 166/1).
cells.remarks: Records the gift of some gold to the temple of Śrī Gōpināthadēva situated at the Daṇṇāyakar entrance at Marudarāśar Paḍaivīḍu.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / POLUR TALUK · Kalvasal — Tamil Nadu
