cells.location: CHITOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION · Pūnimāṅgāḍu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone set up in a field opposite the Vināyaka shrine.
cells.remarks: Records the death of a hero in a fight at Vaidē[siri]koṇḍa. The stone bears the sculpture of a hero holding a lance in both his hands in the act of throwing it. A lady is also represented beside this figure.

cells.location: CHITOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION · Arkāḍu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: West and south walls of central shrine in the Chōḷēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Seems to record a donation.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION · CHITTOOR DISTRICT—contd. / TIRUTTANI DIVISION—contd. / Årkkådu—concld. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: West wall of Chōḷēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: States that Kachohimujáp Tiruvákambam-udaiyáp Tirunattapperumá, a merchant of Takkólam alias Vađa-Muđikonđadójapuram in Papná-náju, a sub-division of Mapavirkótíam, caused the stone temple to be built.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: West wall of the shrine of the goddess in Chōḷēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Built at ist the beginning and end. Seems to record a gift of land for a lamp.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: East, north and west walls of Chōḷēśvara temple. †
cells.date: Šaka 1646, Vilávasu, Arpaši, 9. šu. Paur-pimá, Sunday, Aévi-ni, Lunar colipse.
cells.remarks: Records gift of money and grain made in the regime of Topdamaŋalam Tīlji Raghvanvyant-Muttu Vellumkoŋdama Nāyakkar, son of Vikkra-Nāyakkar of Vikkīkūli-kuppam for the maintenance of a watershed on the way to the Kōpilla Tiruppati, instituted as the gift of Muttu-Lakshmi-Ammal.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: South wall of the Maha-maudapa (left of entrance) in Chōḷēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: States that Muttu Maŋiyāppa Nāyakkar, son of Vollaiondama Nāyakka and grandson of Muṭṭu-Nāyakkar, situated in the construction of the central shrine and the mahāmaṇdapa for the deities Chōdīśvarasvāmi and his consort, besides giving services for Vighnėśvara and other parivāradevatas, śubhāmaṇdapa and other mantapas. On the main stone wall further ou, under date Śaka 1670, Vibhava, Kārttikai 28, Pañchami, Monday, an inscription which states that Mustu Vejjalkoppama, Nāyakkar, son of Muṭṭu Maniyāppa Nāyakkar, has repaired and repaved the idol of the goddess and that he constructed a ten-pillared manlapa for the temple.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pedestal of the bronze image of Vighnésvara in Chōḷēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: States that the image was the gift of Kaṇakakkābi (wife) of Muddu Vellakoŋdama Nāyaku, son of Topdamanjjam Dhūli Rāghava Nāyaka of Kauŋṇappa-gōtra and that Kumāra Mruddu Ramabhra Naỳaka was devoted to it.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Tlupphiku.-Stone set up in front of the Kaikkāttamma temple.
cells.remarks: Records gift of 47 sheep by Paduvalty Kalaiyalaiyan of Iduppūr in Mõlur-nādu comprised in Məlūr-kōttam for burning half a lamp before the goddess Eringarŋai of the village.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Paṇapākkam.-Stone set up in survey No. 109 in the village.
cells.remarks: Records gift of land as mañga to Râghava Nāyakar by the villagers of Paramib[kkam] in recognition of his meritorious service to them, the nature of which is not clear.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Rock below a tamarind tree in survey No. 110 in the same village (as Kaikkāttamma temple). †
cells.remarks: Same as above.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Neigambaram.—Two stones fixed into the pavement of the Patthirānarāsvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: Fragment; beginning of lines lost. Seems to record a gift of land free of taxes to the god by Muṭai aräyan Rājarājadeva-brahman for the maintenance of Neidampāroy-sandi instituted in his name.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone set up in front of the temple of the village goddess in the same village (as Patthirānarāsvāmi temple). †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift for a lamp to the goddess [Vijjaṛumukkilin-Ammau at Negumbram].

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Kāñjīpadi.—Loose stones found in the debris of a dilapidated Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: [Fragment; stone containing ends of lines lost. Seems to record a gift of money for maintaining a lamp in the temple of god Agat[i]śvaram-Udaiyār of the village.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: East wall of the Dharmarāja temple in the same village (as Śiva temple). †
cells.date:
Śaka 1735, Kali 4914,
7th cyclic year exprest, Bhāva, Āvani
20.
cells.remarks: Modern. Records grant of land made in the regime of Mahāmaṇdaléśvara Veṅkaṭāparumāl, by several persons of Kañchīpuram, for worship of Dharmarāja [Peytave] Nāyaked by Rudrappan Poŋṇappillai, son of Ayyappillai Nārāyanapillai.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Sitâpuram.—Stone set up in a field to the south of the village.
cells.remarks: Seems to state that a measuring rod was specified by Ubhayapradhāni Tipparṣasar vāśal-amaranāyaka [Patṭaya] Nāyaka. Mummađi Nāyaka and Chauṇdaya Nāgama Nāyaka.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another stone near the place of Dharmarāja †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the gift of 3000 kuļi of land to the temple of Chittiramēljivṇnagar-Emberumān as Tiruvidaiyāṭtam by Uyyūruđaiyāṇ Tōmāṇdaiyār Malaiyarāyaṇ and others.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Raghunāthapuram.—Stone set up in a field to the west of the village.
cells.date:
Śaka 1436 (in words), Yuva, Makara, śu.
10, Monday, Tirurōņam.
cells.remarks: Records a royal gift, made on the occasion of Saṅkramaṇa-puṇyakāla, to the temple of Raghunatha at the same village Tyāggachchēdri in Mahāppaiperu, situated in the nādu, a sub-division of Kuṇravanaikēttam to god Raghunātha at Nejumbirai. The figure of a chakra is cut below the inscription and on the back of the stone.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Aṭṭippattu.—Stone set up in front of the Ganeśa temple.
cells.remarks: Mentions a measuring rod introduced by Vaṅgana Nāyaka, son of Nūkkama Nayaka for the merit of Karanika Bhūbāgaiyār.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Another stone in the place of Ganeśa †
cells.remarks: Records gift of land by the Gobbūri chief, Etirājayyadēva-Mahārāja for worship, offerings, etc., to the temple Alagapperumāl at Attippatṭu.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone set up in front of the deserted temple in the same village (as Ganeśa temple). †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to a grant of land as dandigai-mānyam.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone set up in a field to the west of the same village (as Ganeśa temple). †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions Ka[l]imallai Nāyakar, the agent of Trinānai-Nāyakar and the residents of Aṭṭippaṭṭu.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Tiruvulaṇgāḍu.—Above the entrance into the kitchen of the Vataranyéśvara temple.
cells.remarks: States that the kitchen was the gift of Paḷiyānji Aṇmaiyappan Vallaraiyan of Paḷaiyānūr and that it was constructed by Kūliyiṇdār alias Mārkandeyā-dēvan.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar near the entrance of Ganeśa †
cells.remarks: Gives the name of the figure in a worshipping posture, over which this is engraved as ‘Kūliyiṇdāran’.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar in the hundred-pillared manlapa of Ganeśa temple. †
cells.remarks: The name ‘Kūliyiṇdār’ is engraved over a standing figure in a worshipping posture. The person represented is probably the same as the builder of the kitchen mentioned in No. 188 above.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION · CHITTOOR DISTRICT—concld. / TIRUTTANI DIVISION—concld. / Tiruvālangādu—concld. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar rear the entrance into the kitchen of Ganeśa temple. †
cells.remarks: The names ‘Kūļāpiḍāran’ and ‘Pāyirāki[na]jebhaṇan’ are engraved over the standing figure of a worshipper. The figure to the proper left has a beard and its hair is tied in a knot slanting to the left. A string (?) is found in the left hand.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: West wall of the temple of Bhairava in the same village (as Ganeśa temple). †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records a written order (ōlai) given by the trustees of the temple of Tiruvālangāḍu-Uḍaiyār to the authorities of the temple of Vaḍugap-Piḷḷaiyār (in the village) granting lands and house-sites with the taxes due thereon to them, to the latter temple.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to record a transaction made by the āchāryas of the four maṇḍapas assembled at Nāgalādēviammapuram with the blessings of Kāḷādēvi.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone set up in a field near Amaraṇtāḍgal tank.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to record that Timmā Reḍḍi renewed a gift previously granted by Mallā Reḍḍi to god Tiruvāḷangāḍu-Uḍaiyār.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone set up in a street
cells.remarks: Damaged. States that a street belonging to god Tiruvālangādu-Uđaiyār was made over to the weavers (kaikkōļar) free of all taxes.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION · Maṅgalam — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone set up in the village
cells.remarks: Bestows ingratitude on those who appropriate the village of Maṅgalam belonging to the temple of Kaṇṇappa Nāyinār. Figures of sun and crescent and śūla are engraved below the inscription.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION · Hariśchandrapuram alias Kāṭramuṭṭiru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone set up in the village.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of land after purchase as śrippaṭṭi by Pāradāyan Nārāyaṇan Ammaḍan of Kaṭuḍipaṇamgalam, a brāhmadēya, situated on the south bank in Śōḻanāḍu. The donor is described as a korṛmi of Pallavamārāyar and is stated to have lived for his livelihood (jīvitam) in the village of Kāṭṭukkumkuṇḍir in Nemma-Pāyirāki-nāḍu, a sub-division of Manayir-kōṭṭam.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · NORTH KANARA DISTRICT—contd. / SIRSI TALUK—contd. — Karnataka
cells.place: Chippagi.—Slab standing in front of the dilapidated Iśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Registers the construction of a tank, the erection of a Śiva temple called Jakkēśvara at Sippake and gift of land for the same by four gāvunđas when Mahāmanđalēśvara Tailapadēva was governing Banavāsi-Twelve Thousand. Mentions in the preamble that Mahāmanđalēśvara Kirtidēva was ruling the same territory. Refers to Sāntayyadēva as administering the Mogalenāđu-70 division.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Dēvātōmane — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying in the forest near the village.
cells.date: Śaka 928, Parābhava, Vaiśākha, šu. pāđiva, Sunday.
cells.remarks: Refers to Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Chattayya as the governor of Banavāsi-Twelve Thousand and records the gift of land made by Jagatmallēśvara-Gāvuṇḍi before her demise.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone in the forest at the same spot
cells.date: 12th century A.D. †
cells.remarks: Completely damaged. The characters belong to about the 12th century A.D.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone set up near the Bhadrakālī temple.
cells.remarks: Brok-n and damaged. Relates that Kōvanna-Gauḍa put up heron fight against the infantry and the cavaliers of the Mallidēva, son of Kāvadēva and died in the battle of Kalu-gāla when the latter made a march and encamped at Ballāļa-Sirisēr.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Honnēhalli — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up near the Nara-siṁha temple in the Svarṇavalli-Maṭha.

cells.remarks: Records the performance and completion of a sacrifice for the prosperity of the chief by His Holiness Sarvajña-Sarasvatī Śrīpāda of Honnēhalli through Viśvapati-Bhaṭṭa who was brought down from Kāsī (Benares). The stone records the gift of the agrahāra maṇiṇḍopa with the three holy fire-pits.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built, in the south wall of the temple of Svarṇavalli. †
cells.remarks: Seems to record the construction of a temple by the chief.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: On boulder No. 1, at the Sahasraliṅga near the village.
cells.remarks: Seems to record the setting up of an image of Kēśava by Rājēn-dra-Bhārati, the disciple of Prakāśa-Tīrtha.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: B uoulder No. 2, same place.
cells.remarks: Indistinct. Seems to refer to Hōpaḷḷi and to Candra-sēkhara Sarasvatī.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Boulder No. 3, same place.
cells.remarks: Indis. inct. Seems to refer to a gift of [li] nahaḷi and other villages to God Kēśava. Mentions Kōṇasunguḍi.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Hosamane — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the forest near the village.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 18th century A. D. States that it is a charity (probably for the benefit) of Virūpākshadeva of Kōrāṇṇa.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Eulōkal — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up by the side of the road near 'the Vyasarnya Maṭha.
cells.remarks: Seriously damaged. In characters of about the 14th century A. D. It is a Jina śāsana. Mentions some mahājana and seems to record a gift for feeding (āhārādāna), etc.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Māsti stone lying in the compound of the house of Chennabasappa.
cells.remarks: Damaged. In characters of about the 16th century A. D. Records the death of Bireppa, son of Huḷiviteya Mallappa of Hulyakali.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone set up in the forest of Māsi-kān, near the village.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 15th century A. D. States that when Mahādēva, son of Duggū-Rāva was governor of Machagamuḍi, who were the followers of Immadi Narasappa-Vojeya, died in an encounter between Sadāśiva-Nāyaka and Arasappa-Vodeya.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone set up at the Kaḍabala-katte in the forest near the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. In characters of about the 15th century A. D. Seems to record the death of a warrior named Bīra and the erection of the hero-stone by his people. Mentions Sōdeya Arasappa-Nāyaka, Dugguga-Nāyaka, Māvaṇa-siṁga-Nāyaka, etc.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Māsti-stone set up at the place of Vyasarnya †
cells.remarks: Damaged. In characters of about the 15th century A. D. Seems to record the self-immolation of a Nāgatī (wife of a Nāyaka; name not clear).

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Left-side pillar at the entrance of the Lakshminārāyaṇa temple.
cells.remarks: States that [the maułapa] was renovated by His Holiness Šri Lakshminivása-Tirtha of the Vyäsaräja-Samsthâna. Refers to the püräšrama of the pontiff.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar lying in the forest near the Rāma-liṅga temple.
cells.date: Śaka 904, Chitra-bhānu, Chaitra, śu. 1, Sunday, uttarāyaṇa-sam-krānti.
cells.remarks: States that Pañchavata-[jiga, son of Biyajaiya who was administering (kāyika) the Teingere-Tirtha (division) endowed some money to the Mahājanas of Jāulfūru for a charit [able purpose] when the said warrior was lord of Banavāsi 'Twelve Thousand and Sāntalige 'Thousand.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. I) in a row set up near Rāma-liṅga temple. †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 15th century A. D. Indifferently written. Seems to refer to the Chief of Sōde (Sōda) and [his] warrior (name not clear) who was cut to pieces in a fight. Mentions Arasappa-Odeya, the chief of Sōde (Sōda).

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. II) set up at the same spot.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 15th century A. D. Indifferently written. Mentions Aravari and Haridāva-Dāṇṇāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. III) set up at the same spot.
cells.remarks: Indifferently written. Purport not clear.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. IV) set up at the same spot.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Details worn out. Seems to mention some nāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. V) set up at the same spot.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 15th century A. D. Indifferently written. Details not clear. Mentions Södeya Arasappa-[Nâyaka].

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone set up in the forest, a furlong from the Rāma-liṅga temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. In characters of about the 14th century A. D Mentions a certain Vīra.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Huṇaśahalli — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the forest
cells.remarks: In characters of the 18th century A. D. States that Ara-sappa-Nāyaka (of Sōde) endowed the village of Huṇaśi-haḷḷi to Kōrāṇḍa-paṭṭada Virūpāksha Svāmi.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · NORTH KANARA DISTRICT—contd. / SIRSI TALUK—contd. / Hupasihalli—concld. — Karnataka
cells.place: contd. Sirsi Taluk—contd. Another slab set up in the forest, Rāma-liṅga temple. †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 18th century A. D. States that (the land) belongs to Kōraṇada Viṭhṭhakadēva.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the forest near the village
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to mention a gift to Kōraṇada (Vīra-) pōḍha Svāmi.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Iḍaṭaḷi — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone set up in the forest near the village.
cells.remarks: Worn out. In characters of about the 15th century A. D. Seems to record the death of one Sirumeyu-Nāyaka, in a fight near Hattimattūr, in the time of Apparasa-Vodeyn. Mentions Sōdeyn Rāmappa.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Another hero-stone set up near the above
cells.remarks: Damaged. In characters of about the 12th century A. D. Records the death of fone Basava-Gauḍa in a fight. Mentions Viḍṭahaḷi, Guṭṭi-Arasa, Sōvidēva, Nāraṇa-Daupyaṭaka, etc.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Kaḍahḷi — Karnataka
cells.place: A hero-stone lying in a wet field near the village.
cells.date: 12th century A. D. †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 12th century A. D. Relates that Koṭṭiga, son of Kōiṇchāri Barma fought bravely and died in the battle when Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Jōkidēvarasa marched forth towards Haive after killing two horses in a fight.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. I) near the Kadambēśvara temple.
cells.date: 12th century A. D. †
cells.remarks: Worn out, except for a few concluding lines. In characters of about the 12th century A. D. Seems to record the death of a warrior after killing two horses in a fight.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Fragment of hero-stone (No. II) at the same spot.
cells.date: 12th century A. D. †
cells.remarks: Fragment. In characters of the 12th century A. D. Mentions Laikadēva as ruling, Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Tailamadēva and Tuḷuva (country).

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. III) at the same spot
cells.remarks: Records the death of [Dē]ṭṭikankāra (ensign-bearer) Dāvuda (?) in the battle of Kangele Kadaba. Mentions Mahā-pradhāna Shāntavegadēyara Bīrarasu who was perhaps the opponent of the victim.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. IV) at the same spot
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. In characters of the 12th century A. D. Main portion is worn out.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. V) at the same spot
cells.remarks: Seriously damaged. In characters of the 12th century A. D. States that the vīra-kallu (hero-stone) set up in memory of a warrior (name lost) who died in a fight.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Kalkuni — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab standing in the site of Vijayanagara an old temple near the village.
cells.date: Śāka 1317, Yuva, . Pushya, śu. 15, eclipse (sēpadhī, sōmopatiga).
cells.remarks: Records the endowment, to please god Madukanātha, of the village Kakukani by the chief Karuvūra Sānta- Dannāyaka and the several gaudas of the Kabunaligeyasime. Further, on the occasion of a solar eclipse, Kampana into the lands of Simana Midappa who was entrusted it from him. Siriyana Midappa who was entrusted with the endowment it bestowed on the learned Brāhmaṇas living in the śarkanmas and the śēstras dividing the same into twelve shares. It registers a grant called Lakshmipuran, on Magha ba. 30 of the same year.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Kar svalji — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the village Sōde
cells.date: Śālivahana Śaka 1525, Sōbhakrit, Jyeshtha, śu. 15, Saturday, lunar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Partly damaged. Seems to record the gift of the village Kalusavalli by the chief to a certain Virapuppa.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the boundary of a field
cells.remarks: Partly damaged. Records the gift of some land to Brahmana Sādura Sātapa-Darnāyaka when Bāchanna-Odeya was administering the Guți-rajya.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Karūr — Karnataka
cells.place: Māsti-stone in the site near the village.
cells.remarks: Upper portion much damaged. Records the death of Mallappa-Dānikyādhyakaha, son of Killappa-Dannāyaka. Mentions Hosamanaikadevi and the lord of Banavāsiipura.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Another Māsti-stone in the same site
cells.remarks: Seriously damaged. Purport not clear.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Kengare-math — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab on the Sirsi-Sonda road.
cells.date: 10th century A. D. †
cells.remarks: In characters of the 10th century A. D. States that the śāsana was set up in memory of Basava's son Eryaha and his wife on the death of the former when Chattuvarasa was administering the peggede of Biyala. Mentions the headmen (?) of five other villages.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Kibballi — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built into the lintel of the entrance into the Īśvara temple.
cells.date: 18th century A. D. †
cells.remarks: In cursive characters of the 18th century A. D. Seems to record the death of some individual.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in front of Īśvara temple. †
cells.date: Śālivahana Śaka 1732, Pramōdūta, Kārttika, su. 7, Thursday.
cells.remarks: States that Nārana-Heggade, son of Timmanna-Heggade of Kiballi constructed the stone temple, installed the god Rāmēśvarasvāmi and performed the dhvajasthāpanā.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hēry-stone set up in the place of Īśvara †
cells.remarks: Relates that one Jaka-Gauda died on the battle-field having fought valorously and killing a horse. The memorial stone was set up by his son Kaja-Gauda and (the latter's wife) Kaji-Gaudimabe.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Kuḷave — Karnataka
cells.place: Māsti-stone set up near the village.
cells.date: Śāka 1343 (in words), . Sarvari, Āshādha, . śu. 2, Sunday.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. Seems to be the memorial raised to the memory of Tama-gauda, grandson of Mahāprabhu Sānta- Oḍeya (evidently to the matha).

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Makkalajavimane — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying in the Śivāgva-matha.
cells.king: Bhairarasa-Oḍeya †
cells.remarks: Damaged. In characters of about the 18th century A. D. Records the gift of the village Śivagrāma by Bhairarasa- Oḍeya (evidently to the matha).

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Pañchalingas — Karnataka
cells.place: Herosstone (No. I) set up in front of the Nārāyaṇa temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the death of a certain Tiraȳaka-Nāyaka who participated in the encounter that took place between Mahāpradhāna Sāta-Verggade and Biravasa at Settūru.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · NORTH KANARA DISTRICT—contd. / SIRSI TALUK --contd. — Karnataka
cells.place: Pañchalingas concld. Sirsi Taluk-contd. Hero-stone (No. II) set up in the place of Nārāyaṇa. †
cells.remarks: Seriously damaged. In characters of about the 14th century A.D. Seems to record the death of a hero and the setting up of the stone by Bīchaya-Gauḍa.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. III) set up in the place of Nārāyaṇa. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record the death of Li[n]ga-Gauḍa, Huḷi-Gauḍa and others, while Anetappa Dannāyaka was the Commander-in-Chief. Mentions Sōdeya Rāmāṇya and the sculptor Sommaṇṇi Tammōja.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. IV) set up in the place of Nārāyaṇa. †
cells.date: 16th century A.D. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. In characters of about the 16th century A.D. Records the death of Jakava-sivai, a follower of Arasappa- Voḍeru of Sōde. Mentions Raya-Danika and Ramachandra- Danika and also the sculptor Tipōja who carved the stone.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. V) set up in the place of Nārāyaṇa. †
cells.remarks: Seriously damaged. In characters of about the 11th century A.D. Mentions a Daṇḍanāyaka (name not clear).

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Puṭṭanamane-Slab lying near the Śiva temple.
cells.date: [Chālukya-Vikrama Varsha] 42, (in words) Klaka, Kārttika, . śu. 13, Thursday.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. States that the village Betehalli belonged to Hadavala Maraiyappa and records the construction of a temple and gift of land at the village of Mapaguganaji by him. Mentions the Kadamba chief Kāmādēva.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Sahasraalli-Slab set up in the Rāmēśvara temple.
cells.date: Year 4, Vijaya, . Phālguṇa, Pūrṇiami, . Monday, lunar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the installation of a linga by Kabbila- Gāvuṇḍa and gifts of land made by him and others to the god when the feudatory Kardamba Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Tailapadēva was governing the province of Banavāse-12,000 from Hangal. Mentions Huḷijiya-Daṇḍanāyaka as the administrator of Kabunalige-70 division. The gift was made into the hands of Mahādēva-Paṇḍita of Banavāse.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Singaṇalli — Karnataka
cells.place: Herosstone (No. I) in the forest near the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the death of one Sōmeya-Nāyaka, the son of Golla Bomma-Nāyaka in a battle during the regime of Chāmeya-Oḍeya at Gōve and the setting up of the herostone by his wife and his elder brother Mādarasā-Nāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. II) lying in the place of Śiva. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the death of Huḷiyappa-Nāyaka, the son of Singamanahalli Kanche-Nāyaka and the setting up of the sati memorial (vīra-māstikeyi) stone

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. III) lying in the place of Śiva †
cells.date: 15th century A.D. †
cells.remarks: Indifferently written and damaged. In characters of about the 15th century A.D. Mentions Bhīda Bayana-Arasa and Singe-Nāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Bōmanalli — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the forest near the village.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged and worn out. Mentions the Kadamba chief Chattāyya administering as peggede and his Sandhi-vigrahin Mārastīga, with the titles Vādyavidyādhara and Sahajakavi as the composer of the grant.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Broken slab set up in the place of Śiva †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Mentions Chattā of the Kadamba family administering as peggede, Puliyamma and Annammagāyiga and seems to record the installation of a deity.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Three pillars set up in the place of Śiva †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the performance of gōdāna by the son of Ayyavēṇṇe Dōraya and Hariyabe.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Sōṇḍa — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. I) set up in the Hosakōṭe fort.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to the Mahāpradhāna Bayicheya-Daṇṇāyaka as governing the Chandragutti and Gōve-rājya.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Another hero-stone (No. II) set up in the place of Śiva. †
cells.remarks: Seriously damaged and fragmentary. Purport not clear.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: A Sati-stone set up in the same spot
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to the king as reigning from Dōrasamudra (ard) Vijayanagara-neleīḍu. Seems to record the death together with his nine wives, of Arasappa, son of Saṅkaṇa Sōvaḍe who bears some titles.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Boulder called Basavana baṭṭe
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 18th century A.D. Records the grant of a land by Arasappa-Nāyaka to the Nirāsi-maṭha. At the top is given an invocation to Gurulingas.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Broken stone lying in the wet land of the Nirāsi-Maṭha.
cells.remarks: Indifferently engraved. Characters of about the 18th century A.D. States that the land is a gift by [Arasappa-Nāyaka] to the Nirāsi-maṭha.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: The dhvajasthambha set up in front of the Trivikrama temple.
cells.date: Śalivāhana Śaka 1562, Vikrama, Jye-shṭha, śu. 5, Monday.
cells.remarks: States that the pillar was set up by Śrī-Vēdānidhi-Tīrtha, the grand-disciple (praśishya) of Śrī-Vādīndra-Tīrtha.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up at a distance to the south of Trivikrama temple †
cells.remarks: States that Śrī-Vēdānidhīrtha constructed the temple and installed the image of Trivikrama while the chief Arasappa-Nāyaka was ruling at Sōḍe. Describes in detail the assignment of several grain and money incomes made by Śrī Vādīndra for the temple. It also mentions that in the same year and in the same states that Śalivāhana Śaka 1505, Chitrabhānu, Vai-śākha, śu. 15, Wednesday was the muhūrta of the installation of the god Trivikrama.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab standing in a lawn (survey No. 79) near the Jain Maṭha.
cells.date: Śaka 1491 (in chro-nogram), Vibhava, Māgha, śu. 5, Monday.
cells.remarks: The composition is the gift of land made for the maintenance of a satra in a maṭha at Sōḍāpur by Arasamma, daughter of the chief Arasappa-Nāyaka with the permission of the king. The chief is stated to belong to the Sūryavaṁśa. Mentions the maṭha as the Sōḍāpur Timmara-sa of the Kausika gōtra and Āśvalāyana-sūtra.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Sides of a niśidhi-maṇṭapa (No. I) in the forest (burial ground).
cells.date: Šālivāhana Šaka 1630, Plavaṅga, Kārtika, šu. 10, Wednesday.
cells.remarks: Records the demise of the Jaina ascetic Rāya-Maṇḍalāchārya Vidit-Piṭāmaha Śrīmad-Akalaṅka-dēva of the Sēna-siṁhāsana and the Dēśigaṇa and the setting up of the niśi-dhi-maṇṭapa by Śrī Bhaṭṭākalaṅkadēva.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT · NORTH KANARA DISTRICT-contd. / Sirsi Taluk-contd. / Bōnḍi-concld. — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab on another niśidhi (No. II) in the place of Jain. †
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Records the demise of Bhaṭṭakalalanka who bears similar birudas.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab on another niśidhi (No. III) in the place of Jain. †
cells.remarks: Seriously damaged and worn out. Purport not clear.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab on another niśidhi (No. IV) in the place of Jain. †
cells.remarks: States that these are 'the feet of the guru' carved by a devotee.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT · Tuhhimane — Karnataka
cells.place: Sati-stone standing in the forest at a place known as Māstikaṭṭe.
cells.date: 18th century A.D. †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 18th century A.D. Records the homage paid by Sanama, the wife of Dēvi-Nāyaka who died in the disturbance at Kārur.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT · Yasaje — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar (No. 4) of the first group of nine pillars set up in the forest near the village.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 10th century A.D. States that Koṇḍara, Guṇṇakamma performed the gōdāna for the second time, and that the sculpture of the gōdāna was set up at the time. Above the epigraph is sculptured the figure of a plough drawn by two bulls. The first three pillars bear no writing.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar (No. 5) set up in the place of Jain †
cells.remarks: States that Taliyara Vuttaya of Talavūru performed the gōdāna. May be a continuation from pillar No. 8 (No. 86). There is a sculpture of plough and bulls above the inscription.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar (No. 6) set up in the place of Jain †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions the chief as governing Banavāse Twelve-Thousand. Seems to be a continuation from no. 84 above. The pillar contains at the top the sculpture of the 'talkative tortoise and the swans' (Photo App. D, no. 1812).

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar (No. 7) set up in the place of Jain †
cells.remarks: Damaged at the end. Seems to be continued in no. 84 above. The figure of an elephant is sculptured above the inscription.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar (No. 8) set up in the place of Jain †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. States that Chattayya was governing Banavāsi Twelve-Thousand and Säntalige-Thousand and that he was conducting the parbharvu at Esale. Seems to be continued on pillar No. 83 above. Bears the figure of an elephant carved at the top.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar (No. 9) set up in the place of Jain †
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. States that Chattayya was governing Banavāsi Twelve-Thousand and Säntalige-Thousand and that Marayya of Kammarūr and Chattayya were conducting the parbharvu at Esale. The figure of an elephant is sculptured at the top.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar (No. 2) of the second group of six pillars set up in the place of Jain. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Contains the figure of Gaṇēśa in a shrine above the epigraph. The first pillar of this group bears no inscription.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar (No. 3) set up in the same place .
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out fragment. Refers to the performance of gōśāsa. Mentions one Kannayya. Bears at the top the sculpture of two bulls yoked to a plough.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar (No. 4) set up in the place of Jain †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to be continued on the next pillar, No. 91 below. The figure of an elephant is carved above the epigraph.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar (No. 5) set up in the place of Jain †
cells.remarks: Seems to be a continuation from the above inscription. Mentions Chaṭṭayyadēva as governing Banavāsi Twelve-Thousand and Chaṭṭayya and Dēvayya Maṇṇachaiyya as performing perbbārvvu at Esaḷe. Contains the sculpture of two bulls with a plough. Kannayya is stated to be conducting the perggaḍetana.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar (No. 6) set up in the place of Jain †
cells.remarks: Seems to be a continuation of from No. 91 above. Records the performance of gōśāsa by Andabaḷḷiya Raggasa Garuvaṇṇa. Contains the sculpture in high relief of Gaṇēśa in a shrine above the inscription and 'the Talkative tortoise and the swans' on the reverse side. The swans are depicted in a different attitude from that in No. 84 above.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. 1) set up in a meadow near the above.
cells.remarks: Refers to the king's capital as Hastināvati-Vijayanagara and records the gift of land at Yasaḷe, made to the son of Bīra-Nāyaka who died in a fight at the village Biḷigere, by the people of Hariya-nāḍu and the local gauḍas. Mentions Bācheya-Nāyaka of Aṇṇigēri.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. II) set up in the place of Jain. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the death of some hero (name not clear) in a fight. Mentions Hariya-nāḍu, the village Esaḷe, Hanuma-Nāyaka and Arasappa-Nāyaka of Sōde.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. III) set up in the place of Jain. †
cells.remarks: Seriously damaged and worn out. The characters belong to about the 16th century A.D. Mentions Arasappa-Voḍeya, [Rēva] rasa-Voḍeya, Hariyanāḍu and the village Yasaḷe. Seems to record the death of a warrior (name not clear).

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT · Kumta Taluk. — Karnataka
cells.place: Gokarn.—Slab set up above the western entrance of the raṅgamaṇḍapa of the Mahābalēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 18th century A.D. States that the construction of the raṅgamaṁṭapa was completed during the management (pārupatya) of Viśvēśvarayya of Malasunāḍu.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built in the pavement of the front corridor in the same temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1[3]39, (in words) Durmukhi, Chaitra, śu. 2, Sunday.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land for the maintenance of a satra in the temple of the god Mahābala of Gōkarṇa when Mahāpradhāna Baṁkarasa-Voḍeya's son (name lost) was governing the province of Hayive, Tuḷu and Koṁkaṇa from his capital at Hoṁnāvura. Seems also to record a gift of land for feeding the ascetics of three communities (parishat).

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar set up on the left side of the southern entrance of Mahābbalēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Built in and incomplete. In characters of about the 12th century A.D. Refers to a Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara who bears titles such as Gōkarṇa-puravarādhīśvara, Birudanṟiparaṅkuśa, etc.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / KUMTA TALUK · NORTH KANARA DISTRICT—concld. / KUMTA TALUK—concld. / Gōkarp—concld. — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar set up on the right side in the place of Mahābbalēśvara. †
cells.date:
Śaka 1000 (in words)
Kālayukta, Mākhanavami (for Mahānavami), Aśvayuja, śu. 9, Monday.
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Refers to a Mahāmaṇḍaleśvara who styles himself as Oṅkāra-puravādhīśvara and seems to record a gift of money income for the benefit of the temple of god Mahābala.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / KUMTA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Fragment built into the wall of the Tāmragauri temple.
cells.remarks: Seriously mutilated. In characters of about the 15th century A.D. Records gift of the village Hosa-ūru to Mābala-Liṅga-Bhaṭṭa for maintaining a charitable boarding-house (chhatra) in the temple of the goddess Tāmragauri. My Mahā pradhāna Mādhava-Nāyaka. The administration of the charity is vested in the hands of Rāgūavendra-Srīpāda of the Dēvārāya-Maṭha at Hampe.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / KUMTA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying in the gerdia of Gopi Bhaṭṭa adjoining the Mahābala temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and mutilated. In characters of the 14th century A.D. Seems to record tax-free endowment (sarvamānya) of land by Bjaavaya-Daṇayāke with the sanction of Bukka-kṣmāpati to Puruṣōttama-Srīpāda, a disciple of Sōmanātha-Srīpāda for lamps and offerings to the (god) Vēdēśvara of Gōkarṇa. Mentions the nāḍu of the twelve shares of the village Hubbapāṅkere.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / KUMTA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built above the entrance of the Amṛitēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: States that the Amṛitēśvara temple was constructed (renovated?) by Lakṣhumayya of Haratu, the munsif of the Ankola taluk.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / KUMTA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the house of Mūle Sēsha Bhaṭṭ.
cells.remarks: Partly damaged and worn out. In characters of about the 14th century A.D. Records a gift of land by Rājēndra-dēva to the temples of Mahābala and Amṛitēśvara for feeding Brāhmaṇas in the Būchapodaya-maṭha by Mādārasa-Oḍeyaru after purchasing them. The assignment of the income is referred to in minute detail. Refers to a previous transaction of Saka 13...

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / KUMTA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the house of Śiva Bhaṭṭ Ādi
cells.king: Harihara Mahārāya reigning from the nelevīḍu at Dōrasamudra.
cells.date: Śaka 1[3]15, (in words) Āṅgirasa, Āshādha, ba. 7, Thursday.
cells.remarks: Damaged and broken. Registers grants made by certain śeṭṭis in the presence of Joga Mādhava-Bhaṭṭa for the maintenance of a feeding house (satra-dharma) when the king's feudatory, Mahāpradhāna Mallappa-Oḍeyaru was governing Hayive and other provinces from (Hom)jāvara-rājadhāni.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / KUMTA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built into the wall of Nārāyana Upādhyāya's house.
cells.date: 15th century A.D. †
cells.remarks: Broken and worn out. In characters of the 15th century A.D. Records a gift of gold made for the renovation of the temple of Virabhadra by goddess Hațtamvi, wife of Vithaladēvī, queen of Vira-Bukka in the presence of the Rajaguru Īsvara-Bhatta. The endowment is stated to have been put into execution by Honnabba as a deputy of the queen.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / KUMTA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the dilapidated Honnehallimatha.
cells.date: Šaka 1206, Pramādi, Kārtika, šu. 1, Saturday, Svāti.
cells.remarks: Slightly damaged. Records in detail the assignment of the income derived from the lands endowed in the presence of Upādhvāya by a local chief, queen of Bukkarāya, for a feeding house and offerings, and other charities when Mallappa-Odeya was governing the province of 'Haïve.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / KUMTA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built into the entrance of the Sankara-Nārāyana temple.
cells.remarks: Portions lost. Seems to record a gift of money. Mentions Hūmanayaka and Sankaral[nārā]laya.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / KUMTA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the house of Anant Krishna Karant.
cells.date: about the 15th century A.D. †
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. In characters of about the 15th century A.D. Registers in detail gifts and provision made for a feeding house (satra) and offerings in the Sankar-Nārāyana temple at Mahābbalēśvara. Mentions Chāndigūra-Pārśvanātha the Hiriyabasti at Gērusoppe in connection with the imprecations. Chandapa-Bhakta engraved the grant.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / KUMTA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up near the Subrahmanya temple
cells.remarks: Highly damaged and worn out. Seems to record the provision made for a feeding house (satra) by a daughter of the king.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / KUMTA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab standing in the Kāmēśvara-matha
cells.date: Year 14, Vikrama, Mārgasīra, śu. 15, Monday, lunar eclipse
cells.remarks: Refers to the king as Kadamba-Chakravarti. States that a matha was constructed at Dhārēśvarashētra in Gōkarna and land endowed thereto to the preceptor Purushōttamपुरी Sripāda and his disciples by the king.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / KUMTA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying near the Paīja Ganapati temple
cells.remarks: Registers a transaction made by Virūpākşi, son of Āyibhatta Mādanna with Mahābhābatta for the purchase of land for a house site at Gōkarna. Sōvidēva-Odeya was governing the provinces of 'Haïve, Tulu and Konkana from his capital at Homnāvūru.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / KUMTA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab standing in the house of Morebhat
cells.remarks: Partly damaged. Registers gift of land in the Baniganenādu made to Amarēśvara Bhārati-śrīpāda in the presence of the god Mahabala for the maintenance of a chatra by Visuvarasa, son of Siddappa for the chaitya of the Visvinimira-gāra. Also records gift of land for feeding the poor by Abbaya. chandra-Sarasvati-Śrījāda in the name of Bithapa-Odeya. Mahāpradhāna [Sōma]appa-Odeya was governing the provinces of 'Hayive, Tuļu and Konkana from his capital at Hōnnāvura.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / KUMTA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built in the wall inside the house of Hire Bhat.
cells.date: Šaka 147[5], Paridhā-vi, Simha-Guru, Pushya, ba. 30, Monday, Śravapa-nakshatra, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Registers endowments of lands made for the benefit of mathas, feeding houses and temples. Registers also the renovated temple of Vaiśravanēśvara by Bhattakali Ganesa-bhatta and others having purchased the same from certain pontiffs and bhattas when Mahāmandaleśvara Sāluva Krishnadēvarasa-Odeya was governing the provinces of Nagara-rājya, Haïve, Tulu Konkana and the management and management of the several incomes are set forth in full detail.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK · BELGAUM DISTRICT. / PARASGAD TALUK. — Karnataka
cells.place: Artagaj : Slab set up near the Kalamēsvara temple.
cells.remarks: Records gift of land for the salvation (?) (parīksha-dharma) of Narasagunda who attained heaven by entering the sacrificial pit (pīth-āgni) in a cattle raid. Mentions Kēsiya, the chief mason, along with his consort of his liege-lord, Dēvati, the son of Mahāsāmanta Chilkkarasa and the commander of the Tulu guards who were the body-guard of the king.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Asundi; Stone set up in the Bamdān-kari temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records gifts of land to god Śańkara-Nārā-yana after purchasing it from the Two Hundred Mahā-janas of Hiriya-Hasundi which was a sravanamāy-nitya inscription endowment of the king. Mentions the land at Mānīkēśvara.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Fragment lying in Bamdān-kari temple †
cells.remarks: Invokes the Jinasāsana. Mentions the Two Hundred Mahā-janas of Hasundi, woodcutter Rāvaṇu, and Āvārasēsha-Vēdas and in the six tarkas. Asundi was a sareanamasya-nitya-bhāmdāra endowment of the king.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Badli; Pillar in the Chidambarēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: The pillar is reported to have been brought from Amnigēri (Dharwar district). Published in the Karnatak Inscriptions. Vol. I (1941), No. 29.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Fragment set us in the Nārāyana temple [Ratta]
cells.remarks: Do. No. 33.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Fragment built into the top of the above Ratta
cells.remarks: Do. No. 32.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Chachadi; Slab standing at the entrance of the Nārāyana temple.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 12th century A.D. Records the gift of the village of Kōnigāpāla to the god Bhūgēśvara of Chachadi by the mahāmandaleśvara Kanna[ra]rasa and Kongajarasa.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built in the pedestal of the image of god Nārāyana at the place of Nārāyana. †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 18th century A.D. Seems to state that the image is the jirnōdhāraṇa (reconsideration) made by Mudeya, son of Chapa of Thavati.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone set up behind the Sanga-mēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. In characters of about the 13th century A.D. Describes the valour of two warriors who died in the fight for the recovery of cows from the hands of the enemy in a cattle raid. One of these is Bānavā-Gāvunḍa. The name of the other is not clear.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying in the dēsagati-hola
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records gift of land to the god Sangamēśvara by the dēsagati-hola-vāsi and others of the mahājana of Chachakhaki. The gift was made into the hands of Nāgarā-sīdēva.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Chik-Budnur ; Hero-stone built into the wall of the temple of Lakkavva.
cells.remarks: Seems to record the death of the warrior Nāgapa in a fight and his attaining the vīrasvargeya.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Chik-Koppa ; Slab lying near the Huti Gavi on the Alabappana Gudda (hill), four miles away from the village.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 19th century A.D. Refers to Rudrappa, his bhakti and Kailāsa-mukti.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hārugoppa ; Slab set up in the Chachadi Desai's field.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Refers to Dēsāya Raghunātha.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hosūr ; Broken slab set up near the Basavaṇa temple.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Refer to Kundī-Threes Thousand (division) and to the Ratta chief [Barma]dēvarasa probably ruling over it. Mentions also some gāvunḍas.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Two fragments set up near the same [Ratta] temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1030, Sarva-dhārin, Pushya, bahu. 5, Thursday, Uttarāyana-samkrānti.
cells.remarks: Damaged. It is a śāsana-śāsana. Records gift of land by the Ratta [basadi] built by himself. Mentions some Jaina teachers.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK · BELGAUM DISTRICT. / PARASGAD TALUK. — Karnataka
cells.place: Two fragments set up near the same [Ratta] temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records gift of land by a gāvunḍa to the basadi renovated by him.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hūli ; Slab set up in the Patchalinga temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1103, Plava, Vaiśākha, śu. 14, Wednesday, Uttarāyana-tīpāta.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records a gift of land for the water-shed (aro-trōdeya) of Pūli in the One Hundred of Ghaisasāgri and the (in the place, by Prabhu Sōma of the Bhārāgēya, who also records gifts of land to the God Tigulēśvara and for the renovation of the town-hall of the Tigulas (Tamilians) by the respectable One Hundred of Ghaisagēri.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Second slab set up in Patchalinga temple †
cells.date: Śaka 1084, Chitrabhānu, Pushya, ba. 2, Monday, Uttarāyana-samkrānti.
cells.remarks: Published in Ep. Ind., Vol. XVIII, pp. 208 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Third slab set up in Patchalinga temple †
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Mentions Pūli-grāma. Seems to register a gift of land. Refers to a certain Barmina

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: A fragment kept in the place of Patchalinga †
cells.remarks: Published in Karnatak Inscriptions, Vol. I, No. 18.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Second fragment kept in Patchalinga temple †
cells.language: Kannada script and Sanskrit and Kannada language.
cells.remarks: Published in Ep. Ind., Vol. XVIII, pp. 201 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: A pillar on the right side of the raiga-maṇḍapa of the place of Patchalinga. †
cells.remarks: Published in Ep. Ind., Vol. XVIII, p. 206.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: A pillar on the left side at the place of Patchalinga †
cells.remarks: Published in Ep. Ind., Vol. XVIII, pp. 205 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK · BELGAUM DISTRICT—contd. / PARASGAD TALUK—contd. / Hūli—contd. — Karnataka
cells.place: contd. Lintel of the right-side door in the inner shrine of Patchalinga temple. †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 12th century A.D. States that the two door-jambs were endowed by the merchants (nakara) Govayya, Kālī-Gāvuṇḍa of Navilūru, Tāvare Mahādēvi-Siddhēśvara-Śrī-Siddhēśvara-dēva were the disciples of Nēmichandra Siddhānta-Chakravarti.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Lintel of the left door-way in the place of Patchalinga †
cells.remarks: Records the erection of the entrance (dēvara-kōṭhe) of the Māyi-kya-dētha at Hūli.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Stone built into the right side of the eastern wall of Patchalinga temple. †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 13th century A.D. States that it was 'measured' (aṭaduda).

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Another stone built near the above, Patchalinga temple. †
cells.remarks: Do. Reads 'Pitturara-Maddhēga-Viśuddhi'.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Stone built into the left side of the eastern wall of Patchalinga temple. †
cells.remarks: Do. Reads 'Kapōta-Taramuṭṭa-Viśuddhi'.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Stone built into the southern wall of Patchalinga temple. †
cells.remarks: Do. Reads 'Mākaravaṭṭige-Viśuddhi' and 'Piṭṭiga Gari[ḍa] [palli]ye'.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Fragment of a hero-stone lying near the Vīrabhadra temple.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 12th century A.D. Records the death of a warrior (name lost) who fought with Kurimba[ṛm] Kūḷa in an attempt to rescue the cows.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: A slab set up in Vīrabhadra temple †
cells.date: Śaka 966, Tāraṇa, Pushya, śu. 10, Sunday, Uttarāya-ṇa-saṅkrānti.
cells.remarks: Published in Ep. Ind., Vol. XVIII, pp. 172 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Same slab
cells.remarks: Published in Ep. Ind., Vol. XVIII, pp. 172 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Second slab set up in Vīrabhadra temple †
cells.remarks: Do. pp. 178 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Third slab set up in the place of Vīrabhadra †
cells.date: Śaka 1019, Īśvara, Pushya, śu. 5, Sunday, Uttarāya-ṇa-saṅkrāma, Vyatīpāta.
cells.remarks: Do. pp. 182 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Fragment lying in a well called Hoḍḍa Bāvi.
cells.remarks: Published in the Karnatak Inscriptions, Vol. I, No. 23.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Fragment built into the platform called Bhamadēvarakaṭṭe
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Seems to register gifts of oil, etc., for the sacred lamp and flowers to god Kalidēva by Kēśava-singa, Bōgadeva-Chāva, Heggade Samayya and others. Mentions also the Uroḍya and the Thousand (community).

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Two fragments lying near the Šankāri temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Udayāditya and Padmaladēvi. Published in the Karnatak Inscriptions, Vol. I, No. 26.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Fragment built into the wall of the Siddhananjēśa-maṭha.
cells.remarks: Damaged. States that the maṭha of Śrī-Siddhananjēśachārya of Pañchavaṇigi was renovated and a Pañchapalli set up for the glory of his nijaliṅga. The characters appear to be modern.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar in the same maṭha
cells.remarks: Damaged. Authenticity questionable. Almost reproduces the text of the above record and registers a new gift of land and money-income made on the same day for the benefit of Śrī-Siddhananjēśa-pañchavaṇigi-maṭha of the village of Belavāḍi, by the chief Vīra-Vijayarasa through Kari Kēśimayya.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Decorated lintel (makara-tōraṇa) of the entrance into the inner shrine of the Nīlakaṇṭhēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Published in Ep. Ind., Vol. XVIII, pp. 206 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: A hero-stone in Nīlakaṇṭhēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Record the death in fight of Pergade Padalpayya of Pūli and the erection (of this memorial) by the son of the latter.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Another hero-stone in Nīlakaṇṭhēśvara temple †
cells.date: Chālukya Vikrama year 32, Sādhāraṇa, Śrāvaṇa ba. 5, Vaḍḍavāra.
cells.remarks: Published in Ep. Ind., Vol. XVIII, pp. 199 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Third hero-stone in the same temple
cells.remarks: Do., pp. 171 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Third hero-stone in Nīlakaṇṭhēśvara temple †
cells.date: Chālukya-Vikrama-kāla 29, Tāraṇa, Puṣya, śu. 10, Thursday, Uttarāyaṇa-saṅkramaṇa.
cells.remarks: Do., pp. 189 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Same slab
cells.date: Year 7, Chitrabhānu, Śrāvaṇa, śu. 15, Monday, lunar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Do., pp. 192 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Same slab
cells.date: Year 2, Krōdhin, Jyeṣṭha, śu. 15, Monday, Uttarāyaṇa-saṅkramaṇa.
cells.remarks: Do., pp. 193 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Same slab
cells.remarks: Do., pp. 193 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Rudrapāda in the Rudrapāda temple
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 14th century A.D. Records obeisance to Śrī Rudrapāda.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK · BELGAUM DISTRICT-contd. / PARASGAD TALUK-contd. / Hill-concld. — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab in the Agastyēśvara temple
cells.date:
Śaka 1084, Chitrabhānu, Pushya, ba.
2, Monday, Uttarāvyatipāta.
cells.remarks: Published in Ep. Ind., Vol. XVIII, pp. 212 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab in the Korē-Siddhēśvara temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1029, Sarvajit, Vaiśākha, śu. 12, Wednesday, Uttarāyaṇa-samkrānti, Vyatipāta.
cells.remarks: Do. pp. 196 ff.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Inohal:-Slab in the Basavēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Begins with a homage to Trimūrti. Ends abruptly after giving the king's birudas, etc., and referring to his vijaya-rājya.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying near the Karī-guḍi
cells.remarks: Incomplete. In characters of about the 14th century A.D. Begins with the invocation of the god Gavarēśvara, refers to a Śivasimhāsana and then describes the Kūṇḍi province in the Kuntala-vishaya.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Iṅgalgi.-Twelve stones built in the interior walls of the Karī-guḍi.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 14th century A.D. Contains abbreviations showing the directions of the wall and the number of rounds, possibly meant to facilitate the masons in arranging the several stones of the walls.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK · Kārimani — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab in the Mallayaṇṇa-guḍi
cells.remarks: Very much damaged and worn out. In characters of about the 16th century A.D. Mentions Mahamahōpādhyāya Basavarāja-Mantri-Rājayaśadēva-Mahā-arasu, and god Mayillirādēva.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK · Katamalli — Karnataka
cells.place: Stone set up in the Īlolagēri
cells.remarks: Worn out. In characters of about the 14th century A.D. Seems to mention some private individuals and a tank (ke-re).

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Kōtūr.-Hero-stone set up in the open space (S.N. 8) near the Paramānanda temple.
cells.remarks: Too badly worn out to yield any sense. In characters of about the 12th century A.D.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Broken slab lying in the premises of Paramānanda temple. †
cells.date: about the 9th century A.D. †
cells.remarks: Published in the I.I., Vol. XX, pp. 69 ff. and plate. In characters of about the 9th century A.D.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Madalūr.-Hero-stone set up near the Siddhēśvara temple in a valley near the village.
cells.date: Chāljukya-Vikrama year 16, Prajāpati, Phālguna, śu. 8, Sunday.
cells.remarks: Records the death of Ganigāra Sōma-Ga[v]uṇḍa in a sanguinary fight with the cavalry force of Kurumba Gālīga and his followers who had besieged Ja[k]īrāja.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK · Manōḷi — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the Uḍachavvana-guḍi.
cells.date: Śaka 1174, Virōdhikrit, Jyēshṭha, ba. 30, Friday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Published in J.B.B.R.A.S., Vol. XII, pp. 34-41 and Karṇāṭak Inscriptions, Vol. I, No. 31.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up at the northern entrance of the Pāñchaliṅga temple.
cells.date: Śalivāhana Śaka 1777, Rākshasa, Āshāḍha, śu. 10, Saturday.
cells.remarks: States that the gate, napārakhaṇā and other structures (of the Pāñchaliṅga temple) were constructed by Sātavīravva, wife of Śivaliṅgappa Bāji Cheṇṇappanavaru.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the Pāñchaliṅga temple
cells.date: Śaka 1145, Chitrabhānu, Mārgasira, śu. 15, Monday, lunar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Published in J.B.B.R.A.S., Vol. XII, pp. 11-24 and Karṇāṭak Inscriptions, Vol. I, No. 30.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the compound of Siddhēśvara temple. †
cells.date: Šālivāhana Šaka 1739, lévara, Dakshināyana, Śaradritu, Kārtika, va. 1, Monday, Rōhiṇi-nakshatra.
cells.remarks: States that the temples of Śrī Rāmliṅga and other gods were renovated by Rāmachandra Śilāhāra who was the headman of the village (not named).

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: A stone with damaged Jaina figures set up near Kariyavvana-guḍi.
cells.remarks: Damaged. In characters of about the 12th century A.D. States that this nisidige stone was set up in memory of Munichandradēva of Munivalli, belonging to the Yāpanīya-saṅgha, the disciple of the daughter of Kulleya Kēta-gāvunda. This states that Munichandradēva was the Āchārya of the basti founded by one Siryādēvī.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Another stone of a similar nature set up in the place of Siddhēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. In characters of about the 12th century A.D. Records the demise of Pālyakīrtidēva, the disciple of Munichandra[dēva] of Munivalli of the Yāpanīya-saṅgha on the given date.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Third stone of a similar nature set up in the place of Siddhēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. In characters of about the 12th century A.D. Seems to record the demise of another Āchārya of the same line.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK · Mugaḍ — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying in the field known as Rāyarapaṭṭi (S.N. 252).
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. In characters of about the 14th century A.D. Mentions god Tiruveṅgajanāthadēva.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the Mallikārjuna temple.
cells.remarks: Seriously damaged and worn out. Registers the gift of land made by the villagers of Mugaḍ-Mālhārjuna, by Mura-goḍu Pēḍi-Nāyaka, the agent of Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Bāchirāja-Narasarājayadēva-Mahā-Arasu.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up at the back of the Vīrabhadra temple,
cells.remarks: Registers the remission of the terige (tax) on the harbors of the villages in the Toragale-sīme in favour of Timmōja, Koṇḍōja and Bhadrōja of the community.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying near the dilapidated temple of Western Chāḷukya Bēṭṭada Iraṇṇa.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Registers the gift of Nāgarapāja into the hands of [Mālikarjun]-Paṇḍita for feeding the ascetics who worship the god Bhōgēśvara at Muḍugaḍe, whose temple was constructed by the order of Mahā-maṇḍalēśvara [Koṅgālvarasa], who was governing Kuñji Three-Thousand and Miṛinje Three-Thousand.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK · BELGAUM DISTRICT-contd. / PARASGAD TALUK-concld. / Murgōd-concld. — Karnataka
cells.place: Same slab
cells.remarks: Do. Registers an endowment of money into the hands of the mahājana (muruvaru) of Vidhyamāseți to the Bhōgēśvara-matha at Murgōd (centre). The income from the endowment was to be used for feeding the ascetics and the students in the matha. Mentions twelve gurundar, in connection with the preservation of the dharma.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Same slab
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Seems to register gifts of oil, land, etc., to the god Nakarēśvara and to the matha of the Bhōgēśvara temple by several persons. Mentions Madiyabbe and Kalidēva.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Sātigavāra.–Fragment lying in the dilapidated Kalamēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. In characters of about the 10th century A.D. Seems to contain the description of the bravery of some warrior, name not clear.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Sīngārakoppa.–Fragment lying near the Rūmalinga temple.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka

cells.remarks: Damaged. Commences with the praise of the gods Trikajēśvara and Gangēśvara. Registers an endowment of land including wet lands for the feeding and clothing of the ascetics living in the maṭha attached to it by the Thirty Representatives (mūvadimbaru) of Sōval. The gift was made into the hands of Kaliyuga-siddha Abhinava-vādīndra. It mentions that the Gangēśvara was built after the consecration of the god Gangēśvara by Gangārāśi.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK · Śrīraṅgāpur — Karnataka
cells.place: Detached stone pedestal lying outside the village.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 11th century A.D. Mentions that (the pedestal) was built by Kēśavayya, son of Mallasara Kāḷiyamma, the pāṇḍya of Modallūr.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab kept near Godachi Vīrabhadra temple
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 14th century A.D. Mentions the Śaka year 31 (current) Śubhakṛt, and states that the Cāḷukyas (Cāḷukya-Satyāśrayadēva and states that the grants were made to the twenty grahāras of Modallūr by Honnakomtada Mīleya. The boundaries of the village are stated. The purpose of the gift is not clear The record seems to be a forgery. Being a stone slab set up to record the gift of a maṭha and land. Mentions the god Goḍachi Vīrabhadra.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK · Ugarōḷ — Karnataka

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK · Yallammana Guḍḍa (near Saundatti) — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying in the compound of Yallamma's temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. In characters of about the 18th century A.D. Records the erection of the Mahāmmaya-Sōbra by one Sākṣāṭaṭe Barmma-gauḍa.

cells.location: BELGAUM DISTRICT / PARASGAD TALUK · Vēṇagi — Karnataka

cells.place: Stone standing near the Hanumān temple.

cells.location: BIJAPUR DISTRICT / BIJAPUR TALUK · BIJAPUR DISTRICT. / BIJAPUR TALUK. — Karnataka

cells.location: BIJAPUR DISTRICT / BIJAPUR TALUK · BIJAPUR DISTRICT-concld / BIJAPUR TALUK-concld — Karnataka
