cells.remarks: Much damaged and mutilated. Seems to record a gift of toll to god Mallikārjuna (details lost). Mentions some seṭṭis and one Durgarasa.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · SHOLAPUR DISTRICT. PANDHARPUR TALUK. Pandharpur — Maharashtra
cells.place: Stone pilaster built as a beam in the roof of the outer maṇḍapa of the eastern side of the Viṭṭhala temple.
cells.remarks: Nāgarī soript, Sanskrit and Kannađa verse and prose. Damaged. Registers gift of two hundred varāhas for the conduct of daily worship, perpetual lamps and other perquisites of the god Śrī-Viṭṭhala at Pamđarange on the river Bhīmarathī by the king for his welfare while he was camping in the neighbourhood after his victorious campaign against his rivals. Among these is mentioned the Kūđavarāya.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · JATH STATE. Aṭkajagi — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab set up in the Hanumān temple.
cells.date: 5th year, Sādhāraṇa, Vaiśākha, śu. 10, Monday, Uttarāyaṇa-saṅkramaṇa.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records a votive offering of money into the hands of Gamgajīya for the benefit of the god Sōmanātha at Arnkulage by the headman (prabhu) Chāvuṅ đeya-Nāyaka, the Mēlālike-adhikāri Kupparasa Damđanāyaka, all the residents, mānyakāras, Eṅfuhiṭju, etc.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab lying in the Mēṣappaṇa ōḷa
cells.remarks: Broken and damaged. Seems to record some gift (details of which are lost) to the deity (name lost) by (Cha)vuṇḍayya-Nāyaka. This deity is described as Mahā-yōgēśvari, Ugra-Chaṇḍēśvari, etc. It also mentions the village Amkula-grāma, the mahā-haste, Kemjere-mahā-chaturvvēdya-kōmālāṅgi, of sixty yōgīṭhas and residing at the holy seat (divya-sthāna) of the glorious (Śrīmat) Amkulage.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Bāgēvāḍi — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab built in the wall of the mosque.
cells.remarks: States that the mosque was built in the time of Ibrāhīm Ādil Shāh, by one Abdar Khan.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Bāgēvāḍi — Maharashtra
cells.place: Two pieces of a slab lying in the Majumdār's well.
cells.remarks: Records the endowment of a well, of land and a garden by Sāhib Khān, son of Malik Kamāl, of Malik Alāuddīn the above property. Also states that after Shāh Alāuddīn the above property will be inherited by one Sahib Khan.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Bāḷēgāon — Maharashtra
cells.place: Two fragments of a slab built in the wall of the Hanumān temple.
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Registers various gifts of oil, garden, tax of house etc., by Heggaḍe Kēśirājayya, Hergaḍe Habbaha and others.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Bilur — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab standing near Basavaṇṇadēvara Guḍi.
cells.date: Śaka 1168, Viśvāvasu, Pushya, ba. Amāvāsye, Monday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Registers gifts of land, flower-garden, house-site, oil-mill, etc., for the conduct of daily worship and other rituals, feeding the Brahmins, etc., in the three temples of Bhāgalēśvara, Kaṁnagōpāla and [Bai]jalēśvara erected at Bīḷūr by Viṁchuva Basavarasa of the Gautama-gōtra for the merit of the deceased Bhāgubaye(yi). Basavarasa was Bāhattaraniyōgādhipati and Sarvādhikāri to Vāsudēva Kaṁnuva-Paṁḍita who was governing the districts of Heḍa-Kaṇambaḍe and Tarddavāḍi from Vijayāpura. Bīḷūr (Bilavura) was situated in the Kaṇambaḍe-nāḍu, included in [Karahaṭṭa], which formed a part of Kuṁtala-vishaya.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK — Maharashtra
cells.place: Another slab standing in the place of Hanumān. †
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Records gifts of house-site, oil mill, wet lands, etc., for the daily worship of the god Basavēśvara whose temple was constructed at Bīḷūr by Viṁchuva Basavarasa of the Gautama-gōtra. Bīḷūr was situated in the Kaṇabaḍe-nāḍu included in the Karahaḍa-dēśa which formed a part of Kuṁtala-vishaya. Basavarasa was the sarvādhikāri of Vēsugidēva son of Bhāgubāyi and his minister Kaṁnuva Paṁḍita who were governing the districts of Tardavāḍi and Heḍa Kaṇabaḍe from their headquarters at Vijayāpura as subordinates of the king.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab lying in Kambara Mallappa Nirvani's house.
cells.date: Chāḷukya Bhūlōka year 9, Ānanda, Āshāḍha, Amāvāsye, Monday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Registers gift of land and money income at Biyaḷavura by Mahāpradhāna Daṇḍanāyaka Kimirapavya, Manevergaḍe Ayamarasa, etc., for the worship, offerings, etc., of the god [Mallikārjuna]dēva and the feeding of ascetics.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Guddapur — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab set up in the Dānamma's temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Registers a gift of land for the benefit of the god Vīra-Sōmanātha of Nāyiṁtige. The gift was made into the hands of Vīrabrata-kshētrasaṁnyāsi Rēvaiya. Mentions the female devotee Guḍḍiyavve.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK — Maharashtra
cells.place: Same slab
cells.date: 2nd year, Plavaṅga, Pushya, amāvāsyā, Monday, solar eclipse, Uttarāyaṇa-saṁkramaṇa.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Registers gift of the village Sōraḍi for the benefit of the god Guḍive-priya Svayaṁbhu-Sōmanātha, by the king and his officer Mahāpradhāna Sēnādhipati Prachaṁḍa-Daṁḍanāyaka Bammidēvarasa from their camp at Hū-Baṁnūru. The gift was made into the hands of Vīrabrati-kshētrasaṁnyāsi Sakaiya Taileyagaḷu. Some other gifts of land into his hands are also registered.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Jath — Maharashtra
cells.place: Portion of a slab built into the wall of the Baṅkēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Mutilated and incomplete. Seems to record gift of a garden etc., to the god (name lost). Mentions [Ma]hāmaṇḍalēśvara Permāḍidēva with the Kaḷachurya titles and Madhugaṇḍa-Daṇḍanāyaka of the Ātrēya-gōtra.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Kolgiri — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab set up in the temple of Bhairavanātha in a valley near the village.
cells.date: Chaḷukyēśvara Vikrama-kāla 11, Prabhava, Vaiśākha, puṇṇame, lunar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Registers the endowment of the village Kōlegira attached to Kaṇambaḍe Three Hundred (district) for the benefit of the god Kēdārēśvara into the hands of Amṛitarāsi-Paṇḍita when Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Jōgamarasa of the Kaḷachurya family was governing the province of Karahāḍa. Also records gift of toll revenue of the village to the god Iṁdrēśvara consecrated in his own name by Pergaḍe Iṇḍapayya, who was the amātya of Jōgamarasa.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK — Maharashtra
cells.place: Hero-stone set up in the same temple .
cells.remarks: Much damaged and worn out. Mentions the chief Kumāra Maiḷugidēvarsa and god Rāmēśvara.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Māḍgyāḷ — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab lying in the compound of the Mahādēva temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1093, Namdana, Phālguna, Amāvāsye, Sunday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Published in Epigraphia Indica, Vol. XV, p. 315 ff.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK — Maharashtra
cells.place: Two fragments set up in Mahādēva temple †
cells.date: [3rd] year, Subhānu, Āshāḍha, Amāvāsye, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Mutilated and worn out. Seems to record gift of some toll (sunka) etc., income for the offerings, etc., of god [Kāḷē]śvara.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Samkha — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab set up in the Kumbāra Dēgula.
cells.date: Śaka 1100 (in words), Viḷambi, Māgha, Amāvāsye, Sunday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Registers an endowment of the village Āsage included in the kampana of Athukūge Fifty included in the Tarikāḍa-nāḍu for the benefit of the gods Māṇikēśvara and Mahādēva. The gift of some garden, etc., seems to be made by the king at the request of Mahāpradhāna Masayya Sāhaṇi. The temples of these gods were erected by Masayya to perpetuate his own name and the names of his father and mother respectively at Saṅkha in the Tarikāḍa-nāḍu.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK — Maharashtra
cells.place: Same slab
cells.date: Pārthivi, Phālguna, Paurnamāse, Monday, lunar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Registers an endowment of the village Āsage included in Ankulage Fifty for the benefit of the gods mentioned in the above record. Gifts of land, garden, oil mill, etc., made by several persons and trading communities are also recorded.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Samkha — Maharashtra
cells.place: Same slab
cells.remarks: Registers an endowment, of the village Aralige-Khairalige situated in Ankulage Fifty for the benefit of god Mānikēsvara and for feeding ascetics, made by the king at the request of Masayiya-Sāhani. The gift was made into the hands of Amarēsvara-Pamṇita who was the sthānāchārya of the Svayambhū-Śri-Rāmēsvara-Tīrtha, situated to the south of the village, Urnbaravāni in the district of Karahada Four-Thousand, and whom Masayiya-Sāhani installed as the sthānāchārya of the god Mānikēsvara also.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Sēgaon — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab kept in the Darga
cells.remarks: Records the endowment of a plot of land.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Sidhannāḷ — Maharashtra
cells.place: Broken slab kept in the Kaḷachurya Siddhēśvara temple.
cells.date: 6th year, Vishu, Pushya, Amāvāsye, Monday, Vyatīpāta, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Registers a gift of land and house-site made for the benefit of the god Śrayambhu-Śrī-Siddhēśvara of [Dōrgi]algave incorporated in Kaṇathabade by Mahāpradhāna-Sāyid-Pīr-Pāyā-bēg, son of Pīr-Pāyā-bēg, of the house of Gautama-gōtra and his brother Bōyidēva-Dēmadēva who were jointly governing the Three-Hundred division with its headquarters at Kaṇathabade.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Strīmāgi — Maharashtra
cells.place: Root stone in front of the Bhairavanātha temple.
cells.remarks: Indiastinct.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK — Maharashtra
cells.place: Stone set up near Bhairavanātha temple †
cells.remarks: Records the grant of some and a seer of oil per day for the upkeep of a mosque in the village of Sīraṇāvaḍagi included in the samut of Karaji and the maintenance of the tomb of the saint Shaikh Farīd gajaha-kar, or Shakar-ganj, as he is otherwise called, with the right of collecting several types of dues. (Transcribed for the Dept. by Mr. G. H. Khare.)

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Tikōḍi — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab set up near Svāmi-guḍi.
cells.date: Chāḷukya-Vikrama-varsha 5, Rauri, Phālguna, śu. 10, Mōnday, Vyatipāta, saṅkrānti.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Mentions a chief of the Gūmuva-kuḷa who is also styled as the prabhu of Lokkiguṇḍi and registers gift of land to the god Mūlasthānadēva.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK — Maharashtra
cells.place: Same slab
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Registers gifts of land, oil-mill, oil, etc., by the Gāvuṇḍas of Sīraṇāvaḍagi to the god Mūlasthānadēva of Mūchchasa of the Gūmuva family. It records further gifts of tolls on pack-horses and pack-donkeys by Suṅka-veggaḍe Somvarasa Daṇḍanāyaka.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK — Maharashtra
cells.place: Another slab set up in the place of Bhairavanātha †
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. In characters of about the 12th century A. D. Registers gift of land and toll income by Suṅka-veggaḍe Vā[na]rasa Nāyaka to the god Kēdārēś-vara [Lokkiguṇḍi]. Praises Kēdārēś-Paṇḍitadēva of the Bhujabala-vaṁśa who was the Sthānadēvarya of the god, and one Mācheya-Sāmanta.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Umaḍi — Maharashtra
cells.place: Broken slab lying near Rāma-ṇṇa Kuḷkarṇi's house.
cells.date: 9th year, Manmatha, Phālguna šu. Pun-ṇami, Thursday.
cells.language: Sanskrit verse and Kannaḍa in Kannaḍa script.
cells.remarks: Begins with five verses in praise of Śiva, Nārāyaṇa and other gods. Registers gifts of land, garden, oil-mill, etc., for the benefit of the main god Jalašayana Nārāyaṇa amidst twelve Nārāyaṇas consecrated at Uṅinade by Mahāpradhāna Mahāvadđaryavahārin Nāgadēvayya-Nāyaka, the Mūligas, the Eṇṭu Hiṭṭu, Puñcha-maṭhasthāna, Aruvattokkalu (sixty tenants) all the Baṇamṇu and other groups at the instance of the king and with the approval of the five ministers (Pañcha-Pradhāna). Describes in detail in Sanskrit verse the genealogy of Nāgadēva who is said to have been born in the solar race.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Umaṛāṇi — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab set up at the right wall in the Hēmāḷinga temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1089 (in words), Sarvajit, Māgha, Amāvāsye, Monday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers a gift of land and oil-mill for the benefit of the temple of Hēmāḷēśvara by Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Hemmaḍi, Dēvarasa of Maḍuvaṇayya and other Karaṇas at the instance of the king. This Hemmaḍi bore the title Kopana-puravarādhīś-vara and was a chief of Uṇḍaravāḍi (modern Umaṛāṇi), the chief town of the thirty-two villages of the Hemmaḍi-baḍe-nāḍu, which was included in Karaḍa-dēśa. Four-Thou-sand province of the Kumita-dēśa. Also states that Madu-vaṇayya Daṇḍanāyaka and Mallidēva-Daṇḍanāyaka were governing the province of Heḍa-Kaḷambaḍe-nāḍu.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK — Maharashtra
cells.place: Same slab
cells.date: Šaka 1096 (in words) Vijaya, Jyēshṭha, amāvāsye, Monday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land at Basurige for the benefit of the Hēmāḷēśvara temple by the queen of the king, Hemmaḍi-Chaṇḍaladēvi who transferred it to the king, at whose instance it (the land) was assigned as a sarva-namazya endowment by Kappadēva Gēpati Daṇḍanāyaka and other Karaṇas.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · JATH STATE—concld. / Umarāqui—concld — Maharashtra
cells.place: concld. Slab set up near the left wall in Hēmāḷinga temple. †
cells.date: Śaka 1044 (in words), Subhakṛit, Māgha, Amāvāsye, Monday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers a gift of land, oil, garden, tolls, etc., for the benefit of the temple of god Hemmāḍēvara, by Chaṇḍalādēvi and her son, Polakēsidēva-Vanasimhādēva. This temple was erected in the name of her husband by Chaṇḍalādēvi, who was the crowned queen (Paṭṭa-mahādēvi) of Tribhuvanamalladēva (Vikramāditya of the Chāḷukya lineage at their capital Uṃbarāṇi). Mentions prince (kumāra) Mallikārjjuna.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK — Maharashtra
cells.place: On the slab of Hēmāḷinga. †
cells.date: Śaka 1064 (in words), Dumdubhi, Chaitra, punpave, Monday, Vishu-samkramaṇa.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the conferment of the adhēya of god Hemmāḍēvara with all its sthānāchārya on Chaṇḍrabhūṣaṇa-Paṇḍitadēva, who was the sthānāchārya of the god Tīrthada-Śrī-Svayambhū Rāmēśvara, by the Paṭṭa-mahādēvi Chaṇḍalādēvi and prince Baṇasamhādēva, who had erected the temple of the said god. Also registers the gift of a house-site to god Vakkēśvara of the Mūlasthāna, evidently by the same donors.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Uṭagi — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab set up in a mosque
cells.remarks: Records the construction of a mosque.

cells.location: SHOLAPUR DISTRICT / PANDHARPUR TALUK · Wairāwaḍa — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab built in to a wall of Basavēśvara temple.

Issued from Śāntanapura. States that the Mahārāṇaka with the permission of Ananta-Mahādevī, the chief queen (of the king) granted to the Brāhmaṇa Śūmasvāmin of the Kauṇḍinya gotra, land in the city of Ambrakannagara. The king Harijña is stated to be the son of Mahārājādhirāja and grandson of [Bha]- grahaja of the Śūra-vaṃśa. The record is in characters of about the 5-6th centuries A.D. Published in J.U.P.I.S., Vol. XVIII, p. 167.

cells.language: Sanskrit in early (Central Indian) box-headed characters.
cells.remarks: Issued from Śarabhapura. States that the village of Sarkkarāpadraka in Nandapura-bhōga to Svāmīdatta of the Ātrēya-gōtra and Vāja-sanēya-charaṇa.

Gives the Western Gaṅga genealogy. Reco-ds the gift of four khaṇḍukas of land in the village of Sirandarangalampalau situated in Pudukanḍa-viṣaya to a Brāhmaṇa named Nīlakaṇṭha Śarman, the last of the five sons of Nīlakaṇṭha of the Harita-gotra, probably by Dugganāmā, the king's son, at the request of his wife Kancikāmbā. Gives also the genealogy of Nīlakaṇṭha, the wife of Dugganāmā, and the older sister (?) of Indrarāja, whose descent for three generations is traced from a king called Nīlamappa. [Published in Ep. Ind., Vol. XXVII, pp. 145 ff.

Gives the genealogy of the king. Records the gift, by the king, of the village of Vudukuni-grāma together with all its incomes, to the Brāhmaṇa Viṣṇu, son of Śivadāsa and grandson of Śrōttama of Vatsa-gotra. The gift is stated to have been made on the occasion of a lunar eclipse on the day of Kārttika 15. [Published in Ep. Ind., Vol. XXVIII, pp. 146 ff.

cells.date: Year 6, Phālguna, śu. di. 1, tṛitīyapakṣa (in words and figures)
cells.remarks: Published in I. H. Q., Vol. XXX, pp. 238-244. The record is issued by the king from Ambarasimapaṭṭana. States that the king granted the village of Jambugrāma in Pōta-viṣaya to Bhaṭṭaputra Śrī-Gōvinda, son of Bhaṭṭapura Konda of the Parāśaragōtra and Vājasaneyi-vādhyāyana-dīkṣitā who had migrated from Hastipada and resided at Jambugrāma.

Published in I.H.Q., Vol. XX, pp. 245 ff. The record is issued by the king from his victorious camp at Suvarṇapura. Registers the gift, by the king, of the village of Kāliṇḍā in Tikkārikā-viṣaya in Kōsaladēśa to Kālaśadēva Bhaṭṭa, Bhaṭṭaputra, who was a vādhyāya (resident) of Saṇḍakāpaka and was the son of Gāṅgēya and grandson of Arjuna. The donee is stated to have hailed from Muktāvatī in Śrāvastī. The record also states that the donee was itsuided at Āhjjigrāma.

cells.remarks: Damaged. Records gift of the village Piḷaiļi alias Sāyapa-nallūr in Mayiļṟi-kōṭṭam to the temple.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION · Chinnamandali — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: North and west walls of central shrine in the Nīrañjanēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land by Pāḷichchi Eruvappaḍai-Nāyaka, the amaram officer of Tūpākula Krishṇappa-Nāyaka, to the temple of Kachchhalai-Īśvara at Siru-mamuļūr.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: East wall of the maṇḍapa of the Vināyaka shrine in Ādikēśava-Perumāl temple. †
cells.date: Śaka 1695 (wrong for 1690), Sarvadhārin, Chittirai 21, Friday, Trayōdaśi, Hastā
cells.remarks: Incomplete. States that the image of Jñānaśiddhi-Vināyaka was set up by Kandappan, son of Nāgappa-Mudali, who was the mudalai-kāriyam of Rāghavanājavan Muttu-Vīra bhadra-Nāyaka of Toṇḍaimandalam.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Slab set up on the east side of Vināyaka shrine. †
cells.remarks: Modern. States that the wall (turavu) was constructed by Kandappa-Mudali, son of Nāgappa-Mudali.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION · Kajāmbākkam — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: West wall of the central shrine in the Tirunāgēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: In characters of the 9th century A.D. Records gift of land to the śālai-uḍaiyār of Kilāmbākkam for celebrating a festival, evidently in the local temple.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same place
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the provision made for celebration on the new and full-moon days (amāvāsyā), evidently in the temple, by the drār of Kilāmb[ākkam].

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Wall of the central shrine in Tirunāgēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions Śālaippuram in Takkōlam.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: East wall of the maṇḍapa in Tirunāgēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Stones lost in the middle. Records gift of land for a lamp in the temple.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Pillar on the east side of the Nandi-maṇḍapa in Tirunāgēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone set up near balipīṭha in Tirunāgēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records gift of sheep for a lamp in the temple of Kajambakkai Nakkār by Paṅgari Naṇḍi Kuppaḍigal of Kiļāmbākkam in Ūrattūr-kūṟram, a subdivision of Kōṉādu alias Kaḍadaḷayilangaṇḍa-sōļa-vaḷanādu. It is stated at the end that the shepherds to whom the sheep were entrusted had died and that these were given to other shepherds.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: South wall of the central shrine in the Chōla Ammaiyappēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Records an agreement made by the śivabrāhmaṇas to burn a twilight lamp in the temple of Taluvakkulijīvaram-uḍaiyār at Pañjaṇūr-kōṭṭam, a subdivision of Maṉavāvir-kōṭṭam.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: East and north walls of the central shrine of Chōla Ammaiyappēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: of Jayaṅgoṇḍa-maṇḍalam for two paḻankāśu received by them from a deṉaradiyāḷ of the temple. Another in-complete and damaged inscription on the same wall records a similar agreement to maintain five light lamps in the temple.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION · Paḻaiyaṉūr — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: East wall of the Kailāsanātha temple.
cells.remarks: A similar agreement by the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple of Kayilāyamuḍaiyār for a śandi of the lamp in the temple.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION · Vyāsapuram — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: South wall of the Vyāsēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Records an order of Madhurāntakapottappichechōla, also known as Tammusiddhi, remitting certain specified taxes for worship and service (tiruppaṇi) in the temple of Tiruvarambōsuramudaiya-Nāyapār. Two verses from the Tiruppāāūr inscription of Tammusiddhi are also introduced in the inscription.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records gift of sheep to the temple by a person of the village.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone set up in front of Vyāsēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Records gift of sheep for two lamps and for an additional lamp during the asterism Kārttigai in the temple of Arumbai Nakkar, by Kaliyaṇ Kuppaṇ alias Pūdū-Muttaraiyap of Mēlmalai Arumbākkam in Mellūr-nādu, a subdivision of Mellūr-kōṭtam.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION · Chakramallūr — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Stone set up in the village
cells.remarks: Records remission of taxes on Chakkarallūr by Śiluva Tippayadēva-Mahārāja for conducting in the temple at Tiruvilaṅgāḍu a festival in the month of Kārttigai for the welfare of Rāya (Kṛishṇadēvarāya). See A.R. No. 473 of 1905.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Manūru.—South wall of the central shrine of the Subrahmanyesvānin Temple MADURA DISTRICT
cells.remarks: Records gift of land by three persons to the temple of Subrahmanya-Pillaiyār at Maṇayil in Maṇayil-nādu, a subdivision of Maṇayil-kōṭtam in Jayangonđasōla-manđalam-Montions the linear-measure Vālavandāṇ-kōl.

cells.location: Madura — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of second prākāra in the Suntlersēvarar temple
cells.remarks: States that Arulālaṇ Ševagattēvaṇ alias Vānādhirāyar of Tachohapūr effected repairs to the temple and that the king granted, at the request of Anṇaṇ Tamijappallavaraiyar, the village Šō(apānđyanallūr, in [ Anma]-nādu and another (whose name is lost) for constructing 'Adiravisīyāduvār-tirumaṇdapa ', a tirunadaimāļigai, and a processional car and for general repairs including those to the gōpura with seven storeys.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / TIRUTTANI DIVISION — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the oral order of the king given from his throne Vānādarāyar, remitting the taxes on the village Iđaikkuđi in Parappu-nādu given as gōsālai-madcappuram (?) to a Malayāla-brāhmaṇa in exchange for lands in Tiruvēdagam in Pāganīr-kūgram granted as gōsālai-madcappuram by Māmađi Sōmōsāvara, on the representation of Ningrayangi-yāduvār of the bhikshāmaļha-santāna and the recommendation of Anṇaṇ Vānādarāyar.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: contd. MADURA TALUK—contd. MADURA—contd. Same wall
cells.remarks: Engraved in continuation of the previous inscription and connected with it. Records the sanction of uṭaiyār and gifts to the above order.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: contd. MADURA TALUK—contd. MADURA—contd. Same wall
cells.remarks: Connected with the above inscription. Records the royal order remitting the taxes on the village Tiruvēḍagam (situated in the Pāṇḍya country) for the maintenance of Niṉṟanāyakiṉyāduvār (with his disciples) who was responsible for adding 30 cows to the temple and for the maintenance of 41 persons looking after these animals.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: contd. MADURA TALUK—contd. MADURA—contd. Same wall
cells.remarks: Engraved in continuation of the previous inscription and connected with it. Records the sanction of uṭaiyār for the above order.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of second prākāra (inside) in the Mīnākshi temple (near the west closed gōpura).
cells.remarks: Commences with the introduction, Pūmalar tiruvum, etc. Records a royal order issued, at the instance of Aiyyan Māḷavarāyan, from the seat called Māḷavarāyan in the palace at Madura, remitting the taxes on the village of Kūḍal-biḍaiyāṉallūr granted by Vāṇādhirāyar (mentioned in No. 187 above) for worship and offerings during the śandi instituted by him in the temple, for feeding the temple servants, for the Tiruvādhirai festival in the month of Mārgaḷi and for the maintenance of the deity by bearing the śadāri-paṇ, at the Vāṇādhirāyar-tiruvāśal to the south of the shrine of the goddess.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of second prākāra in the Mīnākshi temple.
cells.remarks: States that a maṭha was constructed by Śivaṉaḍiyār-muḍi-uḍaiyār, wife of Nāyāṉār Vikrama-Pāṇḍyadēva.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of the third prākāra (proper left of entrance into the second prākāra) of the Mīnākshi temple.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Pūmalar-tiruvum, etc. Ends of lines built in. Seems to provide for offerings to Vira-d.muđitta-ļėvaramuđaiyār set up by Mahābali Vānarāyar at the instance of Ayyaṇ Majavarāyar.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Inner wall of the Kīḻai-gōpura (proper right) in Mīnākshi temple. †
cells.date: Šaka 1427, Yuva, Kumbha, su. 12, Thursday, Punarpūšam.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of 500 paṇ by Narasa-ayyar of Mahīpāla-kulakā-lachchēri in Uttaramērūr alias Rājēndraśōḻa-chaturvēdimangalam in the district of Jayaṅgoṇḍaśōḻa-maṇḍalam, for taking out the deity in procession round the Tiruvīthiyāṉ-tiruvīthi on the day of his natal star Puṉarpūśam, halting at the maṇḍapa which he constructed on the street and for offerings. Part of the donor is Vēṅkaṭādri, the fifth generation from Gōmadam Vēṅkaṭādri-ayyar of Kāuṇḍinya-gōtra and Āpastamba-sūtra.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Peruvamba — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of central shrine in the Tāḷiyālappan temple.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions an assembly that met in the temple.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / PARAMAKUDI TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT / PARAMAKUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pāndiyūr.—Stone set up near the Ayya-nār temple.
cells.king: Kulaśēkharadēva †
cells.remarks: Records the grant of vīli for the land given for lighting lamps in the matha called after Sundara-Pāṇḍya at Tiruvāmūrēśvaram (i.e., Rāmēśvaram) in accordance with the oral (vāymoli) and the written (tirumugam) order of Poriya-Nāyaṉār Kulaśēkharadēva.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / PARAMAKUDI TALUK · Mummuḍi Śāttan — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up near the tank.
cells.king: Achyutarāya †
cells.date: Śaka 1461, Vikāri, Dakshiṇā-yaṉa, ba. 7, Thursday, Rōhiṇī.
cells.remarks: Records a gift, in accordance with the rāyasam of Achchyutarāya, of the village Mummudišāttān alias Šetuvukkuvāyttanallūr, in his širmai, by Virappan alias Achchyutarāya Tummiši-Nāyaka of Varišai-ūr who bears birudas like Antambaragandaṇ and Sillavār-kula-ka[r]tta[n], as dēvadāna to god Nāyinār Rāmanāthadēva (at Rāmēsvaram).

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / KULITTALAI TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / KULITTALAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Kujittalai.—South wall of the central shrine in the Nilamēghapperumāl temple.
cells.remarks: States that the temple of Nāyaṉār Paśchima-nāthaṉ at perumal at Kuṭṭittalai was constructed of stone after removing the brick (construction), by a daughter of Forumāḷ Parākrama-Pāṇḍyadēva.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / KULITTALAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of Ayya-nār temple †
cells.remarks: Built in the middle and end. Records a gift of 1,000 paṇam by Ēdirilperumāḷ alias Āḍa Kaṇḍyadēva of Vāriyūr for taking out the god in procession for bath on the day of the donor's asterism Makhā in the month of Paṅguṉi. It also mentions that some of the temple authorities, if it is seated, purchased a bit of land.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / KULITTALAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Door jambs of entrance into Ayya-nār temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Begins with the introduction Tirumagaḷpōla, which is also lost. I. Gives the details of a bit of land which was not suitable for growing paddy.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / KULITTALAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Left door jamb of entrance into the first prākāra of Ayya-nār temple. †
cells.remarks: States that this pillar (nīrvāśal) at this entrance were caused to be made by a certain Viśāyan Aḷkoṇḍapiḷḷai.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / KULITTALAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillar on the north side of the first prākāra of the temple.
cells.remarks: States that this pillar was the gift of Āṇḍanaṅgaikōr of the temple. All the pillars in the same prākāra also bear the name of this lady.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / KULITTALAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone built into the north wall of the kitchen in Ayya-nār temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions the temple of Kuṭṭaiyapperumāḷ and seems to refer to a gift of gold. Mentions Viḍiviḍuṅgu-kāl.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / KULITTALAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Eastern entrance into the first prākāra (proper left).
cells.remarks: States that the compound wall was the gift of Aṉantāḷvāṉ, son of Śiraṅgarājaṉ of Uttarāmērūr.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / KULITALAI TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd. / KULITALAI TALUK—contd. / Kujittalai—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of mandapa in front of the central shrine of the dilapidated Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Records the installation of a liṅga in Chokkanāthapuraagraḥāra by a certain Chinnasāmi Cheṭṭi as the gift of his wife.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK · LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Marudūr.—South wall of the central shrine, Kailāsanātha temple.
cells.remarks: Indifferently engraved towards the end. Records gift of land by the person mentioned in No. 210 below for providing offerings daily and for the sacred bath on the day of Tiruvādirai, at the temple, to the god Āvuḍaiyār Ālagiyakuttār and his consort in the temple of Tiruttāṇṭōrīsvaramuḍaiyār at Marudūr.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple by the assembly of Perumārudūr. Mentions Gaṅgakoṇḍaśōḷa-purāṇakarai among the boundaries of the land.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Jamb (proper left) at the entrance into Kailāsanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: States that the sill (tiruvāśal-nilai) at the doorway of the temple of Tiruttāṇṭōr-Mahādēva at Perumārudūr was caused to be constructed by Irukkuvēḷ alias Kaṇḍan Āḍigal alias Śivapādāśēkhara-Māḷanāḍu-Vēḷān alias Śiruṭṭoṇḍanambi.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Kailāsanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete and inscribed surface peeled away. Seems to record a gift of land by Araṇakkattāḻvān alias Tirunāḷapaḍi-uḍaiyān alias Śivapādāśēkhara-kōg for offerings to the deity set up by him in the temple.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillar in the mahāmaṇḍapa of Kailāsanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Records gift of land to the god Mahādēva at Tirumalaivāṉūr by the ūrār of Kēvarādikkai, for a festival on the day of Śadaiyam, the natal star of Rājārājadēva.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On two stones built into the east wall of the Subrahmaṇya shrine in Kailāsanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions Śōkaḻi.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Entrance into the first prākāra (proper left) of Subrahmaṇya shrine. †
cells.date: Śaka 1496, Bhāva, Kumbha, śu. 3, Uttiraṭṭādi; Sunday,
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records a gift of land for the expenses of halting the deity Aṇbukkuṅkūṭṭinār of Perumārudūr at the garden of Aḍikkalakkāṭṭān, on the day of Māghā in the month of Māśi.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Tiruppaṅgili.—Pillar at the entrance into the first prākāra of the Nilavāṇēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Gives the name of the tirumaṇṭapa (containing this pillar) as 'Śārṅgapaḍiyārai Mummuḍi-ven-kaṇḍān'.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillars in the north and east side of the prākāra of Nīlāvanēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Gives the name Naṅgan Viḷādaiyāḻiyāṉ.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the second prākāra in Nīlāvanēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Pūmīni vaḷar, etc. Records an order issued while the king was in the palace at Āyirattaḷi, granting as dēvadāna for providing offerings to the god Mahādēva at Tiruppaiññīli, the village Āṇaippayaṇallūr which had been newly formed by adding more lands to Śeppālakkuḍi alias Uttamachōḷanallūr.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the prākāra of Nīlāvanēśvara †
cells.remarks: Records a sale of land by three persons for a flower-garden to the temple of Tiruppaiññīli-uḍaiya-Nāyaṇār.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of the second prākāra of Nīlāvanēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Begins with the introduction Pūmīni-miḍaindu, etc. of Vikrama-Chōḷa. Records a gift of land by Kōn Uttamachōḷar Vayirāgarāyaṇ of Āḍamangalam of Vaḷavalak-kūṟṟam, a subdivision of Rājēndraśōḷa-vaḷanāḍu, for providing offerings during the midnight service in the temple of Tiruppaiññīli-uḍaiya-Nāyaṇār.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillar near the flag-staff in Nīlāvanēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Records the construction of the dhvajastambha-maṇḍapa.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of the central shrine in the Vēṇugōpālasvāmin temple.
cells.remarks: Records the re-grant of the village Śāttaṇūr in their nāḍu, the Nittavinōda-vaḷanāḍu, to the temple to be met in the maṇḍapa of the temple of Nāyaṇār Vāṇḍu-maṇḍa-Maṇṇāṇār at Turaiyūr, for providing offerings, sacrifice, etc. in the temple, for the welfare of the king. (Perumal). See No. 222 below.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North, west and south walls of Vēṇugōpālasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Records gift of the village Murungūr by the pūjāḷas who met in the Vaḷḷuvappaḍi-āṭṭi-tirumaṇḍapam in the temple of Uḍaiyār Amaragal Sundara-Nāyaṇār at Śīṭṭagāḷan-nallūr, a village in the Kīḻ-Vaḷḷuvappaḍi-nāḍu for offerings, worship, etc., to Vāṇḍu-maṇḍa-Maṇṇāṇār alias Sōmidēva-iṇṇagar-Embarumān set up by Śāmuṇḍi Kaṇṇuḍaipperumāḷ alias Paṇṇaikkoṇḍa Śōjakōn, in the Tirumērkōyil at Turaiyūr, for the welfare of the king.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Vēṇugōpālasvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: Records the commission of the royal order to the Śrī-Vaishnavas of the temple of Vaṇḍu-varāpati-Maṇṇāṇār regarding the grant of the village Śāttaṇūr in Kīḻ-vaḷḷuvappaḍi-nāḍu as dēvadānam, made free of taxes, for providing offerings and for expenses of conducting in their temple the Kōdaṇḍarāma-śanti instituted after the name of the king. See also No. 220 above.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / LALGUDI TALUK · Tuṟaiyūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine.
cells.remarks: States that Śīṟiḷangō-Aṇḍān of Śīṟaṇḍūr constructed the [tavana]-maṇḍapa in the court-yard of Vaṇḍu-varāpati-Maṇṇāṇār alias Sōmidēva-iṇṇagar-Embarumān.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / MUSIRI TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / MUSIRI TALUK—concld — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of Vēṇugōpālasvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: Left incomplete. Records gift of the village Kiḷiyūr alias Amudavallavan-nallūr for worship, offerings, etc., to the god Vaṇḍuvarāpati-Maṇṇar, by the gōpālas who met in the temple of this deity at Tuṛaiyūr.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / MUSIRI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: States that the Kaṇmāḷas of Āmur-nāḍu and Vaḍavalli-nāḍu claimed exclusive (service?) rights in Vaḍavalli-nāḍu and that the question was settled by ordeal of boiling ghee in favour of the latter during the administration of Aḷagiya Veṅkaṭāchala-Reḍḍiyār of Śoḻikulam, at Tuṛaiyūr.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / MUSIRI TALUK · Śiṅgāḷantapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillar in the antaṛāḷa of the Amaranḍarēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gives the names of persons who set up pillars in the maṇḍapa called ‘Vaḷḷuvappaḍi-nāṭṭāṉ nūṛṛukkal-maṇḍapa’. Soc. No. 227 below.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / MUSIRI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another pillar in the place of Amaranḍarēśvara †
cells.remarks: States that the tirukkaṇṇakkal in the above maṇḍapa was set up by a certain Araśiḷāḷanḍā Kōmaḷan of Aṇikōvaḷnallūr.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / MUSIRI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of central shrine in Amaranḍarēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Stones lost in the middle. Seems to record a gift of land to Amaranḍa-īśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēva at Śiṅgāḷantapuram in Vaḷḷuvappaḍi, a subdivision of Kaṛikāla-kaṇṇa.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / MUSIRI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North and west walls of Amaranḍarēśvara temple †
cells.date: 13th century A. D. †
cells.remarks: Obstructed by a pillar in the middle. Engraved in characters of about the 13th century A. D. Begins with the tirumagaḷ-pōla, etc. Records the sale of their village Piḷḷaiyūr by the ūr to the temple of Amaranḍa-īśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēva at Śiṅgāḷantapuram as a protective measure against the Kuṛumbas and Veṇṇiyas who harassed and took some of them prisoners.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / MUSIRI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Amaranḍarēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to record a sale of land in Kiraṇbūr to the temple.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / MUSIRI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records sale of the village Karuṅkulam as a tax-free dēvadāna, by the ūrāḷar of Kiḷvaḷḷuvappaḍi who met in the maṇḍapa of the temple of Perumāḷiśvaram-uḍaiya-Nāyaṇār at Tuṛaiyūr for providing worship, offerings, etc., in the temple of Amaranḍa-īśvaram-Nāyaṇār at Śiṅgāḷantapuram, for the welfare of the king.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / MUSIRI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Amaranḍarēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Has a portion of the introduction commencing with the words Puḻal-mādu-viḷaṅga, etc. Seems to make provision for offerings to the god, by a merchant.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / MUSIRI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Amaranḍarēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Inscribed stones and some lost. Begins with the introduction. Tiruvāmāttūr etc. Seems to record an agreement made by the villagers of Tiruvāmāttūr to conduct a festival for seven days to the goddess in the month of Chittirai on the day of Tiruvādirai, the asterism of the king for money received by them from the king.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / MUSIRI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up to the south of the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Refers to the construction of a maṭha by Taṇṇaraśan, son of Kēśavadēvan of Uchaṅgaṇpāḍi-nāḍu, for feeding itinerant Māhēśvaras and to a grant of land for its upkeep and for the maintenance of devotees looking after the gardens evidently attached to this maṭha.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / MUSIRI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone in a field to the north of the Amarasundarēśvara temple in the same village (as Śiva temple). †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record a gift of land by purchase from the nagarattār of Siṅgalaṅtakapuram, by Taṇṇaraśan, mentioned above, for the maintenance of a flower garden formed by him.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / MUSIRI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in front of the Perumāḷ temple.
cells.remarks: Records an agreement made by the temple tenants residing at Siṅgalaṅtakapuram to plant śappai trees on the lands belonging to the temple of Eḷu-nāyanār at Arasalaṅgalam, for maintaining lamps in it.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / MUSIRI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone called ‘Sandikkal’ set up in the village.
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Gives an eulogy of merchants (śeṭṭis) and mentions their children. Possibly records a grant of land for the stabbing of a certain Nāḍālvān and restoration to life of Vaykuṇḍa-nāḍālvān, probably after some accident. Also mentions the Śeṭṭis of different nāḍus.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PEBAMBALUR TALUK · PEBAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Vāḷikaṇḍapuram.—North wall of central shrine in the Vāḷikaṇḍēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Records an agreement made by the Śaṅkarappāḍiyār of nagarattār to burn a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tiruvāḷivāratup-Paramēśvara at Vāḷikaṇḍapuram by Vāṇiḍu for 7½ kalañju of gold received by them from Miḷāḍuḍaiyān alias Rājarāṅgadap-Pallavaraiyan of Puḷiyūr.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PEBAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.king: Parakēsarivarman who took Madura and īlam.
cells.remarks: Engraved below the previous inscription. Records gift of the village Maṅgalam as dēvadāna to the temple of Tiruvāliśvārattu-Mahādēva, by Vaṇṇādudaiya Akkōppugalaraiyar.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PEBAMBALUR TALUK · PEBAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Do. Records gift of 5 kaļañju of gold to the temple for a perpetual lamp, by Tiruvađi-Kanṇaṇ alias Pugalarppēraiyaṇ. Mentions the liquid measure nārāyam.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PEBAMBALUR TALUK · PEBAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Do. Records an agreement by the Šankarappādiyār of Vālikanđapuram to maintain a lamp in the temple for 7½ kaļañju of gold received by them from Nāṭṭađigal, the daughter of Vaṇṇādudaiyār Akkōppugalaraiyar, and wife of Viraśōla-Milādudaiyār. See Nos. 239 above and 248 below.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PEBAMBALUR TALUK · PEBAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of gold to the temple for a lamp by Nakkaṇdi of Kuprakkūṇram.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Vālikaṇdapuram—contd.
cells.remarks: States that Maravaṇ Tūngānai alias Pirāntakavalaṇādūdaiyāṇ and his brother-in-law Vānarāyaṇ Araviñjaṇ Rājādittanṇ entered into a contest in which the latter was defeated. He thereupon provided for a perpetual lamp in the temple by a gift of gold for (the merit of) the former.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Vālikaṇdapuram—contd.
cells.remarks: Engraved below the previous inscription. Gift of gold for a lamp in the temple by Tiruvāḷi-vāraṇan of Aṭṭiyūr in Uḷaiyūr-kūṟṟam.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Vālikaṇdapuram—contd.
cells.remarks: Engraved by the side of the previous inscription. Gift of gold for a lamp in the temple by Vadaṇan Iḷaiyan, a shepherd residing at Aindai in Kāvirikkarai-(vaḷanāḍu).

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Vālikaṇdapuram—contd.
cells.remarks: Engraved below the previous inscription. Gift of 7 kaļānju of gold by Achchaṇakkaṇ, a warrior (šėvagaṇ) attached to 'Ilaiyagengavā', for a lamp in the temple.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Vālikaṇdapuram—contd.
cells.remarks: Gift of gold for a lamp by Kēśa[va]nķāri of , Šeūguṇram in Va[n]nādu. The manīgrūmattūr and Šankarappādiyār received the gold and agreed to supply ghee to the temple.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Vālikaṇdapuram—contd.
cells.remarks: Gift of 5 kaḻañju of gold for a lamp by Vaṇṇāttu-uḍaiyār Akkoppōgalanār mentioned in Nos. 239 and 241 above.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Vālikaṇdapuram—contd.
cells.remarks: Gift of gold for a lamp by Mākāḷan Ādittan alias Śembiyan Vaṇṇāṭṭukkoṇ. Also mentions a gift of nine copper vessels for the sacred bath of the deity.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of the same shrine
cells.remarks: Gift of 90 sheep for a lamp by Pugalaraian-nāyakkāṇ of Śiruvaiyūr. Mentions the liquid measure nārāyam.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Vāḷikaṇḍēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of 7 kaḻañju of gold for a lamp by Śaṅkarappāḍi Śūran-kaṇḍan residing in the big street called 'gaṇḍar-gaṇḍa-perunteruvu'.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Vāḷikaṇḍēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of 7 kaḻañju of gold for a lamp by Piḍampāṇḍāri, a resident of Maṅgalapuram in Pāṇḍināḍu, entrusted to the Śaṅkarappāḍiyār who agreed to undertake, on the amount, to supply ghee for the lamp.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of a betel-holder (kālānji) weighing 30 palam, a mirror weighing 14 palam and a forehead plate (patṭam) weighing 1 kaļānju of gold, by the person mentioned in No. 252 above and these were presented to the temple by Kapdaṇ Amudaṇ of Vālikaṇdapuram.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Engraved below the previous inscription. Highly damaged. Seems to refer to a gift to the temple of Tiruvālīśvarattu Perumāṇadigal.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records gift of two forehead plates (paṭṭam) to the temple by Kumāraḍi Tiruvaraṅgan, an officer (kāśi-nāyakan) of Piḷḷaiyār Rājādittadēva. See No. 261 below.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Engraved below the previous inscription. Damaged. Seems to register a grant of land below the tank at Puḷiyūr to the temple by Vaṇṇāḍuḍaiyār for the prosperity of his family.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Seems to record an endowment for the lamp in the temple by Taṭṭaḍi-Kumaran, a vāṇiyan.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of 96 sheep for a lamp by a vāṇiyan of Aṭṭanapaḷḷi-Niyamam in Eyināḍu and a further gift of 16 sheep by the same person for lighting a lamp on the day of Kārttigai.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Engraved below the previous inscription. Records gift of 7 kalañju of gold for a lamp in the temple by Śaṅka-rappaḍi Śeyān-Ulbai, a resident of the street Gaṇḍar-gaṇḍaperuneruvu.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Do. Damaged. Gift of a golden perpetual lamp to the temple by the Kammāḷas of Vaṇṇāḍu and others (name lost) of Vāḷikāṇḍapuram with provision for lighting it.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records a gift of 21 kalañju of gold for three lamps in the temple, from the gold entrusted with Kumāraḍi Tiru-varaṅgan by the nāṭṭār of Vaṇṇāḍu, the dēvaradiyār, the nagarattār of Vāḷikāṇḍapuram and paramēśvaras for maintenance of lamps in the temple of Tiruvālīśvarattu-uḍaiya-Perumāḷ at Vāḷikāṇḍapuram. Of the three lamps, one was set up by Kumāraḍi Tiruvaraṅgan and the other two, by the Maṇimāṭṭār of Vāḷikāṇḍapuram.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Engraved in continuation of the previous inscription. Records gift of a piece of land to the guardman (śirmey-kāppār) of the Ālvār temple at Tiruvālīśvaram, by the vāccahar, Mahēśvaras, dēvakaṇmis, etc.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Engraved below the previous inscription. Gift of gold for a lamp in the temple by Śaṅkan Śēndan of Vāḷikāṇḍapuram.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall of Vāḷikaṇḍēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: States that the 'Padineṇbhūmi-viśaiya-nagaraṭṭār' including those of Vīraśōlanallūr and Āraḷūr met in the Daṇṇadi-vajan-tirukkāvanam in the temple of Śrī-Kailāsamuḍaiya-Nāyaṇār at Urattūr and made provision for maintaining 27 lamps of Tiruvālīśvaram and 145 on annual festival days in the temple of Tiruvālīśvaram. Vāḷikāṇḍapuram was made claimed as their nagarakkāni. Vāḷikāṇḍapuram was made into a Sāraḍāfam(?) i.e., military quarter(?) and provision was also made for repairing the car (belonging to the temple) from the income of the village and the amañji due to the (officer) Vāṇavadaraiya.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd. / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd. / Vālikandapuram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of the village Vālikanđapuram to the temple by Nāyan Rājarājadēvan alias Rājādhirāja Magadaināđājvāp, the lord of Vapṇādu.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd. / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd. / Vālikandapuram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of land by Mīnavan Vattērayan for worship etc. to the images of Kumaramēnda Piḷḷaiyār and his consorts set up by him in the temple of Tiruvāḷīśvaramuḍaiyār at Vālikandapuram, for the welfare of Nāyarājadēvan Tāyillamala-perumāḷ alias Kuḷōttunga-Vāṇakōvaraiyar.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall (above the entrance)
cells.remarks: States that Ilakkanap restored worship in the temple as originally arranged by the nāṭlavar for the welfare of the king, his consort and elder sister (akkap), but which had been hindered by the inability of the kuḍimakkā of the village to pay agara-viniyōgam. Also states that Ilakkanap presented to the temple 2 hand-bells, 1 trumpet (kālam) and 1 chiyyam.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall (proper left of entrance)
cells.remarks: Records gift of money and paddy by the 70 nāṭṭār and the paḍin-viṣayam-nāṭṭār to celebrate as a festival of the nāḍu Mūsi-tirunāḷ by taking out the deity in procession on that day.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd. / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd. / Vālikandapuram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall (proper left of entrance)
cells.remarks: States that Śevagapperumā| Afjādaperumā| Tirumudikkāri of Puttūr constructed the shrine of the goddess Tiruk-kāmakkōṭṭam Periya-Nāchchiyār in the temple of Tiruvāliśvaramuđaiya-Nāyanār at Vālikanđapuram.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd. / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd. / Vālikandapuram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall (proper left of entrance)
cells.remarks: States that Kōvan Teri Paṇparappaṉ alias Tirunāṇasambandan, a servant (agambadiyār) of Mīnavan Vattērayan a Sāmanta-mudali of the king, founded a street in front of the main entrance for taking out the deity in procession, and provided for offerings etc. to the deity and to the pūjār to the flower garden situated to the north of the temple at Vālikandapuram.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd. / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd. / Vālikandapuram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall (proper left of entrance)
cells.remarks: Verse in praise of Subrahmaṇya (Vaḷḷimanaōharan) at Vāḷikaṇḍapuram, i.e., Vālikandapuram.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall of Vāḷikaṇḍēśvara temple (proper right of entrance). †
cells.remarks: Records gift of 7,000 kāśu by Puḷiyūruḍaiyāṉ Perumāḷ alias Vājarāyar who had the kāṇi right of Kīḻanallūr, a brahmādēya in Śirukūḍal, for offerings, lamps, etc., to the images of the deity set up by him in the temple of Vālikandamuḍaiya-Nāyaṉār.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: States that Terri Ponparappinpān made over the 500 ē2u due to him as carpentry charges for the renovation of the tiru-māīgai, to be utilized for maintaining one of the twilight lamps (Panđārabandivlakku) burning before the debty.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd. / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd. / Vālikandapuram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Engraved below the previous inscription. States that Uttamamuḍaiyāṉ Jayangoṇḍaśōḻamuḍaiyāṉ, who had the kēṇi right of Karikālakkaṇṇa-valanāṭṭu-Vaṇṇāḍu, vowed that he would present a gold paṭṭam to the god if he got a son and that, on his wish being fulfilled, he granted the (pūjā) village (name not given in the temple) to meet the expenses of the promised ornament.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd. / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd. / Vālikandapuram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records provision of milk for curds to the temple by adhikāri Śāyaṇar, as the gift of Mādaya-Nāyaka.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd. / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd. / Vālikandapuram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Do. (proper left of entrance)
cells.remarks: States that the Idaṅgai-98 classes met in the temple of Tiruvāliśvaramuđaiya-Nāyanār and decreed that the good or evil affecting one class, should be shared by the rest of them, evidently to ensure soldarity among their ranks.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd. / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd. / Vālikandapuram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Do. (proper left of entrance)
cells.remarks: Records the order of Śāyaṇa-Daṇḍanāyaka and Śēṉai-Daṇḍanāyaka to the nāṭṭavar of Kīḻūrru in Vembaṟ-nāḍu regarding the re-grouping of the three nāḍus, viz., Kīḻūrru-nāḍu, Uruṭṭūr-nāḍu and Perumaḻala-nāḍu into two.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: North wall of Vāḷikaṇḍēśvara temple †
cells.date: Śaka 1338, Durmukhi, Makara, śu. Friday, Uttirāṭṭādi.
cells.remarks: Records the royal order remitting the tax oḍal-paṇam on all castes including ulavaraśu and kāṇiyāṭci in Vembaṟ-nāḍu, which was enjoyed by the temple of Aṇṇamalaiyār-Dēvamahārāja who has the titles Paṭṭukāṭṭāṉ, Vasavāśakaṉ, Irāya-dōrtta-Abahāguttārayaṉ and Māḍiyāḍamaga-mapavāḷaṉ.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of land in Poṉṉappaṉnallūr and Toṇḍai to the temples of Tiruvālīśvaramuḍaiyār and Bhuvaṉēśvaramuḍaiyār as oḍu-koḷḷāḍa variyāṭci, by Mahādēvarāyaṉ, Śiriyāṇṇa-Daṇḍanāyaka and Dēvaṇṇa-Daṇḍanāyaka.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd. / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd. / Vālikandapuram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.date: Šaka 1268, (wrong for 1363) Dunmati, Makara, šu. Āévati, chaturthi, Monday.
cells.remarks: Records remissions of taxes in favour of the temple for offerings during the mid-day service for the health and welfare of the king, by Mahādēvarāya-samudr-āśchādhipati Iḷakēya-samudr-āśchādhipati Iḷakēya-Daṇḍanāyaka.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd. / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd. / Vālikandapuram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the village Brahmādēyam to the temple of Tiruvālīśvaramuḍaiyār-Nāyaṉār, by Vākaḷavāralya śē-mabai rājā[ja]dēvaṉ.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd. / PERAMBALUR TALUK—contd. / Vālikandapuram—contd. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Records the decision of the nāṭṭavar of Vembaṟ-nāḍu who met in a garden called Iṟiya-nāṉ-kāvu at Aṟumadal, regarding the payment of kaḍamai and kuḍimai dues on their nāḍu [to the state] and the abolition therein of the levies kuṟṟam, and mugam-pāṭṭam. Refers to coins (paṇam) minted in the treasury.

cells.location: TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT / PERAMBALUR TALUK · TRICHINOPOLY DISTRICT—contd. / PERAMBALUR TALUK—concld. / Vālikaṇdapuram—concld. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of Vāḷikaṇḍēśvara temple †

Similarly the Kōmaṭis also agreed to pay to the god a sum of one māḍa and 1 śāṇa of rice on the occasion of each marriage.

cells.remarks: Mutilated and worn out. States that while nandalika Pērya was governing [Hānu]hgal-500 and Hulikere-300 he, along with the karanas headed by Udayamrasa, Rīmadēva and the prabhu-gārundas of Hānungal-500 renewed the gift formerly made by Muhāmandulēśvara [Taila] hn of the village Hānagunda sinated in Kontakuj-30 which was a kañpaṇa of Hānungal-500. Also registers a gift of land on the same day in Midle by Dandanāyaka Hōmarnsa who was the Pergude of the village Hānungal, in the presence of the Prabhugārundas of Kontakuj-30, and with the consent of Gommagāruṇda.

cells.remarks: . States that Mājaladēvi, daughter of Sēnabōra Rāyaṇa and Volajikabbe, and queen of Tribhuvanamalladēva, caused to be constructed the temple of Mājabēśvara and that the āchārya of this temple was Sūryābharana-paṇditadēva disciple of Varēśvara-paṇditadēva of the Teṅgina-maṭha at Bōdhane. It records the gift by Sūryābharana, of this Mājabēśvara and other sihānas under his charge, to Iśānaśakti-paṇditadēva, when Tailapa was governing Pānungal-500 and when his piriya-padēvala Dēvaṇa was in charge of the manneya of Edevojal-70, Belvatti and Elavatti and when Bammagāvuṇda was administering Yalavatti. Also registers that Bammagāvuṇda and the 70 (of Elavatti) placed in the hands of Mājaladēvi 100 gadyāṇa of gold and some lands for the same temple.

cells.remarks: Records a gift of land made by Mahápradhāna, Maháprachandadandanayaka Sóvidévarasa to the god Râméévaradéva of Elavatti. The gift was placed in the hands of Chandrabhūshana-pandita. The donor is stated to be ruling over Hânungal-500.

cells.remarks: Records that a Nayaka died fighting when Salumkî Kési attacked Elavatti in the expedition of Hoyisaladeva against Panungal. At the time of the fight, Mallikarjunadéva was ruling Pánungal-500.

cells.location: DHARWAR DISTRICT / HANGAL TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone set up in Survey No. 74
cells.remarks: Records certain gifts of land by Tailagavunda and the 70 people of Elavatti to a hero who died fighting. Also registers some gifts, by the mahajanas and the 1000 of Belvola, of land and 10 gadyāņas of gold for the obsequies of this hero who fought for them and died.

cells.remarks: Records the death by Samadhi of Sûraméva Kótayya, lay disciple of Salakahanadéva of Malasamgla and Désigana.

Also registers gift of oil, etc., to the same temple by the ayaguttukaras of the Ugura-300.
